article.articleHeadline: 江苏2026年秋冬季流感疫苗接种全面启动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangsu fully launches the 2026 autumn-winter influenza vaccination program.
article.articleSummary: Jiangsu Province, China, has fully launched its 2026 autumn–winter influenza vaccination program under the national policy offering free vaccines to rural residents aged 65+ and schoolchildren. By Oct 18, about 1.28 million doses had been administered free of charge in rural areas: roughly 780,000 for the elderly and 500,000 for students. The campaign was publicly announced Oct 19 by the Jiangsu Health Commission and CDC, using the trivalent inactivated influenza vaccine (split-virus). The Jiangsu flu season typically runs from October to March, with higher transmission after school starts. Influenza can progress to pneumonia and, in children, may lead to bacterial superinfections and, less commonly, influenza-associated encephalopathy, myocarditis, or myositis. Priority groups include those 60+, chronic disease patients, children 6 months–5 years, and residents of care facilities, as well as students and healthcare workers. Vaccination sites offer weekend clinics, extended hours, time-slot appointments, and some employers’ promotions such as “2 people, one free,” with some clinics providing dual adult/child vaccination stations.

triage.headline_ja: 江蘇省、2026年秋冬季インフルエンザワクチン接種を全面的に開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種事業に関する行政広報であり、異常な感染拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの予防接種キャンペーンに関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、アウトブレイクや異常な流行を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria ghi nhận 11.000 ca mắc bệnh lao tại một bang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria records 11,000 tuberculosis cases in one state.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) in Plateau State, Nigeria, totals about 11,000 confirmed cases over nearly 10 months, with more than 2,000 identified from July to September 2026. All diagnosed patients are in treatment across state health facilities, and the incidence is 219 per 100,000 population. Deaths are not reported in the data. Nigeria remains among the world’s TB-burden leaders; WHO data indicate Nigeria accounted for about 4.8% of global TB cases in 2025 and ranked sixth globally, with India leading (roughly one-quarter of cases). TB is transmitted via the respiratory route; vulnerable groups include the elderly, children under five, and people living with HIV. Vaccination can prevent TB, with Bacillus Calmette-Guérin (BCG) vaccination most effective when given to newborns under one month.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで一州において結核症例11,000件を記録
triage.triage_reason: 結核はナイジェリアで慢性的流行疾患であり、死亡報告もなく突発的異常事象とは言えないが、継続的曝露と流行しやすさの観点から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・プラトー州における結核の慢性的流行状況を報告する内容であり、インドは世界的な結核負担比較の文脈でのみ言及されているため、対象国としては除外した。ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يودي بحياة 4561 شخصا في الكونغو وإصابات كينيا ترتفع إلى 8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 4,561 people in Congo, and Kenya's infections rise to 8.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Kenya as of Oct 17, 2026. In DRC, the Health Ministry reports 4,561 deaths among 9,455 confirmed infections (case fatality rate 48.2%). In Kenya, infections rise to 8 after a new case in a man believed to have contact with the initial patient; laboratory tests confirmed 1 positive among 38 tested, with authorities continuing contact tracing. Kenya had earlier in the month recorded a Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo strain) case, the patient who died after arriving from the DRC via Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, prompting regional concern, as Africa CDC warns of potential spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで4,561人死亡、ケニアの感染者は8人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ流行（死亡4,561人、致死率48.2%）が継続し、隣国ケニアへの越境感染・ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されており、Africa CDCも地域拡大を警告しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。ただし越境感染の事実はinternational_spread評価に反映した。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、地域的懸念が高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يودي بحياة 4561 شخصا في الكونغو وإصابات كينيا ترتفع إلى 8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 4,561 people in Congo, and Kenya's cases rise to 8.
article.articleSummary: Ebola kills 4,561 people in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) from 9,455 confirmed infections as of October 17, 2026, a case fatality rate of 48.2%. In Kenya, Ebola cases rise to 8 after a new infection in a man believed to be a contact of the first case; laboratory tests confirmed 1 of 38 people tested, with ongoing contact tracing. Kenya previously recorded the first Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease case earlier this month; the patient died after arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. Regional concerns grow as there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment for this Bundibugyo strain; Africa CDC warns the virus could spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで4561人死亡、ケニアの感染者数は8人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模な死者数（4561人、致死率48.2%）と、ケニアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、ワクチン・治療法が存在しないためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダでの感染確認も報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo株に対するワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点がリスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 케냐서 8명 에볼라 감염, DR콩고선 어린이 피해 심각 - 시사저널
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Eight people infected with Ebola in Kenya; children severely affected along the DR Congo border - Sisa Journal
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports eight Ebola virus disease cases with one death by Oct 18, 2026, after the first imported case diagnosed Oct 5. The index case, a Kenyan national who had lived in DR Congo, entered Kenya after transiting Uganda and was confirmed Oct 5. Seven secondary cases—three family members, three healthcare workers, and one caregiver—were linked to the index case, all from pre-isolated contacts. About 128 of 130 contacts were quarantined; two remain under trace. No evidence of widespread community transmission. Kenya designates a priority quarantine region from Oct 20 with reinforced entry screening: arrivals with exposure in the past 21 days must report health status via Q-CODE or health questionnaire; Ebola prevention messages by SMS; suspected cases to call 1339; DUR-ITS enables travel-history checks at clinics. WHO notes no travel/trade restrictions; domestic risk remains low. In Nord-Kivu Butembo, four Ebola cases linked to Bundibugyo virus; MSF notes 30 pediatric patients at a treatment center with 24 deaths, most under five.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで8人がエボラに感染、DRコンゴでは子どもの被害が深刻 - 時事ジャーナル
triage.triage_reason: DRコンゴ由来のエボラ感染がケニアに越境し二次感染（家族・医療従事者）が確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する重大な国際的拡大事例であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入・二次感染事例だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRコンゴ北キブ州ブテンボでの小児死亡例（MSF報告、24名死亡）も同時に報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: 欧林生物金葡菌疫苗Ⅲ期达主要终点，闭合性骨折术后金葡菌感染保护效力73.25%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Orin Biotech's Staphylococcus aureus vaccine Phase III reached its primary endpoint, with a 73.25% protective efficacy against Staphylococcus aureus infection after closed-fracture surgery.
article.articleSummary: Orin Biotech announced on Oct 19 that its recombinant Staphylococcus aureus vaccine reached the Phase III primary endpoint for preventing S. aureus infection after closed-fracture surgery. In a multicenter, randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial led by Beijing Jishuitan Hospital across 66 centers in China, 6,014 subjects were enrolled; 5,849 formed the full analysis set (vaccination n=2,935; placebo n=2,914). Within 42 days post-surgery, 47 S. aureus bone infections occurred (vaccine 10; placebo 37). Cox hazard ratio 0.2675 (95% CI 0.1331–0.5380); protective efficacy 46.20%–86.69% (one-sided P=0.0001). Subgroup analyses by age 18–59 and 60–70 and by sex were consistent. Safety: adverse events 40.85% vs 23.13%; mainly mild/moderate local reactions; no difference in grade 3+ events. Immunogenicity showed robust responses to five antigens (mHla, IsdB-N2, SpA5, mSEB, MntC) with Day 14 rises maintained to Day 42 and Day 180. No approved S. aureus vaccines exist domestically or internationally; the data support a post-surgical prevention indication.

triage.headline_ja: 欧林生物の黄色ブドウ球菌ワクチン、第III相試験で主要評価項目を達成し、閉鎖性骨折術後の黄色ブドウ球菌感染に対する防御効果73.25%
triage.triage_reason: 疾患発生のアウトブレイク報告ではなく、ワクチン臨床試験（第III相）の結果発表であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染症イベントとしての特徴に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はコクシジオイデス症（Coccidioidomycosis）ではなく黄色ブドウ球菌（Staphylococcus aureus）ワクチンの臨床試験結果に関する内容であり、疾患名タグと記事内容が一致していない。感染症アウトブレイクイベントではないためDISMISS。

article.articleHeadline: PhilHealth to expand access to TB medicines
article.articleSummary: PhilHealth will expand access to first-line tuberculosis medicines for its members in the Philippines. Acting President Beverly Ho signed PhilHealth Circular 2026-0018 (dated Oct 13) enabling eligible patients with confirmed drug-susceptible TB to obtain Ethambutol, Isoniazid, Rifampicin, and Pyranzinamide from PhilHealth-accredited GAMOT facilities via prescriptions by YAKAP physicians, starting Nov 1. The program ties primary care consultations to medically prescribed TB drugs under the Yaman ng Kalusugan Program (YAKAP) to strengthen primary care and continuity of care. A maximum one-month supply may be dispensed per transaction, with the full prescribed quantity to be provided within two days of prescription issuance. Medicines will not be deducted from the member’s P20,000 annual GAMOT limit. Claims not made within the prescribed period must be paid by the member.

triage.headline_ja: PhilHealth、結核治療薬へのアクセスを拡大へ
triage.triage_reason: 既知の疾患（結核）に対する医療保険制度上の施策発表であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 政策・制度に関する記事であり、感染症の流行や症例急増を報告するものではないためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Epidemiological Situation in the Region of the Americas - Epidemiological Week 38, 2026 - Brazil
article.articleSummary: Brazil recorded 1,782,016 suspected dengue cases in Epidemiological Week 38 of 2026, yielding a cumulative incidence of 273 per 100,000 population. This marks a 55% decline from the same week in 2025 and a 62% decline relative to the five-year average. The report covers the Region of the Americas and shows the trend through EW 38, with Figure 1 depicting the trajectory of suspected dengue cases. No laboratory-confirmed case counts or mortality data are provided in this brief. The data indicate ongoing dengue activity in Brazil during late EW 38, 2026, characterized by transmission but a reduced reported burden compared with prior periods. Public health surveillance continues to monitor dengue dynamics in the region.

triage.headline_ja: アメリカ地域におけるデング熱の疫学的状況 - 2026年疫学週38週 - ブラジル
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの定期デング熱サーベイランス報告で、症例数は前年・5年平均より減少傾向にあり、異常性や重症化の兆候はない定例報告である。
triage.notes: デング熱の流行は既知のエンデミック疾患であり、本報告は前年・過去5年平均比で減少傾向を示す定期疫学サーベイランスレポートである。カナリア諸島・スペインはBluedotの発生地域に含まれるが、記事本文はブラジルのデータのみを扱っており対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tiếp xúc trẻ mắc não mô cầu đã vài ngày, uống kháng sinh dự phòng còn kịp?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exposure to a child with meningococcal disease for several days: are prophylactic antibiotics still timely?
article.articleSummary: Prophylactic antibiotics for close contacts of meningococcal disease are most effective when started promptly, ideally within 24 hours of case confirmation, according to Dr. Nguyen Minh Tien, Deputy Director of City Children's Hospital in Ho Chi Minh City. If 2–3 days have passed, parents should still seek medical assessment rather than assume prophylaxis is unnecessary. After about 14 days from illness onset, the benefit is generally limited; final decisions depend on physician and public health officials. Per Ministry of Health guidance, close contacts—household members, roommates, direct care workers, and classmates who had contact from 7 days before onset to 24 hours after the patient received antibiotics—should be monitored and offered prevention measures. Vaccination, personal hygiene, and healthy habits are emphasized; seek hospital care promptly if meningococcal symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症の子どもに数日接触した場合、予防抗生剤はまだ間に合うか？
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例への対応ガイダンスを伝える医療情報記事であり、アウトブレイクの発生や拡大を示す内容ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例への濃厚接触者への予防投与タイミングに関する医療Q&A形式の啓発記事で、集団発生や新規クラスターの報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: México prohíbe ingreso de pollo y productos avícolas de Brasil por Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico bans the import of chicken and poultry products from Brazil due to Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Mexico bans the import of chicken, fertile eggs, live birds, and poultry products carried by travelers from Brazil after Newcastle disease was confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The outbreak was confirmed Oct 18, 2026, in a farm of about 6,000 turkeys; samples were taken between Sept 21 and Oct 14, 2026. Brazil immobilized the farm, halted bird movements, and ordered culling with cleaning and disinfection. A surveillance zone covering roughly 133 properties in Nova Itaberaba and nearby Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim, and Águas Frias was established. The ban, announced Oct 19 by Mexico’s Secretariat of Agriculture and Senasica, aims to protect an Newcastle-free Mexico by suspending zoosanitary requirements for affected goods. Newcastle is a viral disease in poultry with respiratory, digestive, and nervous signs; human infections are rare. Mexico previously restricted Brazilian poultry during the 2025 H5N1 avian influenza outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病を理由にブラジル産鶏肉・鶏産品の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）であり人への感染は稀だが、貿易制限が発生しており国際的な動向として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥の疾患であり、人への感染は稀と記事内で明記されている。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルの家禽農場での発生が主題。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones avícolas de Brasil por brote viral: estos productos quedan restringidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Suspends Brazilian Poultry Imports Due to a Viral Outbreak: These Products Remain Restricted.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended temporary imports of poultry products from Brazil after Newcastle disease was confirmed at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development (SADER) and SENASICA stated the restriction covers meat and poultry by-products, fertilized eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental and raptor birds, and pets, as well as traveler-borne poultry items, applying to both imports and goods carried by travelers. The measure aims to protect Mexico's poultry industry and prevent the virus's entry while investigators review the outbreak and align with international protocols. Mexico remains Newcastle-free; restrictions will persist until Brazil provides zoosanitary information. Brazil was Mexico's second-largest poultry supplier, with 128,632 tonnes imported in July 2026.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ウイルス性疾患の発生によりブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を一時停止：対象製品は引き続き制限される
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの養鶏場でニューカッスル病が確認され、メキシコが輸入を制限した事例。貿易制限基準は該当するが、人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は不明で情報も限定的なため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）疾患であり、ニューカッスル病のヒトへの感染・健康影響は極めて限定的。主眼は貿易・農業への影響であり、公衆衛生上の直接リスクは低いと考えられるが、家きん産業や食料供給への波及、今後のブラジル国内での感染拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Daniel Vilela mobiliza prefeitos para conter avanço da dengue, zika e chikungunya em Goiás - Brazil Urgente
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daniel Vilela mobilizes mayors to contain the spread of dengue, Zika, and Chikungunya in Goiás - Brazil Urgente.
article.articleSummary: Goiás, Brazil — Governor Daniel Vilela announced a state-wide protocol to mobilize municipalities against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, intensified by El Niño-driven rains and heat that favor Aedes aegypti proliferation. The Goiás State Health Secretariat records 108,540 dengue cases (up 17% from the same period in 2025) and 11,309 chikungunya cases (up 343% year over year); no Zika case counts are provided. As part of the strategy, a Dia D (Day D) is set for 26 November to bolster statewide control efforts. The Health Secretariat will assist local administrations with extended hours at Basic Health Units, a weekend reference unit, and supplies for rehydration (oral and intravenous), saline, and analgesics; monitor stocks of diagnostic tests and vaccines; maintain adequate community health workers; remove barriers to care with appropriate referrals; and provide updated arbovirus dashboard data.

triage.headline_ja: ダニエル・ヴィレラ氏、ゴイアス州でデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱の拡大抑制のため市長らを動員
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ゴイアス州における季節性アルボウイルス感染症（デング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱）の国内流行で、チクングニア熱が前年比343%増と異常増加しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、州レベルの通常対応の範囲内と見られる。
triage.notes: エルニーニョによる気候要因でAedes aegyptiの繁殖が助長され、デング熱・チクングニア熱の症例数が前年より大幅増加。州政府は対策日（Dia D）を設定し医療体制強化を図っているが、重症度（入院・死亡数）に関する情報は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao ca não mô cầu tăng ở miền Nam?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why are meningococcal meningitis cases increasing in Southern Vietnam?
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis meningitis cases are rising in Southern Vietnam, with Ho Chi Minh City bearing most of the burden. The Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City reports 12 cases in 2024 (1 death), 39 in 2025 (6 deaths), and 42 in 2026 through October (7 deaths). Serogroup B remains predominant. Experts attribute part of the rise to improved diagnostics; others warn that co-circulating respiratory pathogens—influenza A/B, adenovirus, and RSV—can damage mucosa and facilitate bacterial invasion, while individual health affects susceptibility. At Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in HCMC, about 23 students had respiratory symptoms; some tested positive for influenza A or B, and one meningococcal case was co-infected with influenza B. Transmission is via respiratory secretions, and crowded settings amplify spread. Vietnam has vaccines covering serogroups A, B, C, Y and W-135; vaccination is advised for under-2s and high-risk groups, alongside early detection and close-contact prophylaxis.

triage.headline_ja: なぜ南部ベトナムで髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例が増加しているのか？
triage.triage_reason: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例数が年々増加し死亡例も報告されており、学校での集団発生や呼吸器系病原体との共感染による流行拡大リスクが示唆されるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 疾患タグはインフルエンザA/Bとなっているが、記事の主題は南部ベトナム（ホーチミン市）における髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の増加であり、インフルエンザ等の呼吸器感染症との共感染が増悪因子として言及されている。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases drop 55% in late September -- DOH
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines dropped 55% in the last two weeks of September, according to the Department of Health (DOH). In the Sept 17–30 window, 1,159 cases were recorded, down from 2,570 in Sept 3–16. Provinces and highly urbanized cities flagged for leptospirosis fell to six from 46. As of Oct 14, 2026, total nationwide cases for the year reached 13,530, still about 47% higher than the 9,188 at the same point in 2025. The year’s case fatality rate (CFR) was 5.41%, lower than 10.37% in 2025. The DOH will continue monitoring morbidity weeks to ensure the downward trend persists. Leptospirosis is a bacterial infection contracted through floodwater, soil, or food contaminated with urine from infected animals such as rats, dogs, and pigs.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例、9月下旬に55%減少──DOH
triage.triage_reason: 症例数は減少傾向にあるが、年間累計は前年比47%増でCFRも高水準であり、季節性疾患として継続監視が妥当。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: DOHによる定期モニタリング報告であり、既知の風土病（レプトスピラ症）の季節的動向を伝える内容。CFRは5.41%と前年より改善している。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ khuyến cáo phòng bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors urge prevention of meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis remains a priority in Ha Tinh, Vietnam, where no confirmed cases are reported yet, though authorities warn of rapid progression and ongoing risk from travel and gatherings. Transmission occurs mainly via respiratory droplets through close contact, with asymptomatic carriers capable of spreading the bacteria. Serogroups A, B, C, Y and W commonly cause invasive disease, which often begins with nonspecific symptoms—fever, headache, fatigue, and sore throat—and can quickly advance to meningitis, septicemia, multi-organ failure, and death. Critical warning signs include high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, altered consciousness, seizures, or petechial rash; urgent medical care is essential. Prevention emphasizes hand hygiene, avoiding shared utensils, ventilation, and vaccination; vaccine type depends on age, exposure, and serogroup. In Ho Chi Minh City, a four-case cluster including one death boosted vaccination uptake eightfold, underscoring the need for early detection and prompt care in Ha Tinh.

triage.headline_ja: 医師、髄膜炎菌感染症の予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ・ハティン省で髄膜炎菌感染症の確定例はないものの、ホーチミン市での4例・1死亡のクラスターを受けワクチン接種が急増するなど社会的関心が高まっており、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクも指摘されているためフルRRAでの確認が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: ハティン省では現時点で確定症例なし。ホーチミン市の過去クラスター（4例・1死亡）が注意喚起の根拠となっており、新規アウトブレイクの直接報告ではなく予防啓発記事である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận hàng trăm ca cúm A nhập viện mỗi tuần
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records hundreds of influenza A hospital admissions each week
article.articleSummary: Influenza A remains a public health concern in Hanoi, with about 200–300 hospital admissions per week. Most patients recover, but the virus can cause pneumonia, respiratory failure, and worsen chronic diseases such as asthma, COPD, cardiovascular disease, and diabetes, particularly in children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions. Transmission is mainly droplet spread via coughing or sneezing. Fever alone is not a reliable severity marker; seek care for warning signs like shortness of breath, chest pain, blue lips, confusion, or for children: reduced feeding, dehydration, or seizures. Prevention focuses on annual vaccination, especially for high-risk groups, plus hand hygiene, masking, respiratory etiquette, and ventilation. Avoid unnecessary contact if infected. Care involves rest, fluids, and medical supervision; antibiotics do not treat influenza, and antivirals require physician prescription. Early recognition and proper management reduce complications.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、毎週数百人がA型インフルエンザで入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザAの通常の流行状況を伝える啓発的記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザAに関する一般向け医療情報記事。流行の急増や異常な重症度を示すデータはなく、通常の公衆衛生啓発内容。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberkulosis Tak Kenal Status Ekonomi, Orang Kaya Bisa Kena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Does Not Discriminate by Economic Status; Even the Rich Can Be Infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, tuberculosis (TB), caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis, can infect anyone, including the wealthy, dispelling the notion that TB targets only the poor. Transmission is airborne via droplets when someone with TB coughs or sneezes, with up to 3,500 bacilli released per cough and 4,500 to one million particles per sneeze. TB can affect the lungs and spread to other body parts. In Jakarta-area settings, including Menteng and Pondok Indah, TB transmission can occur in shopping centers, markets, offices, and public transport. Incubation after exposure is typically 6–14 weeks. Prevention emphasizes wearing a mask around the sick and maintaining immune health through a balanced diet, regular physical activity, adequate rest, and stress management. If TB is present in a community, investigate household contacts to assess exposure and trace infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は経済的地位に関係なく感染する、富裕層も感染しうる
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発・教育記事であり、特定の集団発生や異常な事象を報告するものではないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の一般的な感染経路・予防策に関する啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。ジャカルタの地名（Menteng、Pondok Indah）は例示として挙げられているのみで、実際の集団感染報告ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 아프리카돼지열병 테마 열기 식었나...사료·백신 관련주 매도 봇물
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has the African Swine Fever theme cooled off? A flood of selling in feed- and vaccine-related stocks.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, African Swine Fever (ASF) stocks in Korea showed overall weakness, though a subset of animal-health and disinfection names rose. ASF is a fatal viral disease affecting pigs and wild boars, with no commercially available vaccine or treatment, making outbreaks and biosecurity measures key market drivers. After recent outbreak-related momentum cooled, investors pared back expectations for quick rallies, triggering broader profit-taking in the sector. Notable moves included gains in some veterinary-drug and disinfectant stocks, while feed, poultry, and vaccine-development plays declined, including China-related meat-processing interests. The article cautions that ASF-related equities are highly sensitive to actual outbreak locations and control actions. It advises focusing on concrete fundamentals—real supply performance of medicines and disinfectants, progress on vaccines, and core profitability—rather than relying on short-term sentiment.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚コレラ関連テーマ熱は冷めたか…飼料・ワクチン関連株に売り殺到

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases down from 2025 levels -- DOH
article.articleSummary: Philippines' Department of Health (DOH) reports dengue cases in 2026 remain lower than 2025. As of Oct 14, 205,347 cases nationwide, 22% below the 261,749 cases recorded by the same date in 2025. Case fatality rate stands at 0.38%. From Sept 17–30, 22,095 cases were reported, down 2% from Sept 3–16 (22,479). The number of provinces and highly urbanized cities (P/HUCs) flagged for increases fell to nine from 11. Overall, cases remain below alert and epidemic thresholds. Dengue is a viral infection transmitted to humans by infected mosquitoes.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱症例数、2025年水準を下回る ― フィリピン保健省
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年比で減少しており、警戒・流行閾値も下回っているため、新規性や緊急性のあるシグナルとは判断されない。
triage.notes: 定例の保健省報告であり、症例数は減少傾向かつ閾値以下のため通常のサーベイランス情報と判断。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende la importación de productos avícolas de Brasil tras brote de Newcastle - El Heraldo de México
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends the importation of poultry products from Brazil after an outbreak of Newcastle disease - El Heraldo de México
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Mexico suspended imports of poultry products from Brazil after a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development (SADER), via SENASICA, announced the restriction to prevent disease entry and safeguard Mexican poultry production. Mexico maintains its Newcastle disease–free status and applies preventive sanitary protocols. The suspension covers poultry meat, fertile eggs, chicks, pet birds, and poultry products carried by travelers or tourists from Brazil. SENASICA temporarily blocked entry by deactivating Zoosanitary Requirements forms, pending Brazil’s measures to control the outbreak. Continuation of the restriction will depend on information from Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. Newcastle disease is a viral infection affecting various birds, with severe forms causing respiratory and nervous symptoms, reduced egg production, and high mortality, and it can spread via direct contact and contaminated equipment.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けてブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を停止 - エル・エラルド・デ・メヒコ
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）によりメキシコがブラジルからの家禽製品輸入を停止した事例で、貿易制限は発生しているがヒトへの健康影響は報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Confirms Newcastle Disease at Turkey Farm in Santa Catarina | TokenPost
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, on Oct 18, 2026, with public disclosure on Oct 19. The farm houses about 6,000 turkeys; movement from the property is halted and the flock will be culled, followed by cleaning and disinfection. Authorities are monitoring roughly 133 nearby properties across Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim and Águas Frias; officially inspected poultry products are deemed safe to eat. Brazil is notifying trade partners and reviewing bilateral rules with China, including an initial suspension of poultry meat exports to China while China defines the scope of any import restrictions. Background: Brazil’s prior commercial poultry outbreak occurred in Rio Grande do Sul in July 2024, and the country self-declared Newcastle disease-free on Oct 23, 2024 after stamping-out.

article.articleHeadline: México frena importaciones avícolas de Brasil por brote infeccioso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico halts poultry imports from Brazil due to an infectious outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian-origin poultry—chicken meat, offal, and avian genetic material—after confirmation of a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious avian viral infection with variable severity and potential for high mortality in unvaccinated flocks. The suspension, announced by SADER via SENASICA, safeguards Mexico’s disease-free status and will endure while containment measures are assessed. The General Directorate of Animal Health deactivated Zoosanitary Requirements sheets to block entry of affected products. Brazil supplied 25.4% of Mexico’s chicken imports in 2025 (about 244,391 tonnes); total poultry imports were about 1.07 million tonnes, ranking Mexico second globally after Japan. Reopening depends on Brazil’s zoosanitary information and Mexican evaluation; duration and availability of alternatives will shape price and supply impacts.

triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクはほぼない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められず、主に貿易・畜産経済に関する事案である。
triage.notes: 本事案はヒトの公衆衛生リスクではなく家禽の動物衛生・国際貿易に関する問題であり、EBS（イベントベースサーベイランス）の公衆衛生シグナルとしての優先度は低い。日本・メキシコは輸入統計上の比較対象として言及されているのみで、発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Malaria or Ebola? When a fever should worry you
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to several provinces; Uganda reported 20 cases with two deaths earlier in the year, now declared over. Kenya confirmed its first case about two weeks before 2026-10-20: a citizen who had worked in the DRC, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, admitted Oct 3 and died Oct 5; a second case, a close family contact, tested positive in quarantine on Oct 13. Ebola symptoms start 4–10 days after exposure and resemble malaria: fever, weakness, fatigue, muscle pains; bleeding is not universal and typically appears in severe illness. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected body fluids after symptoms begin, through broken skin or mucous membranes; handling bodies poses high risk. No approved Bundibugyo-specific vaccine or treatment; supportive care is essential, with a Ugandan vaccine study under way. WHO’s Hub for Pandemic and Epidemic Intelligence aims rapid detection by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアかエボラか？発熱時に注意すべきポイント
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）がウガンダを経てケニアに拡大し死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCが発生源かつ継続的な感染拡大地であるため含めた。ワクチン・治療薬未承認であり、WHOのパンデミック・インテリジェンス・ハブも言及されるなど国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc cúm A gia tăng, làm gì để phòng bệnh?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising influenza A infections among children: what can be done to prevent the disease?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A and B and respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections are rising among children in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, amid unusual seasonal weather. In Thach Ha District, the local Center for Medical Services reports the 30-bed pediatric ward is full as admissions increase, with some patients moved to other departments. Ha Tinh Provincial General Hospital’s pediatric department notes about a 30% month-over-month rise, alongside cases of hand-foot-mouth disease, diarrhea, and bronchitis. An 18-month-old child, Thai Hai Vy of Nam Son village, Xuan Loc commune, was admitted with fever, cough and poor appetite, diagnosed with influenza A and pneumonia. Doctors warn that early symptoms mimic other illnesses; red-flag signs include difficulty or rapid breathing, lethargy, or poor feeding, necessitating urgent care. Preventive measures emphasize hand hygiene, personal and environmental cleanliness, covering coughs, balanced nutrition, rest, and vaccination per health guidelines.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザA型感染増加、子どもの病気予防には何をすべきか？
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハティン省で季節性インフルエンザA/B、RSV等の小児感染症が増加しているが、通常の季節性疾患の範囲内であり、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の異常性を示す根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 地元メディアによる季節性感染症の増加報告。異常気象により季節外れの流行という記載があるが、重症例や死亡例の明示はなく、通常の小児科疾患の範囲内と見られる。続報での重症度・拡大状況の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue cases rise to 58, malaria count reaches 82 in Ludhiana
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Ludhiana district rise to 58 this month from 55, while malaria cases reach 82, up from 71, per health department data as of 2026-10-20. District epidemiologist Supreet Kaur says teams conduct dengue checks on Mondays and Fridays and malaria checks on Tuesdays, with regular inspections for mosquito breeding and awareness. Dengue is caused by a virus transmitted by Aedes aegypti, which breeds in stagnant water in coolers, discarded tyres, flower pots and containers. Malaria is caused by plasmodium parasites, with two found in Ludhiana: Plasmodium vivax (more common, recurring fever) and Plasmodium falciparum (life-threatening malaria, found among migrants from other states). Residents are advised to reduce breeding by cleaning water containers, preventing water accumulation, keeping storage containers covered, and changing cooler water; protective measures include mosquito repellents, nets and full-sleeved clothing. Dengue checks occur Mondays and Fridays; malaria checks on Tuesdays.

triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・マラリアの通常監視報告であり、通常の公衆衛生対応（定期検査・啓発活動）が実施されている。異常な増加や重症例、国際的拡大のリスクは報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Japan eyes subsidies for supply of infectious disease drugs
article.articleSummary: Japan plans fiscal 2027 subsidies to bolster end-to-end domestic production of infectious disease medicines, aiming to reduce reliance on overseas APIs, notably from China and India. The Health, Labor and Welfare Ministry seeks to fund API production and drug manufacturing in Japan, covering up to 80% of costs for new plant construction and equipment upgrades for APIs, and 50% for medicines. The move follows API shortages during COVID-19 and aging factories, rising costs. The government will preselect pharmaceuticals deemed highly necessary for health and medical security before awarding support. In its fiscal 2027 budget request, the ministry earmarked 84 billion yen for medicine manufacturing expenses, and requested API manufacturing funding as part of a national strategy approved by the Cabinet in March to ensure stable supplies during infectious disease outbreaks. The policy targets strengthened domestic production to withstand global outbreaks.

triage.triage_reason: COVID-19に関連した政策・補助金の話題であり、新規の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は日本政府の医薬品供給政策に関する内容であり、対象国（India, China）は原薬輸入元としての言及のみで、感染症の発生国ではないため verified_locations は空とした。日本も対象国リストに含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Meat Stock Falls 4% on Bird Disease
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed on a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. About 6,000 birds on the farm; samples collected 21 September and lab-confirmed 18 October. The Agriculture Ministry MAPA placed the area under quarantine with disinfection, and ~133 farms in the region are under oversight. Brazil, the world’s largest chicken exporter, could suspend exports to China under a sanitary understanding; China accounted for about 10% of Brazil’s chicken exports in Jan–Sept 2026 (≈420,000 tonnes) of roughly 4.4 million tonnes in that period. Market reaction: MBRF shares fell ~4% on Monday, with JBS down ~1–2%. A suspension limited to Santa Catarina would be less damaging than a national ban. The virus source remains under investigation; authorities say inspected poultry products already on the market are safe to eat.

article.articleHeadline: With 24 cases, Chandigarh dengue tally hits 5-year low
article.articleSummary: Chandigarh records 24 dengue cases so far in 2026, a five-year low, with nine cases in September and nine in October. National Centre for Vector Borne Diseases Control data show a long-term decline: 2021—1,596 cases (3 deaths); 2022—910 (1 death); 2023—454 (no deaths); 2024—349; 2025—66 (no deaths). Dengue is transmitted by Aedes aegypti mosquitoes that breed in stagnant water, with spikes typically in monsoon/post-monsoon periods. Last year, about 90% of cases occurred in the final quarter (October: 14, November: 32, December: 14); a similar pattern was seen in 2024. Dr. Monica Gupta notes case numbers depend on weather, cleanliness drives, and awareness about water accumulation, reflecting dengue’s cyclic pattern driven by immunity and mosquito density. Symptoms usually appear 4–5 days after a bite, with fever as a common sign. Free testing is available at PGIMER Virology, GMCH-32 Microbiology, and GMSH-16 Microbiology.

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh não mô cầu có nguy cơ chuyển nặng và tử vong cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease carries a high risk of progression to severe illness and death.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease can rapidly progress to meningitis and septicemia, with death possible if untreated. By October 20, 2026, Ho Chi Minh City reported a school-linked cluster, including one student death. Transmission is mainly via respiratory droplets and close contact, especially in crowded classrooms and dormitory settings, or through sharing utensils. At-risk groups include children and students, particularly those with chronic illness or immunodeficiency. Distinguishing features from influenza include abrupt fever >38.5°C, chills, severe headache, nausea or vomiting, photophobia, and neck stiffness; a petechial or purpuric rash may occur in severe cases. When a case appears, schools should coordinate with health authorities for epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, cleaning surfaces, improving ventilation, and transparent communication. Testing of suspected cases should be pursued promptly to enable early detection and treatment. Dr. Vu Ngoc Long advocates proactive prevention to reduce spread.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性疾患は重症化・死亡リスクが高い
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校関連クラスターで死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準2つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 学校・寮など集団生活環境での感染拡大リスクが指摘されており、接触者追跡や環境消毒などの対応が進行中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点では報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội kiểm soát chặt dịch bệnh, giảm số ca sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi tightens control of the epidemic, reducing dengue fever cases.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever cases in Hanoi fell during Oct 9–16, 2026, with 509 cases across 91 wards and 17 new clusters as the city intensifies surveillance, environmental sanitation, and vector control. Cumulatively since Jan 2026, Hanoi reports 4,860 dengue cases in 120 wards, with no deaths; this is 3,876 fewer than the 2021–2025 five-year average of 8,736 and far below 2023’s 24,373. Total dengue clusters reach 211, with 30 active. Hand-foot-mouth disease totals 230 cases in 87 wards; year-to-date 6,244 cases in 126 wards, 99 clusters overall with 2 active. Measles: 3 cases in 2 wards; cumulative 409 in 112 wards. Pertussis: 1 case in Thuận An commune; cumulative 113 in 59 wards. COVID-19: 7 cases in 6 wards; cumulative 1,674 in 122 wards. Hanoi CDC stresses targeted surveillance, zone-based investigations, vaccination campaigns, environmental sanitation, and One Health collaboration; next week expands dengue surveillance to 15 wards and reinforces child-care surveillance for hand-foot-mouth disease.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイ、疫病対策を強化しデング熱症例が減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱や手足口病、麻疹等の症例数は例年と比較して減少傾向にあり、死亡例もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。既存の監視体制で対応可能と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は複数感染症の定例サーベイランス報告であり、いずれも前年・過去平均より減少傾向。ハノイ市当局による通常の監視・対策強化の一環として報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones avícolas de Brasil por brote de Newcastle - Medios OBSON
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends poultry imports from Brazil due to Newcastle disease outbreak - OBSON Media.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil triggered Mexico’s Senasica to suspend imports of poultry-origin products from Brazil. As of 20 October 2026, the suspension blocks entry of meat and offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks up to three days old, canary and ornamental birds, birds of prey for sale, and pet birds, as well as avian genetic material from Brazil. The decision follows confirmation by Brazil’s MAPA of a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba. Senasica has deactivated Zoosanitary Requirements on its platform pending further zoosanitary information. The measure applies to commercial imports and to avian-origin products travelers may bring into Mexico, aiming to curb cross-border transmission while awaiting additional outbreak details.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの家禽類輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用ブロイラー農場でニューカッスル病が確認され、メキシコ当局（Senasica）が家禽関連製品の輸入を全面停止するなど、政府機関の対応と貿易制限がすでに発生しているため、フルリスク評価によるフォローが必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（鳥類）に限定された動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は確認されていない。メキシコは輸入国であり発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。今後の感染拡大状況や他国への波及（特に対象国リストの養鶏輸出入国）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Toàn cảnh chùm ca mắc não mô cầu ở TP.HCM, hơn 2.000 người uống kháng sinh dự phòng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overview of a cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases in Ho Chi Minh City, more than 2,000 people receiving prophylactic antibiotics.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a MenB meningococcal meningitis cluster at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước, with 4 cases and 1 death. The first cases were identified on 16 October 2026; the fatal patient developed headache, fever, rash, septic shock, and multiorgan failure after two days of symptoms and died on 14 October. A fourth case, a school student with close contact, emerged on 17 October. Laboratory assessments noted co-circulating respiratory infections from seasonal influenza and rhinovirus among students. On 19 October, authorities convened to intensify control measures: thorough disinfection, prophylactic antibiotics for contacts, and contact tracing. All 177 close contacts (163 students, 14 households) completed prophylaxis with daily health surveillance; prophylaxis was expanded to the entire school (2,031 people). By 19 October, no new cases among contacts; three students remain stable in Hospital for Tropical Diseases, continuing antibiotics. School attendance resumed; no online classes.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスターの全容、2,000人超が予防抗生物質を服用
triage.triage_reason: 学校でのMenB髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスターで死亡1例を含む4例が確認され、2,000人超への予防的抗生物質投与など大規模な公衆衛生対応が行われているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 学校内クラスターで死亡例ありだが、接触者からの新規感染は報告されておらず、国レベルでの対応で管理されている模様。季節性インフルエンザ・ライノウイルスの同時流行も確認されているが、主題は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスターである。

article.articleHeadline: 伊波拉疫情跨國蔓延　美國調升肯亞旅遊警示至第三級 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads across borders; U.S. raises Kenya travel advisory to Level 3
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported a new Ebola case on Oct 18, bringing its total confirmed infections to eight, as the Congo-centered Ebola outbreak spreads across borders toward East Africa. The U.S. State Department raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, urging Americans to reconsider travel due to health risks and additional safety concerns including crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, and road safety. Kenya’s healthcare system is limited, with rural areas often lacking medical resources, medicines, and equipment. Congolese authorities confirmed the outbreak had expanded to North Ubangi Province, the eighth province affected, highlighting ongoing regional transmission and cross-border spillover risk. No deaths are reported in the article, but authorities emphasize heightened vigilance and preparedness in neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ疫情が国境を越えて拡大　米国がケニア渡航警告をレベル3に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ発のエボラ流行がケニアへ越境拡大し、米国が渡航警告を引き上げるなど国際的な関心と対応が高まっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアでの感染拡大が報じられているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの国内拡大（第8州への拡大）が主題の一部であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: US says travelers should reconsider Kenya trips on health risks amid Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: US State Department raises Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3 (Reconsider Travel) on Oct 19, 2026, citing Ebola-related health risks along with crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic safety concerns. Kenya has confirmed one more Ebola case on Sunday, bringing its total infections to eight as the Congo-centered outbreak spills across borders in the region. Congo has now confirmed the outbreak reaching North Ubangi, its eighth province. The advisory notes that medical services in Kenya are limited, especially in rural areas, with shortages of medicines and equipment. This situation highlights ongoing cross-border Ebola transmission from Congo and the associated travel and public-health risks for the region.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ拡大を受けケニア渡航の再検討を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を起点とするエボラ流行が国境を越えてケニアに拡大し、米国が渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げるなど、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし流行の起点であるDRCの北ウバンギ州（第8州目）への拡大が明記されており、DRCは主題国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports over disease
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended on Oct 19 imports of chicken meat, live birds and hatching eggs from Brazil after detecting Newcastle disease at a commercial farm in southern Brazil on Oct 18 and shutting it down. The highly contagious respiratory virus is not a risk to humans but in chickens can cause neurological disorders, reduced egg production, and higher mortality. The measure is intended to protect domestic poultry production and marks Mexico’s second poultry ban on Brazil in 18 months. Brazil exports about 30% of its poultry products. In 2025, Mexico, China, the European Union and other Latin American countries halted imports of Brazilian chicken during May–June amid an avian influenza outbreak, highlighting periodic trade disruptions tied to poultry diseases.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、疾病発生によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり人への健康リスクはないとされており、人の公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。貿易制限は発生しているが人健康面での深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の疾病で人への感染リスクはないと記事中で明記されており、人健康EBSの観点からは低優先度。家禽貿易・農業分野の関心事項として位置づけられる。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil poultry exports face fresh threat after disease detected at MBRF supplier
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was identified at a commercial turkey unit in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, a supplier to MBRF Global Foods' Chapeco export plant. The facility was closed and bird movements suspended. Detection announced Oct 19; authorities say there is no food safety risk; the Agriculture Ministry will monitor about 133 properties in Nova Itaberaba and three neighboring towns, while maintaining dialogue with international health authorities. The case highlights potential export impacts for Brazil, where Santa Catarina accounts for roughly 23% of chicken exports through September 2026; a 2024 Newcastle outbreak led to halts to China and the European Union. Industry groups ABPA and local Santa Catarina bodies stressed no consumption risk and cited Brazil's established animal health system. As containment continues, buyers’ decisions will shape whether imports are restricted or redirected elsewhere.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの鶏肉輸出、MBRFのサプライヤーで疾病検出により新たな脅威に直面
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはほぼない。影響は主に貿易・輸出面に限定され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当数が低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病で、食品安全リスクはないとされている。ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは低く、主な懸念は輸出停止など経済・貿易面。中国は過去の輸出停止先として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle, detectada em granja de perus, não traz risco para humanos; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease detected at a turkey farm poses no risk to humans; here's what you need to know.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting a 60-day zoosanitary emergency across four municipalities: Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The unit was closed and poultry movements suspended after DNA of the Newcastle virus was found in multiple birds from a roughly 6,000-bird flock; those birds will be culled. The Ministry of Agriculture emphasizes that consumption of officially inspected poultry remains safe. The outbreak triggers Brazil’s protocol with China, resulting in a temporary suspension of poultry exports to that country. No widespread clinical signs were reported by ABPA, though Newcastle is highly contagious and can cause up to 100% mortality with respiratory and nervous symptoms. The last Brazilian case was July 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul; a 90-day post-cleanup window to request OIE/WOAH disease-free status is planned.

triage.headline_ja: 七面鳥農場で検出されたニューカッスル病、人への感染リスクはなし；詳細解説
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、記事は人への健康リスクがないことを明記している。輸出停止等の貿易影響はあるが公衆衛生上の脅威ではないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: China（中国）は家禽輸出停止の相手国として言及されているのみで、発生地域ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Governo decreta emergência em quatro cidades de SC por doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Declares a State of Emergency in Four Cities in Santa Catarina Due to Newcastle Disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease prompts a zoosanitary emergency declaration by MAPA in four western Santa Catarina municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim—for 60 days. The outbreak centers on a commercial turkey farm housing about 6,000 birds. Diagnosis was confirmed by the Federal Laboratory for Agricultural Defense in São Paulo after investigation by Santa Catarina's Official Veterinary Service. The farm is interdicted and poultry movements halted. Newcastle disease is a viral infection that affects domestic and wild birds, causing respiratory, digestive, and neurological signs. Measures aim to contain spread and protect flocks; consumption of inspected poultry meat and eggs remains safe. Authorities continue surveillance to control and eradicate the focus in western Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、ニューカッスル病によりサンタカタリーナ州の4都市に緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の疾病であり人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの健康影響が報告されておらず、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や社会的関心の高まりも確認できないため。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。家禽の移動制限や養鶏場の隔離など地域の畜産業対応にとどまり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Around $1 billion missing in Ebola outbreak funding
article.articleSummary: Eight provinces in the Democratic Republic of Congo are affected as the Ebola outbreak—the fastest-growing on record—spreads into neighbouring Kenya and Uganda. Since its mid-May declaration, authorities report about 9,400 cases and more than 4,500 deaths, making it the deadliest Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history. Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention (Africa CDC) and Congolese officials say about $US1 billion in Ebola aid is unaccounted for, with $US962 million disbursed by international donors but only $US200 million accounted for on the ground. At a recent meeting, organisations reported receiving $US228 million; about $US127 million had been spent and roughly $US100 million remained. Only one-third of invited organisations attended. Africa CDC urged transparency and said it would work with authorities to investigate the missing funds. The backdrop includes strikes by frontline workers over unpaid pay and dangerous conditions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応資金、約10億ドルが行方不明
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で史上最速・最悪規模のエボラ流行が発生し、ケニア・ウガンダへ越境拡大。IHR基準複数該当かつ資金不正疑惑により社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を中心としたエボラ流行と、その対応資金約10億ドルの使途不明問題を主題としている。ケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大も言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones avícolas de Brasil ante brote de la enfermedad de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends poultry imports from Brazil amid Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry after Newcastle disease was confirmed in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina (Brazil), according to Senasica. The ban covers chicken meat and by-products, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, and ornamental or raptor birds, including products carried by travelers. Senasica’s General Directorate of Animal Health disabled the sanitary-requirement sheets on its platform to enforce the measure. Authorities said the step protects Mexican poultry while awaiting Brazil’s health information and in line with international protocols; no re-opening date was announced. Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry identified the outbreak at a facility with about 6,000 turkeys for meat; birds remained on-site and animal movement was halted. The minister noted that consumption of officially inspected poultry poses no human health risk. Newcastle is a highly contagious viral disease causing respiratory, nervous, and digestive symptoms with high mortality, transmitted by contact or contaminated water, feed, or equipment. Mexico has been velogenic Newcastle-free since 2015 per Senasica.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、記事中でも人の健康リスクはないと明記されている。人の公衆衛生事象としての基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生に伴う動物衛生・貿易措置であり、人の感染症公衆衛生事象ではないためヒト向けEBSのシグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango brasileiro após surto de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian chicken after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil prompts Mexico to suspend imports of chicken meat and other avian products from Brazil. Brazil is the world's largest exporter of chicken meat, and Mexico—a Newcastle-free country—announced the measure on Oct 19 to shield its domestic poultry industry. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious respiratory infection in birds, causing nervous signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality; it poses no human health risk. The suspension covers chicken meat, live birds, and fertile eggs. In Brazil, authorities detected the outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in the south, and the facility was quarantined with control and eradication measures planned. The outbreak concerns Santa Catarina and Rio Grande do Sul, where authorities are monitoring spread.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり人への健康リスクはなく、貿易制限（メキシコの輸入停止）以外にIHR基準やWPRO基準の該当は確認できないため、人感染症シグナルとしては見送り。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の高病原性疾患で人には感染しないため、公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく農業・貿易上の問題として扱うべき事案。メキシコは発生国ではなく輸入停止措置を取った国のため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 450 tấn lợn bị tiêu hủy, dịch tả vẫn diễn biến phức tạp ở Nghệ An
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 450 tons of pigs culled, swine fever remains complex in Nghe An.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) remains complex in Nghe An Province, Vietnam, with over 30 outbreaks and 7,500 pigs culled in 2026, totaling 450 tons. The first outbreak was in Nghia Binh hamlet, Nghia Dong commune, triggering culling and movement restrictions. In Nghia Dong, 13 households across Nghia Binh, Yen Binh, and Dai Thanh have infected pigs, with more than 46 tons culled there. Since Oct 7, Nghia Dong has banned slaughter, trading, and transport in Nghia Binh, Yen Binh, Binh Son, Khe Than, Dai Thanh, and Nghia Binh Market. ASF is also active in Chau Tien (since June 2026, with >3,000 pigs) and Anh Son (early Oct 2026, >6.5 tons culled; disease persists in 6 hamlets). On Oct 18, 2026, the province issued Directive 27 to tighten surveillance, culling, sanitation, vaccination, and movement controls, aiming for >80% vaccination coverage and compensation of 40,000 VND/kg for eligible culled pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 450トン以上の豚が殺処分、ゲアン省でアフリカ豚コレラの流行が依然として複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（ASF）であり人獣共通感染症ではないため公衆衛生への直接的影響は低いが、広範囲な畜産業への影響と拡大が続いているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生リスクは直接的にはない。ただし畜産業・経済への影響が大きく、地方政府が対策を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola Gains Falter as Transmission Worsens in North Kivu
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a reversal of earlier gains as transmission worsens in North Kivu, eroding progress in the outbreak’s original epicenter. As of 2026-10-20, weekly totals of confirmed infections and deaths rose for the third straight week after dipping to a low about a month earlier. The resurgence underscores sustained transmission within the outbreak, with North Kivu remaining the focal point of activity. The report indicates that declines have stalled and case numbers are climbing again, signaling persistent transmission chains. Health authorities continue surveillance and response efforts, but the excerpt provides no detailed laboratory confirmation data, infection sources, imported or exported cases, or new containment milestones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、北キブ州での感染悪化により改善傾向が逆転
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の感染拡大がコンゴ北キブ州で再燃しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の重症度・流行しやすさに該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事は北キブ州での感染者・死者数の3週連続増加を報告しているが、詳細な検査確認データや感染源、越境事例については情報なし。

article.articleHeadline: ராமநாதபுரத்தில் டெங்கு எண்ணிக்கை உயர்வு - மக்கள் அச்சம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in dengue cases in Ramanathapuram — people's fear.
article.articleSummary: Ramanathapuram district reports a rising dengue fever burden, with hospital authorities noting an increasing number of cases. Daily testing shows dengue infection confirmed in more than 10 individuals. At Ramanathapuram Government College Hospital, there is no dedicated dengue ward, so dengue patients are admitted alongside patients with ordinary fevers. Patients express concern about shared wards and potential infection risk, questioning the adequacy of care during the outbreak. The report highlights an ongoing rise in detections and the lack of isolation facilities for dengue cases within the hospital, reflecting challenges in clinical management amid the dengue surge in the district.

triage.headline_ja: ラーマナータプラムでデング熱患者が増加 - 住民に不安広がる
triage.triage_reason: インド・タミルナードゥ州の一地域での季節性デング熱増加であり、地方の医療対応上の課題（隔離病棟不足）が報告されているが、IHR基準の複数該当や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、続報を注視するレベル。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの地方部で季節性に発生する風土病であり、本記事はラーマナータプラム県の地域医療体制の課題を報じるローカルニュース。重症度や死亡者数についての情報はなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا ترفع تحذير السفر إلى كينيا بسبب المخاطر الصحية وتفشي إيبولا | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. raises travel advisory for Kenya due to health risks and an Ebola outbreak | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been confirmed in Kenya after an additional infection was reported on Sunday, raising the national total to eight as Kenya remains on high alert for a cross-border outbreak. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with transmission reaching Nord-Ubangi Province (North Ubangi) across the border. The United States has raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, advising Americans to reconsider travel due to health risks, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, and road safety concerns, with some areas showing higher risk. Kenya’s health services are limited, particularly in rural areas, and facilities often lack adequate medicines and equipment. The report highlights Ebola-related risk and warns travelers of evolving regional health threats linked to the Congo outbreak, without detailing laboratory confirmation beyond the Kenyan case count.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、健康リスクとエボラ流行を理由にケニアへの渡航勧告を引き上げ｜カイロ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（北ウバンギ州）を起点とするエボラ出血熱の越境拡大が報告され、米国が渡航警告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的な懸念と渡航制限が生じているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニアでの感染確認を主題としているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの起点であるコンゴ民主共和国（北ウバンギ州）のみ verified_locations に含めた。なお、ケニアとDRC北ウバンギ州は地理的に直接国境を接しておらず、記事内容の正確性には留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Nhu cầu tiêm vaccine não mô cầu tăng mạnh, bác sĩ cảnh báo bệnh diễn tiến nhanh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The demand for meningococcal vaccine has surged; doctors warn that the disease progresses rapidly.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease vaccination demand surges in Ho Chi Minh City after a cluster of meningococcal meningitis at a local school. At the Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City, routine vaccination averages 15–20 daily; in the past three days, volumes rose seven to eightfold. The VNVC system reports close to 15,000 vaccine doses across about 80 city centers, a 125-fold increase versus the same period. Available vaccines include meningococcal group B, a B+C combination, and an A,C,W,Y combination; no single vaccine covers all five groups (A, B, C, W, Y), so selection relies on vaccination history and professional guidance. Parents should check records since immunity develops over multiple doses. Early signs—fever, headache, nausea, fatigue; petechiae may appear late. A severe case in an 8.5-month-old progressed to septicemia and limb necrosis; death can occur within 12–24 hours if untreated. Transmission is via droplets; emphasize vaccination and hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種需要が急増、医師は病状進行の速さに警鐘
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎のクラスターが発生し、重症例（敗血症・四肢壊死）や死亡リスクが報告されており、ワクチン需要が急増するなど社会的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 学校でのクラスター発生とワクチン接種需要の急増（通常比7〜8倍、VNVCでは125倍）が報告されている。重症の乳児例（敗血症・四肢壊死、未治療なら12〜24時間で死亡の可能性）があり、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。ただし国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Cukup Menunggu Pasien, Pemprov Malut Gencarkan Skrining TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Not Enough to Wait for Patients, North Maluku Provincial Government Steps Up TB Screening
article.articleSummary: North Maluku Province accelerates tuberculosis (TB) control through cross-sector collaboration, under the 2026 TB Provincial Action Plan (RAD). At Muara Hotel Ternate, on 20 October 2026, officials highlighted proactive case finding via screening of high-risk groups and household contacts, particularly important in the archipelago with dispersed populations and limited health access. Health Chief Dr. Giscard Kroons said addressing TB requires involvement of schools, village governments, Social Services, and Public Works, not just health facilities. He warned that stopping treatment early risks drug resistance and higher costs. The RAD provides clear targets, indicators, and funding to guide implementation and ensure reach down to desa/kelurahan levels. Education Department support for school-based screening; Social Services for social-risk factors; Public Works for environmental sanitation; and Village Governments through Gerakan Desa Siaga TB are emphasized to extend outreach and sustain treatment adherence until completion.

triage.headline_ja: 患者を待つだけでは不十分、北マルク州政府がTBスクリーニングを強化
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関する行政的な取り組みの報道であり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 結核の恒常的な公衆衛生プログラムに関する地方政府の取り組み報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh: Chùm ca não mô cầu tại trường học được kiểm soát tốt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: A cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases at schools is well controlled.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a cluster of meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis group B) at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước. Four cases have been identified since Oct 14, including one fatality; three patients remain hospitalized at the Hospital for Tropical Diseases in stable condition. No new cases were recorded from Oct 17 through Oct 19. The fourth case, who had close contact with the first, developed fever Oct 15; PCR confirmed group B meningococcal meningitis with co-infection by influenza B. Health authorities conducted school cleaning, contact tracing, and prophylactic antibiotics for 177 contacts (163 students, 14 others), expanding prophylaxis to staff, totaling 2,031 people under surveillance. In-person classes will be maintained. The Hiệp Phước commune Health Station will monitor the 177 contacts through Oct 25; those who took prophylaxis should remain vigilant. There is a concurrent rise in respiratory infections, including influenza; seek care if fever.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：学校での髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスターは良好に制御されている
triage.triage_reason: 学校内で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（B群）のクラスターが発生し死亡例も出ており、閉鎖集団でのヒト-ヒト感染可能性とインフルエンザB共感染という異常な事象が確認されたため、シグナルとして継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 4例中1例死亡、新規症例はOct17以降確認されていないが、学校という閉鎖環境でのクラスター発生とインフルエンザB共感染という点から、続報の有無を注視する必要がある。保健当局は接触者177名への予防投薬と2,031名の監視を実施し、現時点で状況は制御されている。

article.articleHeadline: Đậu mùa khỉ đã thay đổi như thế nào sau đợt bùng phát toàn cầu?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: How has monkeypox changed since the global outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Mpox (monkeypox) is caused by the Mpox virus, an orthopoxvirus related to smallpox. The first human case was in 1970 in Democratic Republic of Congo; before 2022, cases were clustered in Central and West Africa. A 2022 outbreak spread internationally, with most cases linked to person-to-person transmission via close contact, including sexual contact. Mpox has two lineages, Clade I and Clade II; Clade II underlies the global outbreak. Disease severity depends on viral lineage and host factors such as immune status, age, comorbidities, and access to care. Diagnosis relies on PCR testing from lesion samples; presentations range from fever, headache, myalgia, fatigue, lymphadenopathy, to rashes that may be genital, anal, or oral. Smallpox vaccines offer cross-protection but are not absolute. Tecovirimat has been used in some settings; its effectiveness is not definitively proven. Prevention emphasizes avoiding contact with lesions or contaminated materials, hand hygiene, avoiding wildlife, and vaccination when indicated.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な流行後、サル痘はどのように変化したのか？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はMpoxの一般的な解説・総説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はMpoxの病態・歴史・診断・予防に関する解説記事であり、特定の発生地（DRCやアンゴラ）における新規症例増加や具体的なアウトブレイク報告ではない。そのため発生地域として挙げられているDRC・アンゴラは記事の主題とは直接関連せず、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Virus di 48.500 anni tornano attivi: quali rischi comporta lo scioglimento dei ghiacci
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 48,500-year-old viruses become active again: What risks does the melting of the ice pose?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Siberian researchers revived 13 ancient viruses from frozen soil, including a sample dating to about 48,500 years ago. In lab tests on amoebae, some virions remained intact and could infect, but there is no evidence they infect humans. In Tibet, researchers analyzing a Guliya glacier ice core identified 1,705 viral groups spanning over 41,000 years; most sequences do not match known viruses, and viability or human infectivity was not demonstrated. Overall, the risk to the general population is considered low, but permafrost thaw could release microorganisms, especially where human activity increases. The article outlines three scenarios: viruses still viable, only genetic traces, or concrete health risks such as Bacillus anthracis (anthrax), linked to the 2016 Yamal outbreak that killed ~2,350 reindeer, caused dozens of human cases, and one human death. Emphasizes environmental surveillance and study of ice-borne microbes.

triage.headline_ja: 48,500年前のウイルスが再び活性化：氷の融解がもたらすリスクとは
triage.triage_reason: 記事はシベリア永久凍土とチベット氷河コアからの古代ウイルス研究に関する科学記事であり、ヒトへの感染性や現在進行中の疾病アウトブレイクは確認されていない。炭疽菌の言及も2016年ロシア・ヤマル半島の過去事例であり、現在の対象国でのアウトブレイクではない。
triage.notes: 記事はチベット（中国）とシベリア（ロシア）での古代ウイルス・永久凍土研究に関する科学的考察であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクを示すものではない。炭疽菌事例は2016年ロシア・ヤマル半島の過去の出来事であり対象国外。チベットの氷河コア研究ではウイルスの生存能力やヒト感染性は実証されていないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Enfermedad aviar en proveedor de MBRF amenaza las exportaciones de Brasil y golpea acciones de procesadoras
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian disease at an MBRF supplier threatens Brazil's exports and hits processors' shares.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, a highly contagious avian viral infection, was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, supplying exclusively to MBRF Global Foods SA for its Chapecó export operation. The farm was shut and bird movements suspended as authorities intensified containment; 133 other facilities in Nova Itaberaba and three nearby towns were placed under surveillance. The outbreak threatens Brazil’s poultry exports, with MBRF shares down 4.1% in São Paulo and JBS down 1% in New York. The Agriculture Ministry confirmed the viral disease and said the sector’s animal-health system would proceed with monitoring and control measures. Associations ABPA and Santa Catarina poultry groups emphasized no consumer risk. The event follows Brazil’s efforts to resume EU trade after new livestock drug requirements; Santa Catarina accounts for about 23% of Brazil’s exports through September, the second-largest supplier.

triage.headline_ja: MBRFのサプライヤーで発生した鳥類疾患がブラジルの輸出を脅かし、食肉加工会社の株価を直撃
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きんの動物疾病であり、ヒトへの重大な健康被害は報告されていない。影響は主に貿易・経済面に限定され、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例はニューカッスル病という家きん疾病による経済・貿易影響（輸出停止、株価下落）が主題であり、人への感染リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は記載されていない。動物衛生当局が監視・封じ込め措置を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: Bé trai chảy máu cam sau hai ngày sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy with a nosebleed two days after dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, District 8, a 9-year-old boy with dengue fever and acute bronchitis presented with high fever (39°C) and epistaxis on day two. Dengue was confirmed at Tam Anh General Hospital, and the patient was admitted due to mucosal bleeding, a warning sign for potential severe dengue. The team monitored bleeding, vital signs, urine output, and labs (platelets and red blood cells), while administering fever control, fluids, and supportive therapy for bronchitis. After six days, fever resolved, cough improved, appetite returned, and laboratory indices stabilized; he was discharged with home follow-up. Dengue virus can lower platelet counts or impair function and promote vascular leakage, causing mucosal bleeding. Not all children bleed or rash; dengue typically progresses through febrile, critical, and recovery phases. Dengue has four serotypes (DENV-1 to DENV-4); vaccination is advised for children, alongside vector control and mosquito bite prevention.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱発症2日後に鼻血を出した少年
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の臨床報告であり、デング熱はベトナムで既知の流行病であるため異常性・国際的拡大リスクはなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 個別患者の臨床経過を紹介する医療啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクや集団発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones avícolas de Brasil por Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends poultry imports from Brazil due to Newcastle disease
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of poultry-origin products from Brazil after a confirmed Newcastle disease outbreak at Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Senasica restricted meat and poultry offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, and ornamental and pet birds destined for sale or as pets, covering both commercial shipments and traveler goods. To enforce the measure, Senasica disabled sanitary-requirement sheets in its platform. The action aims to protect Mexican poultry production while awaiting Brazilian health information and in line with international protocols; no resumption date was announced. Brazilian authorities identified the outbreak at a facility with about 6,000 turkeys for meat; birds remained on the property and animal movements were halted. Brazil’s Agriculture Minister said consumption of officially inspected poultry poses no human health risk. Newcastle is a highly contagious viral disease affecting birds with respiratory, nervous, and digestive signs and high mortality; Mexico has been velogenic Newcastle-free since 2015.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病によりブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、記事内でもヒトへの健康リスクはないと明言されている。貿易制限は発生しているがIHR基準は1つのみ該当、公衆衛生上の社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒトへの感染リスクがないことが明言されている家禽の動物疾病であり、貿易上の措置が中心の事案。公衆衛生上のフルリスク評価の対象には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: US says travelers should reconsider Kenya trips on health risks amid Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: On Oct 20, 2026, the US State Department raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, urging Americans to reconsider travel due to health risks, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic safety concerns; some areas remain at higher risk. Kenya reported one new Ebola case, bringing total infections to eight, amid a regional outbreak centered in Congo. Congo confirmed the outbreak had spread across borders to North Ubangi province. In Kenya, health services are limited, particularly in rural areas, and facilities may lack essential medicines and equipment. The advisory underscores ongoing regional transmission concerns and advises travelers to weigh health risks against benefits before travel.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ拡大を受けケニア渡航の再考を勧告
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境拡大し、米国が渡航勧告レベルを引き上げるなど、国際的拡大と渡航制限の両方が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアおよび米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしアウトブレイクの起点であるコンゴ民主共和国（北ウバンギ州）は対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: An Giang ghi nhận thêm ổ dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Giang records another outbreak of African swine fever.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever outbreak in An Giang Province, Vietnam, with the latest case at hamlet Chom Sao in Hon Dat commune, where 11 infected pigs were culled (weight >300 kg). This marks the 12th ASF outbreak in the province this year. As of Oct 18, 2026, 12 outbreaks have occurred across 8 communes: Bình An, Thạnh Đông, Thạnh Lộc, Châu Thành, Đông Hòa, Giồng Riềng, Gò Quao and Hon Dat. Nearly 500 pigs have been infected or culled, weighing over 14 tons. Authorities urge rapid zoning, containment, and strict controls on pig movement and product commerce. Farmers are advised to bolster biosecurity, sanitize facilities, limit access of people and vehicles, and report suspicious cases. Do not sell, transport, slaughter, or discard carcasses of sick pigs; authorities will handle culling and disposal.

triage.headline_ja: アンザン省でアフリカ豚熱の新たな発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は豚のみに感染する動物疾病でヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはなく、ベトナムで継続的に発生している既知の家畜疾病であり、国際的な緊急性や社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、ベトナム国内の養豚業における家畜衛生・経済上の問題として地方当局が対応中の事案。公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: South Sudan to simulate suspected virus case to test emergency response - Radio Tamazuj
article.articleSummary: South Sudan will run a full-scale simulation from 19 to 23 October 2026 to test preparedness for Bundibugyo Ebola Virus disease (BVD) in Juba, Yei and Yambio. The scenario begins with a suspected BVD case detected at Juba International Airport and reported to the Emergency Operations Centre, activating a rapid-response to coordinate surveillance, infection prevention and control, patient transport, and isolation. Led by the National Public Health Institute, the exercise aims to strengthen prevention, detection, and response to public health emergencies and to identify coordination gaps among health professionals, emergency responders, and government bodies. Nimule is deferred to a second phase due to budget constraints. Authorities monitor cross-border movement from the DRC Nabanga area (Ibba County), estimating 2,000–3,000 people returning and being screened and monitored, with no confirmed diagnoses reported.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダン、緊急対応能力をテストするため疑い症例のシミュレーションを実施へ
triage.triage_reason: 実際のエボラ感染症例ではなく、南スーダンが緊急対応能力を検証するための訓練（シミュレーション）であり、確定診断例の報告もない。
triage.notes: 記事は南スーダンにおける疑いエボラ（BDBV）症例対応訓練についての報道であり、実際の感染事例は確認されていない。DRCとの国境地域からの移動者2,000-3,000人を監視中だが、確定診断なし。南スーダンおよびDRCの実際の発生は報告されていないため対象国の実発生としては該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Dünya çapında salgın uyarısı: Çok yüksek riskli bir tür giderek yayılıyor
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global outbreak warning: A very high-risk strain is spreading rapidly.
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization warns that the deadly Ebola strain once controlled in Uganda continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with cross-border transmission now classified as very high and threatening neighboring states. Ongoing violence between military forces and armed groups drives population displacement, crowded camps, and limited access to safe water, food, shelter and essential health services, fueling transmission. Health facilities in conflict zones struggle to operate, hampering case finding, contact tracing, and outbreak surveillance. Inadequate infection control in healthcare settings and in funeral rites involving direct contact emerge as major amplification factors. Early case detection, accelerated laboratory testing, and timely supportive care for patients are critical to reducing mortality. Secure access and robust public health measures are urgently needed.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な感染拡大警告：非常に高リスクの株が急速に拡大している
triage.triage_reason: WHOがウガンダで制御されたはずのエボラ株がDRCで拡大し、国境を越えた伝播リスクが「非常に高い」と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ拡大を主題としており、ウガンダは過去に制御された株の出典として言及されるのみで現在の主発生国ではないため、対象国リストにも含まれないウガンダはverified_locationsから除外した。紛争地域での医療アクセス低下・葬儀慣行による感染拡大が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن ترفع مستوى التحذير من السفر إلى كينيا بسبب تفشي إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington raises travel advisory level for Kenya due to an Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, the U.S. Department of State raised Kenya's travel advisory from Level 2 (exercise increased caution) to Level 3 (reconsider travel) due to an Ebola outbreak. Kenyan health authorities confirmed eight Ebola infections in Nairobi, with Kenya reporting its first Ebola death on October 5. The outbreak in Kenya is linked to the neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, where the disease has killed at least 4,000 people. The advisory shift, while not legally binding, may affect travelers, tour operators, and insurers. Kenya's economy, reliant on safari and nature tourism, is particularly sensitive to travel-safety advisories. The situation underscores ongoing cross-border transmission concerns and East Africa Ebola dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラ出血熱の流行を受けケニアへの渡航警告レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで4000人以上の死者を出しているエボラ出血熱の流行が隣国ケニアに越境し、米国が渡航警告を引き上げるなど国際的な影響が顕在化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はケニア（対象国リスト外）だが、流行の起源・主要な死亡者数（4000人以上）はDRCに由来し、越境感染の文脈でDRCが重要な位置を占めるためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア国内の感染者数（8人）・死者数（1人）は本文に明記されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola death toll in DR Congo reaches 4,561 as cases in Kenya rise to eight
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 4,561 deaths with a case fatality rate of 48.2% as of Oct 17. Nord-Ubangi Province is reported as the eighth affected province, signaling regional spread. Africa CDC warns of the risk of further spread to neighboring countries. In Kenya, Ebola cases have risen to eight, with a new infection in a man presumed exposed to the first Kenyan patient; 38 people were tested and one was positive, with contact tracing ongoing. Kenya had confirmed its first Bundibugyo strain case earlier this month; the patient traveled from the DRC through Uganda and died. The Bundibugyo strain currently lacks an approved vaccine or specific treatment. The report highlights ongoing regional concerns and surveillance for imported cases across East Africa.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ死者数が4,561人に達し、ケニアの感染者数が8人に増加
