triage.triage_reason: DRCで死者4,561人・致死率48.2%の大規模流行が8州に拡大し、ケニアへの越境感染も複数確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに多数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・モザンビークも記事中で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。Bundibugyo株にはワクチン・特異的治療法がなく、国際的な波及リスクが高い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola kills 4,561 in DR Congo, Kenya cases rise to 8
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola toll climbs to 4,561 deaths from 9,455 confirmed cases as of 17 October, CFR 48.2%. In Kenya, confirmed Ebola cases rise to eight after a new infection detected in a man believed exposed to the country’s first Ebola patient; 38 people were tested, one positive, with contact tracing ongoing. Kenya had earlier this month confirmed its first Bundibugyo strain case, a patient who died after travelling from the Democratic Republic of the Congo through Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, heightening regional concerns about spread. Africa CDC warns of the risk of transmission to neighboring countries as authorities monitor crossings and pursue containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で死者4,561人、ケニアの症例は8人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模なエボラ流行（致死率48.2%）に加え、ケニアへの国境を越えた感染拡大が確認されており、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、国境を越えた感染拡大の重要な文脈として言及されている。ブンディブギョ株には承認されたワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch bệnh não mô cầu vẫn có thể xuất hiện ở bất kỳ đâu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease outbreaks can still occur anywhere.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis remains a threat in Vietnam, with Hanoi reporting 2 sporadic cases in 2026 to date, no deaths. In the south, Ho Chi Minh City area clusters have emerged; as of Oct 17, 2026, the southern region recorded 42 cases and 7 deaths, with approximately 94% of infections attributed to serogroup B. Outbreaks have occurred in schools and centralized facilities. Meningococcal disease is a rapidly progressing acute infection that can cause meningitis and septicemia; transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and close contact, with carriers capable of spreading. High-risk groups include children, adolescents, people in crowded settings, asplenic or immunocompromised individuals. Early warning signs include sudden fever, severe headache, nausea, vomiting, neck stiffness, photophobia, confusion, seizures, and a characteristic non-blanching rash. Vaccination is the most effective prevention; close-contact prophylaxis and strict hygiene, masking, and ventilation are advised; seek medical evaluation promptly.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症の流行はどこでも発生し得る
triage.triage_reason: 南部ホーチミン市エリアでクラスター発生（42例、死亡7例、血清群B優位）があり、学校等集団施設での感染拡大と重症化がみられるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 南部（ホーチミン市周辺）でのクラスター発生と死亡例増加が主眼。ハノイは散発例のみで死亡なし。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事内に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: واشنطن ترفع تحذير السفر إلى كينيا بسبب إيبولا ومخاطر أمنية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Washington lifts travel advisory for Kenya due to Ebola and security risks.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kenya reported a new Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, bringing total infections in the country to eight, amid heightened concern over a large Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo that has crossed the border into the North Ubangi region. The United States has elevated Kenya's travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, citing health risks alongside crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, and road safety, with risk higher in certain areas. The U.S. embassy warns of limited medical services in Kenya, especially in rural areas, where facilities commonly lack medicines and equipment. The report underscores ongoing regional EVD transmission and health-system vulnerabilities that affect travel planning and require vigilance for imported/exported risk, without detailing laboratory confirmations or infection sources.

triage.headline_ja: ワシントン、エボラと治安リスクを理由にケニアへの渡航警告を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生した大規模エボラアウトブレイクが北ウバンギ地域を越えて拡大し、隣国ケニアでも感染者が確認され米国が渡航アドバイザリーを引き上げており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの大規模エボラアウトブレイクがケニアへ越境拡大したことを主題としている。ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの感染状況（北ウバンギ地域）が主題の中心であるため含める。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: 3 bệnh nhi mắc não mô cầu sức khỏe ổn định, học sinh tiếp tục đến trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: 3 pediatric patients with meningococcal meningitis in stable condition, students continue to attend school.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B meningitis cluster linked to Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City. Four related cases reported; one fatality on 14 October; three pediatric patients remain hospitalized at the Ho Chi Minh City Hospital of Infectious Diseases with stable conditions and receiving full antibiotic therapy until discharge. From 17–19 October, no new cases among those monitored. Health authorities deployed precautionary antibiotics to 2,031 individuals, including 177 close contacts (163 students, 14 household or cohabiting persons), all given prophylaxis and daily health surveillance. A fourth case, with close contact to the first, developed fever on 15 October; PCR on 16 October confirmed serogroup B meningococcal meningitis and influenza B coinfection. Early detection, timely treatment, and coordinated preventive measures are credited with containment. Classes continue in person; no online shift, and surveillance continues through 25 October.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の小児患者3名は容体安定、生徒は通学継続
triage.triage_reason: 学校を中心とした髄膜炎菌（血清群B）クラスターでインフルエンザB共感染例も確認され、死亡例も発生していることから、WPRO基準（異常性・重症度・流行性）を満たし社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 新規症例は17〜19日間で確認されておらず、2,031名への予防的抗菌薬投与と監視体制により封じ込めが進んでいる模様。インフルエンザB共感染例の意義は不明で、続報での病原体動態の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: 2.031 người được dự phòng não mô cầu, học sinh Trường THCS Hai Bà Trưng tiếp tục đến lớp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: 2,031 people received meningococcal prophylaxis; Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School students continue to attend classes.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a meningococcal disease cluster (Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B) at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune, comprises 4 cases, including 1 death; 3 patients remain hospitalized at the National Infectious Diseases Hospital and are reported to be in stable condition as of Oct 19, 2026. From Oct 17–19, no new cases were detected. Prophylactic antibiotics have been expanded to 2,031 people linked to the school, including 163 students, 14 household contacts, plus other staff; all 177 close contacts completed prophylaxis and will be monitored through Oct 25. The school continues in-person classes, with ongoing health surveillance. Prophylaxis lowers risk but does not eliminate it; parents should seek medical care if fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, altered mental status, or purpuric rash occur. Authorities emphasize continued monitoring and targeted outbreak measures rather than broad school closure.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：2,031人が髄膜炎菌感染症の予防投薬を受け、ハイバーチュン中学校の生徒は通学を継続
triage.triage_reason: 学校内で死亡例を含む髄膜炎菌感染症クラスター（4例、うち1名死亡）が発生し、重症度と二次感染リスクが認められる一方、行政・住民の関心も高いため、経過確認のためフルリスク評価への移行を推奨する。
triage.notes: 現時点では1校内のクラスターに限定され、濃厚接触者177名全員が予防投薬を完了し10/25まで経過観察中。新規症例は10/17〜19の間確認されておらず、学校閉鎖には至っていない。今後の新規症例発生や拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: México frena importación de pollo desde Brasil por brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico halts chicken imports from Brazil due to Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of chicken meat from Brazil, including live birds, fertile eggs, and various poultry derivatives, after Brazil detected Newcastle disease on a southern turkey farm. Mexico, currently Newcastle disease–free, says the ban shields domestic poultry from this highly contagious respiratory infection, which the World Organisation for Animal Health notes causes nervous signs, drastic drops in egg production, and high mortality, while posing no significant human health risk. The Brazilian outbreak was found at a commercial turkey farm in southern Brazil; authorities closed the facility and launched control and eradication actions. This marks the second suspension of Brazilian poultry imports in about 18 months, with earlier pauses in 2025 during avian influenza outbreaks. Brazil exports roughly 30% of its poultry, and Mexico is a major international buyer.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの鶏肉輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場で発生したニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、記事内でも人への重大な健康リスクはないと明記されている。人間の公衆衛生への影響がなく、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともにほぼ該当しない。
triage.notes: 本疾患は家禽のニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクはWOAHの見解として否定されている。貿易上の措置（輸入停止）は発生しているが、公衆衛生上の危機ではなく動物衛生・貿易分野の事案であるため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: USA verschärfen Reisewarnung für Kenia wegen Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. tightens travel advisory for Kenya over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been confirmed in Nairobi, Kenya, with the first death reported on Oct 5. The most recent patient, who had contact with the initial case, is in quarantine; there is no evidence of community transmission beyond known contact chains. The U.S. Department of State raised Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3 (Reconsider travel) due to rising Ebola activity; advisories are non-binding but can affect tourism, business planning, and insurance. Kenya’s safari and nature tourism sector is economically important, making such warnings consequential. In neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, a severe Ebola outbreak persists, with at least 9,400 infections and more than 4,500 deaths since mid-May. Monitoring and response efforts continue in both countries as of 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱によりケニアへの渡航警告を強化
triage.triage_reason: ケニア(ナイロビ)での新規エボラ出血熱発生に加え、隣接するDRCでは既に9,400人感染・4,500人超死亡の深刻な流行が継続しており、米国が渡航警告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的な関心・影響が大きいためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア(ナイロビ)でのエボラ発生と米国の渡航警告強化だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、DRCの深刻な流行（9,400例・4,500人超死亡）が具体的数値とともに言及されており、実質的な感染症イベントとして verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Ethiopia Health Ministry intensifying Ebola outbreak preventive measures
article.articleSummary: Ethiopia's Health Ministry in Addis Ababa, along with the Ethiopian Public Health Institute, regional health bureaus and partners, intensifies Ebola virus disease prevention after confirmed cases in neighboring Kenya. Measures include health screenings at air and land entry points, expanded laboratory testing capacity, isolation facilities, rapid response teams, and strengthened disease surveillance with round-the-clock monitoring of travelers from affected countries. The public is urged to report suspected Ebola cases or symptoms such as vomiting and bleeding. Kenya confirmed its first Ebola case on Oct 6; the index patient, a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3. Kenya later confirmed an eighth Ebola case on Oct 19, 2026, in a 49-year-old patient attendant. Ethiopia’s actions aim to prevent cross-border entry and enable swift response as of Oct 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エチオピア保健省、エボラ出血熱の予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来とみられるエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境し複数例が確認され、隣国エチオピアも渡航者スクリーニングを強化するなど、国際的拡大とIHR基準複数該当が認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき案件と判断。
triage.notes: ケニア・エチオピアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし感染源とされるDRCは対象国リストに含まれるため記載。実際の患者発生国（ケニア）の情報は参考情報として考慮。

article.articleHeadline: Rèn thói quen rửa tay cho trẻ khi ở trường giúp phòng ngừa dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Instilling handwashing habits in children at school helps prevent disease outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: Handwashing with soap and clean water at school reduces transmission of influenza, hand-foot-and-mouth disease, diarrhea, and other respiratory and gastrointestinal infections. The article explains how classrooms and shared objects facilitate spread and why children often touch their eyes, nose, and mouth. Key handwashing times include on arrival, before and after meals, after using the toilet, after play or outdoor activities, after coughing or sneezing, when hands are dirty, and before going home. The recommended 20-second routine uses six steps, with rinsing and drying using a clean towel; avoid shared towels. If water or soap is unavailable, alcohol-based sanitizer can be used temporarily but does not replace washing for dirty hands. Parents and schools should model good hygiene, ensure access to soap and water, and reinforce positive routines; seek medical care for fever, breathing problems, dehydration, rashes, or persistent illness, and keep sick children at home.

triage.headline_ja: 学校での手洗い習慣づけが感染症予防に役立つ
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、一般的な手洗い啓発・予防啓発記事であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発的な健康教育コンテンツであり、具体的な発生事例や症例数データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: 受伤流浪狗咬人后几分钟莫名死亡 当事人：已第一时间打了疫苗和血清蛋白
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Injured stray dog dies inexplicably within minutes after biting someone; the involved party says they had vaccines and serum protein administered at the first opportunity.
article.articleSummary: On October 18 in Tianjin, a woman released a video after being bitten by an injured stray dog she found near her car. The dog bit her for several minutes and then inexplicably died shortly after. The woman immediately sought medical care, receiving rabies vaccines and serum protein. She posted the clip to warn others not to approach injured dogs, noting that aggression can intensify when dogs are hurt. Netizens urged immediate rabies-related treatment for potential exposure, specifically rabies vaccines and immunoglobulin. The piece highlights ongoing concern about rabies risk from stray dogs and the importance of prompt post-exposure prophylaxis. The article does not report laboratory confirmation of rabies, but discussions centered on the high likelihood the dog carried the rabies virus and the need for rapid vaccination and immunoglobulin if exposed.

triage.headline_ja: 負傷した野良犬、人を噛んだ数分後に原因不明の死亡 当事者「すでにワクチンと血清タンパク質を接種済み」
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別咬傷事例であり、狂犬病の検査確認もなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性、国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 狂犬病の検査確認なし。個人の咬傷エピソードであり、既知の風土病リスクの範囲内の報道。

article.articleHeadline: US raises Kenya travel advisory to Level 3 over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Eight confirmed Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease cases in Kenya as of October 19, 2026, including health workers who treated the first patient and a relative of the deceased. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, which has affected the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The United States raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3 (Reconsider Travel) on October 19, citing health risks, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and transportation hazards. The CDC has issued a Travel Health Notice for Ebola Bundibugyo Virus Disease in Kenya, with a separate notice for the DRC. WHO declared the Congo/Uganda Ebola outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. The advisory notes limited medical services in Kenya, potential medical evacuation at traveler expense, and lists areas designated Level 4 within Kenya; travelers are advised to monitor media, avoid demonstrations, secure travel insurance with evacuation coverage, and enroll in the Smart Traveler Enrollment Program (STEP).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱を理由にケニアへの渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、WHOがPHEICを宣言済みのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行であり、米国が渡航勧告を引き上げるなど国際的関心・影響が大きいためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は主にケニアへの渡航勧告だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはブンディブギョ株流行の発生国として記載されているため対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Keluarga Ungkap Kondisi Ibunda Marsha Aruan Sebelum Meninggal, Sempat Masuk ICU hingga Alami Infeksi Pernapasan : Okezone Women
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Marsha Aruan's Mother's Condition Revealed by Family Before Her Death: She Was Admitted to the ICU and Suffered a Respiratory Infection: Okezone Women.
article.articleSummary: In Jakarta, Indonesia, Lisa Diana Tambunan, mother of actress Marsha Aruan, died on 19 October 2026 after an ICU admission for a respiratory infection. Family member Benjamin Tambunan said she had suffered from a respiratory infection for months, with low oxygen saturation and flecks in the right lung. She underwent about a month of treatment, improved enough to be discharged home, but her breathing deteriorated and she was admitted again on 18 October 2026 at about 14:00 WIB. She died following ICU care. The funeral arrangements were reported at Ukrida Hospital’s funeral home in Kebon Jeruk, West Jakarta. The report notes the illness was respiratory in nature; no laboratory confirmation or infection source is provided in this account. One death linked to the respiratory infection; no outbreak details are indicated.

triage.headline_ja: マーシャ・アルアンさんの母親、死去前の容態を家族が公表:呼吸器感染症を患いICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 個人の死亡事例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態やアウトブレイクを示す情報がなく、社会的・政治的関心も個人的な芸能ニュースの範囲にとどまる。
triage.notes: 単一の個人死亡例であり、病原体や感染経路、アウトブレイクを示唆する情報は記載されていない。芸能人家族の個人的な健康問題報道。

article.articleHeadline: Congo's Ebola gains falter as transmission worsens in North Kivu
article.articleSummary: Ebola transmission in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsened in North Kivu, eroding gains from the Ituri epicentre. Weekly confirmed infections and deaths rose for a third straight week, with 97 new cases on Saturday—most since Oct 3—and 30 community deaths. North Kivu recorded 48 infections, ahead of Ituri’s 42; nearly half of recent infections and deaths occurred outside Ituri in the six days to Oct 18. Kenya reported eight cases linked to a Congo traveller, including three health workers. Despite some improvements noted by IOM, limited treatment capacity and delays getting suspected patients into care hamper the response. Beds for suspected cases in North Kivu are nearly full, and one in five hospitalized patients are treated outside designated facilities. In Beni, 13 of 18 new cases were community deaths; response teams were attacked in two areas and 22 decontamination homes not disinfected. Total: 9,552 infections, 4,602 deaths since outbreak began.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ対策の成果、北キブ州での感染拡大悪化により後退
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ感染・死亡者数が3週連続で増加し、北キブ州に拡大、ケニアへの越境感染例（医療従事者含む）も確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニアでの8例（うち医療従事者3名）はコンゴ渡航者由来の輸入症例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。累計9,552感染・4,602死亡の大規模アウトブレイクであり、治療能力逼迫・対応チームへの攻撃など対応上の課題も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh nhi 8,5 tháng tuổi mắc não mô cầu, hoại tử chi sau vài giờ nhập viện: "Một ca thôi đã là quá đủ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 8.5-month-old patient with meningococcal disease, limb necrosis within a few hours of admission: "Even one case is already too much."
article.articleSummary: An 8.5-month-old patient in Ho Chi Minh City’s Children's Hospital 1 developed disseminated meningococcal infection with septicemia and meningitis, progressing within hours to hemorrhagic rash and bilateral limb necrosis requiring amputation and joint debridement. Invasive meningococcal disease from Neisseria meningitidis can rapidly cause life-threatening septic shock, respiratory failure, and multi-organ dysfunction within 24 hours, with fulminant cases fatal in 6–8 hours if untreated. Early signs may resemble common infections, and a late or subtle rash complicates recognition. The case highlights substantial resource needs (antibiotics, vasopressors, ventilation) and potential costs. Transmission occurs via respiratory secretions; serogroups A, B, C, W, X, Y circulate in Vietnam. At-risk groups include children under 5 (especially under 1), teens, the elderly, residents of crowded settings, asplenia or complement disorders. Vaccination and close-contact prophylaxis, plus hygiene and rapid medical evaluation after exposure, are advised.

triage.headline_ja: 生後8.5か月の乳児が髄膜炎菌感染症を発症、入院から数時間で四肢壊死：「1例でも多すぎる」
triage.triage_reason: 単一の重症髄膜炎菌感染症例の報告であり、アウトブレイクやクラスターの情報はないため、現時点ではフルRRAに進む根拠は乏しいが、重症度が高く続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は単一症例の臨床報告であり、集団発生やヒト-ヒト感染クラスターの証拠はない。ベトナムでは血清群A,B,C,W,X,Yが流行しているとの記載があるが、これは背景情報であり本件が集団感染を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Echocardiographic findings in children with malaria: a systematic review and narrative synthesis
article.articleSummary: Seven observational studies including 550 children with malaria across Kenya, Mali, Mozambique, Uganda, Ghana and Nigeria evaluated cardiac function by transthoracic echocardiography. The review, aligned with PRISMA 2020, updates to Sept 10, 2026. Findings were heterogeneous: mild echocardiographic abnormalities at admission that improved during follow-up (Yacoub et al.); increased pulmonary arterial pressures and myocardial wall stress (Janka et al.); largely preserved LV function (Mocumbi; Murphy); high-output physiology linked to anaemia rather than universal systolic failure (Nguah; Kotlyar). The 2026 Nigerian study reported higher tricuspid regurgitant velocity, lower mean LVEF, and more abnormal TAPSE, MRV, and MAPSE versus controls. No quantitative pooling due to substantial clinical/methodological heterogeneity. Overall, paediatric malaria can involve the heart but there is no single universal cardiac phenotype; severity of anaemia and acute haemodynamics are important modifiers.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア罹患児における心エコー所見：系統的レビューと物語的統合
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は過去の観察研究に基づく系統的レビューであり、新規の公衆衛生上の異常事象や発生を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的な系統的レビュー（研究論文）であり、感染症の発生・流行イベントを報じるものではない。対象国のうちGhanaのみがCEPR対象国リストに含まれるため記載したが、実際には疾病発生報告ではなく研究データの統合分析である。

article.articleHeadline: Diare di Serpong Lagoon Tangsel Bertambah Jadi 161 Kasus, Bakteri E Coli Ditemukan di Air Warga
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Diarrhea in Serpong Lagoon, South Tangerang, Rises to 161 Cases; Escherichia coli Found in Residents' Water.
article.articleSummary: Acute diarrhea in Serpong Lagoon, Setu, South Tangerang, rose to 161 cases by 15 October 2026, with 4 patients still hospitalized at Eka Hospital. As of 12 October, 67 had recovered, 67 were on outpatient care, and 11 were in intensive care. The outbreak began after 7 October 2026 when residents reported diarrhea, fever, nausea and vomiting. Epidemiological and lab investigations detected Escherichia coli in water from the residential water treatment plant and taps, exceeding SBMKL standards and indicating continuous common-source exposure. Authorities ordered a temporary halt to piped water distribution from the Serpong Lagoon WTP; clean water is to be supplied by tanker trucks during repairs. Proposed measures include flushing, cleaning and disinfection of the WTP, checking for leaks, ensuring chlorination, and periodic water testing. Distribution should not resume until water quality meets health standards and all fixes are verified. Of the cases, 35 are toddlers (about 51.5%).

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン・セルポンラグーンの下痢、161例に増加—住民の水からE.coli菌検出
triage.triage_reason: 住民飲用水の汚染による局所的な大腸菌集団感染で重症例（ICU11名）も見られるが、原因特定済みで当局が給水停止・消毒等の対応中であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 水道水汚染による共通感染源型の下痢アウトブレイク。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く、地方自治体が給水停止・消毒等の是正措置を実施中。国際的な関心・支援要請の情報は確認されず。

article.articleHeadline: Gia tăng trẻ nhập viện do bệnh nhiễm khuẩn hô hấp khi giao mùa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in pediatric hospital admissions due to respiratory bacterial infections as the seasons change.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, during the autumn-to-winter transition in Ha Tinh Province, Vietnam, pediatric respiratory infections have risen. Over the past three weeks, pediatric visits increased 20-30% versus summer. At Thach Ha District Medical Center, 30 beds are reserved for RSV, influenza A/B, adenovirus, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and hand-foot-mouth disease, with inpatients including bronchiolitis, pneumonia, and otitis media. Ha Tinh General Hospital reports similar trends: a child with influenza A admitted and improving after about a week. The Ha Tinh General Hospital pediatric department currently treats about 80 inpatients; outpatients rise from 40-50 to 60-80 per day. Since early October, over 200 cases of influenza, RSV, and pneumonia have been recorded province-wide. Authorities emphasize hygiene, nutrition, vaccination, avoiding self-medication, and prompt medical care for fever, prolonged cough, or breathing difficulties to reduce transmission and complications.

triage.headline_ja: 季節の変わり目における小児呼吸器感染症入院の増加
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の小児呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザ等）の通常の季節変動による増加であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節の変わり目に典型的な小児呼吸器感染症の増加報告であり、地方（ハティン省）レベルの通常診療対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: Myanmar issues preventive guidelines for El Niño health risks
article.articleSummary: Myanmar, 20 October 2026: The Ministry of Health issued preventive guidelines to reduce health risks linked to El Niño. Heat-related illnesses—dehydration, heat exhaustion, and heat stroke—should be prevented by drinking plenty of water, resting in cool shaded areas, and using hats or umbrellas outdoors; limit alcohol, coffee, and sugary drinks. Water scarcity and flooding can contaminate supplies, elevating risks of diarrhea, dysentery, food poisoning, typhoid, hepatitis, and skin or eye infections; prevention emphasizes boiled or purified water, freshly cooked meals, avoiding food exposed to flies, and frequent handwashing with soap. Mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue fever and malaria can be reduced by eliminating breeding grounds, tightly covering water storage, and sleeping under treated nets. Hot, dry conditions raise wildfire, dust, and smoke risks, potentially triggering asthma and respiratory infections; wear masks during heavy dust or smoke, keep indoor air clean, and heed wildfire alerts.

triage.headline_ja: ミャンマー、エルニーニョによる健康リスクに対する予防ガイドラインを発表
triage.triage_reason: 特定の疾病発生報告ではなく、気候変動（エルニーニョ）に伴う一般的な健康リスクへの予防的ガイドライン発表であり、異常な公衆衛生事象や具体的なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は具体的な感染症の発生報告ではなく、ミャンマー保健省による季節的・気候関連の予防啓発情報である。実際の症例数や流行状況の記載はない。

article.articleHeadline: দু'দিন রাত জেগে ঠাকুর দেখার পরেই শুরু গলাব্যথা-কাশি, কী ভাবে এড়াবেন সংক্রমণ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sore throat and cough begin after two sleepless nights watching the idol—how can you prevent infection?
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, crowded Durga Puja festivities can spread viral infections causing sore throat and cough, including common cold, influenza, and COVID-19. Fever is not always present, but body aches may occur. Prevention focuses on masks in crowds, covering the nose and mouth, avoiding crowds when symptomatic, and hand hygiene. Hydration, rest, and nutritious meals with protein are advised; steam inhalation may help loosen chest congestion. Do not take antibiotics without a doctor's advice. Seek medical care if fever lasts five days or persists beyond ten days, if fever is with body pains or abdominal pain or repeated vomiting, or if shortness of breath or reduced urine occurs. Dengue testing is recommended if dengue-like symptoms accompany fever. The article also mentions safety guidance for stampede-like crowd situations.

triage.headline_ja: 二日間徹夜で祭りの神像見物をした後に喉の痛みと咳が始まった―どうすれば感染を防げるか？
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は季節的な風邪・インフルエンザ・COVID-19・デング熱に関する一般的な予防啓発内容であり、特定の発生報告や統計データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Beni mobilisée contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Beni mobilized against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Stop Ebola day in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, mobilizes communities against the Ebola outbreak. Schools, businesses, and intercity transport were suspended; only the health sector operated to raise awareness and support patients. Residents urged collective vigilance, with handwashing stations at checkpoints, though some bypass them. A month after Radjati Kamanyola recovered at an Ebola Treatment Center in Oicha, she urged trust in health teams and prompt care for symptoms. Community leader Angelus Kavutirwaki called for stronger government action to overcome resistance, ensure sensitizers are supported, and target noncompliant groups. Official numbers as of October 18 show Nord-Kivu with 2,164 confirmed Ebola cases, up 368 in ten days. Authorities imposed travel restrictions from Ituri, bans on certain gatherings, regulated public transport, and limited safe burials to 20 participants, underscoring daily community engagement in the response.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ベニ市がエボラ対策で総動員
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州で確認エボラ症例が2,164件に達し、10日間で368件増加するなど急速な拡大が続いており、渡航制限や集会禁止などの対策も講じられているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 北キブ州（Beni/Oicha）およびIturi州に関連する既存のエボラ流行の継続報道。症例数が10日で368件増加しており、拡大傾向が懸念される。渡航制限は国内（Ituri発）のものであり国際的な渡航・貿易制限ではないが、感染拡大による国際波及リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Først pest, nå apekopper: Putin står overfor nytt utbrudd i to byer | Dagens.no
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Plague, Now Monkeypox: Putin Faces a New Outbreak in Two Cities.
article.articleSummary: Two Russian metro areas face simultaneous monkeypox concerns. In St. Petersburg, four residents have tested positive and are hospitalized with moderate illness; in the Moscow region, five more people were admitted after contact with a suspected monkeypox patient and remain under medical observation with lab results pending by Rospotrebnadzor. Background notes from the CDC characterize monkeypox as a rare virus, typically from Central and West Africa, spreading from rodents and primates to humans, with symptoms usually 5–21 days post-infection. Earlier cases surfaced in February in both Moscow region and St. Petersburg: a man at Domodedovo hospital and a close contact, followed by two tourists returning from Thailand. Separately, an October death at an Irkutsk pest research institute sparked plague outbreak rumors; Moscow denied, citing pneumonia, while the WHO said the exact cause remains unknown and there is no evidence of spread.

triage.headline_ja: まずペスト、次に猿痘：プーチン氏は2都市で新たな流行に直面
triage.triage_reason: ロシア国内2都市でのMpox症例集積と、別地域でのペスト流行の噂が同時発生しており、異常性・重症例（入院）・社会的関心の高さからWPRO基準に複数該当し、フルリスク評価に進むべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（モスクワ、サンクトペテルブルク、イルクーツク）での出来事であり、対象国リストに含まれない。タイは過去症例の帰国者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、タイでの発生ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。ペストに関する噂はWHOが原因不明・拡大の証拠なしとしている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／M痘「暴增18例」創單月新高！確診數估增3倍　去「這5國」要注意
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Mpox Sees an 18-Case Surge, Setting a New Monthly High! Confirmed Cases Expected to Triple; Be Careful When Traveling to These Five Countries.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports a mpox (Monkeypox) Ib-clade surge. Through Oct 19, 2026, 18 new confirmed cases this month—the highest October total since 2024—with 16 Ib infections in adults aged 20s–40s who engaged in unsafe sex; only 2 were vaccinated. Year to date, Taiwan has 52 new mpox cases (41 local, 11 imported), for a cumulative 568 since 2022 (522 local, 46 imported). Of 30 Ib detections since May, 22 are domestic and 8 imported; imports linked to Thailand (6) and Hong Kong (2). Globally by August 2026, 44 countries/regions reported 1,867 mpox cases and 7 deaths; Madagascar, Angola, DRC, Thailand, and China have the most cases. Two-dose mpox vaccine offers about 90% protection; one dose ~40–80%. Taiwan has 112,774 with ≥1 dose, 80,847 fully vaccinated, 31,927 awaiting second dose. Public-funded vaccination at 327 clinics; paid vaccination at 8 travel clinics for exposed individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／M痘（サル痘）が「18例急増」で単月過去最高を更新！確診数は3倍に増加予想　渡航時要注意の『この5カ国』
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ibが台湾で単月過去最高の増加を示し、性的接触による市中感染拡大とワクチン未接種者の多さが確認され、国際的に拡大しているIHR懸念病原体であるため、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾CDCによる国内Mpox Ib流行報告だが、台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。世界的に症例が多い国としてDRC、タイ、中国が明記されているため、これらを発生国として採用した。マダガスカル・アンゴラは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: M痘10月已18例！疾管署示警「創近2年單月新高」：疫苗第2劑快補齊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox: 18 cases in October already! Taiwan CDC warns, 'Highest monthly total in nearly two years' as the second vaccine dose is being rapidly administered.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) outbreak in Taiwan reports 18 confirmed cases in October (through Oct 19, 2026), the highest monthly total since Oct 2024. Of these, 16 are Mpox type Ib, with 14 unvaccinated individuals. Since May, Taiwan has 30 Ib-type cases: 22 locally acquired and 8 imported (Thailand 6, Hong Kong 2). Among the 16 Ib infections, ages are predominantly 20s–40s, all with risky sexual behavior; only 2 had mpox vaccination. Transmission can occur from days before onset (1–4 days) with incubation up to 21 days; Ib-type may have broader rash and higher household spread. Total mpox cases in Taiwan for 2026 by Oct 19: 52 (41 local, 11 imported); since 2022: 568 cases (522 local, 46 imported). Globally, Aug 2026 reports 1,867 cases across 44 countries with 7 deaths; 68 countries report Ib-type. Taiwan has 327 public facilities for mpox vaccination; 31,927 still need a second dose. Public-health guidance includes avoiding high-risk contacts, masking when symptomatic, and reporting exposure/travel history; vaccination sites via DOH or 1922 line.

triage.headline_ja: 台湾でM痘、10月はすでに18例！疾病管理署が警告「過去2年で単月最多」：ワクチン第2回接種を急ぐよう呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのMpox（Clade Ib）症例が過去2年で単月最多となり、国内感染拡大とタイ・香港からの輸入例も確認されるなど異常性と国際的拡大の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）だが、輸入症例の感染源としてタイ（6例）と香港（2例、Chinaに分類）が明記されているため、これらを含めた。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 미 국무부, 케냐 여행경보 격상..."에볼라로 건강 위험
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. State Department raises Kenya travel advisory... Health risk from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department raises Kenya travel advisory to Level 3 amid rising Ebola risk. The warning follows Kenya’s Ebola outbreak linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month; by Oct 18, an additional case was confirmed, bringing the total to eight. The Level 3 alert (reconsider travel) signals heightened health risks and the strain’s spread within Kenya. The advisory notes that Kenyan health services are limited, with shortages of medicines and medical equipment, and that rural areas may lack access to facilities. Ebola presents with fever, muscle pains, vomiting, and diarrhea; for Bundibugyo ebolavirus there are currently no approved vaccines or treatments.

triage.headline_ja: 米国務省、ケニアの渡航警報を引き上げ…エボラによる健康リスク
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニアに拡大し8例確認、米国務省がレベル3渡航勧告を発令するなどIHR基準4項目すべて該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ拡大(対象国リスト外)だが、原因株はDRCから拡大したものであり、DRCが感染源として明示されているためDRCのみ対象国として計上。米国は渡航勧告発令元であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola touche huit provinces et 66 zones de santé
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak affects eight provinces and 66 health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 9,455 confirmed cases and 4,561 deaths as of 17 October 2026, according to the Ministry of Communication and Media. Eight provinces and 66 health zones are affected. Currently, 925 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 2,530 have recovered. The case fatality rate stands at 48.2%, with 80% of contacts traced. No new health zones have been affected in the last 24 hours. Eight additional patients were declared recovered on the same day. Authorities urge the public to report any symptoms or suspected cases by calling the toll-free 151 line.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ出血熱の流行が8州66保健地区に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.2%、9455例・4561人死亡という大規模流行で8州に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が48.2%と非常に高く、規模（8州66地区、9455例）から大規模国際的関心事項となっている可能性が高い。続報で国際支援の状況や渡航制限の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases down by more than half in recent weeks
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis in the Philippines shows a 55% drop in the two-week period (Sept. 17–30: 1,159 cases) from Sept. 3–16 (2,570 cases). Cumulative cases reached 13,530 as of Oct. 14, up 47% from the same period in 2025. Case fatality rate fell to 5.41% from 10.37% in 2025. The number of provinces and highly urbanized cities flagged for the disease declined from 46 to six. The DOH will continue to monitor morbidity weeks and intensify advisories against floodwater contact, with doxycycline supplies maintained in flood-prone areas. The agency is coordinating with Centers for Health Development to assess local needs, provide technical assistance, and ensure DOH measures. Health facilities offer consultations, treatment, bed capacity checks, and possible surges. Financial support channels include Zero Balance Billing, Medical Assistance to Indigent, and PhilHealth benefits. A Oct 6 memorandum directs notification to LGUs and enhanced outbreak reporting and prepositioning of medicines and diagnostic kits.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例数、直近数週間で半数以上減少
triage.triage_reason: フィリピンでレプトスピラ症の症例は減少傾向にあるが、累積症例数は前年比47%増であり、当局が継続的な監視と対策を実施しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: レプトスピラ症は毎年雨季・洪水期にフィリピンで発生する季節性疾患。本記事は症例数減少を報告する内容であり、新規の異常事態ではない。DOHによる既存の対策枠組み内での対応が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: 美 국무부, 케냐 여행경보 격상..."에볼라로 건강 위험"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. State Department raises Kenya travel advisory due to health risk from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk prompts a U.S. travel advisory upgrade for Kenya to Level 3 (reconsider travel) due to rising cases, with the outbreak spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month; by Oct 18, one more case was confirmed, bringing Kenya’s total to eight. The DRC, where the outbreak originated (declared May 15), has accumulated 9,415 confirmed cases and 4,536 deaths through Oct 16, indicating a 48.2% case-fatality rate. The affected virus is Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no approved vaccines or therapeutics exist. Transmission occurs via contact with infected animals or people, including consumption of infected animals; symptoms include fever, muscle aches, vomiting and diarrhea. Kenya’s travel advisory warns limited healthcare capacity and possible lack of facilities in rural areas. The DRC-level advisory remains at Level 4 (do not travel).

triage.headline_ja: 米国務省、エボラによる健康リスクでケニアの渡航警報を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに拡大し、死亡率48.2%と極めて高く、米国が渡航警報をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的な懸念が顕在化しているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアと米国は発生地域として記載されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは本イベントの発生源であり対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ワクチン・治療薬が存在しないブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスによる致死率48.2%の重大な流行で、国境を越えた拡大とそれに伴う渡航制限が既に発生している点が特徴的。

article.articleHeadline: 美 국무부, 케냐 여행경보 격상..."에볼라로 건강 위험
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. State Department raises Kenya travel advisory... Health risk from Ebola.
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department upgrades Kenya travel advisory to Level 3 due to escalating Ebola risk linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The Kenyan embassy urged travelers to reconsider travel as Ebola spreads toward Kenya; Level 3 advises reconsideration, while Level 4 is do not travel. Kenya reports eight laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases after one new case on Oct 18, with the first Kenyan case earlier this month. Medical services in Kenya are limited and rural areas may lack adequate facilities. The change follows the DRC Ebola outbreak that began May 15; by Oct 16, cumulative confirmed cases reached 9,415 with 4,536 deaths (case fatality rate 48.2%). The U.S. already lists DRC at Level 4 (do not travel).

triage.headline_ja: 米国務省、ケニア渡航警報を引き上げ…『エボラによる健康リスク』
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ出血熱（累計9,415例、致死率48.2%）がケニアに拡大し、米国が渡航警報をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的対応が強まっており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大イベント。
triage.notes: ケニアおよび米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。実際の発生源であるDRCのみを記載。ケニアへの越境拡大は国際的拡大リスクの重要な根拠として評価に反映した。

article.articleHeadline: M痘再增52例確診！Ib病毒株病例增加「已檢出30例」　症狀一次看 - 鏡週刊 Mirror Media
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: 52 more confirmed cases! Ib virus strain cases rise, with 30 cases detected — Symptoms at a glance - Mirror Media
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports 30 Mpox (Ib-clade) cases since May, with 22 domestic and 8 imported (Thailand 6, Hong Kong 2). By Oct 19, 2026, 18 cases were diagnosed that month—the highest October total since 2024—with 16 Ib-type, ages mainly 20s–40s who all had unsafe sex; only 2 were vaccinated. Globally, by August 2026 mpox affected 44 countries/regions with 1,867 confirmed cases and 7 deaths, led by Madagascar (426), Angola (290), DRC (207), Thailand (164), and China (154); about 56.8% of cases are in Africa. Since 2022, 145 countries have reported 193,009 cases and 536 deaths. Ib clade cross-border transmission is increasing; 68 countries have reported Ib since Jan 2024, with community transmission in four: DRC, Madagascar, Angola, and Kenya. Vaccines and antivirals are effective; Taiwan reports 112,774 with ≥1 dose, 80,847 fully vaccinated, 31,927 awaiting second dose. Public health advice urges risk-reduction during holidays.

triage.headline_ja: Mpox:新たに52例確診！Ib株の症例が増加し「30例を検出」症状まとめ - Mirror Media
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Ib系統の国際的な拡大（44カ国・地域、community transmissionが複数国で確認）と重症例・死亡例の報告があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適当。
triage.notes: 台湾のMpox国内発生状況を中心に、世界的なIb系統拡大の文脈でタイ・中国（香港含む）・DRCの症例数が具体的に言及されている。マダガスカル・アンゴラ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。台湾自体も対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: കെനിയയിൽ ആശങ്കയുയർത്തി എബോള: എട്ടാമത്തെ കേസും സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola raises concerns in Kenya: eighth case confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its eighth Ebola case in Nairobi. Health Director General Patrick Amoth stated that 38 samples were tested, with one positive. The new case involves a 49-year-old man who cleans hospital containers and clothing; he developed fever and headache and was quarantined pending test results. Kenya’s mid-October Ebola case appears linked to the first patient reported that month. Authorities have intensified containment, including isolation and contact avoidance; some frontline healthcare workers who treated the initial patient have also tested positive. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Transmission occurs via blood, secretions, and other fluids; animals such as monkeys, humans, wild boar, and pigs can harbor the virus. Prevention centers on properly cooking meat, with border controls and travel restrictions to curb cross-border spread from the Democratic Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラが懸念を高める：8例目の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）の感染が拡大しており、医療従事者への二次感染も確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントはケニア（ナイロビ）で発生しているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCは感染源として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での症例発生の記述はないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Confirms Eight Ebola Cases, Seeks Urgent Support for Outbreak Response
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases have been confirmed in Kenya, with the index case imported from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) via Uganda. Seven of the cases are linked to close contacts with the initial patient. Of 404 samples tested, eight were positive and 396 negative; results for 39 contacts are pending. Authorities identified 130 contacts, with 128 traced and placed in quarantine. The first patient died in Nairobi on October 5; EVD was confirmed on October 6. Kenya seeks stronger support to sustain surveillance, testing and isolation, including contact tracing and protection for healthcare workers, and transparent communication with communities. Civil society, including HENNET, warned inconsistent messaging could erode public confidence. The DRC outbreak persists across eight provinces, with more than 9,400 cases and about 4,500 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱8例確認、アウトブレイク対応への緊急支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、死亡例・濃厚接触者隔離を伴う新規発生国への拡大が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規エボラ発生（輸入例）だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは感染源かつ継続中の大規模流行（9,400例超、死亡約4,500人）として記事内で具体的に言及されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: 80歲嬤泰國遊染流感燒60萬！　醫：比悲傷還悲傷
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 80-year-old grandmother who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza, incurring 600,000 in medical costs! Doctor: It's sadder than sadness.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity continues in Taiwan: last week’s emergency department and outpatient visits reached 123,820 (down 5.4% week-on-week), with 159 new severe cases and 44 deaths, most due to Influenza A(H1N1). The CDC extended the public-funded antiviral program through November 15 for a second time this year. At a briefing, NTU Hospital Beihu Branch Dean Zhan Dingzheng described an imported case: an almost 80-year-old woman with diabetes and reduced lung function who traveled to Thailand in July, contracted influenza there, required ICU care for a month upon return to Taiwan, and incurred total medical costs of NT$600,000. Authorities urge vaccination, noting vaccines have mild side effects and promoting public-funded vaccination, aided by a health-coin policy to boost elderly uptake. triage.notes: 記事は台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況の定例報告。タイは患者が旅行中に感染した場所として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での流行を示す情報はない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleSummary: Taiwan remains in an active influenza season. Last week, influenza-like illness outpatient visits reached 123,820, with 159 new severe cases and 44 deaths. Influenza A dominates community transmission, with A(H1N1) accounting for about 92.7% of Type A viruses; the season has eased for four consecutive weeks but remains an active epidemic, with relief possible by early November. triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況であり、タイでの感染は個人の渡航中エピソードに過ぎず、タイ国内でのアウトブレイクを示すものではないためverified_locationsから除外した。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: 流感就醫破12萬人次、單周44死！8旬婦肺浸潤卻快篩陰 住院1個月亡
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-related medical visits exceed 120,000; 44 deaths in a single week! An octogenarian woman with pulmonary infiltrates but negative rapid test; died after one month in hospital.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports ongoing, high influenza activity. Week 41 (Oct 11–17) influenza-like illness visits reached 123,820, down 5.4% from the prior week. A-type influenza dominates, with A(H1N1) accounting for 92.7% of A strains. Last week (Oct 13–19) added 159 severe cases and 44 deaths, largely due to A(H1N1); season total 307 severe cases and 42 deaths. Severe cases are mainly ≥65 years (72.6%) with chronic diseases (86.6%); none vaccinated this season. An 80-year-old woman with coronary disease, heart failure, COPD died after hospitalization; initial URI on 9/18, right-lung infiltrates, rapid flu test positive, antivirals given, death 10/10 after ICU transfer on 10/6. Public-funded antivirals extended to 11/15; outbreak expected to taper by mid‑November. COVID-19: week 41 visits 3,873 (−27.7% w/w); 56 severe and 6 deaths this season; dominant variants PQ.16.1.1 and NB.1.8.1. International trends show Japan/Singapore rising; HK/S Korea above baseline; US/Canada/Europe rising; China down. Public health guidance stresses early antiviral eligibility, vaccination, hand hygiene, masks, and returning to school after recovery.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザ受診者12万人超、1週間で44人死亡！80代女性、肺浸潤陽性も迅速検査は陰性、入院1か月後に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザ(A型H1N1優位)の重症・死亡例増加が報告されているが、例年の季節的流行パターンの範囲内であり、国際的異常事象としての明確な根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾における季節性インフルエンザ流行であり、対象国リストに台湾は含まれない。中国・香港・韓国・日本・米国等は国際的流行動向の比較データとして言及されているのみで、イベントの主たる発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 米、ケニアへの渡航再考を勧告　エボラ感染拡大で警戒引き上げ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. urges reconsideration of travel to Kenya as Ebola infections spread, alert raised.
article.articleSummary: U.S. State Department raises Kenya travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3 amid rising Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) infections. As of Oct. 18, Kenya reports one new case, total confirmed infections reaching eight. The upgrade follows the regional Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with cross-border spread suspected. U.S. embassy notes Kenya’s healthcare system is limited, with shortages of medicines and equipment in many areas. The advisory urges travelers to reconsider travel to Kenya due to health risks, alongside other threats such as crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, and road safety concerns. Some regions are at higher risk than others.

triage.headline_ja: 米、ケニアへの渡航再考を勧告　エボラ感染拡大で警戒引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で発生したエボラ出血熱がケニアへ国境を越えて拡大し、米国が渡航勧告を引き上げるなど国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが現実化しているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよび米国はトリアージ対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCが流行の起点として明記されているため対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu trẻ mắc tay chân miệng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Signs of severe hand, foot and mouth disease in children.
article.articleSummary: Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease (HFMD) in children in Hanoi, Vietnam, is caused mainly by enteroviruses, notably Enterovirus 71 (EV71) and Coxsackieviruses. Most children recover in 7–10 days, presenting with fever, oral ulcers, and vesicular rashes on hands, feet, knees, and buttocks. EV71 is associated with severe neurological and cardiovascular complications, which can emerge early, typically days 2–5, potentially by day 7. Severity is not predicted by the number of skin lesions; signs of CNS or autonomic involvement may include startle reflex, altered consciousness, poor sleep, irritability, or seizures. Alarm features include fever >39°C or fever >48 hours with vomiting, lethargy, or irritability, plus tachycardia with cold extremities, rapid breathing, or SpO2 <94%, indicating possible complications requiring hospital care. Parents should monitor for 7–10 days, ensure hydration, practice good hygiene, and avoid self-medication or unnecessary antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 子どもの手足口病重症化のサイン
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハノイでの手足口病（EV71含む）に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、アウトブレイクの規模や症例数増加等の情報がないため、現時点では経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は手足口病の重症化サインに関する保護者向け啓発情報であり、具体的な流行状況・患者数の急増等は記載されていない。続報で症例数の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : huit provinces et 66 zones de santé touchées au 17 octobre - Mali Actu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: eight provinces and 66 health zones affected as of October 17 - Mali Actu
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) affects eight provinces and 66 health zones as of October 17, 2026. The official tally reaches 9,455 confirmed cases and 4,561 deaths, with 925 patients currently isolated or hospitalized and 2,530 recovered. Eight additional recoveries were reported on the reporting day. The case-fatality rate stands at 48.2%. Since October 12, the totals rose by 311 cases and 151 deaths, reflecting continued transmission across an expanded geographic footprint (one additional province and health zone). Contact tracing coverage has reached 80%, up from 77.6% five days earlier. No new health zone was reported as affected in the last 24 hours. Authorities urge the public to report suspected cases or symptoms by calling the toll-free number 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：10月17日時点で8州66保健ゾーンが影響を受ける - Mali Actu
triage.triage_reason: 大規模なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで症例数・死亡者数が多く致死率48.2%と非常に高い。複数州に拡大しており国際的関心・対応が必要なため。
triage.notes: 致死率48.2%と非常に高く、症例数9,455件、死亡4,561件の大規模アウトブレイク。継続的な感染拡大と地理的拡大が確認されており、既にWHO等による継続的な国際支援が行われている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kanpur News: नहीं थम रहा बुखार, एक और युवक की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kanpur News: The fever is not subsiding; another young man dies.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kanpur Dehat district in Uttar Pradesh reports an ongoing fever outbreak with rising dengue and malaria cases. A 30-year-old man, Nirmal Kumar, from Ajad Nagar, Rasoolabad, died after several days of fever; his condition worsened on Tuesday morning and he was declared dead at a Community Health Centre. In the past six weeks, the district has seen 12 fatalities linked to the feverish illness. Patients are described with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, cold symptoms, and skin problems, while authorities note dengue and malaria spreading in the area with changing weather. Family members attribute the death to fever. The body was sent for postmortem at Rasoolabad, and police will act following the autopsy report.

triage.headline_ja: カンプールニュース：熱は収まらず、また一人の若者が死亡
triage.triage_reason: カンプール・デハト地区で6週間にわたりデング熱・マラリアによる発熱症例が継続し、12名の死亡が報告されており、地域住民の関心も高いためWPRO基準を満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 季節性のベクター媒介感染症（デング熱・マラリア）の地域的流行であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、継続的な死亡例の発生と地域での関心の高さからWATCHではなくPICKUPと判断。続報での死者数・対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleSummary: Taiwan faces an active influenza season, with community transmission dominated by influenza A, particularly A/H1N1 (92.7% of A-type). An almost 80-year-old grandmother who had never received flu vaccine traveled to Thailand in July–August, contracted influenza, required ICU care for a month, and incurred over NT$600,000 in medical bills abroad. Taiwan's CDC reports ongoing high activity: last week, influenza-like illness outpatient/inpatient visits reached 123,820; 159 new severe influenza cases and 44 deaths were recorded. Health authorities expect domestic influenza activity to subside by early November. Since Oct 1, free influenza and COVID vaccines have been administered, with about 3.4 million flu doses and 1.07 million COVID doses by Oct 19. The Healthy Coin program incentivizes vaccination; people 18+ can earn coins for vaccines. Officials urge seniors (65+) and high-risk individuals to vaccinate promptly, noting concurrent administration of flu and COVID vaccines is safe.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザワクチン未接種でタイ旅行、「60万元の損失」―80代の祖母が感染し1か月入院

triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況（CDC統計、ワクチン接種キャンペーン等）であり、タイは個人の旅行先として言及されているのみ。台湾・タイともに今回の対象国リストの主題条件を満たさないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: M痘「19天增18例」創新高！疾管署示警赴這「5國家」多注意
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox: 18 new cases in 19 days hit a new high! Taiwan CDC warns: travelers to these five countries should be more vigilant.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox (Mpox) in Taiwan hit 18 new cases by October 19, 2026, the highest October tally this year. Among these, 16 are Clade Ib mpox virus, ages mainly 20s–40s, with all reporting unsafe sexual behavior; only 2 had mpox vaccination. Taiwan's CDC cautions rising international mpox activity, especially in Southeast Asia, noting Thailand as a key source due to travel volumes. In Taiwan, 52 mpox cases were newly confirmed in October up to Oct 19 (41 locally transmitted, 11 imported), bringing cumulative since June 2022 to 568 cases (522 local, 46 imported). Since May, 30 Ib-type cases have been detected in Taiwan (22 local, 8 imported), with infections predominantly from Thailand (6) and Hong Kong (2). Globally, as of August, 44 countries/regions reported 1,867 confirmed mpox cases and 7 deaths; Madagascar, Angola, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Thailand, and China accounted for most. Ib-type has been reported in 68 countries since 2024; WHO notes higher risk among high‑risk sexual behavior groups, while general population risk remains low.

triage.headline_ja: エムポックス「19日間で18例増加」過去最高に！台湾疾病管制署が渡航注意の『5か国』を警告
triage.triage_reason: Mpox Clade Ibの症例が台湾で急増し、国際的な拡大（タイ・中国・コンゴ民主共和国等）が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 7旬婦遊泰國染流感！慘噴60萬才回國 專家籲接種疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 70-year-old woman who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza! Spent 600,000 before returning home; experts urge vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports influenza activity remains above the epidemic threshold but is easing, while COVID-19 has exited the pandemic phase. In Week 41, influenza outpatient visits reached 123,820, down 5.4% from the prior week, with 159 new influenza severe cases and 44 deaths; COVID-19 outpatient visits totaled 3,873, down 27.7%, and the past seven days saw 25 local severe COVID-19 cases with 6 deaths. Public funds for influenza antivirals have been extended through November 15 amid ongoing transmission and the approaching respiratory-infection season. Authorities also urge vaccination, especially for the elderly, to reduce severe outcomes and death. A notable case involves a 70+ woman with diabetes and poor lung health who contracted influenza during a Thailand trip in July–August, requiring ICU care and a month in a Thai ward; total costs exceeded NT$600,000 after returning to Taiwan. Novavax COVID-19 vaccine started yesterday (1,265 first-day doses); Moderna doses reached 28,914.

triage.headline_ja: 70代女性がタイ旅行中にインフルエンザに感染！帰国までに60万台湾元超を費やす、専門家はワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19の定例サーベイランス報告であり、個別の重症化事例も既知の季節性疾患によるもので、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾CDCの定例週次報告記事。タイは個人旅行者の感染経験地として言及されているのみで、アウトブレイクの発生国ではない。Taiwanは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 香港9岁男童发烧、咳嗽5日后死亡，官方：肺炎链球菌呈阳性，诊断为肺炎并发脓胸、败血性休克及急性肾衰竭，接触者至今没出现病征，正调查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong 9-year-old boy dies after 5 days of fever and cough; officials say positive for Streptococcus pneumoniae, diagnosed with pneumonia with empyema, septic shock and acute renal failure; contacts have not shown symptoms to date; investigation ongoing.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a fatal case of invasive pneumococcal disease in a 9-year-old boy. Streptococcus pneumoniae was detected in pleural fluid, and clinical diagnosis was pneumonia with empyema, septic shock, and acute renal failure. Illness began October 10; clinic visits on October 10 and 13, hospital transfer October 14, and death on October 15. Public Health officials are conducting further bacterial testing and serotype analysis; the case will be referred to the coroner, and contacts have not shown symptoms to date. The investigation notes no travel during the incubation period. Hong Kong data indicate about 3% of pediatric invasive pneumococcal disease cases have been fatal in the past decade. Invasive pneumococcal disease includes meningitis, bacteremia, and pneumonia. Vaccines include PCV13 (6 weeks–5 years) and PPV23 (2+ years); neither is part of the public immunization program and vaccines are self-funded, with PPV23 especially recommended for older adults and high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 香港9歳男児、発熱・咳5日後に死亡、肺炎球菌陽性と判明 肺炎に膿胸・敗血性ショック・急性腎不全を併発、接触者は現時点で無症状、当局調査中
triage.triage_reason: 侵襲性肺炎球菌感染症による単発の小児死亡例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の急速な拡大や国際的拡大の証拠はないが、血清型解析など続報を要するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 侵襲性肺炎球菌感染症は既知の病原体によるもので、散発例として報告。渡航歴なく、接触者に症状なし。血清型解析結果など続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Triệu chứng, cách phòng bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Symptoms and prevention of meningococcal disease
article.articleSummary: Four meningococcal disease cases (serogroup B) were reported at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, as of Oct 19, 2026. One student died; three others are in stable condition at Hospital for Tropical Diseases and are receiving full antibiotic treatment. The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health says the transmission chain has been cut and the cluster is under control, allowing students to return to school; no online classes will be implemented. Public health guidance emphasizes early detection and treatment to reduce severe complications and death. Preventive measures include regular handwashing with soap and water, wearing masks in public places, avoiding contact with cases, and environmental cleaning with standard cleaners; ensure good ventilation and nutrition, and coordinate with health authorities for ongoing surveillance. The article highlights ongoing vaccination and outbreak monitoring by health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症の症状と予防法
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター（4例、死亡1例）が発生したが、保健当局は感染連鎖を遮断し管理下にあると発表しており、国際的拡大の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 当局によりクラスターは制御済みと報告されているが、死亡例が出ており学校という閉鎖環境での感染拡大リスクがあるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: M痘疫情升溫！10月確診18例創2年單月新高　僅2人打過疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox outbreak heats up! 18 confirmed cases in October, the highest monthly total in two years; only two people have been vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan CDC reports 18 new Monkeypox (Mpox) cases in October through Oct 19, the highest monthly total since Oct 2024; 16 Ib-type, 2 vaccinated. Ages 20s–40s with high-risk sexual activity; only 2 vaccinated. Year-to-date through Oct 19, 2026: 52 confirmed Mpox; cumulative 568 since Jun 2022. Since May, 30 Ib-type infections in Taiwan: 22 locally acquired, 8 imported. Globally by Aug 2026: 1,867 cases in 44 countries, 7 deaths; Madagascar 426, Angola 290, DRC 207, Thailand 164, China 154; Africa 56.8%. Since 2022: 190,009 cases in 145 countries; Ib-type in 68 countries since 2024; Clade Ib community transmission in four: DRC, Madagascar, Angola, Kenya. Vaccination: 112,774 with ≥1 dose; 88,847 fully vaccinated; 31,927 awaiting second dose. Two-dose vaccines ~90% protective; one-dose 40–80%. 327 clinics offer free two-dose Mpox vaccination. Public guidance: minimize high-risk contact, seek care for rash/fever and report exposure.

triage.headline_ja: M痘（サル痘）流行が加速！10月の確診は18例で2年ぶりの月間最多、ワクチン接種済みはわずか2人
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのMpox（主にクレードIb）症例が2年ぶりの月間最多となり、ワクチン接種率も低い。グローバルにクレードIbの市中感染が継続する国（DRC等）があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）でのMpox流行拡大だが、グローバル統計としてDRC・タイ・中国の具体的症例数とクレードIbの市中感染継続国（DRC等）が明記されているため、該当する対象国を抽出した。台湾自体は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 161 Warga Serpong Lagoon Tangsel Terserang Diare akibat Bakteri E. coli, 35 Balita
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 161 Residents of Serpong Lagoon, South Tangerang, Struck by Diarrhea Due to E. coli Bacteria, 35 Under-Five Children.
article.articleSummary: Escherichia coli-driven diarrhea outbreak in the Serpong Lagoon neighborhood, Setu, South Tangerang, with 161 total diarrhea cases recorded as of 15 October 2026, including 35 toddlers diagnosed with acute diarrhea linked to E. coli. Four patients were hospitalized at Eka Hospital. The South Tangerang Health Office (Dinkes) indicates the surge is concentrated among young children. Water testing at the local Water Treatment Plant shows E. coli levels exceeding safe limits, prompting preventive actions: avoid contaminated water, use bottled drinking water meeting health standards, and disinfect/maintain water storage tanks and taps. Rotavirus vaccination is emphasized as long-term protection against severe diarrhea, starting at two months of age. Authorities also stress PHBS (Clean and Healthy Living Behavior) and household hygiene to cut transmission, including handwashing with soap and routine septic-tank maintenance. Parents are urged to seek care for dehydration signs in children and vulnerable groups.

triage.headline_ja: 南タングラン、セルポンラグーン住民161人が大腸菌によると見られる下痢に罹患、うち35人は5歳未満児
triage.triage_reason: 水道水からE. coli汚染が検出され、161人（うち乳幼児35人）が下痢症を発症し4人が入院。当局が水質検査と対策を講じており、社会的・行政的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 地元自治体（南タングラン保健局）が水質検査と衛生対策を実施中。死亡例の報告はなく、国際的拡大の兆候もないが、浄水場汚染による継続的曝露リスクがあるため経過を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: บุรีรัมย์เร่งสกัดพิษสุนัขบ้า! พบสุนัขติดเชื้อไล่กัดชาวบ้าน 5 ราย ปูพรมฉีดวัคซีนรัศมี 5 กม. - สยามรัฐ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buriram ramps up rabies control! Five residents bitten by a rabid dog; mass vaccination drive within a 5-km radius.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 Oct 2026, five Buriram residents were bitten by a dog later confirmed rabid. On Oct 13–14, 2026, a owned dog in Moo 8, Ban Thawon, Sawai Jeak Municipality, Mueang Buriram District, bit a nephew on the hand and a neighbor on the hip, then attacked others; the dog was killed and laboratory tests confirmed rabies. In response, authorities declared a 30-day temporary animal disease outbreak zone and launched a mass vaccination drive for dogs and cats within a 5-km radius, also vaccinating high-risk cattle kept in shared pens. Vaccination coverage targets more than 3,500 dogs and cats in the area. Surveillance will run six months. Ongoing rabies vaccination and sterilization programs continue; stray animals remain a challenge. Citizens should report suspected animals to authorities promptly.

triage.headline_ja: ブリーラム県が狂犬病対策を強化！感染犬が住民5人を襲撃、半径5kmで緊急ワクチン接種
triage.triage_reason: タイ国内での散発的な狂犬病発生事例であり、地域当局による封じ込め対応が既に行われているため国際的拡大のリスクは低いが、動物由来感染症として継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 狂犬病は致死率が高い疾患であり、咬傷を受けた5名への曝露後予防が重要。地域当局が迅速に封鎖区域設定とワクチン接種を実施しており、現時点で国際的な懸念事項には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Mumps incidence linked to weather and air pollution in Chongqing study
article.articleSummary: Mumps incidence in Chongqing, a mountainous, densely populated city in Southwest China, shows nonlinear and delayed links with meteorology and air pollution from 2015–2024. Using geodetectors, distributed lag nonlinear models, and bivariate response models, the study identifies temperature and carbon monoxide as the only meteorology-pollution pair with a statistically significant synergistic interaction: relative excess risk due to interaction 0.237 (95% CI 0.032–0.477) and attributable proportion due to interaction 0.232 (95% CI 0.039–0.39). Relative humidity exhibits a U-shaped association; sulfur dioxide and nitrogen dioxide show S-shaped exposure-response curves; carbon monoxide has a continuously rising association with incidence. All five factors have significant lagged effects in specific windows. The results indicate a joint association beyond additive effects but do not establish causation between any factor and individual mumps risk.

triage.headline_ja: 重慶における流行性耳下腺炎の発生率は気象と大気汚染に関連する:研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は流行性耳下腺炎の発生率と気象・大気汚染との統計的関連性を調べた学術研究であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 研究論文の紹介記事であり、具体的な症例急増やアウトブレイクの報告ではないため、対象国としての特定イベントなし。

article.articleHeadline: 今年流感季，别以为得过一次就安全 _光明网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: This year's flu season: don't think you're safe after you've had it once.
article.articleSummary: Autumn–winter respiratory infections prompt renewed influenza focus in China as of 2026-10-20, with this season displaying new patterns in influenza activity. Vaccines have shifted from quadrivalent to trivalent, prompting public questions about potential protection gaps. Antiviral drug selection is discussed amid online misinformation. Beijing You’an Hospital's Li Tongzeng, chief physician of the Respiratory and Infectious Diseases Department, integrates current surveillance data with frontline clinical observations to explain seasonal differences, clarify antiviral use and selection, and scientifically address concerns about reduced-valent vaccines. The briefing aims to dispel myths, identify appropriate prevention and treatment windows, and help the public navigate the flu season in Beijing and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: 今年の流感シーズン：一度罹患したから安心とは思わないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般向け啓発・Q&A記事であり、異常な流行や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザワクチン（4価→3価移行）や抗ウイルス薬選択に関する一般向け医療情報記事であり、異常発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil confirms outbreak of Newcastle disease on turkey farm
article.articleSummary: Brazil reports Newcastle disease outbreak on a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina, home to about 6,000 turkeys. Birds remain on site and are not intended for current meat production. Outbreak confirmation followed lab analyses of samples collected between September 21 and October 14. The premises are closed and bird movements suspended. Control measures per WOAH protocols include epidemiological monitoring in a 133-property restricted area, with teams conducting clinical assessments and sampling. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral disease in birds; the highly pathogenic form is WOAH-listed and must be reported. Brazil, the world’s largest poultry exporter with over 37% of global market share, will inform the WOAH and trading partners and assess trade restrictions; exports to China may be suspended pending decisions. Consumption of officially inspected poultry remains safe; no human health risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）疾病であり人への健康リスクはないと明記されているが、貿易制限の可能性があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒトへの健康リスクがないと明記されている動物（家禽）感染症。中国は輸出停止検討対象として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 國際M痘疫情增溫！連7週報本土病例 疾管署：較去年增2成
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: International monkeypox outbreak heats up! Seven consecutive weeks of local cases reported; Taiwan CDC: up 20% from last year.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports seven straight weeks of local monkeypox cases amid an ongoing international outbreak. As of October 19, 2026, Taiwan’s CDC records 52 confirmed monkeypox cases this year (41 locally acquired, 11 imported), with 18 new cases in October and 16 identified as Ib-type, predominantly among people in their 20s–40s who had unsafe sex; only two had prior monkeypox vaccination. Cumulatively, 30 Ib-type virus strains have been detected in Taiwan (22 local, 8 imported), with Thailand the most common infection source domestically. Internationally, Ib-type transmission continues across borders, with sporadic cases in China, Australia, Japan, Singapore, South Korea, and Malaysia. WHO notes, as of August, low risk for the general public but higher risk for high-risk groups; monkeypox has a potential incubation up to 21 days. Vaccination remains the most effective preventive measure for eligible individuals.

triage.headline_ja: 国際的なエムポックス(サル痘)流行が加速！台湾で7週連続の国内症例、疾病管理署：昨年より2割増
triage.triage_reason: 台湾で7週連続のエムポックス国内感染が続き、Ib型を含む国際的な越境伝播が確認されているため、WPRO基準の複数該当と社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国リスト外）だが、国際的な越境伝播の一例として中国での散発例が明記されているため中国を抽出。タイは台湾への輸入感染の『感染源』として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での発生事例としての記述ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: M痘Ib型病例暴增！10月已新增18例創2年新高　疾管署急籲高風險族群打滿2劑疫苗｜壹蘋新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox Ib-type cases surge! October saw 18 new cases, a two-year high; Taiwan CDC urgently urges high-risk groups to receive two full doses of the vaccine.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports a surge of Ib-type Monkeypox cases, totaling 30 Ib-type infections since May (22 local, 8 imported); since 2022 Taiwan has 568 confirmed M"pox, with 522 locally acquired. Imported Ib-type cases originate from Thailand (6) and Hong Kong (2). Globally, Ib-type Monkeypox has been reported in 68 countries/regions since January 2024. The incubation can reach 21 days; infectiousness may occur 1–4 days before fever or rash. Ib-type illness presents fever, lymphadenopathy, rash and vesicles, with more widespread skin involvement and higher household transmission risk, especially for children, pregnant women, and immunocompromised individuals. Vaccination efficacy: two doses ~90% protection; one dose ~40–80%. By late September, 112,774 people had at least one dose, while 31,927 had not yet received a second dose. Free vaccination is offered at 327 clinics; eight travel-medicine centers provide paid vaccination for those not eligible. Symptoms warrant masking, prompt medical care with travel/exposure history, and reporting via 1922.

triage.headline_ja: M痘Ib型症例急増！10月はすでに18例増加し2年ぶりの高水準に　台湾疾病管理署が高リスク群に2回分のワクチン接種完了を緊急呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でMpox Clade Ib型症例が2年ぶりの高水準に急増し、タイ・香港からの輸入例も確認されており、世界68か国・地域での流行拡大を伴う異常事態であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（Taiwan）における症例急増であり、台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。タイ・香港は輸入症例の由来地として言及されているのみで、当該国での流行発生を示す記述はないため除外した。
