article.articleHeadline: 一輩子沒打過流感疫苗！8旬嬤赴泰國玩染疫「加護病房躺1個月」多噴60萬 | 祝你健康 | 三立新聞網 HEALTH.SETN.COM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Never had a flu vaccine in her life! An octogenarian grandma travels to Thailand for a trip and contracts influenza — "spent a month in the ICU" and more than NT$600,000 was spent.
article.articleSummary: An elderly Taiwanese woman, nearly 80 and with no prior influenza vaccination, contracted influenza while traveling in Thailand during the 2026 summer vacation. She required hospitalization in a Thai ICU for about a month, with medical costs exceeding NT$600,000. Taiwan’s CDC notes ongoing influenza activity and urges pre-travel vaccination. The patient has since been advised to get vaccinated. Domestic surveillance shows influenza activity in flux: Week 41 (Oct 11–17) saw 123,820 influenza-like illness outpatient visits, down 5.4% from the prior week; the prior week (Oct 13–19) recorded 159 severe influenza cases (151 H1N1, 7 influenza A untyped, 1 B) and 44 deaths (42 H1N1, 2 A untyped). The case represents a travel-related, imported infection acquired abroad. Influenza vaccines generally have mild side effects, and eligible elderly individuals are encouraged to receive vaccination, including via the public health funding program (health coins).

triage.headline_ja: 一度もインフルエンザワクチンを接種したことがない！80代の祖母がタイ旅行中に感染し「ICUで1ヶ月」、医療費60万台湾ドル超
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)に未接種の高齢者がタイ旅行中に感染した個別症例報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、台湾国内のサーベイランスも通常の季節流行の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 本記事は季節性インフルエンザ(H1N1)に関する個人の闘病エピソードであり、台湾のサーベイランスデータも例年の季節性流行の範囲内。台湾（Taiwan）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。患者がタイで感染・入院した点のみThailandとして記録。

article.articleHeadline: Africa's conflicts, Ebola outbreak halt children's education
article.articleSummary: Conflict and Ebola outbreaks in eastern DRC and disruption in Sudan have halted schooling for millions. In Sudan's North Kordofan and El Obeid, drones and fighting suspend classes, while the NRC warns displacement and damaged schools threaten education for thousands. In the DRC, 6.5 million people are displaced, half of them children; 3.5 million are on the move in North Kivu, South Kivu, and Ituri. Last year, 2,600 schools closed, leaving 130,000 children out of school. The eastern DRC is the epicenter of an Ebola Bundibugyo virus outbreak, with over 8,000 infections. In North Kivu, 24% of confirmed cases are children under five; infants under one account for 13% (Ituri 6%). From June–Sept 2026, 24 of 30 child deaths occurred at the MSF Butembo Ebola Treatment Centre, many linked to infections acquired in healthcare facilities. Calls for strengthened IPC, PPE, and trained health workers amid systems and porous borders.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカの紛争とエボラ出血熱の流行が子どもたちの教育を妨げている
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部でエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染者が8,000人を超え、小児死亡例や院内感染が報告されており、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準も複数該当するため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: スーダン（北コルドファン州・エル・オベイド）の教育混乱も記事に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。エボラ流行の主題はDRC東部（北キブ、南キブ、イツリ）。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : l'épidémie d'Ebola touche huit provinces et 66 zones de santé. 2.530 personnes déclarées guéries - Site de la chaîne AlManar-Liban
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: The Ebola outbreak affects eight provinces and 66 health zones. 2,530 people declared recovered - Site of the AlManar-Lebanon channel.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak has reached 9,455 confirmed cases and 4,561 deaths as of October 17, 2026, affecting eight provinces and 66 health zones. There are 925 patients currently hospitalized or isolated, with 2,530 recovered. The case fatality rate stands at 48.2% and contact tracing coverage is 80%. No new health zones were affected in the last 24 hours, and eight additional recoveries were reported today. Authorities urge the public to report symptoms or suspected cases by calling the toll-free line 151. This outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC's history and the deadliest on record for the country. In Kenya, a new Ebola case was confirmed on Sunday, bringing the Kenyan total to eight cases, including one death.

triage.headline_ja: DRC:エボラ流行が8州66保健地区に拡大。2,530人が回復と発表
triage.triage_reason: 9,455症例・4,561死亡・CFR48.2%という大規模流行で、DRC史上最悪のエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでも8症例（うち1死亡）が確認され国際的拡大が示唆されるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCはこれまでで最も死者数の多いエボラ流行となっている。

article.articleHeadline: M痘19天增18例創新高！Ib型占16例　疾管署籲高風險族群完成2劑疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox hits a new high with 18 new cases in 19 days; Type Ib accounts for 16 cases; CDC urges high-risk groups to complete two-dose vaccination.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising Monkeypox cases. By Oct 19, 2026, 52 confirmed this year (41 locally, 11 imported); 18 new cases in October—the highest monthly total since Oct 2024. Of the Oct 18 cases, 16 were Ib-type; most were unvaccinated. The outbreak has persisted for seven weeks domestically. Incubation up to 21 days; symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, and skin lesions/vesicles; Ib-type rash can be widespread, aiding household spread. Globally, Aug 2026 saw 1,867 cases in 44 countries with 7 deaths; since 2022 about 190,000 cases in 145 countries. Ib-type reported in 68 countries since 2024, with community transmission in DRC, Madagascar, Angola, Kenya; WHO notes moderate risk for high-risk groups. Taiwan vaccination: 112,774 with at least one dose; 80,847 fully; 31,927 one-dose. Two-dose vaccination ~90% protective; high-risk groups urged to complete two doses; seek care and disclose exposure.

triage.headline_ja: M痘、19日間で18例増加し過去最高に！Ib型が16例を占める　疾病管理署が高リスク群に2回接種完了を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でのMpox（特にIb型）感染拡大が続き、国内伝播が7週間持続し家庭内感染も報告されている。加えてDRC等でIb型の市中感染が継続しており、国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾（対象国外）のMpox流行状況だが、Ib型の市中感染が継続しているDRCも言及されているため対象国として記載。マダガスカル・アンゴラ・ケニア・台湾は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Перший спалах Еболи в Кенії: які ще смертоносні віруси ширяться світом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The First Ebola Outbreak in Kenya: What Other Deadly Viruses Are Spreading Worldwide
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first Ebola outbreak, imported by a Kenyan citizen who lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient died and infected six others, including a family member and three health workers; over 100 contacts have been traced and quarantined. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, with a case fatality around 90%. Early symptoms include fever, malaise, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, and possible hemorrhage. In neighboring Congo, the outbreak numbers reach about 9,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths, while France has confirmed its first imported Ebola case in a physician returning from humanitarian service. Globally, monkeypox has surged, with five people hospitalized in Moscow region after contact with a probable carrier. The piece notes filoviruses—Ebola, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Marburg—and recalls historic plagues. In Irkutsk, a lab incident killed a 28-year-old worker; 200 contacts quarantined; WHO seeks explanations; US advises leaving Russia.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア初のエボラ流行：世界で広がる他の致死的ウイルスとは
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでの初エボラ流行（致死率約90%、医療従事者感染含む）とDRCでの大規模流行（約9000人感染、4000人超死亡）が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア・フランス・ロシア（モスクワ・イルクーツク）など複数国の事例を含むが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ケニアの流行はDRCからの輸入例であり、DRC国内でも既存のエボラ流行（9000人感染、4000人超死亡）が継続中と記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Skrining TBC di Lapas Bontang Gunakan X-Ray Portable, Pengobatan Capai 94 Persen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: TB screening at Bontang Prison uses portable X-ray, treatment reaches 94 percent.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Bontang City Health Department conducted integrated tuberculosis screening at Lapas Kelas IIA Bontang (Jalan Prestasi, Kelurahan Bontang Lestari) as part of the Free Health Check program (CKG). The facility houses 1,814 inmates, far exceeding its 594-capacity. Screening combined symptom assessment, chest X-ray using a portable unit, and free health services for detainees and prison staff, with Lapas Kelas IIA Bontang named as the first site to receive the portable X-ray support. Mayor Neni Moernaeni emphasized health care access for inmates and the need to detect TB early to prevent airborne transmission. She noted TB treatment completion rates in Bontang are about 94%. Warden Agus Wiyono welcomed regional backing for diagnosis, treatment, and hospital referrals, and officials aim to expand screening, active case finding, and patient support.

triage.headline_ja: ボンタン刑務所でポータブルX線を使用したTBCスクリーニングを実施、治療達成率94％
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核検診・治療プログラムに関する地域保健活動の報告であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 刑務所の過密状態（定員594名に対し収容者1,814名）はTB感染リスクを高める要因だが、既存の定期的スクリーニング・治療プログラムの実施報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dấu hiệu cảnh báo cúm nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning Signs of Severe Influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza (flu) usually causes fever, cough, body aches and self-resolves within about a week, but warning signs in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam require hospital assessment. Dr. Nguyen Hoang Anh of the Infectious Diseases Unit, Tam Anh General Hospital, notes severe influenza features include shortness of breath or chest tightness, rapid breathing, inability to lie flat, and cyanosis indicating possible hypoxia; persistent or escalating chest pain; confusion or prolonged drowsiness. Fever and cough may initially improve and then worsen, signaling potential secondary bacterial pneumonia; reduced urine output and dehydration also demand care. Most patients recover without hospitalization, but individuals aged 65+, pregnant women, and those with cardiovascular or chronic lung disease, diabetes, kidney disease, or immune suppression are at higher risk for complications. Clinicians monitor oxygen saturation, lung injury, and circulation to decide on admission and consider early antiviral treatment to reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: 重症インフルエンザの警告サイン
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による季節性インフルエンザの重症化サインに関する一般的な啓発情報であり、アウトブレイクや異常事象の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bontang Temukan 441 Kasus TBC hingga Agustus 2026, Skrining Diperluas ke 73 Titik
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bontang Health Office Finds 441 TB Cases Through August 2026, Screening Expanded to 73 Sites
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) cases in Bontang, East Kalimantan, Indonesia: As of August 2026, the City Health Office had identified 441 TB cases, well below the estimated 1,132. To close the gap, screening has expanded to 73 service points as part of the Free Health Check Integrated TB program (CKG), using symptom tracing and portable chest X-ray. Mayor Neni Moernaeni, speaking on October 20, 2026, warned that TB is airborne and stressed rapid case finding and ensuring treatment completion to prevent relapse and drug resistance. Screening targets include households and close contacts. The program also reaches the Lapas Class IIA Bontang, where overcrowding (1,814 inmates vs 594 capacity) heightens transmission risk. Reported TB symptoms prompting evaluation include prolonged cough, fever, night sweats, unintentional weight loss, and fatigue.

triage.headline_ja: ボンタン保健局、2026年8月までに結核441例を確認、スクリーニングを73ヶ所に拡大
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策プログラムの進捗報告であり、国際的拡大や異常性は認められないが、刑務所の過密状況など流行しやすさの要因があるため継続監視とする。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による既存の結核対策プログラム（CKG）の実施状況報告。刑務所の過密（定員594名に対し1,814名収容）がハイリスク要因として言及されているが、地域の通常公衆衛生活動の一環であり緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : huit provinces touchées au 17 octobre 2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: Eight provinces affected as of October 17, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo affects eight provinces as of 17 October 2026. The official tally through 17 October shows a case fatality rate of 48.2%. There were 925 patients in isolation or hospitalized, and eight recoveries recorded on 17 October. Between 12 and 17 October, 311 confirmed cases and 151 additional deaths were reported, with the geographic scope expanding by one province and one health zone. The ministry notes the outbreak’s geographic extension over five days. Contact tracing coverage rose from 77.6% on 12 October to 80% on 17 October. Authorities urge the population to report any symptoms or suspected cases via toll-free 151.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱：2026年10月17日時点で8州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで8州・66保健地域に拡大し、致死率48.2%、5日間で311例・151死亡と急速に悪化しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 致死率48.2%、5日間で151死亡・311新規確認例という急速な拡大を示しており、国際的な支援・監視が必要な状況。フルリスク評価に進むべき。

article.articleHeadline: US raises Kenya travel advisory over Ebola and security concerns
article.articleSummary: Ebola cases in Kenya have risen to eight as of Sunday, with the eighth case a 49-year-old patient attendant who had cared for the first Ebola patient and tested positive while in quarantine. The initial case, a 40-year-old Kenyan man who traveled from Congo through Uganda and arrived in Kenya on Oct 3, died at Nairobi Hospital on Oct 5. In total, about 130 contacts—including health workers—have been identified; 128 remain in quarantine. Kenya reports no evidence of wider community transmission and maintains that the public risk is low with containment measures in place. The Congo outbreak remains deadly, with at least 4,000 deaths since May. The U.S. raised Kenya to Travel Advisory Level 3 (from Level 2) due to Ebola and security concerns, with Level 4 restrictions in Nairobi's Eastleigh and Kibera and parts of several counties. The advisory was updated on Oct 19.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱と治安懸念を受けてケニアへの渡航勧告を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ流行（5月以降4,000人以上死亡）に関連し、国境を越えた感染拡大と渡航制限（米国の渡航勧告引き上げ）が発生しており、IHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ症例および米国の渡航勧告だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であり継続的に死亡者が発生しているコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 沒打疫苗飛泰國染流感　8旬嬤躺醫院1個月花60萬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unvaccinated, flew to Thailand and contracted influenza; an octogenarian grandmother spent 600,000 yuan on a month-long hospital stay.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s influenza activity remains high but slowly decreasing. Last week influenza-like illness outpatient visits totaled 123,820 (down 5.4% from the prior week), with 159 new influenza-related severe cases and 44 deaths. A notable imported case involves an 80-year-old grandmother with diabetes and compromised lung function who traveled to Thailand in July–August, contracted influenza there, and spent a month in a Thai ICU, incurring over NT$600,000 in medical costs without national health insurance. In Taiwan, public-funded influenza vaccination began on Oct 1; by Oct 19, about 3.4 million doses had been administered (1.1x last year). COVID-19 vaccine doses exceed 1.07 million. A Health Coin program rewards vaccination: 900 coins for COVID-19 vaccine, 450 for influenza, and 600 for pneumococcal vaccine, launched Oct 1. Authorities urge those 65+ and with chronic diseases to vaccinate ahead of holidays to reduce severe illness and death; the wave may last into early November.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン未接種でタイ旅行中にインフルエンザ感染、80代祖母が1ヶ月入院し60万元の医療費
triage.triage_reason: 台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況報告であり、個別の輸入症例が中心。公衆衛生上の重大な異常事態ではないが、重症例・死亡者数の多さから経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況とワクチン接種推進策が主題。タイは渡航先として言及されているのみで、タイ国内の流行状況を示す内容ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: 七旬嬤沒打疫苗遊泰染流感　住加護病房一個月噴60多萬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unvaccinated septuagenarian grandmother who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza, spent more than NT$600,000 in the ICU for a month.
article.articleSummary: An unvaccinated septuagenarian grandmother who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza, becoming an imported case, and developed severe illness due to diabetes, spending more than a month in a Thai ICU before transferring to a general ward. After returning to Taiwan, she incurred over NT$600,000 in medical costs and only later accepted vaccination on a doctor's urging. Taiwan CDC data show influenza activity remains high; Week 41 (Oct 11–17) outpatient visits reached 123,820, down 5.4% from the prior week, while the previous week added 159 influenza-related severe cases and 44 deaths. Laboratory surveillance shows influenza A predominates, with A(H1N1) making up about 92.7% of detected strains. Authorities urge high-risk groups (≥65 and those with chronic diseases) to complete this season’s influenza and COVID-19 vaccinations. A physician notes vaccines are generally safe; co-administration with the COVID-19 vaccine is advised, and vaccination reduces risks of cardiovascular and cerebrovascular events.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン未接種の70代女性、タイ旅行中にインフルエンザに感染し、集中治療室に1ヶ月入院、医療費60万台湾ドル超
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの個別輸入症例であり、台湾国内の例年の流行状況を報じる内容。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 台湾（対象国リスト外）における季節性インフルエンザの個別輸入症例の報道。タイは感染地として言及されているが、タイ国内でのアウトブレイクとしての記述はなく、記事の主題は台湾の流行状況データであるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: [Infographic] Bệnh do não mô cầu: Nhận biết sớm để phòng bệnh chủ động
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: [Infographic] Meningococcal disease: Early recognition to enable proactive prevention.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) is a bacterial acute infection that can lead to septicemia and meningitis. It spreads through respiratory droplets during close contact and has the potential to trigger outbreaks. The disease is associated with significant long-term sequelae, including cognitive developmental delays, deafness, and limb loss in survivors. Mortality is estimated at 5–15%. The accompanying infographic emphasizes early recognition as a key to enabling proactive prevention and control, highlighting the public health importance of rapid identification and response to suspected cases. While the article does not specify affected countries, the core message applies to settings with close-contact exposures where meningococcal transmission can spread rapidly. Overall, heightened awareness, prompt diagnosis, and preventive measures are essential to reduce deaths and prevent disabling outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: [インフォグラフィック] 髄膜炎菌感染症：早期発見による積極的な予防
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事例ではなく、髄膜炎菌感染症に関する一般的な啓発インフォグラフィックであり、具体的な症例数や地域の記載がないため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生国・症例を報告するものではなく、一般的な疾患啓発コンテンツ（インフォグラフィック）である。ベトナムでの具体的な発生事例の言及はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Người dân làm gì để phòng bệnh khi số ca mắc cúm mùa gia tăng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What should people do to prevent seasonal influenza as cases rise?
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza remains circulating year-round in Vietnam and may rise during seasonal transitions and in cooler months. The predominant circulating subtypes are influenza A(H1N1), A(H3N2) and influenza B. Transmission occurs mainly person-to-person via respiratory droplets, with higher risk in enclosed settings. Most infections are mild, but severe disease and complications can occur, especially among adults 65+, children under 5, pregnant women (third trimester or within 2 weeks postpartum), and people with chronic conditions such as cardiovascular or chronic lung disease, kidney failure, liver cirrhosis, diabetes, or immunocompromise. Incubation is 1–4 days (mean ~2). Preventive measures include wearing masks in healthcare settings and spaces, covering coughs/sneezes, hand hygiene, avoiding touching the face, respiratory etiquette, surface cleaning, good ventilation, and maintaining health. Those with fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose should limit contact and seek medical advice; do not self-prescribe antivirals or antibiotics. Authorities will continue monitoring and updating guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザの症例増加に際し、人々は予防のために何をすべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常性や重大な公衆衛生インパクト、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの流行期における一般的な予防啓発情報であり、新規・異常な病原体やアウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Mẹo kiểm tra trên da giúp cha mẹ phát hiện dấu hiệu nguy hiểm của bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tips for skin checks to help parents detect dangerous signs of meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease in Vietnam demands urgent parental vigilance, as initial symptoms mimic flu but can rapidly progress to sepsis or meningitis. According to Infectious Disease Specialist Dr. Ngô Văn An of Medlatec General Hospital, the early course may include sudden high fever (39–40°C), headache, nausea, and fatigue, yet the illness can deteriorate within 24 hours as bacteria invade the bloodstream or meninges. Three warning signs may precede critical illness: severe leg or calf pain causing reluctance to walk; cold hands and feet despite fever; and pale or mottled skin with non‑blanching petechiae or purpura. Check rash with a transparent glass or by stretching the skin; if redness or non‑blanching color persists, seek urgent care. Rash may appear late. Incubation is about 3–4 days (1–10). Even with treatment, survivors may have long‑term sequelae such as brain injury, hearing loss, nerve damage, or amputation. Do not self‑prescribe antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: 皮膚チェックのコツ:髄膜炎菌感染症の危険な兆候を親が見つける方法
triage.triage_reason: 特定のアウトブレイク発生を報じるものではなく、医師による一般的な疾病啓発・症状解説記事であるため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は髄膜炎菌感染症の症状・警告サインに関する一般向け啓発記事であり、ベトナムでの具体的な集団発生や症例報告を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: New Myxobolus species identified in East China Sea fish
article.articleSummary: A new species of Myxobolus, M. branchiostegi, was identified from the gallbladder of Branchiostegus argentatus off Xiamen, East China Sea, Fujian Province, marking the first report of a Myxobolus infection in this host. In 28 specimens collected on 23 July 2017, six were infected (prevalence 21.4%), with infection localized to the gallbladder and no vegetative stages observed elsewhere. Mature myxospores are oval with blunt ends; two equal, pear-shaped polar capsules form an inverted V; polar tubules coil 4–6 turns. Mean spore length 9.21 ± 0.52 μm, width 7.40 ± 0.60 μm; polar capsules 4.40 ± 0.34 × 2.58 ± 0.17 μm. SSU rRNA gene fragment (1,848 bp) deposited in GenBank PV866587; highest similarity 92.0% to M. iwagiensis (distance 0.0653). Phylogenetic analyses (ML/BI) place M. branchiostegi with M. iwagiensis as sister taxa within Myxobolidae; Myxobolus and Henneguya are not monophyletic.

triage.headline_ja: 東シナ海の魚から新種のMyxobolusを同定
triage.triage_reason: 魚類寄生虫の新種分類学的記載であり、公衆衛生・動物衛生上の脅威やヒト・ヒト感染のリスクはなく、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は魚類（Branchiostegus argentatus）の胆嚢に寄生する新種粘液胞子虫（Myxobolus branchiostegi）の分類学的記載に関する学術論文であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: US raises Kenya travel advisory as Ebola cases reach eight
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases, including one death, have been confirmed in Kenya as of October 18, linked to the Bundibugyo strain from the Congo outbreak. The first Kenyan case, a man who had lived in the DRC, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi and died on October 5. A 49-year-old hospital attendant who cared for the initial patient tested positive while in quarantine, bringing the tally to eight. Authorities identified 130 contacts, with 128 traced and quarantined; two remain unlocated. No evidence of wider community transmission; risk to the general public remains low. Kenya has strengthened border screening, contact tracing, laboratory testing, and isolation. The United States raised Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3 on Oct 19; CDC issued Level 1 travel guidance. No vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo, though early supportive care can help. The broader DRC outbreak has thousands of infections and deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ症例が8件に達したことを受けケニアへの渡航勧告を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)由来のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアに越境伝播し、死亡例と医療従事者への二次感染が確認され、米国が渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的な対応が発生しているため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの二次感染とそれに伴う米国の渡航勧告引き上げだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり広範な流行が継続しているDRCを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nord-Ubangi touché par Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nord-Ubangi affected by Ebola
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak has been declared in Nord-Ubangi Province, Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Wapinda health zone, Ngama village. Governor Jean-Bosco Kotongo announced on 19 October 2026 in Gbadolite that two confirmed Ebola cases were recorded in Ngama, confirmed by the National Biomedical Research Institute (INRB). One patient died; the other is receiving care at a local health facility. Ngama lies on the border with Bas-Uele, a neighboring province already affected by Ebola, suggesting cross-border transmission from Bas-Uele into Wapinda. Following the declaration, the governor urged residents to strictly observe barrier measures to interrupt transmission of Ebola in the region. No details on reported symptoms or additional cases beyond these two have been provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: 北ウバンギ州でエボラ出血熱が発生
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で新たなエボラ出血熱の発生が確認され、死亡例も報告されており、公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの観点からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: 隣接するBas-Uele州からの越境感染が疑われており、既存のエボラ流行地域からの拡大の可能性がある。チャドは地域情報に含まれるが記事の主題ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: M痘疫情升溫！ 10月新增18例 創近2年單月新高 僅2人曾接種疫苗
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mpox outbreak on the rise! 18 new cases in October, the highest monthly total in nearly two years; only 2 people had been vaccinated.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports rising Mpox (Mpox) activity: by Oct 19, 2026, 52 confirmed cases year-to-date, with 18 new cases in October—the highest monthly total since Oct 2024 and only 2 of the October cases vaccinated. The current outbreak is dominated by the Ib-type Mpox lineage; among October cases, 16 (≈90%) were Ib-type, with ages mainly in the 20s–40s. Epidemiology shows 16 individuals engaged in unsafe sexual activity, and only 2 were vaccinated. Globally, Ib-type Mpox has been reported in 68 countries/regions since Jan 2024, notably Madagascar, Angola, DR Congo, Thailand, and Mainland China. triage.headline_ja: Mpox(エムポックス)の流行拡大！10月に新規18例、過去2年で単月最多、ワクチン接種済みはわずか2人
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でIb型Mpoxの国内伝播・輸入例が増加し、過去2年で最多の月間新規症例数を記録。国際的な人の移動を介した伝播（タイ・香港からの輸入例）が確認されており、IHR基準の異常性・国際拡大リスクの2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価への移行が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Muntaber di Tangsel Bertambah Jadi 176 Orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gastroenteritis cases in South Tangerang rose to 176.
article.articleSummary: In South Tangerang, Indonesia, in Banten province, gastroenteritis cases in the Serpong Lagoon residential area of Keranggan, Setu, Tangsel have climbed to 176 people as of 19 October 2026. The Tangsel Health Office reported cases—marked by fever, nausea, vomiting, and diarrhea—collected via Google Form from residents served by PT Arfa Putra Soegama. The tally rose from 146 cases reported on 14 October 2026. As of 20 October 2026, one resident remains hospitalized with a bacterial E. coli infection. Authorities advised temporarily stopping use of water distributed by the housing-area provider; the provider was to clean the water-treatment facilities and conduct periodic water-quality checks. Bottled drinking water has been distributed to residents while these measures are implemented.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲランの急性胃腸炎（吐き下し）患者数が176人に増加
triage.triage_reason: 水道水汚染を原因とする地域限定の胃腸炎集団発生で、1名がE.coli感染で入院しているが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生インパクトは認められず、継続的な水曝露リスクのみ該当するため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 南タンゲラン(Tangsel)の特定住宅地(Serpong Lagoon)における水道水汚染が原因と疑われる胃腸炎集団発生。保健当局は給水停止と水質検査を指示済みで、ボトル水を配布中。地域限定の国内イベントであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, leptospirosis cases decline in latest DOH report
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases totaled 22,095 in the two-week period (Sept 17–30), down from 22,479 (Sept 3–16); year-to-date 205,347 as of Oct 14, a 22% drop from 261,749 in the same period in 2025. CFR 0.38%. Eleven provinces and highly urbanized cities across nine regions remain flagged for localized increases. In Metro Manila, Manila City reported 4,048 dengue cases as of Oct 19, and Quezon City 6,302 as of Oct 12. Leptospirosis fell 55% to 1,159 cases (Sept 17–30) from 2,570 (Sept 3–16); however, YTD cases reached 13,530 as of Oct 14, up 47% from 9,188 in 2025. Six P/HUCs are flagged for leptospirosis, down from 46 previously. Leptospirosis CFR 5.41% this year (10.37% in 2025). Prevention: dengue 4S and Alas Kwatro Kontra Mosquito 4Ts; avoid floodwaters and seek early care for leptospirosis; doxycycline prepositioned in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱、レプトスピラ症の症例数が直近のDOH報告で減少
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・レプトスピラ症ともに直近2週間では減少傾向だが、レプトスピラ症は年間累計で前年比47%増加しており、継続的なモニタリングが必要。
triage.notes: DOHによる定期的な感染症サーベイランス報告。両疾患ともフィリピンの風土病であり、季節的変動の範囲内。レプトスピラ症の年間累計増加は注視が必要だが、直近トレンドは改善傾向。

article.articleHeadline: Утечка из лаборатории или естественный процесс: почему распространяется оспа обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A laboratory leak or natural process: why monkeypox is spreading
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox is spreading gradually worldwide but unlikely to spark a new pandemic. Russia reports cases in the Moscow Region and Saint Petersburg, including a Moscow Region case, another, and five in Saint Petersburg. Rospotrebnadzor says border screening under the Sanitary Shield project and real-time Perimeter analysis help identify infections and import-linked cases; national labs maintain advanced mpox tests and can detect new genetic variants. Virologist Alexander Chepurnov notes ongoing global dispersion, possibly due to waning immunity and increased mobility, though lab-leak theories are unproven. Mpox is a DNA virus with lower mutation rates than SARS-CoV-2, and transmission generally requires prolonged close contact, limiting pandemic spread. Symptoms include pustules on skin or organs, fever, malaise, myalgia, sore throat, and lymphadenopathy; severe cases may lead to multi-organ failure. Outbreaks are reported in Thailand, Portugal, Germany, France, England, Ireland; in the United States, 23 states and Puerto Rico have lab-confirmed cases.

triage.headline_ja: 実験室流出か自然現象か：なぜ猿痘(エムポックス)が拡大しているのか
triage.triage_reason: 記事はロシアにおける猿痘流行状況を中心に、複数国での散発的な感染拡大を解説する総説的内容であり、タイにおける具体的な新規発生情報は乏しいため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（モスクワ・サンクトペテルブルク）での猿痘発生状況であり、ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。タイは複数国の中で発生報告国として言及されているが詳細情報は乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Naikkan Status Kesiapsiagaan Ebola di 22 Negara
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Raises Ebola Preparedness Status in 22 Countries
article.articleSummary: WHO raises Ebola preparedness in 22 Eastern Mediterranean Region (EMR) countries, prioritizing Djibouti, Somalia, and Sudan amid conflict-driven displacement. The move follows Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, plus one confirmed case in Kenya with Congo travel history. No cases are yet in the EMR, but war, displacement, and weak health facilities hinder readiness. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus terms the region a 'center of humanitarian crisis.' From July–September, WHO assessed Djibouti, Somalia, and Sudan for surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention, and patient care, with training and supplies provided. Guidelines and tools bolster tighter regional coordination, including lab materials, traveler guidance, and community education. Barriers include detection gaps, lab confirmation, PPE shortages, and funding. Indonesia reports no cases and maintains enhanced border screening.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、22カ国でエボラ出血熱の警戒態勢を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)アウトブレイクに加え、ケニアで渡航歴のある確定症例が発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限（インドネシアの水際対策強化）が確認されるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラアウトブレイクとEMR地域（スーダン、ジブチ、ソマリア等、対象国リスト外）への警戒強化。インドネシアは症例なく水際対策のみのため発生国として含めず。ケニア・ウガンダ・スーダン・ジブチ・ソマリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: EUA elevam alerta de viagem para o quénia devido ao ébola e à insegurança - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. raises travel alert for Kenya due to Ebola and insecurity - O País - The truth as news
article.articleSummary: U.S. raised Kenya’s travel alert to level 3 from 2, with level 4 restrictions in Eastleigh and Kibera, Nairobi, and other counties, amid an Ebola outbreak and security concerns. By Oct 19, 2026, Kenya reports eight Ebola cases, including a quarantined caregiver who tested positive; the patient is a 49-year-old companion of the first confirmed case. Health authorities say quarantined contacts are tested if symptomatic; six other patients are stable after supportive care. About 130 contacts have been identified; 128 remain in quarantine after the first case’s death on Oct 5. The first patient was a 40-year-old Kenyan who traveled from the DRC via Uganda to Kenya on Oct 3 and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood and bodily fluids or contaminated materials; no evidence of widespread community transmission; population risk remains low. Kenya is strengthening surveillance and reassuring residents and visitors.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱と治安悪化を理由にケニアへの渡航警告を引き上げ - O País紙
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ出血熱のヒト-ヒト感染（死亡例含む8症例、濃厚接触者130名）が確認され、米国が渡航警告を引き上げるなど国際的関心と渡航制限が既に発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニア（対象国リスト外）で発生したエボラ出血熱の集団発生。最初の患者はDRCからウガンダ経由でケニアに入国後に発症・死亡した経緯があるが、DRC国内での発生・感染拡大ではないため、ルールに従いDRCはverified_locationsから除外。地域的にはIHR/WPRO上重大な事案だが、対象国リストに該当する発生国がないため検証済み地域は空となる。

article.articleHeadline: Paralympics: போலியோ பாதிப்பு, சவாலான வாழ்க்கைப் பயணம்... முதல் தங்கப் பதக்கம் வென்ற மோனா அகர்வால்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paralympics: Polio-affected, a challenging life journey... Mona Agarwal wins her first gold medal!
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, polio-affected Indian shooter Mona Agarwal, who contracted poliomyelitis as a nine-month-old, has advanced from adversity to international success. After grappling with social stigma and financial hurdles, she found focus in sport with family support, especially her grandmother Geeta Devi. In 2021, she zeroed in on shooting, and her persistence culminated in a gold medal at the Asian Para Games in the 10-metre air rifle standing SH1 event, scoring 250.0 points and setting a new Games record. This follows a silver medal performance at Paris 2024 Paralympics, cementing her status on the world stage. Agarwal's journey underscores resilience, showing that physical challenges need not derail dreams. The India medal haul at Asian events is highlighted by her gold, representing a beacon of hope for athletes overcoming disability across the nation.

triage.headline_ja: パラリンピック：ポリオによる障害を乗り越え、困難な人生の旅...モナ・アガルワルが初の金メダルを獲得！
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はパラアスリートの人物紹介であり、ポリオの公衆衛生上の発生・流行を報じるものではないため、感染症シグナルとしての該当性はない。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツ報道であり、ポリオは選手の既往歴として言及されているのみ。感染症発生イベントではないため対象国なし。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm mùa gây biến chứng nặng, Bộ Y tế khuyến cáo 8 biện pháp phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal flu causes severe complications; the Ministry of Health recommends eight preventive measures.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal influenza is an acute infectious disease caused by influenza viruses, circulating year‑round in Vietnam with seasonal rises driven by region and weather, notably autumn–winter. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets, intensified in crowded, poorly ventilated spaces. Most infections are mild, but influenza can cause severe complications, particularly in those aged 65+, children under 5, pregnant women, women within two weeks postpartum, and individuals with cardiovascular disease, chronic lung disease, kidney failure, liver cirrhosis, diabetes, or immunodeficiency. On 20 October 2026, the Ministry of Health listed eight preventive measures: 1) wear masks in healthcare settings, public transport, crowds, or enclosed spaces; 2) cover coughs/sneezes; 3) practice hand hygiene; 4) avoid close contact with the sick; 5) maintain a healthy lifestyle and stay warm; 6) symptomatic individuals should rest, monitor, and wear a mask; avoid self-medication; 7) clean frequently touched surfaces and improve ventilation; 8) high-risk individuals should avoid crowds and seek care promptly. The Department of Preventive Medicine will continue monitoring and updating guidance.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性インフルエンザが重篤な合併症を引き起こすため、保健省が8つの予防策を推奨
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザに関する保健省の定例的な予防啓発情報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの一般的な予防啓発記事であり、異常な流行やアウトブレイクを示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Tháp: Phát hiện và xử lý nhiều ổ dịch tả lợn châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Thap Province: Detects and contains multiple African swine fever outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 20, 2026, Dong Thap Province, Vietnam, reports African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks affecting 42 pig-keeping households across 12 communes. Since the start of the year, about 790 pigs have been affected, with the total herd around 1,600 and nearly 1,500 pigs culled, weighing over 65 tons. Laboratory confirmation by the National Center for Veterinary Diagnostics II detected ASF virus in samples from pigs in Hau My and Long Khanh. In these two localities, 145 pigs sick or dead have been culled, totaling about 3.9 tons. Two outbreaks remain active, not yet past 21 days. Dong Thap houses roughly 505,900 pigs, up 4.71% year on year, with high concentrations in Tan Phuoc, My Tinh An, Cho Gao, Hung Thanh, and other districts. Authorities urge strict controls on trading/transporting sick pigs, immediate disposal of carcasses, rapid culling, and targeted outbreak containment with farmer support as required by law.

triage.headline_ja: ドンタップ省：アフリカ豚熱の複数の発生を発見・対処
triage.triage_reason: 動物の感染症（アフリカ豚熱）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されておらず、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当は限定的で社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（豚）に関する事案であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染報告はない。地方当局により管理下にあるとされており、継続的な家畜業界への影響として経過観察の価値はあるが、ヒト公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 10月M痘增18例「創單月新高」 近9成為變種Ib型-台視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In October, monkeypox (mpox) cases rose by 18, setting a new monthly record; nearly 90% were the Ib variant - TTV News Network.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s CDC reports 18 mpox (monkeypox) cases in October through Oct 19, 2026, a monthly high since Oct 2024, with October numbers potentially triple the monthly average. Of the 18, 16 were Clade Ib (89%), aged 20s–40s, all with unsafe sex; only 2 were vaccinated. Year to date: 52 confirmed cases (41 domestic, 11 imported); cumulative since 2022: 568 (522 domestic, 46 imported). Since May 2026, 30 Ib cases detected (22 domestic, 8 imported); Thailand and Hong Kong were common sources (6 and 2). Globally, Ib has spread to 68 countries since Jan 2024, with four countries currently experiencing community transmission: DRC, Madagascar, Angola, Kenya. Ib and II symptoms include fever, lymphadenopathy, vesicular rash; Ib rash is more widespread and household transmission is common. Two-dose mpox vaccination provides about 90% protection; one dose 40–80%; Tecovirimat available for severe Ib. End-Sep vaccination: ≥1 dose 112,774; 2-dose 80,847; 31,927 awaiting second dose.

triage.headline_ja: 10月のM痘（サル痘）症例が18例増加し「月間最多」を更新、約9割がIb型変異株-台視新聞網
triage.triage_reason: 台湾でクレードIbのサル痘症例が月間最多を記録し、タイ・香港からの輸入例やDRC等での市中感染拡大など国際的拡大傾向が明確であるため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内の症例動向だが、タイ・香港（中国として扱う）は輸入感染源として明示的に言及され、DRCはクレードIbの市中感染継続国として明記されているため含めた。マダガスカル・アンゴラ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Reports Newcastle Disease at Santa Catarina Turkey Farm | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting a 60-day animal health emergency across four municipalities: Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Infection confirmed Oct 18 and announced Oct 19. The 6,000-turkey Nova Itaberaba flock will be culled with cleaning and disinfection planned; bird movements are barred. Authorities will monitor about 133 neighboring properties, with veterinary teams to examine birds and collect samples for testing. Trading partners have been notified; import restrictions will follow market-specific agreements. ABPA President Ricardo Santin cited a China-related halt on Brazilian poultry exports pending Chinese decision, with potential losses not yet estimated. A previous Newcastle disease outbreak occurred in Rio Grande do Sul in July 2024. Officials say poultry products that pass official inspection remain safe to eat, and further updates will be provided as testing proceeds.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病を確認
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽疾病であり人への健康影響はほぼ無く、トリアージ基準の多くに該当しない。中国向け輸出停止という貿易影響はあるが、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）の動物衛生イベントであり、人の感染症としての直接的リスクは低い。中国が輸出停止を検討している点は貿易上の影響だが、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしては低優先度。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Import of poultry meat and products from areas in Canada and US suspended
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Hong Kong’s Centre for Food Safety suspended imports of poultry meat and products, including poultry eggs, from specified areas after WOAH notified outbreaks of highly pathogenic H5N1 avian influenza. Affected regions: Pembina Municipality, Manitoba, Canada; Stearns County and Benton County, Minnesota; and Jay County, Indiana, USA. The measure, effective immediately, aims to protect public health in Hong Kong. CFS cited that in the first six months of the year, Hong Kong imported about 24,190 tonnes of chilled/frozen poultry meat and about 20.2 million poultry eggs from the United States, with no imports from Canada. The CFS has contacted Canadian and American authorities and will closely monitor WOAH updates, taking appropriate action as the situation develops.

triage.headline_ja: カナダおよび米国の一部地域からの家きん肉・製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: H5N1高病原性鳥インフルエンザの発生はカナダ・米国の家きんに限られ、対象監視国（香港/中国は輸入停止措置を取ったのみで発生国ではない）での発生事例ではないため見送り。
triage.notes: 発生国は米国・カナダであり対象監視国リストに含まれない。香港（中国）は輸入停止という貿易制限措置の実施国であり、疾病発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ヒト感染例の報告はなく家きんのみの事例。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads to 8th province in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 20 Oct 2026, DR Congo's Ebola virus disease outbreak has spread to an eighth province, North Ubangi, after two confirmed cases and one death in the Wapinda health zone near the Central African Republic. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo virus. Besides North Ubangi, seven provinces were already affected: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and South-Ubangi. Ituri remains the principal focus, with substantial transmission in North Kivu and Haut-Uele. Confirmed infections exceed 9,400 with 4,536 deaths since the outbreak's May declaration. Community resistance and deaths predominantly occurring at home—about two-thirds—complicate control. The World Health Organization notes this is Congo's largest, deadliest Ebola outbreak and the second-largest globally after 2014–2016 West Africa. WHO Africa Regional Director Mohamed Yakub Janabi urges local leadership to build trust. Kenya reports one new case this month, bringing total to eight; cross-border vigilance is urged.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で8番目の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国史上最大・最も致死的なエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、ケニアへの越境例も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大シグナルである。
triage.notes: ケニアへの越境例が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。中央アフリカ共和国も同様に対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Raises Kenya Travel Advisory to Level 3 as Ebola Cases Reach Eight | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Eight Bundibugyo Ebola cases confirmed in Kenya as of Oct. 18, with the latest patient—a 49-year-old attendant—testing positive and identified as a contact of the first patient. The first case arrived in Kenya from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a second patient—a relative in quarantine since Oct. 14. On Oct. 19, the U.S. State Department raised Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3, warning Americans to reconsider travel due to health risks, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic dangers. Medical services may be unavailable in rural areas, and travelers could face medical evacuation costs; some areas carry separate warnings. The World Health Organization said on Oct. 16 there is no evidence of community transmission in Kenya; contact tracing and 21-day symptom monitoring of exposed contacts continue. The U.S. CDC maintains a separate Level 1 notice for Ebola in Kenya, noting prior Bundibugyo outbreaks in Uganda (2007) and DRC (2012).

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアのエボラ感染者が8人に達したことを受け渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニアで二次感染を含め8例確認され、米国が渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的対応が発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 初発患者はDRCからケニアに入国し発症・確認された輸入症例であり、二次感染者（親族・介助者）もケニア国内で確認されている。発生国は実質的にケニアであり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは感染者の出身地であり、国内発生の記載はないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Bloomberg Links MBRF Supplier to Brazil Newcastle Disease Case | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting Mapa to close the property, halt bird movements, and cull about 6,000 turkeys remaining on site. The farm reportedly supplies MBRF Global Foods SA, which ships birds to its Chapecó export plant; Bloomberg cited sources on the supplier link, with MBRF declining to comment. ABPA and Santa Catarina groups ACAV and Sindicarne-SC said birds showed no clinical signs and that poultry products passing official inspection remain safe to eat. Mapa will notify trading partners and monitor roughly 133 properties near the farm; importing countries’ decisions will shape immediate export impacts. Brazil’s 2024 Newcastle outbreak prompted halts in shipments to China and the EU. Shares of MBRF reportedly fell 4.1% in São Paulo on Oct. 19.

triage.headline_ja: ブルームバーグ、MBRFのサプライヤーとブラジルのニューカッスル病事例を関連付けて報道
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、人への公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や感染拡大リスクは報告されていない。主に貿易・農業への影響に関する報道。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽(七面鳥)におけるニューカッスル病の発生で、人への感染例や公衆衛生上のリスクは報告されていない。中国・EUへの輸出停止等、貿易への影響が主な論点。中国は過去の輸出停止先として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا ترفع تحذير السفر إلى كينيا بسبب تفشى إيبولا والمخاوف الأمنية - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States lifts its travel advisory to Kenya due to an Ebola outbreak and security concerns - Youm7.
article.articleSummary: The United States has raised Kenya’s travel advisory from level 2 to level 3 amid an Ebola outbreak and rising security concerns; select areas remain at level 4, with Americans advised not to travel to parts of Nairobi’s Eastleigh and Kibera districts and several counties. As of 2026-10-20, Kenya reports eight Ebola cases, including a 49-year-old caregiver who contracted the virus after exposure to the initial patient, who died in a Nairobi hospital on Oct 5 after arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. Six additional patients are stable and receiving supportive care. Authorities have identified about 130 contacts, with 128 under quarantine. Officials say there is no evidence of widespread community transmission and that the overall risk remains low while containment and surveillance continue. Key infection sources involve imported cases from DRC with ongoing domestic monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱の流行と治安懸念を理由にケニアへの渡航警告を引き上げ - ユーム7
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の輸入症例からケニア国内で複数の二次感染（介護者含む8例）が発生し、米国が渡航警告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的な対応が見られるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア（ナイロビ）での発生を主題としており、感染源はDRCからの輸入症例だが、DRC国内での流行拡大についての記述はないため、対象国リストに含まれるケニアおよびDRCは条件を満たさずverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Muntaber di Tangsel Naik Jadi 176 Orang - merdeka.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gastroenteritis cases in South Tangerang rise to 176 people
article.articleSummary: Gastroenteritis outbreak in Serpong Lagoon, Keranggan, Setu, South Tangerang City, Banten, Indonesia has reached 176 residents with fever, nausea, vomiting and diarrhea as of October 20, 2026, per the Tangsel Health Office. The figure, up from 146 cases reported October 14, was updated on October 20 after data were collected via a Google Form linked to customers of the water utility PT Arfa Putra Soegama. One resident remained hospitalized with a bacterial Escherichia coli infection. Health authorities advised temporarily stopping use of water distributed by the housing operator, and urged the provider to clean water treatment facilities and conduct regular water quality checks. Bottled drinking water was distributed to residents following the outbreak notification.

triage.headline_ja: 南タンゲラン市での嘔吐下痢症（ムンタベル）症例、176人に増加
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南タンゲランの特定住宅地域における水道汚染由来の胃腸炎集団発生で、既に当局が対応中であり国際的な拡大リスクは低いが、原因究明中であり継続注視が必要。
triage.notes: 単一の住宅地域（Serpong Lagoon, Keranggan, Setu）での水道水汚染による局所的な胃腸炎集団発生。E.coli感染で入院は1名のみ。当局がすでに水使用停止や水質検査の指示、ボトル水配布を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: 80歲嬤去泰國玩「多花60萬」　染流感住加護
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An 80-year-old grandmother went to Thailand for a trip, "spent NT$600,000 more," contracted influenza and was admitted to the ICU.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains in the Taiwan season with 123,820 influenza-like illness outpatient visits last week and 159 new severe cases, as cooler weather approaches and the respiratory season begins. An 80-year-old patient with diabetes and chronic lung conditions, who had never been vaccinated, traveled to Thailand this summer and contracted influenza there, requiring a month-long ICU stay and incurring about NT$600,000 in medical costs. Domestic surveillance notes ongoing circulation, but expects the season to exit in early November. The Taiwan CDC extended public-funded antiviral eligibility to influenza-like illness patients who are high-transmission groups until November 15. Authorities urge 65+ and people with chronic diseases to vaccinate against influenza and COVID-19; vaccination also earns health coins starting Oct 1 for 18+, with 900 coins for the COVID vaccine, 450 for influenza, and 600 for pneumococcal. Emphasize hand hygiene, masking when ill, and seek prompt care for severe symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 80歳の祖母がタイ旅行で「60万台湾ドル以上」出費、インフルエンザに感染しICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザの個別症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況と個別の重症例（タイ旅行中に感染）、ワクチン接種推奨策について述べているもので、通常の季節性感染症サーベイランス情報。タイは発生地域として記載されているが、感染源地としての言及であり、タイ国内での流行拡大を示すものではないため対象国リストからは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya detects eighth Ebola case
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kenya reports its eighth Ebola case in Nairobi. The latest patient is a 49-year-old man with fever, high temperature, headaches, and muscle pain; 38 people were tested, with one positive result. The man had been in quarantine since 9 October and worked as health-facility support staff (laundry), likely exposed to the virus in the room of the first Kenyan patient. That first case, a businessman in his forties who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled by car and plane via Uganda to Kenya and died on 5 October. The seven other Kenyan cases are relatives or health workers and are in stable condition. Uganda has recorded 20 cases (almost all imported from DRC) and two deaths, and had declared the outbreak over within its borders in August. Kenya has identified 130 contacts, 128 of whom have been traced and quarantined. In the DRC, the epidemic has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで8例目のエボラ感染確認

triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアおよびウガンダでのエボラ症例であるが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であり現在も大規模流行が続くDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア国内での二次感染（医療従事者・家族）が確認されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Pakar IPB: Daging Hewan Antraks Tidak Boleh Dikonsumsi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IPB Expert: Meat From Anthrax-Infected Animals Must Not Be Consumed
article.articleSummary: Anthrax-infected animal meat must not be consumed, even if cooked, according to IPB University expert Dr drh Denny Widaya Lukman. Bacillus anthracis forms durable spores that can survive for decades in the environment; in animals and humans the bacterium exists as infectious vegetative cells, while outside hosts it persists as spores. Transmission can occur when people consume meat or dairy from infected ruminants. Gastrointestinal anthrax results from contaminated foods; bacteria and toxins damage tissues and can spread via the bloodstream, causing bacteremia, sepsis, organ failure, and death. Cooking does not reliably inactivate spores. Regions with past anthrax cases require vigilance. The public is advised not to eat meat from sick or suddenly dead livestock and to report such findings to local animal health authorities to prevent wider spread. As of 20 October 2026, this guidance is emphasized in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: IPB専門家:炭疽菌感染動物の肉は消費してはならない
triage.triage_reason: 専門家による一般的な注意喚起記事であり、新規の具体的な感染事例や集団発生の報告がないため緊急性は低いが、炭疽の流行地域での継続的な警戒が示唆されており経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は専門家による啓発的な注意喚起であり、具体的な新規患者数・発生地域・感染拡大状況の記載がない。過去に炭疽の発生歴がある地域への警戒を呼びかける内容。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kasindi : appel à la dénonciation d'un cas positif en fuite - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kasindi: appeal to denounce a positive case on the run - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kasindi, Nord-Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, on the Uganda border, as of 20 October 2026. A girl tested positive for Ebola and has been on the run since the weekend, during Stop Ebola day, prompting Kasindi mayor Gilbert Bwambale to urge the public to report sightings. The authorities note that fugitive confirmed cases and untraced contacts fuel transmission; the first Kasindi case was diagnosed from a non-traced contact, triggering further confirmed cases. The latest patient is said to come from Butembo. Officials call for rapid contact tracing and strict entry-point measures; Lubiriha is cited as a past facility involved. The mayor requests a permanent ambulance to speed transfers to the Ebola Treatment Center. Kasindi, with about 140,000 inhabitants, borders Uganda, which has closed its border following the 17th Ebola outbreak.

article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian chicken meat and other poultry products after Brazil declared a veterinary sanitary emergency following Newcastle disease outbreaks in a commercial turkey farm in Rio Grande do Sul, southern Brazil, the world’s largest poultry exporter. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious respiratory disease in birds, causing nervous signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality; it poses no significant risk to humans. Mexico, which is Newcastle disease–free, extended the suspension to live poultry and fertile eggs. Brazilian authorities reported the outbreak on Sunday, Oct 18, 2026, with the farm quarantined and control/eradication measures planned. The measure, announced on Oct 19, 2026, aims to protect Mexico’s poultry production and prevent spread via imported products.

article.articleHeadline: 一9岁男童送急诊，发病5日后死亡，香港官方：肺炎链球菌呈阳性反应，潜伏期内没有外游，正调查；"子女出现发烧及呼吸道病征，尽早就医"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 9-year-old boy was brought to the emergency department and died five days after onset; Hong Kong authorities say Streptococcus pneumoniae tested positive, no overseas travel during the incubation period, under investigation; "If your child develops fever and respiratory symptoms, seek medical attention promptly."
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a 9-year-old boy who died five days after onset of fever, runny nose and cough. Pleural fluid tested positive for Streptococcus pneumoniae; diagnosed with pneumonia with empyema, septic shock and acute kidney failure. The child had no overseas travel during incubation; household contacts are asymptomatic; case under investigation and referred to the coroner. This IPD case underscores its rapid progression; HK data show about 3% of pediatric IPD cases are fatal over the past decade. Streptococcus pneumoniae colonizes the nasopharynx and can cause pneumonia, meningitis, bacteremia, sinusitis and otitis; invasive disease can follow infections or occur in immunocompromised states. Vaccines available: PCV13 for 6 weeks–5 years, PPV23 for 2+ years; vaccination is non-programmed and self-paid. PPV23 is emphasized for older adults (60+ or 65+) and those with chronic disease or immune compromise. Seek prompt medical care for fever and respiratory symptoms in children.

triage.headline_ja: 9歳男児が救急搬送され発症5日後に死亡、香港当局：肺炎球菌陽性反応、潜伏期間中の海外渡航なし、調査中；「子どもに発熱や呼吸器症状が出たら早めに受診を」

triage.notes: 侵襲性肺炎球菌感染症（IPD）は既知の病原体でヒト-ヒト感染は限定的、ワクチンも存在するため国際的拡大リスクは低いが、小児の急速進行・死亡例として香港当局が調査中であり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mandro : baisse de la fréquentation des structures sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mandro: drop in attendance at health facilities - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Mandro in the Lita health zone, Djugu Territory, Ituri Province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports a sharp decline in health facility attendance amid an Ebola outbreak. Dr. Moïse Mugisa, medical director of the Mandro referral health center, said that during the Ebola period clinic visits have fallen dramatically. Those still presenting are mainly pregnant women requiring delivery or cesarean sections; other patients arrive only when their condition becomes serious. He attributes the trend to rumors and fear of contracting Ebola in health facilities, prompting families to keep the sick at home before seeking care. Mugisa urged intensified community sensitization to encourage timely use of health services, aiming to prevent symptom escalation and improve outbreak response.

article.articleHeadline: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar: CSMC Offers Nutritional Support To 10 TB Patients
article.articleSummary: Chhatrapati Sambhajinagar Municipal Corporation (CSMC) distributed food baskets to 10 tuberculosis (TB) patients under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme (NTEP) to support treatment completion. CSMC Additional Municipal Commissioner Kalpita Pimple adopted the patients and handed out nutritional support on Monday, with Medical Health Officer Dr Ujwala Bhamre, City Tuberculosis Officer Dr Prerana Sanklecha, and NTEP staff Narayan Giri and Uddhav Kakade present. The initiative aims to provide a nutritious, balanced diet to meet TB patients’ needs, boost morale, and help them adhere to the full course of treatment. TB is curable with accurate diagnosis and consistent medical therapy; regular medication and adherence are essential, along with family and community support to reduce stigma. The Health Department of CSMC is pursuing TB elimination by combining nutritional support with guidance and assistance for patients.

article.articleHeadline: US Raises Kenya Travel Advisory to Level 3 Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports eight Ebola infections from the Bundibugyo strain; the eighth case is a hospital attendant. The index patient contracted Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, travelled via Uganda, and died after arriving at a Nairobi hospital. KEMRI and the National Virology Reference Laboratory confirmed the infections. There is no licensed vaccine or targeted antiviral for Bundibugyo; management relies on early isolation, strict quarantine, and supportive care. Transmission is not airborne; infection requires direct contact with blood or bodily fluids from symptomatic individuals. Early symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle weakness, and GI distress; bleeding may occur later. Overall public risk remains low due to isolation in monitoring centers. The U.S. raises Kenya travel advisory to Level 3; Level 4 Do Not Travel applies to Nairobi Eastleigh and Kibera, several Eastern/Coast counties, and border zones near Ethiopia. CDC urges isolation and prompt care if fever after risk-area exposure.
