triage.notes: 本イベントの主な発生国はケニア（指標症例はDRCで感染しウガンダ経由でケニアに入国・死亡）であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。DRCは感染経路上の言及に留まり、DRC国内でのアウトブレイクではないため含めていない。地域的には対象外だが、エボラの国際伝播・渡航制限という点でグローバルな公衆衛生上の重要性が高い事案。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de tuberculose chamam a atenção no Presídio Estadual de Três Passos - Três Passos News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis cases draw attention at the Três Passos State Penitentiary - Três Passos News
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis cases identified at Três Passos State Penitentiary in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, prompted a formal investigation by the Rio Grande do Sul Public Prosecutor’s Office after an August complaint alleging inadequate isolation, lack of symptomatic screening, and insufficient masks inside the facility. As of October, the State Health Secretariat confirmed 16 active tuberculosis cases associated with the prison (SINAN). Since April, at least nine cases occurred in sequence, with 10 inmates in active treatment and one transferred to Carazinho. One detainee was hospitalized for a week between late June and early July. Authorities say the prison infrastructure prevents full isolation of suspected or diagnosed inmates at intake and during processing of test results, increasing transmission risk to staff, family visitors, and lawyers. The 2nd Regional Health Coordination notes this is not labeled an outbreak due to inmate turnover, but a cluster requiring intensified surveillance, prevention, and control.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・パソス州立刑務所で結核症例が注目を集める - トレス・パソス・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内で結核クラスター（16例）が確認され、隔離不備による感染拡大リスクが指摘されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の可能性は低く、地域的な公衆衛生対応事案と判断される。
triage.notes: 刑務所という閉鎖環境における結核クラスターであり、地域保健当局により『アウトブレイクではなくクラスター』と明言されている。人の出入りが多い施設のため今後の推移を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В Санкт-Петербурге подтверждены пять случаев заражения оспой обезьян
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five cases of monkeypox infection confirmed in Saint Petersburg.
article.articleSummary: Five laboratory-confirmed mpox (monkeypox) infections in Saint Petersburg, Russia, with all patients hospitalized at Botkin Hospital. As of Oct 16, five individuals are under medical observation while investigators trace contacts; patients are stable with mild to moderate illness. MPXV transmits via close contact (touching, kissing, sexual activity), contaminated objects, or animal exposure; incubation 1–21 days; common symptoms include painful skin rash, fever, lymphadenopathy, headache, myalgia, and fatigue. Earlier in October, five people were hospitalized in Moscow region as a precaution after exposure to a suspected mpox case, all asymptomatic at admission, samples taken. In February, mpox cases were reported in Russia: one patient at Domodedovo hospital, then another; on February 15, two men in Saint Petersburg who had returned from Thailand were diagnosed and treated at Botkin Hospital. Ongoing outbreak includes imported cases linked to travel.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクでサル痘（Mpox）感染者5人を確認
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでMpoxの小規模クラスター（5例、軽症〜中等症）が確認され国内の渡航関連既往例もあるが、対象国（タイ等）での発生ではなくロシア国内事例であり、対象国への直接的関連は確認できないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク、モスクワ）での発生であり、タイへの言及は2月の輸入症例（タイ帰国者）の渡航歴に過ぎず、タイ国内での発生ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: اليابان تعتزم دعم تصنيع أدوية الأمراض المعدية محليًا لتأمين الإمدادات خلال الأوبئة - بوابة الأهرام
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Japan plans to support the local manufacture of medicines for infectious diseases to secure supplies during epidemics - Al-Ahram Gate
article.articleSummary: As of October 2026, Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare plans to start offering financial subsidies to drug companies to domesticize all stages of manufacturing medicines for infectious diseases, from active ingredients to final products, to ensure stable supplies during epidemics. The initiative aims to reduce dependence on overseas sources, notably China and India, after COVID-19 highlighted supply vulnerabilities. Japanese firms currently import most active ingredients from low-cost countries. Under the proposal, government subsidies would cover up to 80% of costs for building new factories and upgrading equipment used to produce active ingredients, while the government would bear up to 50% of costs for establishing drug-manufacturing facilities and upgrading their equipment. The government will identify essential health-security medicines and select eligible firms. The Cabinet approved a national strategy in March; the FY2027 budget requests 84 billion yen for medicine manufacturing and additional funding for API production.

triage.headline_ja: 日本、感染症流行時の供給確保へ医薬品国内製造を支援する方針
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19関連だが実際の感染症発生・流行の報告ではなく、日本政府の医薬品製造支援政策に関する行政・経済ニュースであるため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は医薬品製造・サプライチェーン政策に関する内容であり、中国・インドは医薬品原薬の輸入元として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Cough and TB : लगातार हो रही खांसी कहीं TB तो नहीं, डॉक्टर ने बताया कैसे करें पहचान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cough and TB: Could a persistent cough be TB? The doctor explains how to identify TB.
article.articleSummary: Dr. L. H. Ghotekar of Lady Hardinge Medical College in Delhi explains that a persistent cough should not be ignored, as it can signal TB. If a cough lasts three weeks or more, TB testing becomes essential. Additional signs include: persistent cough with thick yellow/green sputum or coughing up blood, fever in the evenings and at night, night sweats, loss of appetite, fatigue, and chest pain on breathing or coughing. TB diagnosis involves sputum testing for TB bacteria and chest X-ray to detect lung lesions or infection; doctors may recommend further tests. With changing weather causing many to develop coughs, timely evaluation to distinguish TB from other causes is emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: 咳とTB：続く咳はTBではないか？医師が見分け方を解説
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例情報ではなく、結核症状の一般的な医療啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の異常事態や新規アウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は医師による結核症状の一般向け啓発・健康情報であり、特定のアウトブレイクや症例急増を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Tăng cường công tác phòng, chống dịch bệnh trên người trên địa bàn tỉnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Strengthening the prevention and control of human diseases in the province.
article.articleSummary: Thanh Hoa province bolsters prevention and control of human diseases following a dengue fever case in Hai Binh Ward. A dengue fever case in Hai Binh Ward has been isolated and treated at Hop Luc International General Hospital. The Chairman of Thanh Hoa Provincial People’s Committee orders tighter disease control across agencies, with leaders held accountable for delays or laxity. The Department of Health must lead close monitoring of trends, forecast seasonal risks, and strengthen community surveillance to prevent spread and the emergence of outbreaks from late detection. Hospitals should ensure triage, isolation, treatment, minimize cross-infection, and secure medicines, supplies, and vaccines per MOH guidance. Other ministries address school hygiene (Education), environmental surveillance post-disaster/zoonoses (Agriculture & Environment), and travel-health messaging (Culture, Sports & Tourism). Public security, military, and Finance provide support and funding; media disseminates accurate information. Local authorities must develop response plans and run vector-control campaigns to curb dengue.

triage.headline_ja: 県内における人の疾病予防・対策の強化
triage.triage_reason: 単発のデング熱症例に対する行政の通常対応に関する内容であり、異常性・重篤性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: デング熱は東南アジアの季節性地域流行病であり、本記事は地方政府による通常の予防強化策の発表に過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: 沒打疫苗飛泰國染流感　她「噴60萬」還慘住加護一個月
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unvaccinated woman who flew to Thailand contracted influenza; she spent 600,000 and remained in the ICU for a month.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan remains in the influenza season with ongoing high activity. A reported case: an unvaccinated woman in her 80s, with diabetes and lung disease, contracted lab-confirmed influenza after a July trip to Thailand, spent a month in ICU there, and incurred about NT$600,000 before returning to Taiwan. Taiwan's CDC notes Week 41 (Oct 11–17) saw 123,820 influenza-like illness visits, down 5.4% week-on-week, while the country still reports 159 severe influenza cases and 44 deaths last week. Public health officials expect the outbreak may ease by early November if vaccination uptake increases; antiviral use extended to Nov 15. Experts emphasize vaccination, including COVID vaccines, which may reduce cardiovascular events. The Health Administration's Health Coin program grants 900 coins for COVID vaccine, 450 for influenza, 600 for pneumococcal vaccines; more elderly are being vaccinated. As of Oct 19, flu vaccines total ~3.4 million; COVID vaccines ~1.07 million; Novavax and Moderna options added.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン未接種でタイ渡航しインフルエンザ感染、女性は「60万元」を費やしICUで1カ月入院
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況を報じる記事であり、個別の重症例紹介が中心。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: 台湾(Taiwan)は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事の主題は台湾の季節性インフルエンザ流行状況だが、タイへの渡航中に感染した事例であるため発生地としてThailandを記載。実質的には台湾国内の通常インフルエンザシーズンの報道であり、季節性の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 9.500 casos y los 4.600 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, the Ebola outbreak declared in May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 9,552 infections and 4,602 deaths (97 new cases, 41 deaths in the last 24 hours). About 2,550 people have recovered; 937 are hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing is at 76.9%. The Ituri province remains the epicenter, but other provinces—North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, Ubangi South and Ubangi North—are increasingly affected, with the last 24 hours contributing 43.3% of new cases. This is the deadliest DRC outbreak to date, with projections to potentially exceed the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths (WHO). Internationally, the United States urges reconsideration of travel to Kenya after eight imported Ebola cases linked to the RDC outbreak; Kenya confirms eight cases, while Uganda had declared itself virus-free on July 28. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine or approved treatment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、感染者9,500人・死者4,600人を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が過去最悪規模に拡大し、致死率も高く、複数州への拡大と国際的な輸入症例（ケニア）も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアで8例の輸入症例が確認され、米国がケニア渡航の再考を促しているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・承認された治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、2014-2016年の西アフリカ流行を超える可能性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 9.500 casos y...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC surpasses the 9,500-case threshold and....
article.articleSummary: By 2026-10-20, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths, with 9,552 infections and 4,602 fatalities; 97 new cases and 41 deaths in the last 24 hours. 2,550 recovered; 937 hospitalized; 76.9% contact follow-up. The epicenter is Ituri (72.9% of cases) but has spread to North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, Ubangi-Sud, and Ubangi-Nord. This is the deadliest DR Congo outbreak, potentially surpassing the 2014–2016 West Africa epidemic of 28,616 cases and 11,325 deaths. The US cautions travelers to Kenya after eight imported cases tied to the DR Congo outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain with no vaccine or approved treatment. Uganda announced on July 28 that it was free of the virus after 2 deaths and 20 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行、感染者9,500人、死者4,600人の大台を突破
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が過去最悪規模に拡大し、複数州への拡大、ケニアへの輸入症例、ワクチン・治療法不在という点でIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ケニアへの輸入症例やウガンダの終息宣言も言及されているが、主題はDRCでの流行拡大であるため、対象国リストに該当するDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé: la population félicitée pour l'évolution positive de la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Haut-Uele: the population congratulated for the positive development of the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Haut-Uele, Isiro, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo, shows positive response progression as of Oct 20, 2026. The governor of Haut-Uélé congratulated residents and health workers for the evolving response to Ebola virus disease, praising community vigilance and adherence to control measures. Governor Jean Bakomito urged continued vigilance, early hospital care if unwell, and adherence to barrier measures, stressing that eradicating the outbreak requires everyone to participate in the response. He indicated that if every citizen becomes a member of the response team, the epidemic could be eradicated quickly. The official noted a decline in confirmed Ebola cases in the Isiro health zone, signaling improved control, though the outbreak is not yet finished.

triage.headline_ja: オート・ウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：対応の前向きな進展に住民に感謝状 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オート・ウエレ州（イシロ保健ゾーン）で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、症例数は減少傾向だが収束していないため、致死率の高いエボラとして継続的なリスク評価・監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のアウトブレイクの進捗（症例減少）についての行政側の発表であり新規イベントではないが、エボラは重篤度が高く既存のRRA対象として継続監視が妥当。国際的拡大リスクや外部支援の必要性については記事内に明記なし。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: 加拿大和美國部分地區爆禽流感　疫區禽產品禁供港
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian influenza outbreaks in parts of Canada and the United States; poultry products from affected areas barred from supply to Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: Avian influenza outbreaks involving highly pathogenic H5N1 have been reported in Manitoba, Canada (Municipality of Pembina) and in the United States (Minnesota’s Stearns and Benton counties, Indiana’s Jay County). Hong Kong’s Food and Environmental Hygiene Department’s Food Safety Centre issued an immediate suspension of imports of poultry meat and related products, including eggs, from these affected areas to protect public health, following WOAH notifications. In the first half of the year, Hong Kong did not import poultry meat or eggs from Canada, but imported about 24,190 tonnes of frozen/refrigerated poultry meat and roughly 20.2 million eggs from the United States. The Centre has alerted authorities in Canada and the U.S. and will continue to monitor developments and adjust measures as necessary.

triage.headline_ja: カナダと米国の一部地域で鳥インフルエンザが発生、流行地域の家禽製品が香港への供給禁止に
triage.triage_reason: 鳥インフルエンザ（H5N1）はカナダ・米国の家禽で発生しており、ヒト感染例の報告はない。対象国（香港を含む中国など）は家禽製品の輸入停止という貿易対応のみで、発生国自体が対象国リストに含まれないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域はカナダ（マニトバ州）および米国（ミネソタ州・インディアナ州）の家禽における高病原性H5N1アウトブレイクであり、ヒト感染の報告はない。香港は輸入停止措置を取った側であり、発生国ではないため対象国リストには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango brasileiro por Doença de Newcastle; entenda o que é
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports due to Newcastle disease; what is it?
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian chicken meat, live birds, and hatching eggs after confirmation of a Newcastle disease focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The focus was confirmed by MAPA and identified during an epidemiological investigation by Santa Catarina’s official veterinary service, with confirmation by the LFDA-SP, an OIE-recognized lab. The farm was quarantined and bird movements halted; MAPA notified the OIE and trading partners. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting domestic and wild birds, with symptoms including sneezing, breathing difficulties, loss of appetite, greenish diarrhea, reduced egg production, and neurological signs. Human infection is rare and usually mild. Inspected poultry remains safe to consume. Control includes rapid detection, culling, sanitation, restricting movement within 10 km, and vaccination where appropriate. Brazil exports about 30% of its poultry; prior Newcastle focus in 2024 affected exports.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止；詳細解説
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染は稀かつ軽症。貿易制限は発生しているがIHR・WPRO基準の該当数が少なく、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽の動物衛生・貿易問題であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクは低い。OIE通報・検疫措置が既に実施されている。

article.articleHeadline: México interrompe compra de frango brasileiro após surto de doença aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico halts Brazilian chicken purchases after an avian disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mexico's suspension of imports of chicken meat from Brazil, plus live birds and fertile eggs, follows Brazil's report of a Newcastle disease outbreak in a commercial turkey farm in the southern region. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious avian respiratory infection causing nervous signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality; the World Organisation for Animal Health notes it poses little risk to humans. The Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural announced the measure to protect Mexico's poultry industry, noting the country is Newcastle-free. The Brazilian farm was quarantined and control/eradication measures will be implemented. Brazil is the world's largest poultry meat exporter, so the halt affects trade in poultry products. No human health risk is implied, and the action targets imported/exported poultry products to safeguard domestic production.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、鳥インフルエンザ様疾病の発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり人への健康リスクはないとされるが、ブラジルの家禽産業・貿易に影響を与えており、動物衛生イベントとして継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 人獣共通感染症ではあるが、本記事ではヒトへの感染・健康被害は報告されておらず、主題は家禽貿易への影響。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue en Santa Fe: confirmaron el primer caso de la temporada en una mujer que viajó a Perú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Santa Fe: first case of the season confirmed in a woman who traveled to Peru.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Argentina: the season’s first confirmed case in Santa Fe is a woman who traveled to Peru; the case is serotype DEN-3 and imported, with a favorable clinical course. By Oct 10, Santa Fe reported 74 dengue-related events (including dengue during gestation); 73 were discarded and 1 confirmed. Nationally, through epidemiological week 39 of 2026, 999 suspected dengue notifications yielded 4 confirmed cases: three in Buenos Aires Province linked to travel to Brazil and Ecuador with DEN-3 detected, and one in Buenos Aires City with prior travel to Peru (serotype not yet confirmed). A probable Santa Cruz case involves a Costa Rica tourist with serotype DENV-2. Six probable cases in Salta, Corrientes, and Buenos Aires remain under investigation; 595 notifications discarded and 391 under study. Officials note an interruption of sustained local transmission but urge intensified surveillance due to travel-associated introduction of new serotypes and potential circulation in favorable conditions.

triage.headline_ja: サンタフェのデング熱：ペルー渡航歴のある女性がシーズン最初の症例として確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン国内の渡航関連（輸入）デング熱症例に関する通常のサーベイランス報告であり、持続的な地域内感染の中断が確認されている。対象国における発生でもなく、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: イベントの主体はアルゼンチン（対象国外）。ブラジル・ペルー・エクアドル・コスタリカは輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。フィリピンはBluedot付与地域に含まれるが記事サマリー内に言及なし（誤判定の可能性）。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico suspends Brazil poultry imports after Newcastle disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry on 2026-10-20 after a Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina. The restrictions cover chicken meat, poultry offal, fertile eggs, chicks up to three days old, ornamental and song birds, birds of prey, and companion birds. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral disease affecting birds. Brazil, the world’s largest chicken meat exporter, reported a case at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina. The measure aims to protect domestic poultry production, with Mexico declaring itself Newcastle-free. Brazil has been Mexico’s second-largest chicken meat supplier since 2022. Mexico was the seventh-largest importer of Brazilian chicken meat last year. In May 2025, Mexico closed its market to Brazilian poultry following a notification of a bird flu case, but reopened it once the sanitary risk eased.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病流行を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽のみに影響する動物疾患でヒトへの感染性はなく、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、ブラジル産鶏肉の輸入停止という貿易制限が発生しており、今後の拡大や関連する鳥インフルエンザ情報の有無を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本イベントはニューカッスル病（家禽の疾患）によるものであり、ヒトへの感染症リスクは報告されていない。鳥インフルエンザの疾患タグが付与されているが記事本文には言及なし。貿易上の影響（メキシコの輸入停止）が主な論点であり、公衆衛生上のフルRRAの優先度は低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: WHO grants bioMérieux's Ebola panel emergency listing amid ongoing Bundibugyo outbreak
article.articleSummary: WHO granted bioMérieux's BioFire panel an emergency use listing (EUL) to detect Bundibugyo virus (BVD), the fifth diagnostic to receive EUL amid the Bundibugyo outbreak in Central Africa, with the WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026. The BioFire global fever special pathogens panel tests 16 pathogens, including Bundibugyo, other Ebola strains, Marburg, and Lassa, from a single whole-blood sample in about one hour, enabling rapid differential diagnosis of acute febrile illness. The Democratic Republic of Congo remains the outbreak epicentre; as of 18 Oct 2026, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. On 5 Oct 2026, Kenya reported a laboratory-confirmed imported BVD case with travel history from the DRC; eight BVD cases were confirmed in Kenya by 18 Oct. No FDA-approved vaccines or antivirals exist; WHO is accelerating R&D through the PARTNERS trial (launched July 2026) evaluating remdesivir Velkury and MBP134, while a separate Phase I Oxford vaccine trial is underway with PSI, not sponsored by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、進行中のブンディブジョ・ウイルス病アウトブレイクの中、バイオメリューのエボラ検査パネルに緊急使用リスト入りを認可
triage.triage_reason: WHOがPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）を宣言済みのブンディブジョ・ウイルス病（エボラ属）アウトブレイクで、9,552症例・4,602死亡という甚大な被害とケニアへの国際的拡大（輸入症例8例確認）が報告されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOは2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言済み。ケニアへの国際的拡大が確認されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。承認済みワクチン・抗ウイルス薬は存在せず、PARTNERS試験やOxfordワクチン治験が進行中。致死率約48%と非常に高い。

article.articleHeadline: Daniel Vilela mobiliza prefeitos para conter avanço da dengue,
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Daniel Vilela mobilizes mayors to contain the spread of dengue
article.articleSummary: Goias Governor Daniel Vilela unveils a state protocol to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, designating November 26 as Dia D for the state. At a October 19 meeting with nearly all Goiás mayors, SES reported 108,540 dengue cases in 2026 (up 17% vs 2025) and 11,309 chikungunya cases (up 343%). Dengue serotype DEN-3 accounts for 53.8% of positives, while DEN-1 and DEN-2 are in decline. The plan includes extended BHU hours, a weekend reference unit, and logistics for rehydration solutions, saline, and analgesics; stock monitoring of tests and vaccines; expansion of field vector-control teams; and elimination of mosquito breeding sites, mass cleaning drives, and targeted inspections. Weekly videoconferences on Thursdays at 10:00 will update actions; investments include 5,736 ovitrampas in 104 municipalities, 3,278 EDLs, and 592 trained professionals. Wolbachia strategy progressing in Valparaíso de Goiás, Luziânia, and Anápolis, with Aparecida de Goiânia and Trindade preparing.

triage.headline_ja: ダニエル・ヴィレラ知事、デング熱の拡大抑制へ市長らを動員
triage.triage_reason: ゴイアス州でデング・チクングニア（前年比343%増）・ジカが急増し、州政府が緊急対策プロトコルを発表するなど行政的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: ブラジル国内（ゴイアス州）の既知の蚊媒介性疾患（デング・ジカ・チクングニア）の季節的流行拡大に対する州レベルの対応。チクングニア症例の前年比343%増加は注視すべき異常値だが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは記載なし。重症度（入院・死亡数）の詳細情報が不足。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola en RDC supera las barreras de los 9.500 casos y los 4.600 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the DRC has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths, with 97 new cases and 41 deaths in the last 24 hours. About 2,550 people have recovered; 937 are hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing is 76.9% complete. Ituri remains the epicenter with 72.9% of infections, though its daily share fell to 43.3% as the outbreak expands to eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, Ubangi-Sud, and Ubangi-Nord. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola, for which there is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. It is the deadliest Ebola outbreak in DRC history and could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 totals (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths) per WHO projections. Imported cases include eight in Kenya; Uganda had earlier reports of cases and deaths, with Kenya issuing travel advisories.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが9,500症例、4,600人の死亡を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクで、9,500症例超・4,600人超の死亡、8州に拡大、ケニア・ウガンダへの越境感染とケニアの渡航勧告発出がありIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC（イトゥリ州を中心に8州に拡大）のBundibugyo型エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが主題。ケニア（8例輸入）・ウガンダへの波及も言及されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認であり、DRC史上最悪規模で西アフリカ2014-2016流行を超える可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans le Haut-Uélé : les fidèles chrétiens appelés au respect des mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Upper Uele: Christian faithful urged to respect barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease persists in Isiro, the capital of Haut-Uélé (Upper Uele) province in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo. As of 20 October 2026, religious leaders were urged to strengthen barrier measures to prevent transmission. Governor Jean Bakomito met with representatives of various faiths in Isiro to reassess the health situation and emphasize continued awareness on preventive measures in churches and community settings. Pastor Pascal Bakili, speaking for the Isiro pastors' caucus, reiterated that the epidemic remains active and called on worshippers to adhere to protective practices to halt spread. The province's appeal focused on ongoing sensitization; no case counts, laboratory confirmation details, or infection sources are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: オートウエレ州のエボラ出血熱：キリスト教信者に感染防止策の順守を呼びかけ - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生リスクであり、DRCで流行が継続していることが明示されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 症例数・検査確認情報・感染源については記事に記載がなく不明。既知のエボラ流行の継続状況を示す続報と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu: les vainqueurs d'Ebola souche Bundibugyo demandent leur implication dans la riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Bundibugyo strain Ebola survivors demand their involvement in the response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola survivors in Butembo, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, demand inclusion in decisions and actions of the outbreak response. At a press briefing on the Stop Ebola day proclaimed by the North Kivu governor, survivors urged to be integrated into media campaigns, conferences, radio programs, community activities, and psychosocial support programs. Dr Raymond Kamwanga emphasized that survivors' participation would help counter rumors, reduce stigma, promote early care, and restore trust between communities and response teams. In the two health zones serving Butembo, more than a hundred people have recovered from Bundibugyo Ebola five months after the outbreak was officially declared on May 15. Three days ago, 11 people were discharged from Katwa Ebola Treatment Center: six survivors and five suspected cases whose latest tests were negative.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ブンディブギョ株エボラの生存者が対応活動への参加を要求 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 既に5月15日に公式宣言済みのブンディブギョ株エボラアウトブレイクに関する続報であり、新規発生情報ではないが、アウトブレイクが継続中であるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は既知のアウトブレイク（5月15日宣言）についての生存者支援要求に関する続報。新規性は低いが、エボラという疾患の性質上、アウトブレイクの進行状況を継続的に注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: São Carlos participa de estudo que acelera teste para tuberculose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Carlos participates in a study that accelerates TB testing.
article.articleSummary: São Carlos-based researchers from IFSC/USP report a hydroxyapatite nanoparticle sensor to accelerate tuberculosis testing. The GNano group’s sensor uses hydroxyapatite nanoparticles modified to emit light and coated with antibodies that recognize Mycobacterium tuberculosis proteins CFP10 and ESAT6. When these proteins bind, the luminescent signal shifts, yielding a result in about 30 minutes. In laboratory tests, the device differentiated samples with the target proteins from controls, with a detection limit around 132 ng/mL and a functional range of 300–500 ng/mL. This approach offers a faster, simpler alternative to culture-based confirmation and is currently a proof-of-concept, not a replacement for existing diagnostics. The nanoparticle preparation is aqueous and avoids complex fluorescence components, suggesting potential for low-cost, adaptable rapid diagnostics. Tuberculosis globally affects over 10 million cases and more than 1 million deaths annually.

triage.headline_ja: サンカルロス市、結核検査を迅速化する研究に参加
triage.triage_reason: 結核の新規診断技術に関する研究開発の記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態に関する情報ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の迅速診断技術（ナノ粒子センサー）の研究開発に関する内容であり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではないため、ブラジルは発生地域として検証されない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importações do setor avícola do Brasil após registro da Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports from Brazil's poultry sector after Newcastle disease is reported.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian poultry after confirmation of a Newcastle disease outbreak in a turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil. The measure, announced by the Mexican Ministry of Agriculture, bans chicken meat, poultry offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks up to three days old, ornamental birds and canaries, plus raptors for sale and pet birds. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting birds. Brazil is the world’s largest exporter of chicken meat; the Santa Catarina outbreak follows a confirmed farm case in turkeys. Mexico, Newcastle disease–free, says the restriction protects its avian industry. Brazil has been Mexico’s second-largest supplier of chicken meat since 2022. In May 2025, Mexico closed its market to Brazilian poultry after an avian influenza case, reopening later when risk declined.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病はブラジルの家禽（七面鳥）で確認された動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは報告されていない。貿易制限は発生しているが、人獣共通感染症としての脅威度は低いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本件はニューカッスル病（家禽の動物疾患）による貿易措置であり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害は報告されていない。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため、発生国はブラジルのみverified_locationsに計上。2025年5月の鳥インフルエンザ関連の輸入停止は別件として言及されているのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mandro : les leaders communautaires mobilisés pour restaurer la confiance - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mandro: Community Leaders Mobilized to Restore Trust - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Mandro, in the Lita health zone 25 km from Bunia in Ituri, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompts mobilization of community leaders to boost awareness, restore trust in health services, and promote rapid reporting of suspected cases. Jean Delacroix Kabwika of Alima states that community engagement is essential to successful case management, aiding community alerts, death notifications, and identification of contacts. Leaders were urged to encourage families to report symptoms and direct patients to health facilities for proper evaluation. The gathering involved customary chiefs, religious leaders, education sector actors, and other influential figures from surrounding villages and displacement sites. As of 17 July 2026, the Lita health zone had 86 cases and 52 deaths, with a transit center already operational.

triage.headline_ja: マンドロでのエボラ出血熱：地域社会のリーダーが信頼回復に向けて動員される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイツリ州でエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続中（86症例、52死亡）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染の可能性があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率約60%と高く、コミュニティの信頼構築や接触者追跡が課題となっている。ALIMA等の国際NGOが対応に関与している。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura identifica foco de doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture Identifies Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in a commercial turkey breeder in Nova Itaberaba, inland Santa Catarina, Brazil. Detected Oct 18, 2026, during an epidemiological investigation by the Santa Catarina Official Veterinary Service. Laboratory confirmation by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense of São Paulo (LFDA-SP) with recognition by the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). The establishment was interdicted and bird movements suspended. Technical teams activated under the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease, implementing cleaning and disinfection, sanitary zoning, and active surveillance in neighboring properties. Newcastle disease, caused by an Avulavirus, can infect domestic and wild birds; transmission occurs through direct contact and contaminated secretions; signs are respiratory, digestive, or neurological, with mortality varying by viral strain. Human infections are rare, usually mild conjunctivitis after direct contact with sick birds; public health risk is limited, though PPE is recommended for poultry workers. Meat and eggs under federal inspection remain safe. Formal notification to the OIE and major trading partners will follow; updates will be provided as investigations progress.

triage.headline_ja: 農務省、サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 商業七面鳥農場での局地的なニューカッスル病発生であり、人への感染は稀で軽症（結膜炎程度）、既に隔離・消毒・サーベイランス等の防疫措置が実施され制御下にあるため、人の公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家禽）事案であり、人への感染リスクは限定的。OIEへの正式通知と主要貿易相手国への情報提供が予定されているが、現時点で人の感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende compra de frango e ovos do Brasil após caso de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Suspends Imports of Chicken and Eggs from Brazil After a Case of Newcastle Disease in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of chicken meat, live poultry, and fertilized eggs from Brazil after a Newcastle disease case was confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, in western Santa Catarina state. Newcastle disease is a contagious viral infection affecting poultry and wild birds. The 6,000-plus-turkey farm had no observed symptoms; the property was quarantined for monitoring. According to Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture, 133 farms across four municipalities in western Santa Catarina are under surveillance. The case was identified during active surveillance; samples collected on 21 September; preliminary results on 14 October suggested infection, with confirmation on 18 October. Brazil activated its Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle disease, and bird movements at the site are suspended. The Mexican notification states that, despite the ban on imports, consumption of officially inspected poultry products remains safe. Brazil is the world's largest exporter of chicken meat.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、ブラジル産鶏肉・卵の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル産家禽でのニューカッスル病確認を受けメキシコが輸入停止措置を取っており、IHR基準の国際的拡大・貿易制限の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）を対象とした動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。主たる懸念は貿易制限（メキシコによる輸入停止）であり、公衆衛生上の重大性よりも経済・貿易影響が中心。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはブラジルのみ記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ngăn chặn dịch Ebola bùng phát xâm nhập vào Việt Nam qua đường hàng không
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent the Ebola outbreak from entering Vietnam via air travel.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's Civil Aviation Authority orders strict anti-Ebola measures to prevent importation via air travel, mandating rigorous disease controls, early detection, and isolation of suspected cases, with close interagency cooperation with the Ministry of Health. Airports must monitor passengers from Ebola-affected regions, promptly identify suspected infections, and reinforce screening and quarantine readiness at all entry points. Ebola is a severe, often fatal disease transmitted by direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, contaminated surfaces, and contaminated objects. The current outbreak centers on the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda and has prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern and to boost preparedness in 22 countries across three continents. As of now, more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths have been reported in the DRC, with Kenya reporting 3 cases. Vietnam aims to prevent importation via air travel.

triage.headline_ja: 航空便を通じたエボラ出血熱のベトナムへの侵入拡大を防止
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで続くエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクについてWHOがPHEICを宣言し、ケニアにも拡大、ベトナムが水際対策を強化しているとの内容であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はベトナムにおける水際対策であり、ベトナム国内での症例発生は報告されていないため、ベトナムはverified_locationsに含めない。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。実際の流行地であるDRCのみを計上。

article.articleHeadline: Cresce l'allerta Ebola, gli Usa sconsigliano i viaggi in Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert rises as the U.S. advises against travel to Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases in Kenya mark the first appearance of Ebola in the country; index patient, a Kenyan businessman resident in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive after returning home in early October, and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Seven additional cases, mostly family members, healthcare workers, and a medical support staffer, are in quarantine and in stable condition. Kenya reports 130 contacts, 128 traced and quarantined. In the DRC, Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,000 cases with about 4,381 deaths. The U.S. raises travel alert from level 2 to 3, advising reconsideration of travel to Kenya due to health risks and other security concerns (crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, road safety), with higher risk areas identified. The index case traveled to Kenya by car and plane via Uganda before dying on arrival.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警戒が高まり、米国がケニアへの渡航自粛を勧告
triage.triage_reason: ケニアで初のエボラ症例が発生し、国際的な人の移動を伴う感染拡大の兆候があり、米国が渡航レベルを引き上げるなど国際的関心・対応が高まっているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ発生だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、既存の大規模流行地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニアでの発生は国際的拡大・渡航制限という点でリスク評価上重要な情報であり、続報を要注視。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Se acabó la picanha? México frena importaciones de productos avícolas de Brasil por brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Has picanha run out? Mexico halts imports of Brazilian poultry products due to Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends indefinitely Brazilian poultry imports after Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The ban, enacted by Mexico’s SAGARPA via Senasica, bans poultry meat, offal, fertile eggs, and day-old chicks up to three days, plus ornamental birds, birds of prey for sale, and pets from Brazil until Brazil provides scientific evidence the outbreak is under control. The disease, affecting respiratory, nervous, and digestive systems in birds, was confirmed by Brazilian authorities at a supplier to MBRF Global Foods SA, which feeds a Chapecó export-oriented poultry plant. ABPA and local Santa Catarina groups say consumption poses no risk. Santa Catarina is Brazil’s second-largest poultry exporter, contributing about 23% of exports through September. Brazil maintains animal health surveillance and control measures per international protocols. Current date referenced: 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: ピカーニャがなくなる？メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽農場でニューカッスル病（動物疾病）が発生し、メキシコが輸入停止措置を取った貿易関連イベント。人間の公衆衛生への直接影響情報はなく、ヒト-ヒト感染性もないため、動物衛生・貿易影響として続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽における動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。主な影響は国際貿易（メキシコによる輸入停止）であり、公衆衛生危機というより経済・貿易上のイベントとして位置付けられる。Mexicoは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: US urges citizens to reconsider Kenya travel over Ebola
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been reported in Kenya, marking its outbreak. The first case involved a Kenyan citizen who had been living in the Democratic Republic of Congo and returned home in early October; he tested positive and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Kenya also identified its first Ebola case on Oct 6 in a Kenyan businessman in his forties who lived in the DRC after traveling via Uganda into Kenya; that patient died. Seven additional Kenyan cases have emerged, mostly among relatives of the index patient and health workers who treated him; all are quarantined and in stable condition. The United States raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, advising reconsideration of travel due to health risks and other threats. About 130 contacts have been identified in Kenya, with 128 traced and quarantined. In the DRC, the outbreak totals over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱流行を受けケニア渡航再考を自国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（9000例超、4381人死亡）が国境を越えてケニアに波及し、ヒト-ヒト感染（家族・医療従事者）と米国の渡航勧告引き上げが確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規エボラ発生だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続流行中のDRCのみverified_locationsに計上した。ウガンダ・米国・ナイロビも対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Catarina monitora 133 propriedades após foco de Newcastle em perus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Catarina monitors 133 properties after an outbreak of Newcastle disease in turkeys.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, involving about 6,000 birds. The property is quarantined with suspension of bird movement; culling of the flock will be followed by cleaning and disinfection per OMSA guidelines. Confirmation came after samples collected between September 21 and October 14 were laboratory-tested. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (Mapa), in collaboration with Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service, is implementing containment to reduce spread. Epidemiological surveillance will cover a restriction area including Nova Itaberaba and neighboring Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim, and Águas Frias, with monitoring of approximately 133 properties. Technical teams will visit farms, assess birds clinically, and collect samples for analysis at the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo (LFDA-SP). No immediate product recalls; human health is not at risk. International trade implications will depend on bilateral market protocols; partner countries will be informed as investigations progress.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州、七面鳥のニューカッスル病発生後133農場を監視
triage.triage_reason: 家きん（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生であり、記事中で人への健康リスクはないと明言されている。既に検疫・殺処分・消毒など標準的な防疫対応が実施中で、国際的な影響も現時点では不確定。
triage.notes: 家畜（七面鳥）の動物衛生イベントであり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの健康リスクは記事内で明示的に否定されている。貿易への影響は二国間プロトコル次第であり未確定。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones de aves de corral de Brasil tras brote de la enfermedad de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of poultry from Brazil following an outbreak of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of poultry from Brazil after a Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, announced by the Mexican Ministry of Agriculture on 20 October 2026. Restrictions cover chicken meat, poultry viscera, fertile eggs, day-old chicks up to three days old, ornamental and songbirds, raptors, and companion birds. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral disease that affects birds, as does avian influenza. Brazil, the world’s second-largest poultry exporter, reported a case at a Santa Catarina turkey farm. Mexico, which declares itself free of Newcastle disease, aims to protect domestic poultry production. Brazil has been Mexico’s second-largest supplier since 2022; Mexico was the seventh-largest importer of Brazilian chicken last year. In May 2025, Mexico briefly closed its market to Brazilian poultry after an avian influenza case, reopening later when risk declined.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生を受けて家禽輸入を停止

article.articleHeadline: México deixa de importar frango do Brasil após surto de doença aviária em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico stops importing Brazilian chicken after avian influenza outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil prompted Mexico to suspend imports of Brazilian poultry products. The embargo, announced Oct 19, 2026 by Senasica, covers meat and offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks up to three days, and ornamental birds, including items carried by travelers. The farm was interdicted and bird movements halted; control measures will follow the contingency plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle disease. The Mexican government said consumption of inspected poultry does not pose a human health risk. The outbreak was confirmed Oct 18, 2026 in Santa Catarina. The World Organisation for Animal Health notes Newcastle is highly contagious among birds, causing respiratory, neurological, and digestive symptoms with high mortality, but no risk to humans. Mexico has been free of velogenic Newcastle since 2015.

article.articleHeadline: Vírus Coxsackie pode atingir o coração; entenda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Coxsackievirus can affect the heart; understand.
article.articleSummary: Coxsackievirus, an enterovirus with two branches (A: hand-foot-mouth syndrome; B: internal-organ involvement), can rarely affect the heart. In São Paulo, Brazil, 90-year-old TV host Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega was hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês after contracting Coxsackievirus type 2, with acute cardiac deterioration causing bradycardia and other arrhythmias on a background of heart failure. Pacemaker implantation was indicated; the procedure was postponed to Tuesday and he remained stable. Transmission occurs mainly via fecal-oral routes, but the virus can spread through saliva, respiratory droplets, and contaminated surfaces. Most infections are mild, yet severe cardiac involvement can occur, particularly in newborns, the immunocompromised, or those with preexisting heart or brain disease. There is no specific antiviral or vaccine; management is supportive, including heart-failure medications. Prevention focuses on hand hygiene and cleaning shared surfaces. The pacemaker aims to correct rhythm disturbances from the infection and existing cardiac condition.

triage.headline_ja: コクサッキーウイルスが心臓に影響を及ぼす可能性；その仕組みを解説

article.articleHeadline: Alpine Fleas Carry Multiple Tick-Associated Pathogens in China
article.articleSummary: Alpine flea Vermipsylla alakurt collected from 23 free-ranging sheep near the China-Kazakhstan border in Xinjiang, northwestern China, tested January 2025 in the Altay Mountains at 2,200 m (Wenquan County, 44°47'30"N, 80°53'30"E). Of 83 adult female fleas examined for pathogens, Anaplasma ovis was detected in 6 (7.23%), Coxiella burnetii in 37 (44.58%), Babesia spp in 8 (9.64%) including one Babesia ovis, and Theileria annulata in 4 (4.82%); several fleas carried more than one pathogen. This is the first report of A. ovis, C. burnetii, Babesia and Theileria in V. alakurt, indicating that an alpine livestock-associated flea can harbor organisms typically regarded as tick-borne. Phylogenetic analyses linked A. ovis to a Xinjiang sheep-derived strain; C. burnetii clustered with local Xinjiang/Kazakhstan isolates; Babesia/Theileria sequences aligned with regional references. While sequences support identification, they do not prove flea transmission or maintenance.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の高山ノミが複数のマダニ媒介病原体を保有

triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究であり、ヒツジから採取したノミにおける複数の病原体（Anaplasma ovis、Coxiella burnetii、Babesia spp、Theileria annulata）の初検出を報告したもの。ヒト感染例やアウトブレイクの報告はない。カザフスタンも地域に含まれるが対象国リストに無いため除外。

Agriculture ministry says that consumption of inspected poultry does not pose a human health risk. article.articleHeadline: Dengue en Santa Fe: el primer caso confirmado de la temporada es importado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue in Santa Fe: the season's first confirmed case is imported.
article.articleSummary: Argentina reports the season’s first confirmed dengue case in Santa Fe as of Oct 10, with 1 of 74 dengue-related events confirmed. Nationally, epidemiological week 39 saw no new dengue cases; since season start, 999 suspected cases have been logged: 4 confirmed (all imported), 6 probable, 595 discarded, 391 under study. The four confirmed involve three residents of Buenos Aires Province with travel to Brazil and Ecuador (DENV-3) and a fourth in Buenos Aires City with travel to Peru (serotype pending). A probable case in Santa Cruz linked to a Costa Rica tourist involves DENV-2 and will be included in the next report. Authorities note interruption of autochthonous transmission but urge vigilance for virus circulation via imports. Rosario advises home prevention: eliminate standing water, clean containers, inspect drains, keep water tanks covered, and use nets and repellents; fumigation alone won’t remove eggs. Dengue symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias/arthralgias, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, and rash; seek care for severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, or drowsiness.

article.articleHeadline: Sichuan sentinel study finds out-of-phase SARS-CoV-2 and influenza
article.articleSummary: From Aug 2024–Jul 2026, seven sentinel hospitals in Sichuan (Chengdu, Dazhou, Nanchong, Mianyang, Panzhihua, Zigong, Ya\'an) tracked SARS-CoV-2 and influenza across 22,436 acute respiratory infection cases. SARS-CoV-2 positivity was 4.39%; influenza 9.83%; coinfections 0.05% (11 cases). Observed coinfections equaled 0.11 of the 0.43% expected under independence, indicating a negative association with co-circulation, with clustering in limited locations and months. A 17-target multiplex RT-PCR tested samples; SARS-CoV-2 targets ORF1ab/N; influenza targets M/NP with subtypes A(H3), A(H1N1)pdm09, B/Victoria; B/Yamagata not detected. Influenza A accounted for 87.5% of positives (A(H3) 1,045; A(H1N1)pdm09 875). Regional heterogeneity: SARS-CoV-2 3.23–6.03% (Chengdu–Zigong; Panzhihua 5.38%), influenza 6.12–13.07% (Ya\'an–Dazhou; Zigong 12.98%). SARS-CoV-2 summer peaks (max 17.46% in Jun 2025); influenza winter peaks (max 40.30% in Dec 2025). Summer OR for SARS-CoV-2 23.88; influenza OR 0.16. Age: SARS-CoV-2 highest 15–34 (7.69%); influenza highest 6–14 (15.17%).

article.articleHeadline: M痘本土疫情連7週升溫！疾管署揭1b型確診者共通點：僅2人接種過疫苗

article.articleHeadline: Iran makes progress in tuberculosis control, but gaps in case detection remain
article.articleSummary: Iran reports progress on tuberculosis control with incidence declining, but an undetected burden remains. At National Tuberculosis Day, WHO estimates about 9,600 people in Iran have TB, indicating gaps in detection. Priority screening targets include close contacts of TB patients, organ transplant recipients, people on immunosuppressive therapy, the homeless, residents of camps and congregate settings, and marginalized populations. While the ideal TB treatment success rate is about 90%, Iran has achieved roughly 84% in recent years, signaling need for stronger patient management. Since March 2025, all diagnosis and TB treatment services are free of charge. An estimated 15 million Iranians have latent TB infection, not currently ill or contagious. Global TB efforts have saved about 79 million lives since 2000, but funding cuts threaten gains; rising drug resistance in Europe and conflicts in West Asia, Africa, and Eastern Europe heighten vulnerability.

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importações de produtos avícolas do Brasil após foco de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian poultry products after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian poultry products after a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The restriction, announced Oct 19, covers meat and offal, fertile eggs, and chicks up to three days old, plus songbirds, ornamental birds, raptors for sale, and pet birds, including shipments by travelers. The outbreak was confirmed by Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA) following epidemiological investigations and analyses by the Federal Lab of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP); the farm houses about 6,000 turkeys and remains quarantined with movement halted. Birds stayed on site and were not slated for meat production. Sanitary measures include the elimination of the focus, cleaning, disinfection, and other controls. Some 133 properties in Nova Itaberaba and adjacent municipalities (Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim, Águas Frias) will be monitored with clinical checks and sampling. Newcastle is viral and distinct from avian influenza.

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango brasileiro após foco de doença em Santa Catarina - Metro 1
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports after disease outbreak in Santa Catarina - Metro 1
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of chicken meat and other poultry products from Brazil after Newcastle disease was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina. The restriction, announced on Oct 19, covers live birds and fertile eggs. The focus was identified at a rural property in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, housing about 6,000 turkeys. The farm was quarantined, bird movements halted, and authorities began containment and eradication efforts while monitoring neighboring holdings. Mexico will notify the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) and Brazilian trading partners; measures align with Brazil’s national contingency plan for Newcastle disease and avian influenza. Newcastle is a highly contagious avian virus; symptoms in birds include respiratory and neurological signs, diarrhea, head swelling, reduced egg production, and death. Human infection is rare, usually conjunctivitis after direct contact with infected birds. Brazil is the world’s largest exporter of chicken meat, and the suspension represents a trade restriction following confirmation of the focus in Brazil.

article.articleHeadline: Đồng Nai tăng cường phòng chống dịch não mô cầu sau ca tử vong tại TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dong Nai strengthens meningococcal disease prevention and control after a fatal case in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: From Jan 1 to Oct 20, 2026, Dong Nai Province has recorded 2 meningococcal disease cases (April in Ta Lai; June in Trang Bom), down from 9 cases and 1 death in 2025. An outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City at a secondary school involves 4 students with meningococcal group B, including 1 death. Dong Nai’s CDC is tightening surveillance and expanding prevention across the province. Public health measures emphasize vaccination promotion, health education, and hygiene (handwashing, covering coughs/sneezes, cleaning surfaces), avoiding shared personal items, and limiting close contact with suspected cases. Residents are urged to seek vaccination screening and obtain age-appropriate vaccine schedules at clinics. The CDC will continue coordinating with healthcare facilities and local authorities to rapidly detect suspected cases, manage contacts, and implement outbreak control per regulations, updating guidance to reduce transmission.

article.articleHeadline: MSF annonce la fermeture de son centre de traitement d'Ebola " Elikya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF announces the closure of its Ebola treatment center "Elikya"
article.articleSummary: MSF announces the closure of its Ebola treatment center Elikya in Bunia, Ituri Province, on Oct 31, redeploying emergency teams to other outbreak-affected areas. Opened in early June, Elikya housed about 100 beds and has treated 572 confirmed Ebola cases since opening. It will stop admitting new patients; those seeking care are directed to the four other Ebola treatment centers still operating in Bunia. MSF’s Ebola response coordinator states Bunia’s remaining facilities can sustain care, enabling redeployment of urgent responses elsewhere. Across Ituri and neighboring zones, eight treatment centers remain active with a total capacity of 300 beds. In Mambasa territory, Niania has reported more than two weeks with no new confirmed cases, attributed to community adherence to prevention measures. Transmission persists in other affected areas; MSF urges continued vigilance and rapid reporting of suspected cases.

article.articleHeadline: México bloqueia aves do Brasil após foco de Newcastle em SC; país lidera compras de carne de peru | Rádio Itatiaia

In Jan–Apr 2026 Santa Catarina exported 8,906 tons of turkey worth R$196 million (+171.1% revenue). Mexico, the top 2026 buyer of Brazilian turkey, imported 6,825 tons Jan–Apr (+319.7% volume; +627.4% revenue to ~R$153.5 million); total Brazil turkey exports 22,328 tons (+23.1%), average price R$20,300/ton (+77.6%). Samples were sent to LFDA-SP; officials stress no risk to human consumption. Possible auto-embargo on poultry to China; industry groups reaffirm food safety and rapid normalization.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉を禁輸へ；同国は七面鳥肉の最大の輸入国

article.articleHeadline: Valdir Barbosa: vírus da Newcastle pode bloquear exportação de frango para vários países | Rádio Itatiaia

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nord-Ubangi: un sénateur appelle à la vigilance et à la responsabilité - ACP

Preventive measures include avoiding contact with blood, vomit, feces and other fluids from infected or deceased individuals; not handling or viewing Ebola-related corpses; funerals to be organized with health team support; avoid handling or consuming bushmeat; follow bushmeat safety guidelines. Suspected cases presenting fever, severe weakness or vomiting should be promptly reported to health services; avoid self-medication or traditional care with high-risk contacts. article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango do Brasil após foco de Newcastle

In 2024 China suspended purchases from Rio Grande do Sul; restrictions were lifted earlier this year.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se extiende a una octava provincia en RDC

article.articleHeadline: México deixa de importar frango do Brasil após surto de doença aviária | Portal Band

Newcastle is a highly contagious viral infection in birds with respiratory, nervous, and digestive signs and high mortality; human risk is low. Mexico remains velogenic Newcastle-free since 2015.

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : fermé pour Ebola, l'aéroport de Bunia toujours cloué au sol, un député national plaide pour sa réouverture - LePotentiel

article.articleHeadline: Pathogen seasonality and genetics in dairy cattle at an Inner Mongolia farm
article.articleSummary: A 2024 study at one intensive dairy farm in Hohhot, Inner Mongolia, China tested 505 cattle fecal samples to assess seasonal prevalence and genetic diversity of two intestinal pathogens. Enterocytozoon bieneusi was detected in 26.53% and Giardia duodenalis in 29.90% of samples. E. bieneusi prevalence peaked in spring and winter, while G. duodenalis was more common in autumn and winter. BEB4 was the dominant E. bieneusi genotype; Giardia assemblages A, B and E were identified, with assemblage E predominant. Genotyping used sequencing: E. bieneusi ITS; Giardia genes SSU rRNA, beta-giardin, glutamate dehydrogenase, and triosephosphate isomerase. This study provides the first systematic look at seasonal distribution and genetic diversity of these pathogens in Inner Mongolia cattle, establishing a baseline for epidemiology in intensive dairy settings. Limitations include a single farm and year (2024), not population-wide trends or transmission dynamics.

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Explained, Spread and US Risk
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, the second-largest on record. As of 6 October 2026, WHO tallies 8,728 confirmed cases and 4,205 deaths (crude CFR 48.2%), with heterogeneity: Ituri hotspots declining while transmission persists in North Kivu. In October 2026, an imported case was confirmed in Uganda in a traveler from the DRC, underscoring cross-border risk. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of symptomatic patients; fever, weakness, muscle pain, and headache are common. Vaccination is central but vaccines licensed for Zaire ebolavirus are not automatically equivalent to Bundibugyo; deployment depends on products and regulatory decisions. Donor funding totals about US$962 million, but only US$200 million is accounted for by Africa CDC, leaving US$700 million unaccounted. The United States has imposed travel restriction: anyone who has been in the DRC within 21 days cannot board a US flight.

triage.notes: 本事例はヒト感染症ではなく家禽の動物疾病（Newcastle Disease）であり、記事中にヒトへの健康影響の記載はない。ブラジル農業省と州当局（Sape, Cidasc）が殺処分・消毒等の防疫措置を実施中。ブラジルは主要な家禽輸出国であるため、OIE通報や貿易制限等の二次的影響を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: plus de cas en 24 heures au Nord-Kivu qu'en Ituri, considérée comme l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more cases in 24 hours in North Kivu than in Ituri, considered the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo now affects eight of 26 provinces. Nord-Kivu has 48 confirmed cases and Ituri 42 as of Oct 18, with Nord-Kivu rising while Ituri edges down, making Nord-Kivu temporarily surpass Ituri in confirmed cases and Ituri still considered the epicenter. Two cases were confirmed in Nord-Ubangi last weekend, with no further transmission reported there. A total of 97 new cases in 24 hours were recorded, the highest since Oct 3. The surge concentrates in the Beni-Butembo area and the corridor between provinces. Security constraints from Allied Democratic Forces (ADF) complicate the response, with no talks possible. MSF confirms closing the Elykia treatment center in Bunia by month’s end to redeploy resources. Healthcare capacity shows Ituri 41% occupancy in CTEs versus ~88% in Nord-Kivu, with suspected-case beds near 94% full.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国：24時間の新規症例数は北キブ州がイトゥリ州（流行の震源地とされる）を上回る
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で複数州にまたがるエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大しており、24時間で97例という急増、治療施設の病床逼迫、治安上の障害（ADFの活動）により対応が困難になっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 新規に北ウバンギ州で2例確認されたがそれ以降の伝播は報告なし。北キブ州の治療施設占有率は約88%、疑い例用病床は約94%と逼迫。治安上の制約（ADF）により対話不能な地域があり、MSFがブニアの治療センターを閉鎖予定。

article.articleHeadline: Gần nhà có ca não mô cầu, phòng ngừa thế nào?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There is a meningococcal meningitis case near my home—how should we prevent it?
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal meningitis case reported near Lam Dong, Vietnam. Do not self-administer antibiotic prophylaxis; only public health authorities can identify close contacts and prescribe appropriate chemoprophylaxis based on age, health, and allergies. Unsupervised antibiotic use risks adverse effects, allergic reactions, gastrointestinal upset, toxicity, and promotes resistance; it may also mask symptoms and hinder diagnosis. For longer-term prevention, complete vaccination. Vietnam uses vaccines covering serogroups A, B, C, Y, and W-135; new group B vaccines protect ages 2 months to 50 years, and VA-Mengoc BC (Cuba) for 6 months to 45 years. ACYW vaccines can be given with group B vaccines at different injection sites in one visit, without delaying intervals. Beyond vaccination, wash hands, wear masks in crowded places, and keep spaces ventilated. Transmission is via droplets or saliva in close contact; close contacts should seek prophylaxis guidance. Seek urgent care for fever, severe headache, vomiting, neck stiffness, or purpuric rash.

triage.headline_ja: 自宅近くで髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の症例、どう予防すべきか？
triage.triage_reason: 単発の髄膜炎菌感染症例に関する一般的な予防啓発記事であり、公衆衛生上の重大性や異常性、国際的拡大リスクを示す情報は見られない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防啓発・医療情報が主体で、感染拡大や集団発生を示す記述はない。単発症例報告のためWATCHではなくDISMISSと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle é confirmada em aviário de perus no Oeste de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease confirmed at a turkey farm in western Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. Detection occurred during sanitary surveillance on Oct 19, 2026; laboratory tests identified the virus despite absence of clinical signs in birds. Authorities from MAPA, Sape, and Cidasc are implementing control measures, including sanitary culling of the affected flock and cleaning and disinfection of facilities. Surveillance extends to 133 farms across Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias. Technical Note 001/2026 on farm biosafety has been issued to strengthen biosecurity. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease that can cause respiratory or neurological symptoms, diarrhea, and head swelling, with potentially rapid mortality. Meat and eggs from inspected establishments remain safe for consumption, with seals SIM (municipal), SIE (state), and SIF (federal). Suspected cases should be reported to Cidasc via e-Sisbravet or at local offices.

triage.headline_ja: 西サンタカタリナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病が確認
triage.triage_reason: 家畜（鳥類）の動物疾病であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、国際貿易・畜産業への影響や広域サーベイランスが行われているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類感染症でヒト感染例は極めて稀。食肉・卵は安全とされ、当局により衛生的淘汰・消毒等の対応が実施済み。133農場への監視拡大は貿易上の懸念材料となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: US Raises Travel Advisory for Kenya to Level 3 Amid Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: US raises travel advisory for Kenya to Level 3 as Ebola outbreak prompts heightened risk; Kenya reports eight Ebola cases as of mid-October. Americans are urged to reconsider travel amid broader risks including crime and unrest. Kenya’s medical facilities are limited, especially in rural areas, with many requiring upfront payment and evacuation costs may fall to travelers. Separately, Congo’s Ebola outbreak has spread to eight provinces as of Oct 17, with 9,455 confirmed cases and 4,561 deaths. The Bundibugyo orthoebolavirus strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Ituri Province in eastern Congo remains the epicenter, accounting for about three-quarters of cases across 66 health zones since the start. North Kivu Province will ban entry from Ituri for one week starting Oct 19 to slow transmission. Uganda previously declared Ebola-free in July; no cases have been confirmed since. Transmission occurs via contact with blood or bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱流行を受けケニアへの渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行が8州に拡大し9,455症例・4,561死亡と深刻化、ワクチン未承認のブンディブギョ株で国際的な渡航制限措置（米渡航勧告レベル3、北キブ州の入境禁止）も発生しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダでの症例報告もあるが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。主たる発生国はDRC。

article.articleHeadline: Joel Tärning Aims to Give Malaria Patients Right Treatment
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major global health challenge, affecting about 250 million people annually, with most deaths among children under five. Joel Tärning, newly appointed Professor of Clinical Pharmacology at Labmed, Karolinska Institutet, combines clinical trial data with pharmacometric modelling to tailor malaria treatments and prevent under- or overdosing across patient groups. He notes many antimalarial drugs introduced over the past decades were prescribed at incorrect doses, particularly for young children and pregnant women, and aims to translate modelling insights into updated treatment guidelines with real-world impact. Tärning brings pharmacokinetics training from the University of Gothenburg, time at MORU Bangkok, and leadership of a clinical pharmacology lab in Thailand, now leveraging KI's translational Labmed environment. He plans to broaden his work to other infectious diseases and join KI's diverse research portfolio.

triage.headline_ja: ジョエル・タルニング氏、マラリア患者への適切な治療を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 特定の発生事象ではなく、研究者の経歴や治療最適化に関する一般的な学術記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常事態を示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、研究者のキャリアと薬物動態研究に関する紹介記事。タイやスウェーデンは研究歴の文脈で言及されているのみで、現地での発生事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: plus de cas en 24 heures au Nord-Kivu qu'en Ituri, considérée comme l'épicentre de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more cases in 24 hours in North Kivu than in Ituri, considered the epicenter of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 48 confirmed cases in North Kivu vs 42 in Ituri—the latter often seen as the outbreak epicenter. Since September, caseload trends diverge: Ituri exhibits a slight decline while North Kivu rises, with transmission concentrated in the Beni-Butembo corridor and the area between the provinces. Security challenges, including armed groups such as the Allied Democratic Forces aligned with Islamic State, hinder response efforts, with 'no discussion possible' according to responders. MSF confirms closing the Elykia Treatment Center in Bunia by month’s end to redeploy resources to higher-need zones. Current occupancy rates: Ituri CTE ~41%, North Kivu CTE ~88%, with suspected-case bed saturation near 94% occupancy. Updates from Congolese authorities underscore ongoing outbreak dynamics and the need for intensified, secure response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：震源地とされるイトゥリより北キブで24時間の新規症例が多数
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続・拡大しており、武装勢力による対応阻害やベッド占有率の逼迫など公衆衛生上深刻な影響とヒト-ヒト感染拡大のリスクが認められるため。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de SP alerta para vacinação contra sarampo antes da temporada de cruzeiros 2026/2027
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Paulo state government issues alert for measles vaccination ahead of the 2026/2027 cruise season.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, the São Paulo State Health Secretariat issued an alert urging cruise passengers and crew to verify measles vaccination before the 2026/2027 season. The season starts 30 October at Port of Santos and involves about 832,000 people. Given international circulation of the measles virus and diverse passenger nationalities, vaccination should be completed at least 15 days before boarding. If fever with a red rash occurs, especially with cough, runny nose, or conjunctivitis, travel should be postponed and medical care sought. Onboard, follow hygiene measures: frequent handwashing, covering the nose and mouth when coughing or sneezing, not sharing utensils, keeping spaces clean and ventilated, and avoiding close contact with the ill. After disembarkation, monitor for 30 days and inform health services if symptoms or travel history is relevant. Vaccination coverage rose April–August 2026: first dose 86.56% to 96.29%; second dose 72.72% to 83.81%. Schedules: children 12 and 15 months; ages 15 months–29 years two doses 30 days apart; ages 30–59 one dose; healthcare workers two doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州政府、2026/2027年クルーズシーズンを前に麻疹ワクチン接種を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な麻疹アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、クルーズシーズン前の予防的なワクチン接種呼びかけであり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de doença aviária leva México a barrar frango do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Avian disease outbreak leads Mexico to ban Brazilian chicken.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil prompts Mexico to suspend imports of Brazilian chicken meat as of Oct 19, 2026, per the Mexican Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection primarily affecting domestic poultry, causing respiratory and neurological symptoms, reduced egg production, and high mortality; human risk is not typically significant. Severity varies by viral strain and flock health. Brazil is the world's largest chicken meat exporter, so sanitary restrictions can impact its poultry trade. The Mexican measure follows the outbreak; officials have not specified how long the suspension will last or its precise impact on exports. The report also notes that the OIE (World Organisation for Animal Health) provides background on the disease, but details on outbreak location within Brazil or laboratory confirmation were not provided.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Wapinda: nécessité de renforcer les dispositifs de riposte - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Wapinda: Need to Strengthen Outbreak Response Mechanisms.
article.articleSummary: Strengthening outbreak response mechanisms in Wapinda health zone, Nord-Ubangi, NW Democratic Republic of Congo, is needed to break Ebola transmission chains, Prof. Dieudonné Mwamba told a weekly coordination at INSP. Eight provinces are affected, including Nord-Ubangi, where response measures are in place and require reinforcement. In epidemiological week 41, the cumulative outbreak tallies surpass 9,400 cases and 4,560 deaths (case fatality rate about 48%), with more than 2,500 recoveries and a contact-tracing rate around 88%. Five health zones report >50% notification, with large-scale interventions ongoing in Katwa, Rwampara, Madima and Bunia to strengthen surveillance and response. The INSP director also addressed concerns about the traceability of some 700 million dollars linked to Africa CDC and the Ebola response, stressing accountability and multisectoral coordination. Other health threats discussed include measles and cholera.

triage.headline_ja: ワピンダのエボラ出血熱：対応体制強化の必要性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで累計9,400症例・死亡4,560人（致死率約48%）の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、複数州に拡大、資金のトレーサビリティ問題も指摘されるなど公衆衛生上・社会的関心ともに高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北西部（Nord-Ubangi州ワピンダ等）および北キブ州（カトワ、ブニア等）での既存の大規模エボラ流行に関する内部調整会議の内容。ルワンダは発生地域リストに含まれるが本文中で感染確認の記述はなく、位置情報として言及されているのみのため除外。はしか・コレラも議題に上るが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh do não mô cầu có tỷ lệ mắc thấp, tại sao vẫn xảy ra bùng phát?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease has a low incidence; why do outbreaks still occur?
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, has low incidence but outbreaks can alarm health systems. A school-based outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City illustrates this risk. The illness can progress from fever or sore throat to septic shock and meningitis within 24 hours, with mortality of 10-15% even with ICU care and lifelong sequelae in 10-20% of survivors. A key driver is asymptomatic carriage: about 5-10% of the population, rising to 20-25% among adolescents, harbor the bacteria in the throat and spread it via droplets. Crowded, enclosed settings with high contact density and shared items facilitate transmission. Immunization gaps exist because at least five serogroups (A, B, C, W-135, Y) cause invasive disease, and many children lack full protection. Prevention emphasizes ventilation, hygiene, not sharing personal items, and broad vaccination covering all serogroups (ACWY and B) before school entry, with sustained vaccination programs.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症は発生率が低いにもかかわらず、なぜ集団感染が起こるのか?
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症の集団発生が報告されているが、規模・症例数・現在の収束状況など詳細情報が不足しているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は啓発的な内容で、学校での集団感染事例は一例として言及されているのみ。具体的な患者数、発生時期、現在の状況などの情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: 传染性强，无特效药 ！这种病毒进入高发季
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Highly contagious, no specific drug! This virus is entering its peak season.
article.articleSummary: Norovirus is entering its peak season in China (October–March), per Zhuhai Release citing the China CDC. There is no specific antiviral drug; infections are self-limiting, with most people recovering in 2–3 days. The virus is highly contagious: a single vomiting event can release billions of virions, and only 10–100 particles can cause infection. Transmission occurs via fecal-oral routes from contaminated food or water, contact with contaminated objects, and aerosols in poorly ventilated spaces. Symptoms include vomiting and diarrhea, fever, and malaise; adults mainly diarrhea, children mainly vomiting. Incubation is 12–72 hours, onset typically within 2 days. Seek medical care for dehydration, high fever, blood in vomit, or inability to wake. Prevention: no vaccine; wash hands with soap and water; wash produce; cook seafood thoroughly (especially oysters); avoid crowded places; if a classmate vomits, exit and report. Severe disease risk is higher in elderly and young children; rare necrotizing enterocolitis in newborns.

triage.headline_ja: 感染力が強く、特効薬なし！このウイルスが流行期に入る
triage.triage_reason: ノロウイルスの季節性流行に関する一般的な啓発記事であり、異常な増加や重大な公衆衛生事象を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño y la salud: qué enfermedades pueden aumentar con las lluvias y cómo prevenirlas, según un reconocido infectólogo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño and Health: Which Diseases May Increase with the Rains and How to Prevent Them, According to a Renowned Infectious Disease Specialist.
article.articleSummary: Heavy El Niño-driven rains through January–February next year in Argentina raise risks of leptospirosis, skin/wound infections, and snake bites, along with mosquito-borne diseases such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. In the Buenos Aires Metropolitan Area (AMBA) and the Litoral, floods coincide with rising Paraná and Uruguay rivers; Iguazú National Park closed; dam gates opened in Brazil. Leptospirosis, caused by Leptospira from rodent urine, can enter via broken skin or mucous membranes and may cause hemorrhagic pulmonary or hepatic/renal involvement. Prolonged exposure increases fungal skin infections; tetanus risk after injuries during evacuations; respiratory outbreaks in shelters; livestock losses near rivers threaten vulnerable populations. Aedes aegypti breeds in domestic containers and can yield dengue, chikungunya, Zika within 7–10 days in the northeast and 12–14 days in AMBA; Culex in standing water. Western equine encephalitis has affected horses and some people, with at least one death. Emphasizes descacharrar and dengue vaccination; preparedness gaps noted.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョと健康:降雨で増加しうる疾患とその予防法、著名な感染症専門医が解説
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンにおけるエルニーニョによる季節性疾患リスクの一般的な啓発記事であり、対象国での発生事例ではなく、異常性や国際的拡大の根拠も乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: 35 cas suspects négatifs (non cas) libérés d'un centre d'isolement - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: 35 suspected cases test negative (non-cases) released from an isolation center - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Beni, North Kivu, DRC: 35 suspected cases tested negative and discharged from an isolation center in Biokene health area over the past three months; two suspected positives were referred to an Ebola treatment center, including a woman. The transit center reportedly does not release non-confirmed Ebola cases. Health worker Janvier Soumaili cited shortages of PPE and bed capacity at the Ebola treatment center, along with ongoing rumors and suspicions against the facility. As Nord-Kivu sees rising confirmed case numbers, the provincial governor ordered a one-week ban on entry of people from Ituri, effective Monday 19 October, at border posts Eringeti and Kainama (border with Ituri) and Mangina-Bela (border with Mambasa).
