article.articleHeadline: Cúm A tăng nhanh, bác sĩ hướng dẫn cách phòng bệnh và chăm sóc để mau hồi phục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A is rising rapidly; doctors advise on prevention and care to speed recovery.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A cases are rising in Hanoi and across parts of northern Vietnam, with Hanoi CDC reporting 200–300 weekly cases seeking treatment. While most recover, influenza A can cause complications, especially in young children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases. Hospital-based surveillance at the National Pediatric Hospital shows pediatric influenza A positives rising from 106 cases in week 35 to 779 in week 40, 2026, with admissions increasing from 18 to 124 in the same period. Transmission is via respiratory droplets and contaminated hands or surfaces. Symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, myalgia, and fatigue; high fever is not universal, and severe illness can occur without it. Prevention emphasizes annual vaccination, masks, hand hygiene, ventilated spaces, avoiding crowded indoor settings when ill, and staying home. Home care focuses on rest, fluids, soft foods, and avoiding antibiotics unless a clinician suspects a bacterial infection.

triage.headline_ja: A型インフルエンザが急増、医師が予防法と回復を早めるケア方法を指導
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの季節的増加であり、重症例の急増や異常な病原性は報告されていないが、小児の罹患率・入院数の増加傾向が見られるため経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango brasileiro após surto viral em granja de Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports after viral outbreak at a Santa Catarina farm.

Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock assured there is no risk to human health from inspected meat or eggs. In response to the outbreak, authorities quarantined the farm and halted movement of poultry to curb spread, with measures aimed at keeping products for the domestic market safe while controlling the outbreak. No virus name, case counts, or laboratory confirmation details are provided. This trace disruption follows export restrictions tied to a non-human-health risk assessment, as of 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリナ州の養鶏場でのウイルス性アウトブレイク発生後、ブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango do Brasil após surto de Doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends chicken imports from Brazil after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian chicken meat after a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in southern Brazil (Santa Catarina). The ban also covers live birds and fertile eggs, announced Oct 19, 2026 by Mexico’s Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development. The measure aims to protect the national poultry sector, with Mexico asserting the country is free of Newcastle disease. Newcastle disease is highly contagious among birds, causing respiratory and neurological symptoms, reduced egg production, and high mortality. Brazil is the world’s largest chicken meat exporter, and sanitary restrictions by importing nations can affect trade. The Santa Catarina outbreak highlights avian-health risks in production systems and the potential for cross-border trade responses even when domestic disease status is claimed as free.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きんに重篤な被害を及ぼす動物疾患で、メキシコがブラジル産鶏肉等の輸入を停止するなど貿易制限が発生しているが、人への健康影響は確認されておらず、続報を注視する段階と判断した。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家きん疾患であり、人への感染リスクは極めて低い。主な懸念は貿易・農業経済への影響であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は現時点で認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 博主发帖"被鱼扎了一下胳膊变黑"，网友在线劝：速就医！医生：需警惕海洋创伤弧菌感染，重症患者48小时内死亡率超50%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A blogger posts “A fish bit my arm and it turned black”—netizens urge: seek medical attention immediately! Doctor: Be vigilant for Vibrio vulnificus infection from marine wounds; mortality rate in severe cases exceeds 50% within 48 hours.
article.articleSummary: Vibrio vulnificus infection from marine wounds can be fatal, with mortality in severe cases exceeding 50% within 48 hours. A blogger’s arm turning black after a fish bite prompts warnings to seek care immediately. Dr. Ye Zhengqing of Nanjing Second Hospital urges early evaluation to distinguish local toxins from Vibrio infection. The bacterium thrives in 20–30°C seawater and infections typically occur via: 1) open skin in contact with warm seawater; 2) wounds from fish, shellfish, or coral; 3) eating raw seafood, especially oysters. Symptoms include severe pain, tense bullae or necrosis, fever, and possible liver/kidney dysfunction or septic shock. Treatment hinges on prompt aggressive antibiotics; surgery or amputation may be required in severe cases. First aid: rinse with running water, disinfect, keep dry; seek care if pain is severe, blisters form, or tissue darkens. Avoid warm seawater with wounds; wear gloves when handling seafood and sandals at the beach.

triage.headline_ja: ブロガーが「魚に刺された腕が黒く変色」と投稿、ネットユーザーが受診を勧める：医師「海洋性創傷弧菌感染に要警戒、重症患者の48時間以内死亡率は50%超」
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例に基づく健康啓発的な記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事象を示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: Vibrio vulnificusは環境由来の感染症でヒト-ヒト感染せず、個別の医療啓発記事であるためアウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah DBD, Dinkes Mataram gencarkan pemberantasan sarang nyamuk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Dengue Fever, Mataram Health Office Intensifies Mosquito Breeding Site Eradication
article.articleSummary: 178 dengue fever cases in Kota Mataram, West Nusa Tenggara, as of 2026-10-20, well below 2025’s 440 cases, with no significant new cases or dengue-related deaths reported, and the situation deemed safe and under control. To prevent dengue ahead of the rainy season, the Mataram Health Office intensifies mosquito breeding site eradication (PSN) through health centers (puskesmas) in collaboration with kelurahan and local authorities to mobilize residents. PSN focuses on waste management and removing standing water in homes, and efforts continue year-round rather than waiting for rain. Meanwhile, Acute Respiratory Infections (ISPA) remain dominant during the dry season, with periodic data monitoring through year-end. Public guidance emphasizes protecting the respiratory tract from dust and air pollution, drinking 8–10 glasses of water daily, and maintaining environmental cleanliness.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱予防のため、マタラム保健局が蚊の発生源対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: デング熱症例数は前年より減少しており、状況は安全かつ管理下にあると明記されている。通常の季節的予防活動の報道であり、異常性や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 症例数は2025年の440件から178件へ減少しており、死亡例の報告もない。デング熱・ISPA双方について通常の予防的公衆衛生活動を伝える内容。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh não mô cầu xuất hiện trong trường học: Những dấu hiệu phụ huynh không thể bỏ qua
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease in schools: Signs that parents cannot ignore.
article.articleSummary: Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B meningococcal disease is affecting students at a secondary school in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. As of 2026-10-20, four students are infected, including one death, indicating a deadly local cluster. Parents are advised to closely monitor their children, seek prompt medical evaluation for any unusual symptoms, and collaborate with the school and health authorities to prevent further transmission. The report emphasizes coordinated action within the school setting and public health systems to curb the outbreak. The situation highlights the importance of vigilance among families with school-age children and a rapid health response in an urban Vietnamese context.

triage.headline_ja: 学校で発生した髄膜炎菌性疾患：保護者が見逃してはならない兆候
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の中学校で髄膜炎菌性疾患（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し、4名感染・1名死亡と重症例を含むため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 学校という閉鎖的集団内での髄膜炎菌感染拡大リスクがあり、死亡例も発生していることから続報・公衆衛生対応の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Πέντε κρούσματα Mpox εντοπίστηκαν στην Αγία Πετρούπολη - Σε απομόνωση οι ασθενείς - ink
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five Mpox cases detected in Saint Petersburg - Patients in isolation - ink.
article.articleSummary: Five mpox cases detected in Saint Petersburg, Russia: five hospitalized patients at Botkin Hospital tested positive for mpox and are in stable condition. All exhibit mild-to-moderate symptoms and are receiving care under strict isolation as authorities conduct extensive contact tracing and enforce anti-epidemic measures. The Russian Federal Service for Consumer Surveillance confirmed tracing of individuals who had contact with the patients. Mpox is generally a mild infectious disease, with most patients recovering within weeks without specific treatment; it was first identified in 1958 in monkeys, with human cases historically concentrated in Central and West Africa. In 2022, sexual transmission was confirmed, and after outbreaks in the Congo, mpox has appeared in more than 70 countries. The World Health Organization continues to monitor the situation and has issued public health advisories to prevent new clusters.

triage.headline_ja: サンクトペテルブルクでMpox感染者5名確認－患者は隔離中
triage.triage_reason: 発生国はロシアであり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRC・Angolaは歴史的背景説明としての言及のみで実際の発生国ではないため、対象国に関する懸念はない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア・サンクトペテルブルクでのMpox発生であり、DRC・Angolaは疾患の歴史的起源や過去の流行地域としての言及に過ぎず、今回の発生国ではないため対象国リストに該当する地域はない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le suivi des contacts tombe à 76,9 %, et à 26 % à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: contact tracing falls to 76.9%, and to 26% in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 confirmed deaths (case fatality 48.2%) as of Oct 18, 2026; 2,550 recoveries and 937 in isolation. In the last 24 hours, 97 new confirmed cases: 48 in North Kivu, 42 in Ituri, 7 in Haut-Uele; 41 deaths (30 community, 11 in treatment centers) and 20 recoveries. Contact tracing coverage falls to 76.9% of 32,744 contacts seen; Ituri 69.9%, Bunia 26.0% (936 seen of 3,599). North Kivu 78.6%. Ituri accounts for 72.9% of national cases (6,960) and 3,217 deaths; 28 of 36 health zones affected. Across eight provinces, 66 health zones and 246 health areas are affected. Vaccination: 322 people vaccinated in Beni (target 7,105; 4.5%), Ituri cumulative 1,260; Bas-Uele 11.4% coverage. Hospitals report 429 in Ituri (59 critical, 41% occupancy) and 450 in North Kivu (62 under‑5, 87.6% occupancy). Note: provider payment delays in Ituri and a PK12 checkpoint strike in Isiro, Bas-Uele.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：接触者追跡率が76.9％に低下、ブニアでは26％に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で大規模エボラ流行（累計9,552症例、致死率48.2%）が継続し、接触者追跡率の低下やワクチン接種率の低さなど対応能力の問題が顕著であるため、フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 既知の進行中エボラ流行（既存アウトブレイクの継続状況報告）。接触者追跡率低下・ワクチン接種率低迷・医療従事者への支払い遅延・検問所でのストライキなど、対応能力の脆弱性が複数報告されており、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF prévoit de fermer le CTE d'Elikiya à Bunia d'ici fin octobre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF plans to close the Elikiya Ebola Treatment Center in Bunia by the end of October.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, MSF will close the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) Elikiya in Bunia, Ituri province, by the end of October 2026, in agreement with health authorities as part of adapting the emergency response while Ebola transmission remains active in the region. Opened in early June 2026, Elikiya treated 572 patients with confirmed Ebola over four months. Closure does not end MSF's Ebola response; with other treatment centers now operating in Bunia, MSF will redeploy emergency teams to areas with greater need. After closure, people with Ebola-compatible symptoms can be treated at four other Bunia-area centers: within Bunia’s general hospital complex (Bigo 1), Rwankole hospital (Rwankole), CME evangelical hospital (Hoho), and near Rwampara General Hospital (Rwampara). The May 2025 Ebola outbreak has caused 4,602 deaths among 9,552 confirmed cases in DRC (48.5% CFR), across eight provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱（DRC）：MSFが10月末までにブニアのエリキヤ・エボラ治療センターを閉鎖予定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ流行は9,552症例・4,602死亡（致死率48.5%）と極めて深刻で、8州にまたがり伝播が継続しているため、フルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 2025年5月発生のエボラ流行は依然継続中で、致死率48.5%と非常に高い。MSFによる治療センター再編成は対応継続の一環であり、流行終息を意味しない。継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les USA invitent leurs citoyens à "reconsidérer" tout voyage au Kenya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States urges its citizens to reconsider any travel to Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been confirmed in Kenya, including the first case identified on 6 October in a 40-year-old man who contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of Congo and traveled through Uganda to Nairobi, where he died on 5 October. Seven additional infections are linked to him—family members and health-care workers—currently in quarantine and described as stable by Kenya’s Ministry of Health. The United States embassy in Nairobi raised the alert level from 2 to 3, urging Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya due to health risks and security concerns such as crime, kidnappings, terrorism, civil unrest, and road safety. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak declared in May has infected over 9,000 people and caused at least 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国がケニアへの渡航再考を自国民に呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で続くエボラ流行（9000人以上感染、4381人死亡）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境伝播し、ヒト-ヒト感染（家族・医療従事者）も確認されている。米国大使館が渡航警戒レベルを引き上げるなど国際的対応も生じており、IHR基準複数該当のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はケニア（対象国リスト外）だが、感染源かつ大規模流行継続中のDRCが対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Trial finds broad poliovirus-neutralizing responses in infants
article.articleSummary: A Sabin strain–based inactivated poliovirus vaccine elicited broad cross-neutralizing antibodies against Sabin, Salk and circulating poliovirus strains in 2‑month‑old infants enrolled in China. In a double‑blind, randomized, 1:1:1 trial, 300 healthy infants received the test vaccine (Wuhan Institute of Biological Products), a control inactivated poliovirus vaccine, or a control wild‑type IPV at 2, 3 and 4 months; 282 completed and provided paired pre/post‑vaccination sera. Seroconversion across ten strains ranged from 91.58% to 100% for the test vaccine; 87.23% to 98.94% for the control IPV; 94.62% to 100% for the wild‑type control. Geometric mean titers were 40.24–2876.29 (test), 25.85–1658.58 (control), and 116.2–958.12 (wild‑type). Safety: no vaccine‑related serious adverse events; higher mild-to-moderate reactogenicity in the test arm. Authors note immunogenicity supports potential role in global polio eradication during OPV→IPV transitions, though protection against infection or transmission was not assessed; trial CTR20211257.

triage.headline_ja: 臨床試験、乳児において広範なポリオウイルス中和反応を確認
triage.triage_reason: これはワクチン臨床試験の研究報告であり、実際の感染症発生や公衆衛生上の脅威を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン臨床試験の結果報告であり、実際の感染症流行事例ではないため対象国の発生地域には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação avícola do Brasil após surto de Newcastle em granja de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian poultry imports after Newcastle disease outbreak on a farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry after confirmation of Newcastle disease on a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Mexican Secretariat of Agriculture said the ban covers poultry meat and offal, canaries and ornamental birds, and avian genetic material—including fertile eggs and day-old chicks up to three days old—and applies to both commercial shipments and goods carried by travelers. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious avian infection affecting poultry, attacking the respiratory tract and causing apathy, neurological signs, and diarrhea, per the World Organisation for Animal Health. Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry confirmed the cases. The measure follows the outbreak notification and coincides with Mexico’s large imports of Brazilian deboned chicken breast, which rose from about 90,000 tonnes in 2022 to 196,000 tonnes in 2025. No duration for the restriction was provided.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でのニューカッスル病発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり人への健康影響はほとんどなく、本件は主に貿易・農業上の措置であって公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病はヒトへの感染性・病原性が極めて低い家禽疾病であり、本件はメキシコによる動物検疫・貿易上の対応が主旨。公衆衛生リスク評価の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Sesapi e UFPI realizam simpósio para fortalecer diagnóstico e tratamento da tuberculose no Piauí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sesapi and UFPI hold a symposium to strengthen tuberculosis diagnosis and treatment in Piauí.
article.articleSummary: On October 21–22, 2026, the State Health Secretariat of Piauí (Sesapi), in partnership with the Federal University of Piauí (UFPI), hosts the III State Tuberculosis Symposium at the Academy of Medical Sciences Auditorium (ACIPI) to update professionals on TB diagnosis, treatment and surveillance and to strengthen strategies for eliminating TB as a public health problem. Notifiable Diseases Information System (Sinan) data show Piauí reported 1,158 tuberculosis cases in 2025, up from 1,109 in 2024 and 1,141 in 2023; 864 were new cases in 2025, with an incidence of 26.1 per 100,000. Ivone Macedo, the state TB coordinator, stresses timely diagnosis, treatment adherence and integrated care. Program topics include epidemiological panorama, diagnostic innovations, biosafety, latent infection preventive therapy, surveillance in vulnerable populations, and care pathways in primary health care. The symposium is part of TB Control Week across all 224 municipalities and complements World TB Day on March 24.

triage.headline_ja: SesapiとUFPIがピアウイ州における結核の診断・治療強化のためのシンポジウムを開催
triage.triage_reason: 通常の結核対策シンポジウム開催と統計報告であり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す内容はない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ピアウイ州の結核罹患率は緩やかな増加傾向だが、これは既知の地方病への通常の対策活動報告であり、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Agricultura confirma foco de doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture Confirms Newcastle Disease Outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The 6,000-bird establishment was identified by the state Official Veterinary Service and confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo. Containment includes interdiction of the site, monitoring of 133 neighboring properties, and reinforced biosafety. Governor Jorginho Melo has been informed and authorities emphasize biosecurity to protect flocks. Although the virus is present, birds show no symptoms or mortality. Brazil, an OIE member, will treat the site as a focus and pursue eradication. Poultry product consumption remains safe, and the sector notes the robustness of the sanitary defense system. This is the second Newcastle case in Brazil, the first reported July 2024 in Rio Grande do Sul, after which poultry exports to several countries, including China, were temporarily suspended.

triage.headline_ja: 農業省、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生事案であり人への直接影響は報告されていないが、貿易制限（過去の輸出停止実績）のリスクがあり、ブラジル国内の養鶏産業への影響として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。感染鳥に症状や死亡はなく、管理下で封じ込め対応中。過去の発生（2024年7月、リオグランデ・ド・スル州）では中国を含む複数国への家禽輸出が一時停止された経緯があり、貿易への影響は継続して注視が必要。人の公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていないため、フルRRAの優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: САЩ препоръчаха на гражданите си да не пътуват до Кения след откриването на нов случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States advised its citizens not to travel to Kenya after the discovery of a new Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been reported in Kenya, with the first case on Oct 6 in a Kenyan citizen living in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), where an outbreak has persisted since May. Since then, seven additional infections have been recorded, mainly among close contacts and healthcare workers; patients are quarantined and reported to be in stable condition. Kenya identified 130 contacts, with 128 under quarantine. The United States has raised Kenya’s travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, advising Americans to reconsider travel due to health risks and other security concerns. In the DRC, authorities report about 9,000 Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths, underscoring cross-border transmission risk and the ongoing regional outbreak.”}

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ケニアでのエボラ新規症例発見を受け、自国民にケニアへの渡航自粛を勧告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行がケニアへ越境伝播し複数の二次感染が確認されており、国際的拡大・渡航制限（米国渡航勧告引き上げ）が既に発生しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの越境感染事例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。米国は感染発生国ではなく渡航勧告発出国のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Presídio de Três Passos registra 16 casos ativos de tuberculose e entra na mira do MPRS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Três Passos Prison records 16 active tuberculosis cases and comes under the MPRS's scrutiny
article.articleSummary: 16 active pulmonary tuberculosis cases confirmed at Três Passos State Prison, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, triggering a Ministério Público investigation. Anonymous complaints allege inmates diagnosed with TB share cells with healthy prisoners without isolation or systematic screening, risking staff and visitors. SES/RS, via the 2nd Regional Health Coordination, confirmed Sinan data and admitted isolation protocols are not fully implemented due to infrastructure, hindering separation of suspects or confirmed cases. Since April, at least nine diagnoses occurred, with one hospitalization of seven days (June–July). The facility houses 386 inmates; triage space exists but a 17-person cell had three under treatment; two inmates transferred to Vila Nova Hospital in Porto Alegre; visits suspended for 30 days for TB-positive inmates; masks provided at entry. 15 staff tested Mantoux, all negative. LGPD used to withhold local testing data; case referred to VEC and Promotoria de Justiça de Ijuí; investigation extended 90 days.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・パソス刑務所で結核活動症例16件が確認され、州検察庁（MPRS）の調査対象に
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの単一刑務所内という限定的な集団感染事例であり国際的拡大リスクは低いが、隔離体制不備によるヒト-ヒト感染継続の懸念があり経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 刑務所内の閉鎖環境における結核集団発生。隔離・スクリーニング体制の不備が指摘され、州検察庁が調査中。国際的な公衆衛生緊急性は低いが、施設内感染拡大の可能性があるため続報を注視。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak update as of October 18
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) updated as of October 18, 2026. A total of 97 new confirmed EVD cases reported across North Kivu (48), Ituri (42), and Haut-Uélé (7). Community deaths: 30. Additionally, 11 confirmed deaths occurred in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs)—6 in Ituri, 4 in North Kivu, 1 in Haut-Uélé—bringing the period's confirmed deaths to 41. Recovered: 20 patients (Ituri 12, North Kivu 7, Tshopo 1) with two negative tests. Cumulative totals since outbreak start: 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths, case fatality rate 48.2%. Ituri remains the epicenter, accounting for 72.9% of all cumulative cases and 43.3% of the last 24 hours' new cases. So far, 66 of 178 health zones (37.1%) across eight provinces have been affected.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク最新情報（10月18日時点）
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイクが継続しており、累計9,552例・致死率48.2%と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、複数州への拡大も確認されているためフルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Suspende México importaciones avícolas de Brasil por brote de la enfermedad de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends poultry imports from Brazil due to Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Mexico suspended temporarily the import of poultry products from Brazil after confirmation of a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The suspension covers poultry meat, offal, singing and ornamental birds, and avian genetic material including fertile eggs and day-old chicks up to three days old. Brazilian authorities closed the farm and halted bird movement while measures to control and eradicate the outbreak are implemented per the contingency plan for Newcastle disease and Avian Influenza. Mexico remains free of velogenic Newcastle disease; SENASICA notes Mexico was declared free of this presentation in 2015. Newcastle is a highly contagious viral infection affecting domestic and wild birds, caused by avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1). Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected birds or their secretions and through contaminated objects. Information from Rio Doce.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽農場でのニューカッスル病発生に伴う貿易措置であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されておらず公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類感染症であり、ヒトへの重篤な健康影響は確認されていない。ブラジル当局は農場閉鎖等の対応を既に実施しており、動物衛生上の貿易措置として処理されている案件。

article.articleHeadline: Exploran el potencial de la eprinomectina como nuevo tratamiento frente a la leishmaniosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Researchers explore the potential of eprinomectin as a new treatment for leishmaniasis.
article.articleSummary: Eprinomectin, an avermectin B1 derivative used as a veterinary endectocide for cats and goats, is explored as a potential treatment for leishmaniasis in a China-based preclinical study. Leishmaniasis, a parasitic zoonosis caused by Leishmania with visceral and cutaneous forms, infects macrophages. In vitro assays showed selective anti-Leishmania activity, with intracellular amastigotes inhibited and morphology altered in a manner consistent with antiproliferative effects. In a murine infection model, treatment reduced parasite burden and tissue antigen levels. Transcriptomics revealed mitochondrial dysfunction, reduced oxidative phosphorylation, increased reactive oxygen species, metabolic stress, and S-phase cell cycle arrest. No systemic toxicity was observed: body weight remained stable and hematological and histopathological parameters were normal across major organs. Authors propose a multimodal mechanism targeting parasite metabolism and proliferation, supporting further study, including combination therapies and resistance-testing; results are preclinical in vitro and mouse models.

triage.headline_ja: エプリノメクチン、リーシュマニア症に対する新規治療薬の可能性を探る研究
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は前臨床（in vitro・マウスモデル）の治療薬研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 中国を拠点とした研究機関による前臨床試験の報告であり、中国国内での実際の感染事例やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため、発生地域としての中国は除外する。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de produtos avícolas do Brasil após foco de Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of poultry products from Brazil after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus identified in Santa Catarina, Brazil, on 19 October 2026. In response, Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian poultry products to protect its status as free of Newcastle disease. The suspension, announced by SENASICA (National Service for Agro-Food Health, Safety and Quality), prohibiting entry of poultry meat, giblets, and other poultry offal, fertile eggs, and chicks up to three days old, as well as songbirds, ornamental birds, and birds of prey destined for sale. The ban covers both commercial shipments and products carried by travelers. Targeting the country’s avian health, the measure aims to prevent introduction or spread of Newcastle disease into Mexico’s poultry sector. The report notes the outbreak location and the import restriction but provides no case counts or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生を受け家禽製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）発生による貿易制限であり、人への健康影響情報はないが、国際貿易への影響が生じているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（動物）における感染症であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的影響は報告されていない。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。症例数や検査確定情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende compra de frango do Brasil após foco de doença aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends purchase of Brazilian chicken after outbreak of avian disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak identified at a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, led to farm interdiction and control measures as authorities work to contain and eradicate the infection; detection occurred on Sunday, October 18, with measures announced and the farm closed. In response, Mexico suspended purchases of Brazilian chicken meat on Monday, October 19, restricting live birds and fertile eggs to protect its poultry industry, which remains free of Newcastle disease. Newcastle disease is highly transmissible among birds, affecting respiratory and nervous systems, reducing egg production, and causing high mortality in flocks; human risk is low, though exposed individuals may develop mild conjunctivitis. Brazil is the world’s leading exporter of chicken meat.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで鳥インフルエンザ(ニューカッスル病)発生後、メキシコがブラジル産鶏肉の購入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病の発生によりメキシコがブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止するなど、既に貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の国際拡大リスクと貿易制限の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）を対象とした動物感染症であり、人への健康リスクは低いとされる（軽度の結膜炎程度）。ただし国際貿易への影響が既に顕在化しているため、IHR基準上はピックアップ対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de aves do Brasil por Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends poultry imports from Brazil due to Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends imports of poultry products from Brazil after Newcastle disease was confirmed in Santa Catarina. On 19 Oct 2026, the Mexican Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development, via Senasica, barred entry of poultry meat and viscera, songbirds and ornamental birds, and poultry genetic material (fertile eggs and day-old chicks up to 3 days) to protect its poultry industry; restrictions apply to commercial shipments and products carried by travelers. Mexico is considered free of Newcastle disease. Newcastle is a viral, acute, highly contagious infection that affects domestic and wild birds; in humans it can cause conjunctivitis. In birds, symptoms include respiratory problems, nervous signs, and drops in daily egg production; mortality can reach 100% in unvaccinated flocks. Brazil’s MAP confirmed on 18 Oct 2026 a focus at a commercial turkey and broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service has adopted containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産家禽の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生事象ではあるが、ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州での発生に対しメキシコが家禽製品の輸入を全面停止しており、国際的な拡大リスクと貿易制限の両方のIHR基準に該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: ヒトへの健康影響は限定的（結膜炎程度）で、主に家禽の産業・貿易への影響が中心の動物衛生イベントである。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Novo surto de Newcastle eleva riscos para exportadoras de frango
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New outbreak of Newcastle disease raises risks for chicken exporters.
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease case identified this week in a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, threatening chicken meat exports even after containment. Itaú BBA warns that trade restrictions could persist beyond the outbreak, depending on importers’ responses; cites the July 2024 outbreak in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, after which China maintained restrictions on poultry meat from that state until January 2026. Santa Catarina accounts for about 22% of Brazil’s chicken exports and 13% of slaughter volume. Secex data compiled by BTG Pactual show October’s third-week daily exports 23.6% above the prior year, with USD revenue up 41.5%. ABPA’s Ricardo Santin signaled a preventive self-embargo for China. European Union imports may be allowed to resume later this year, possibly December, after favorable audits, with remaining bureaucratic steps as the main bottleneck.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなニューカッスル病の発生、鶏肉輸出業者のリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、人への公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。貿易制限への言及はあるが、人間の健康危機シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生であり、人獣共通感染症としての報告はない。記事内容は主にブラジルの鶏肉輸出への経済的影響と中国・EUの輸入規制に関するもの。中国は輸入制限措置の対象国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: México proíbe importação de aves do Brasil devido a surto de Newcastle em Santa Catarina - Fala Canedo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico bans the import of birds from Brazil due to an outbreak of Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina, Brazil - Fala Canedo.
article.articleSummary: Mexico halts imports of Brazilian poultry after Newcastle disease outbreak identified at a farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The ban covers meat, eggs, and live birds, reflecting concern for animal health and food security. Newcastle disease is highly contagious and can affect multiple bird species, triggering a regional sanitary alert in Santa Catarina. Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry is coordinating with health authorities to control the outbreak, reinforce biosecurity on farms, and implement a monitoring program. Once contained, import restrictions are expected to be lifted. The move highlights the vulnerability of global poultry markets to animal diseases, with Mexico—a major export market for Brazilian chicken products—potentially impacting producers and consumers in both countries.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産鳥類の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物衛生事象であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。貿易制限（輸入禁止）はあるが、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当は限定的で、社会的関心も公衆衛生分野では高くない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo Federal decreta emergência zoossanitária por 60 dias após doença de Newcastle ser detectada em granja de perus em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal Government decrees a 60-day zoosanitary emergency after Newcastle disease is detected at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease triggers a 60-day federal zoosanitary emergency in four western Santa Catarina municipalities after confirmation at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The outbreak spans Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim. MAPA Portaria No. 962, published Oct 19, authorizes sanitary measures to contain and eradicate the focus and prevent spread to other holdings. The affected farm houses about 6,000 turkeys; the birds had no clinical signs. Surveillance identified the focus from samples collected Sept 21–Oct 14 and confirmed Oct 18. The property is interdicted and bird movements suspended. Approximately 133 poultry properties in the area will be monitored, with visits, clinical assessments, and samples sent to LFDA-SP for testing. Depopulation of the flock, followed by cleaning and disinfection, is planned; there are no recalls or planned movement of birds from other properties. Officials say inspected poultry meat remains safe for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦政府、サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病確認後、60日間の家畜衛生緊急事態を布告

article.articleHeadline: China deve parar de comprar frango do Brasil após caso de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China should stop buying Brazilian chicken after a Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Brazil must temporarily suspend chicken meat exports to China after a Newcastle disease case was confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina. Under a bilateral sanitary protocol, Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry halts shipments whenever an avian infectious disease is identified, and China will decide whether the embargo covers the entire country or only the outbreak region, potentially allowing other areas to resume exports. Brazil must demonstrate containment measures and restored sanitary conditions before trade normalizes. A similar 2024 scenario occurred when a Newcastle case in Rio Grande do Sul triggered a China export suspension; purchases were later resumed after 26 days, though Rio Grande do Sul products remained blocked longer. Mexico moved quickly to suspend Brazilian imports on 2026-10-19, and the Nova Itaberaba farm remains closed and under sanitary monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、中国がブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止する見通し

triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物衛生事案であり、ヒト感染症としての報告はない。記事は主に中国・メキシコによる輸入停止などの貿易影響を扱っている。中国は発生地域として言及されているが、実際の発生国はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: China food-chain Salmonella resistance forecasts reveal divergent genetic
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, China-wide genomic surveillance finds Salmonella enterica across the food chain remains broadly multidrug resistant. Analyzing 2,536 MDR isolates from 15 provinces (2006–2022) with 421 AMR traits, researchers forecast 84 high-risk traits to increase by 2050. The study links patients, food workers, pork and chicken, livestock and farm environments, enabling cross-source tracing; 88% of traits are mobile on plasmids or insertion sequences, and 134 traits are unique to food workers, including blaCTX-M-64, blaTEM-30, blaNDM-5 and mcr-1.1_IS1A. A five-by-five risk framework and Bayesian models (18 antibiotic-specific fits; temporal validation AUC 0.94) identify 205 high-risk traits, 98% mobile and present in ≥2 provinces and ≥2 serogroups. Projections differ by gene: blaCTX-M-64/blaTEM-1 may rise up to ~20% by 2050; blaCTX-M-65 <5%; tetA/tetM up; tetB down; qnrB17/qnrS1 rise. Associations with socioeconomic, health-system and antimicrobial-use indicators exist, but causality is not proven.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の食品チェーンにおけるサルモネラ耐性予測、異なる遺伝的軌跡を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 急性のアウトブレイクではなく、2006-2022年のゲノムサーベイランスデータに基づく将来予測の学術研究であり、現時点での公衆衛生上の緊急対応を要するイベントではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は薬剤耐性菌(AMR)の将来予測に関する学術研究報告であり、急性の感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。継続的なモニタリング対象ではあるが、現時点でのシグナルとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil suspende exportações de carne de frango para a China após caso de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil suspends chicken meat exports to China after Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease case identified in Santa Catarina leads Brazil to suspend chicken meat exports to China. The virus’s genetic material was detected in birds at a Santa Catarina property, though the flock showed no clinical signs. The measure follows a sanitary protocol between Brazil and China and was confirmed by ABPA president Ricardo Santin during SIAL Paris. The auto-suspension mandates immediate export halt and information sharing while Brazil awaits China’s regionalization criteria for resuming shipments. Brazilian authorities, including the Ministry of Agriculture and the Ministry of Foreign Affairs, notified trading partners and the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) as required. The affected flock has been culled. In most agreements, suspensions are limited to Santa Catarina state, the municipality, or within a 10-km radius of the outbreak, with restarts contingent on technical evaluations by market authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受け中国向け鶏肉輸出を停止

triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は主に鳥類に感染する家畜疾患であり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害の報告はない。記事の主題はブラジル国内の農場での発生とそれに伴う中国向け輸出停止という貿易・産業上の措置であり、公衆衛生危機ではない。中国・フランス（パリ）は取引先/発表場所として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Qué es la enfermedad de Newcastle, luego que México suspendiera la importación de productos avícolas de Brasil por brote en ese país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Newcastle disease, after Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry products due to an outbreak in Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended import of poultry products from Brazil after Brazil’s Ministry confirmed a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. SENASICA deactivated Zoosanitary Requirements in its control platforms, blocking entry for both commercial shipments and travelers. The restriction covers meat (fresh or frozen), poultry by-products, fertile eggs, and live birds, including canaries, ornamental species, raptors for sale, and avian pets. The General Directorate of Animal Health will keep the import inactivation until Brazil provides technical containment and elimination reports for its Production Units. Newcastle disease is a contagious viral infection affecting domestic, wild, and ornamental birds; virulence ranges from lentogenic (mild respiratory) to velogenic (high mortality). Mexico has been free since 2015, with isolated backyard cases in Veracruz and Nayarit. Biosecurity recommendations include disinfection mats, worker hygiene, daily flock checks, and reporting. Imported Brazilian poultry products may be seized or destroyed at entry.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ブラジルでの発生を受けてブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を停止―ニューカッスル病とは何か
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの商業養鶏場でニューカッスル病（家禽ウイルス性疾患）が確認され、メキシコが輸入停止措置を取った貿易関連事象。人への健康影響は確認されておらず、IHR基準は貿易制限の1項目のみ該当のためフルRRAには至らないが、家禽産業・貿易への影響は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本事象は家禽（動物）疾患であり、人への感染・公衆衛生影響の記載はない。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルが発生国として該当。貿易・畜産業への影響として継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Agra News: सोरों के ब्रह्मा कुमारी आश्रम की एक युवती डेंगू पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agra News: A young woman at Soron’s Brahma Kumari Ashram tests positive for dengue.
article.articleSummary: Kasganj district, Soron area reports a dengue-positive case in a young woman named Nemwati, daughter of Surajpal, brought to the district hospital Monday night and admitted after tests confirmed dengue. Another patient, Asha of Nagla Sukha village, also from Soron, was admitted with fever. With changing weather, infectious diseases such as fever, typhoid, malaria, and dengue are increasing, with some patients receiving initial treatment or being discharged, while more severe cases are hospitalized. The dengue-positive case was identified at the Brahma Kumari Ashram in Soron, where Nemwati is under observation. Officials note multiple fever presentations in the area and the health system is monitoring and treating affected individuals.

triage.headline_ja: アグラニュース：ソロンのブラフマ・クマリ・アシュラムの若い女性がデング熱陽性
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域における散発的なデング熱・発熱症例の報告であり、通常の季節性感染症動向を示すもので、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも顕著な該当がない。
triage.notes: 季節性の発熱症例（デング熱、マラリア、腸チフス）の増加を報告するローカルニュースであり、特定の異常な流行や重症化、国際的拡大の兆候は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Air Tercemar E. Coli di Serpong Lagoon, Pipa dan Tandon Perlu Didisinfeksi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli-contaminated water in the Serpong Lagoon, pipes and storage tanks need to be disinfected
article.articleSummary: E. coli contamination detected in water from Serpong Lagoon facilities in Setu, Tangerang Selatan, Banten, Indonesia, prompting disinfection of main supply pipes and storage tanks after most samples—including household water—tested positive for E. coli, a fecal contamination indicator. Cleaning steps include brushing tank walls with detergent, rinsing, disinfecting with a high-chlorine solution, and flushing until chlorine odor dissipates. Water should not be used for drinking, cooking, or brushing teeth until E. coli is zero and chlorine residual meets Ministry of Health Regulation No. 2 of 2023. As of Oct 19, 2026, 176 residents reported vomiting and diarrhea; local health authorities are monitoring. Dicky Budiman warns of possible hemolytic-uremic syndrome in children, usually 5–10 days after diarrhea, requiring prompt medical attention. Health department and water operator have halted water use pending improvements and ongoing quality checks.

triage.headline_ja: セルポンラグーンでE.coli汚染水、配管と貯水槽の消毒が必要
triage.triage_reason: 水道水のE.coli汚染により176名が嘔吐・下痢を発症し地域的な公衆衛生対応が行われているが、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の要素はなく、続報（HUS発症の有無等）を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: 溶血性尿毒症症候群（HUS）発症の可能性が専門家により指摘されているが、現時点で確定症例の報告はない。続報で重症化・拡大の有無を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: China suspende importações de produtos avícolas de Santa Catarina após foco de Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China suspends imports of poultry products from Santa Catarina after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in a commercial farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil prompted China to suspend imports of poultry products from 14 export-enabled facilities in Santa Catarina, per the Chinese GACC registry. The suspension follows confirmation of the Newcastle disease focus in Nova Itaberaba. Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture has not yet confirmed the measure, and ABPA did not comment. China was notified on Oct 19. The bilateral sanitary protocol triggers auto-suspension of poultry exports from the whole country, but Brazilian authorities said they would seek regionalization to limit impact. The article notes that Mexico suspended purchases of all Brazil following the confirmation of the case. No further details on laboratory confirmation timing or the infection source beyond the Nova Itaberaba farm are provided.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、同州からの家禽製品輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業養鶏場でニューカッスル病の発生が確認され、中国・メキシコが輸入停止措置を取るなど、国際貿易制限（IHR基準）と異常性の2基準に該当したため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 本事象は家禽（動物）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は報告されていない。ただし中国・メキシコによる貿易制限措置が取られており、経済的・貿易上の国際的影響としてIHR基準に該当するためピックアップとした。続報でブラジル農務省の公式確認や感染拡大状況を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ada Sampah Covid-19 di TPST Abu & Co, Akademisi Soroti Tingginya Potensi Pencemaran Sungai Cisadane
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: COVID-19 Waste at TPST Abu & Co, Academics Highlight the High Potential for Cisadane River Pollution.
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 waste at TPST Abu & Co in Serpong, Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia, has prompted academic and official scrutiny amid ongoing investigations into administrative violations and environmental pollution. Inspectors from Tangsel’s Environmental Service (DLH), the Spatial Planning and Building Agency, and Satpol PP found domestic waste, restaurant scraps, and pandemic-era plastics at the site, noting the facility lacks an on-site wastewater treatment plant (IPAL). PPLH DLH Tangsel official Sampe Simanungkalit warned the waste pile likely generates leachate and could contaminate surface water and groundwater, despite the operator claiming it is not medical waste. UI risk-management academic Yuki Wardhana cautioned that if the facility lies on the Cisadane River floodplain without adequate management, leachate and runoff could pollute the Cisadane River and local aquifers, reducing dissolved oxygen and harming aquatic ecosystems.

triage.headline_ja: TPST Abu & Co施設にCOVID-19廃棄物、学者がチサダネ川汚染の高い懸念を指摘
triage.triage_reason: 感染症の新規発生や流行に関する内容ではなく、廃棄物処理施設の環境汚染問題に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19の感染拡大事例ではなく、パンデミック時代のプラスチック廃棄物を含む一般廃棄物処理施設の環境汚染（浸出水による河川・地下水汚染リスク）に関する内容。感染症サーベイランスの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de frango brasileiro após surto de doença aviária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports after outbreak of avian disease
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian chicken meat, live birds, and fertile eggs on Oct 19, 2026, after confirmation of Newcastle disease at a commercial turkey farm in southern Brazil. The farm was quarantined and authorities announced control and eradication measures. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection in birds, causing respiratory and neurological signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality; it does not pose a significant risk to human health. Brazil is the world’s largest exporter of chicken meat, making the measure a new challenge for the Brazilian poultry sector while the country maintains its disease-free status. The precautionary ban aims to protect Mexico’s domestic production and disease-free status while authorities address the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、鳥類疾病の発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、記事内で人の健康への重大なリスクはないと明記されている。農場は隔離され、ヒトへの感染拡大の懸念は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de aves do Brasil após Newcastle | SBT News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of birds from Brazil after Newcastle disease | SBT News
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of birds and poultry products from Brazil after a Newcastle disease case was confirmed at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina, announced Oct 19. The ban covers chicken meat, poultry viscera, fertile eggs, day-old chicks up to three days old, ornamental and songbirds, birds of prey, and companion birds. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection in birds, causing respiratory illness, neurological signs, and death; in humans, exposure can cause mild conjunctivitis. Brazil is the world’s largest chicken meat exporter, and Mexico, which is free of Newcastle disease, viewed the measure as protective for its poultry industry. Since 2022, Brazil has been Mexico’s second-largest chicken meat supplier; Mexico was the seventh-largest importer of Brazilian chicken last year (ABPA). In May 2025, Mexico briefly closed its market to Brazilian poultry after an avian influenza notification, later suspended as risk declined.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病発生後、メキシコがブラジル産鳥類の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の感染症で人間への影響は軽微（結膜炎程度）であり、ヒト-ヒト感染もない。主に家禽産業・貿易上の措置に関する内容で、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えない。
triage.notes: 本件は家禽疾患（ニューカッスル病）の発生に伴うメキシコによる貿易制限措置であり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクは低い。農業・貿易分野での関心事項として扱うべき内容。メキシコは発生国ではなく輸入停止措置を取った側のため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Prato, isolata la "camera calda" del pronto soccorso per un sospetto caso di antrace Il Tirreno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prato, the emergency department's 'hot room' isolated for a suspected case of anthrax - Il Tirreno
article.articleSummary: Prato, Italy – The emergency department's 'hot room' at Santo Stefano hospital was isolated for about 30 minutes on 20 October 2026 for a suspected anthrax (carbonchio) case. A patient who had just returned from Zambia, where he worked and visited a region with an anthrax outbreak, presented with a pustule. Although this alone would not trigger alerts, the travel history prompted precautionary measures. The local health authority evacuated the hot room, moved other patients away, and staff donned protective gear; anthrax is zoonotic and not transmitted person-to-person. The patient was treated at the emergency department and later transferred to Florence's Infectious Diseases department. His condition is not serious, but precautions were necessary.

triage.headline_ja: プラート（イタリア）、炭疽疑い例で救急の「ホットルーム」を隔離
triage.triage_reason: イタリアでの疑い例は軽症で人-人感染もなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、渡航歴のあるザンビアで炭疽の発生が継続していることが示唆されており、詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はイタリアでの疑い症例対応だが、患者が訪問したザンビアで炭疽アウトブレイクが発生していると記載されており、ザンビアでの状況を注視する必要がある。イタリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: New Ebola guidelines put contact tracing, cross-border surveillance in focus
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak, linked to a traveler from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Nairobi, has spurred updated surveillance and contact-tracing guidelines from Africa CDC and the WHO. The document, Surveillance, Case Investigation and Contact Tracing in Filovirus Disease Outbreaks, updates the 2015 Ebola contact-tracing guidance and covers five key areas: routine surveillance in humans and wildlife, early warning and alert systems, outbreak investigation and contact tracing, epidemiological analysis, and community engagement. It requires listing and a 21-day follow-up for contact persons of probable and confirmed cases and emphasizes cross-border tracing to prevent transmission across East Africa. By October 18, Kenya had eight confirmed cases with one death; four additional cases announced on October 17 involved three health workers and one male relative, all already in quarantine when tested. The guidelines stress rapid laboratory confirmation, infection prevention for health workers, and building cross-border coordination into outbreak response from the outset.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなエボラ出血熱対応ガイドライン、接触者追跡と国境を越えたサーベイランスに焦点
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（確定8例、死亡1例、医療従事者感染含む）が発生し、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクからAfrica CDC/WHOが新ガイドラインを発出するなど、国際的関心と対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（DRCからの渡航者がウガンダ経由でナイロビに入国し発端）。確定症例はケニアで報告されており、DRCやウガンダでの確定症例の記載はないため、対象国リストに該当する国として確認できる発生国はない。Kenya・Ugandaは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil's Newcastle poultry outbreak unlikely to have major long-term impact, analysts say
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at one farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, on Oct 20, 2026; containment measures underway. Brazil, largest chicken meat exporter, faces trade disruption as Mexico suspended imports and Brazil weighs a self-embargo on shipments to China while awaiting whether restrictions apply nationwide or only to the affected area. JPMorgan and Santander analysts say the outbreak is unlikely to cause lasting damage if contained quickly; China, about 10% of Brazilian exports, remains the key uncertainty. They estimate possible disruption of around 15% of production under current protocols if Chinese restrictions persist. In 2024, a Rio Grande do Sul outbreak led to a 25% export drop, which rebounded. Reactions: MBRF down 4% and JBS about 1%. If restriction duration is unclear, exporters may reroute to markets or the domestic, pressuring prices and margins. China and destinations like the EU, Saudi Arabia, and Japan have moved toward localized responses.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのニューカッスル病による養鶏業への打撃、長期的な大きな影響は見込まれずとアナリスト
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病による農業・貿易への影響に関する記事であり、人の公衆衛生リスクは報告されていないため、感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染症としての公衆衛生リスクはほぼない。記事は貿易・経済影響に焦点を当てており、動物衛生当局のサーベイランス対象ではあるが、EBSのヒト感染症シグナルトリアージの対象外に近い。

article.articleHeadline: Caso de Newcastle em SC trava exportação de frango à China - Visor Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina halts chicken exports to China - Visor Notícias
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, involving about 6,000 turkeys. The flock remained on-site and did not enter meat production; the facility is interdicted and animal movements suspended, with elimination of the outbreak followed by cleaning and disinfection. Surveillance has expanded to roughly 133 properties across Nova Itaberaba, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim, and Águas Frias. The Brazilian-Chinese sanitary protocol triggers an initial export embargo, with China to decide whether to regionalize the restriction to the affected area or extend it to all of Brazil. China purchased about 420,000 tonnes of Brazilian chicken meat from January–September 2026 (around 10% of national exports); Mexico has also suspended Brazilian poultry product imports. The event recalls a 2024 Newcastle case in Rio Grande do Sul. No consumer food safety risk is implied for inspected products; international decisions will define economic impact.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生により、中国向け鶏肉輸出が停止

triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の疾患であり、ヒトへの直接的健康リスクは記載されていない。主な論点は中国・メキシコ向け輸出停止という貿易措置であり、公衆衛生上のリスク評価の対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Duale appoints KMPDU deputy SG Miskellah to Ebola control taskforce
article.articleSummary: Kenya appointed KMPDU deputy secretary general Dennis Miskellah to the National Ebola Disease Taskforce as the government steps up preparedness following confirmation of Bundibugyo virus disease in Kenya. By 2026-10-20, imported cases have reached eight, including close family members of the initial patient and medical staff. The taskforce, chaired by Mary Muthoni (Principal Secretary for Public Health and Professional Standards) and co-chaired by the Council of Governors’ CEO, will provide strategic leadership and coordinate national and county-level outbreak response, surveillance, communications, and mobilization. Miskellah’s appointment is immediate; he will attend meetings, offer strategic advice, support implementation of decisions, and maintain confidentiality, with all public communications routed through authorized Ministry of Health channels. The move brings organized medical practitioner representation to Kenya’s response to the Congo-origin Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: デュアレ氏、KMPDU副事務総長ミスケラ氏をエボラ対策タスクフォースに任命
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ由来のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）がケニアに輸入され、家族・医療従事者を含む感染者が8例に増加しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de aves do Brasil por Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends importation of birds from Brazil due to Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 20, 2026, Mexico suspended imports of poultry products from Brazil due to a Newcastle disease focus confirmed in Santa Catarina. The focus was identified at a commercial turkey and broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, SC. Mexico's Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development (SADER), via the National Service for Agro-Food Health, Safety and Quality (SENASICA), restricted entry and approvals for meat and viscera from birds, canaries and ornamental birds, fertile eggs, and day-old chicks, for both commercial imports and tourist-transported products. Newcastle disease is a viral, highly contagious infection affecting domestic and wild birds; in humans it can cause conjunctivitis. In birds, symptoms include respiratory and nervous signs and reduced egg production, with mortality up to 100% in unvaccinated flocks. Brazil's MAPA confirmed the Nova Itaberaba outbreak on Oct 18, 2026, and Santa Catarina's Official Veterinary Service implemented property interdiction, restricted access, movement controls, and a containment plan.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽に限定された動物衛生事案であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは低い。貿易制限（メキシコの輸入停止）はあるがIHR基準の他要件を満たさずWPRO基準も該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Manila dengue cases now at 4,048
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 20, 2026, Manila, Philippines, logged 31 new dengue cases on Monday, bringing the total to 4,048 since Jan 1. On the same day, the city reported 28 new influenza-like illness (ILI) cases, 2 severe acute respiratory infection (SARI) cases, and 1 leptospirosis case. Totals to date include 2,508 ILI, 1,648 leptospirosis, 525 SARI, 106 COVID-19, 85 typhoid fever, and 4 cholera cases. Mayor Isko Moreno urged residents to seek prompt medical care rather than waiting for symptoms to worsen.

triage.notes: 複数疾患（デング熱、インフルエンザ様疾患、レプトスピラ症、COVID-19、腸チフス、コレラ）の定期累計報告。季節性の年次サーベイランスデータであり、特定の異常増加や重症化の兆候は記事から読み取れない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: MSF ferme son centre Elikiya à Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: MSF closes its Elikiya Center in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: MSF closes its Ebola treatment center Elikiya in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on October 31, 2026, after four months of operation during which 572 patients with confirmed Ebola were treated. The facility, about 100 beds, is being shut as part of an emergency-response adaptation; no new admissions are allowed, with other Bunia centers absorbing patients. After closure, suspected cases will be routed to four nearby centers: Bunia General Reference Hospital, RWankole Hospital, CME Hoho, and the center near Rwampara General Reference Hospital. MSF continues to operate eight treatment centers across affected areas, with a total capacity of 300 beds. While transmission persists, there are signs of calm in Mambasa territory (Niania) with over two weeks without new confirmed cases, though cases remain elsewhere. Since May, the outbreak has caused 4,602 deaths among 9,552 confirmed cases (48.5% CFR) across eight provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi, Nord-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：MSFがブニアのElikiyaセンターを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で継続中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクは9,552例確定、致死率48.5%と極めて深刻であり、8州にわたり感染が継続しているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本記事はMSFの治療センター閉鎖という運用上の更新だが、背景にある大規模アウトブレイク（9,552症例、4,602死亡、8州に拡大）は既にフルリスク評価の対象として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Raises Kenya Travel Warning to Level 3 as Ebola Outbreak Spreads Across East Africa - [your]NEWS
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to expand in East Africa. Kenya reports its eighth Ebola infection, all tracing to the initial patient who traveled from Congo through Uganda to Nairobi, where he died on Oct 5; laboratory confirmation identifies Bundibugyo virus. The latest case is a 49-year-old hospital attendant who handled laundry and other items; fever, headache and muscle pain were noted, with 1 positive among 38 tested on Sunday. No evidence of widespread community transmission in Kenya, but authorities are tracing contacts and enforcing isolation to curb spread. The Congo outbreak has killed more than 4,500 people across eight provinces, fueling cross-border spread. On Oct 19, the U.S. State Department raised Kenya to Travel Level 3, citing limited medical resources and evacuation costs, and warning of crime and terrorism risks, including avoidance of Nairobi’s Eastleigh and Kibera neighborhoods and Garissa, Wajir, Mandera, and Lamu counties.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ拡大を受けケニアの渡航警告をレベル3に引き上げ—東アフリカで感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）が複数国境を越えて拡大し、米国がケニアの渡航警告を引き上げるなど国際的対応が生じており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC由来のエボラ流行がウガンダ経由でケニアに拡大している事例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、流行の発生源であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: US urges citizens to reconsider Kenya travel over Ebola - US urges citizens to reconsider Kenya travel over Ebola
article.articleSummary: United States warns citizens against travel to Kenya due to Ebola risk as Kenya reports an eighth Ebola case. The first Kenyan case, a citizen who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, tested positive after returning home in early October and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Seven additional Kenyan cases have followed, mainly among relatives of the initial patient, health workers who treated him, and a medical support staff member. The U.S. embassy said the advisory level was raised from Level 2 to Level 3, advising to reconsider travel due to health, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest and traffic safety. Kenya has identified 130 contacts; 128 have been traced and placed in quarantine. The Kenyan outbreak follows a major Congo outbreak that has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ熱によりケニアへの渡航再考を市民に要請

triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源かつ現在進行中の大規模流行地であるDRC（9000例超、4381人死亡）は対象国リストに該当するため含めた。ケニアでの8例目確認と米国の渡航勧告引き上げは国際拡大の重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Vigilância Ambiental de Varginha faz ações educativas sobre doenças transmitidas por insetos e pombos | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Environmental Surveillance of Varginha Conducts Educational Actions on Diseases Transmitted by Insects and Pigeons | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Varginha, Brazil—On 2026-10-20, the Municipal Environmental Surveillance unit distributed educational materials during the city’s 2nd Inclusive Walk to raise awareness of diseases spread by insects and pigeons. The outreach emphasizes arboviruses such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, and health risks from expanding pigeon populations. Pigeon-related diseases highlighted include cryptococcosis, a severe fungal infection caused by spores in dried droppings that can reach the lungs and central nervous system. Also noted are histoplasmosis and salmonellosis linked to dried feces or contaminated food, and dermatitis and allergies from mites and lice that can migrate into homes. Preventive guidance includes not feeding pigeons, securing garbage and pet food, sealing roof gaps, and never sweeping dry droppings; instead dampen with a bleach solution before cleaning. Use basic PPE, including gloves and a mask, during cleaning.

triage.headline_ja: ヴァルジーニャ環境監視局、昆虫・鳩媒介疾患に関する啓発活動を実施
