triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染症アウトブレイクを報告するものではなく、地方自治体による啓発・予防教育活動の紹介記事である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases: Health workers union questions system's readiness to protect them
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola cases have been recorded in Kenya, including one in the past 24 hours, after a Kenyan who fell ill in the Democratic Republic of Congo sought treatment in Nairobi. Approximately 4,000 health workers have been trained to handle Ebola, but the Kenya Medical Practitioners, Pharmacists and Dentists Union (KMPDU) says this is insufficient and seeks union representation on the national Ebola task force to monitor PPE, staffing, insurance, and budget plans. The union notes gaps in exposure control and says direct-contact staff were isolated per WHO protocols, while some lower-exposure staff faced different quarantine rules. Kenya faces health worker shortages (roughly 1 doctor per 16,000–17,000 people in some areas versus WHO 1 per 10,000). Last mass recruitment was in 2019; the pledged 2,000 doctors remains unimplemented. The union calls for real protection: adequate PPE, isolation/quarantine units, and affordable care amid Ebola concerns in the DRC and regional outbreaks such as Liberia.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ症例：医療従事者組合が防護体制の準備不足を問う
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染者がケニアで確認され、国境を越えた伝播が発生していることに加え、医療体制の脆弱性への社会的懸念が高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア国内での対応体制（医療従事者組合の懸念）だが、感染者はDRCで発症し越境伝播が発生しているため、背景としてDRCでのエボラ流行が確認される。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Pode atingir humanos? Entenda a doença registrada em granja de perus de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can it affect humans? Learn about the disease recorded at a Santa Catarina turkey farm.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak identified in a Santa Catarina turkey farm, Brazil. A surveillance collection on 21 September at a farm with 6,000 birds led to confirmation by the Federal Agricultural Defense Laboratory (LFDA) on 18 October 2026. The event prompted market impacts as Brazil, a major poultry producer/exporter, saw temporary import suspensions by China and Mexico (China's restriction limited to Santa Catarina products). Newcastle disease is a virus affecting domestic and wild birds; infected birds exhibit respiratory, nervous, and digestive signs, with mortality that can reach 100% of the flock. No treatment exists; affected lots must be culled to prevent spread. Transmission mainly via aerosols and feces. Prevention relies on biosafety programs, keeping birds confined, restricting visitors, vaccination per MAPA, and effective disinfection. In humans, infection is rare and usually mild conjunctivitis after close contact with infected birds, and consumption of poultry products is safe.

triage.headline_ja: 人にも感染する？サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場で確認された疾病について解説
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場でのニューカッスル病発生は家禽への影響が主で、ヒトへの感染は稀かつ軽症（結膜炎）にとどまり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威は低いため。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒト感染は稀で軽度の結膜炎程度。中国・メキシコによる一時的な輸入停止は貿易上の影響であり、公衆衛生リスクとしては低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil suspende exportações de aves para China e Malásia após foco de Newcastle; México interrompe compras - Money Times
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil Suspends Poultry Exports to China and Malaysia After Newcastle Disease Outbreak; Mexico Halts Purchases - Money Times
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil prompted the suspension of poultry meat exports to China and Malaysia by the Ministry of Agriculture as of 20 October 2026, after confirmation at a commercial turkey farm of about 6,000 birds. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared across four Santa Catarina municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim—facilitating rapid response and interjurisdictional coordination. Measures include restricting movements near the farm and halting outbound birds from the establishment. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection of birds, causing respiratory signs, apathy, neurological symptoms, and diarrhea. This is Brazil’s second documented outbreak in a commercial operation; the first occurred on 17 July 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, with control by 25 July 2024. Mexico, a major buyer, paused imports of Brazilian chicken to protect its poultry sector; Mexican data show boneless chicken breast imports rising from 90,000 to 196,000 tonnes (2022–2025) per UNAC.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けて中国・マレーシア向け鶏肉輸出を停止；メキシコも購入を停止 - Money Times
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで商業家禽農場におけるニューカッスル病の発生が確認され、複数国（中国・マレーシア・メキシコ）が輸出入を停止するなど貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の『異常性』『貿易制限』の2項目に該当するため、家禽疾病・貿易影響の観点からフルアセスメントへの移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒトへの感染ではなく家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生であり、公衆衛生への直接影響は低いが、国際貿易（輸出入停止）への影響が顕著であるため、農業・貿易リスクの観点からモニタリングを継続することが望ましい。中国・マレーシア・メキシコは発生地域ではなく貿易相手国として言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil comunica à OMSA caso de Doença de Newcastle em aviário comercial de perus em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil reports a Newcastle disease case to OMSA at a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease (paramyxovirus type 1, PMV-1) was confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The outbreak was reported to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH/OMSA) on Oct 18, 2026, with onset on Sept 21 as samples collected during active surveillance tested positive on Oct 14 and were confirmed on Oct 18 by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP). Twenty-six of 6,526 susceptible birds in the flock were affected; the case is described as a recurrence of an eradicated disease, with unknown or inconclusive origin. The farm was immediately quarantined; control measures include bird movement restrictions, zoning, disinfection, sanitary disposal of birds and waste, enhanced surveillance beyond the restricted area, and traceability. Four municipalities are under zoosanitary emergency: Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. This is Brazil’s second official Newcastle disease case in commercial poultry (first in 2024, Anta Gorda, RS).

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病の症例をOMSA（世界動物保健機関）に報告
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（家禽）であり直接的なヒトへの健康影響は報告されていないが、貿易・家禽産業への影響と再発事例という点で注視が必要。ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）における動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害は報告されていない。貿易面でOMSA通報・検疫措置が取られているため家禽産業への影響はあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : une flambée de diarrhée cholériforme à Ufamandu, une quarantaine de décès rapportés
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: a cholera-like diarrheal outbreak in Ufamandu, around forty deaths reported.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, Ufamandu groupement in Katoyi sector, reports a cholera-like diarrheal outbreak with more than 100 cases across at least four health areas and around 40 deaths (Busiire 20, Kikoma 15, Biolo 5). Fourteen patients are hospitalized in Mangere. Authorities have not confirmed these figures; bacteriological confirmation for cholera is not yet established. The Chief Medical Officer for Katoyi, Dr. Justin Safari, says he has been informed and requests detailed reports and a humanitarian corridor to access the area. The situation is hampered by inaccessibility, potentially biasing community versus official tallies. North Kivu is also confronting an Ebola outbreak that strains resources; the latest national tally cites 2,084 confirmed Ebola cases and 1,176 deaths in the province.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:ウファマンドゥでコレラ様下痢の流行、約40人の死亡が報告される
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高い下痢症(コレラ疑い)の集団発生で死者約40名、入院患者もあり、同地域で進行中のエボラ流行と資源が競合し医療アクセスも困難なため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でのコレラ様下痢の流行を主題としている。アルメニア、イタリアの地域情報はBluedotの誤付与と判断し除外。細菌学的確認はまだ得られておらず、当局による数値確認も未了。同地域で進行中のエボラ流行（確定2084例、死亡1176例）が医療資源を圧迫している点も重要。

article.articleHeadline: Mais de 10 casos de tuberculose são identificados no presídio de Três Passos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 10 tuberculosis cases identified at the Três Passos prison.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis cases identified at the Estadual de Três Passos Prison in northwest Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. From July–August, 16 notifications were reported; 13 cases remain active and two inmates are hospitalized at Hospital Vila Nova in Porto Alegre. Epidemiological surveillance indicates all patients are in treatment and monitored by prison health teams; no new cases were reported from September–October, keeping notifications stable. Lacen’s analysis suggests some cases may be related, but the absolute count alone does not confirm an outbreak given inmate turnover. Control measures include Directly Observed Therapy (DOT), active contact tracing, and referral for testing to Lacen. Ongoing monitoring is hampered by high inmate density and facility infrastructure limiting isolation. The issue became public via an anonymous tip to the Public Prosecutor’s Office in August. The Rio Grande do Sul Penal Police states all diagnosed inmates received care; no staff tested positive.

triage.headline_ja: トレス・パソス刑務所で結核症例が10件以上確認
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内という集団感染リスクの高い環境での結核クラスターだが、既に管理下にあり新規症例もなく、国際的拡大の懸念は低いため、経過観察に留める。
triage.notes: 刑務所内の結核クラスターでDOTや接触者追跡など対策は実施済み、9-10月は新規症例なし。地域の公衆衛生当局（Lacen）が監視中で既存の管理体制下にあると判断。

article.articleHeadline: Alarma por $700 millones en ayuda contra el ébola sin rastro en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm over $700 million in aid to combat Ebola with no trace in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola funding in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is in question as $700 million in aid is untraceable, prompting calls for enhanced financial transparency from Africa CDC and Congolese authorities. The outbreak, described as the fastest-growing Ebola crisis on record, has spread to eight provinces in the DRC and to neighboring Kenya and Uganda. Since the start of the response, international donors have disbursed about $962 million to organizations operating in eastern Congo, but field partners can only account for $200 million. Attending NGOs reported receiving $228 million, with $127 million spent and roughly $100 million remaining. Congolese authorities say they have not received funds directly from donors and have restricted field operations to 25 of nearly 100 accredited organizations, demanding recipient details and spending plans. The government seeks joint management with partners, including WHO, for transparency.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対策支援7億ドルが行方不明、警鐘が鳴る
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は史上最速の拡大とされ、複数州やケニア・ウガンダへの越境拡大が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。資金管理問題が主題だが、疾病自体の公衆衛生リスクも高いためPICKUP判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: திருச்சியில் டெங்கு கொசு ஒழிப்பு தடுப்புப் பணிகள் தீவிரம்: ஆணையர் பொன்மணி ஆய்வு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Intensification of dengue mosquito control and prevention measures in Tiruchirappalli: Commissioner Ponmani reviews.
article.articleSummary: As the northeast monsoon begins, Tiruchirappalli City Corporation has intensified dengue control across all 65 wards to curb dengue and other vector-borne diseases. Commissioner N. Ponmani inspected Zone 3, Ward 35 Sankiliyanthapuram, and announced expanded measures citywide. To prevent mosquito breeding in standing water, approximately 60 house-to-house Dengue Breeding Checkers (DBCs) are deployed per zone, with an additional 20 dengue control workers per zone. In total, about 350 dengue larval-control staff are visiting homes to identify water-holding containers and conduct fever surveys. Homes and businesses are required to segregate waste into four categories, with sanitation workers enforcing proper disposal; violators will face penalties for littering in streets and public spaces. Public cooperation is urged to maintain Tiruchirappalli’s cleanliness and prevent vector proliferation during the monsoon.

triage.headline_ja: ティルチラーパッリでデング熱予防の蚊駆除対策を強化:ポンマニ市長が視察
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱予防・媒介蚊駆除の行政活動を報じる内容で、異常な流行や重症例の急増等は報告されておらず、通常の公衆衛生対策の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の感染者数増加や流行の異常性を報告しておらず、モンスーン季の恒例予防対策（家屋訪問・幼虫駆除・衛生啓発）についての内容。インド・タミルナードゥ州の地方自治体活動であり、対象国リストに該当する国だが、記事内容自体は通常の予防活動でありシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil detects Newcastle disease at turkey farm, raising export concerns
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, southern state, triggering sanitary measures and potential export disruptions. Brazil, the world's largest poultry exporter, faces possible impact on shipments to China, which previously halted imports from Rio Grande do Sul after a 2024 Newcastle case (ban lifted this year). Officials say measures could affect about 133 farms in the region, with information to trading partners forthcoming. Acting Secretary for Agricultural Trade Rafael Requiao said it’s too early to confirm any import suspensions. ABPA cited Brazil’s China trade protocol allowing an auto-embargo after an outbreak, potentially restricting exports to the entire state or limited areas around the farm. Santa Catarina accounts for around 15% of Brazilian poultry production, underscoring the potential scope of disruption.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病を検出、輸出への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: 家禽の家畜疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり人の公衆衛生への直接的な深刻性は低いが、ブラジルの主要輸出先（中国）への貿易制限リスクがあり、政府・業界の関心が高いため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、人への感染リスクは極めて低い動物衛生イベント。主眼は貿易・輸出への影響（特に中国向け）であり、公衆衛生上のフルリスク評価対象というよりも農業・貿易分野の継続監視が適切。中国は発生地域ではなく貿易相手国として言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le gouverneur du Nord-Kivu compte 1 252 décès, le bulletin national en recense 1 176
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: the governor of North Kivu reports 1,252 deaths, the national bulletin records 1,176.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, shows divergent death tallies. Governor Évariste Somo Kakule reported as of 17 October 2026 1,252 Ebola deaths with a case fatality rate around 60%, amid a 'Stop Ebola' day that halted activity in Beni, Butembo, Oïcha, Lubero-centre and Kasindi-Lubiriha on 19 October. The national health institute’s bulletin no. 157 lists 1,176 confirmed deaths and a 56.4% fatality rate across 2,084 confirmed cases. The discrepancy stems from provincial totals including probable and suspected deaths (clinical pictures without lab confirmation); the national tally includes only lab-confirmed cases. Consequently, two official tallies coexist on the same territory, guiding different decisions—bed allocation, team deployment, and zone prioritization. Authorities have not standardized the counting method, and provincial measures (and travel restrictions from Ituri) hinge on the local count, while the national figures drive international reporting and funding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：北キブ州知事は1,252人の死亡を報告、全国集計では1,176人
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、致死率56〜60%、確認症例2,084例という深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、州と国の集計の相違が対応の混乱を招いている。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Kasindi-LubirihaはウガンダとDRCの国境検問所であり、国境地域での活動停止（Stop Ebola day）が実施されている点は国際拡大リスクの根拠となる。イトゥリ州からの渡航制限も報告されている。州と国の死亡者数・致死率の集計方法の不一致が対応の優先順位付けに影響している点は特記事項。

article.articleHeadline: Governo suspende exportação de carne de aves de todo o País para a China após detectar Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government suspends export of poultry meat nationwide to China after detecting Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting an immediate suspension of nationwide poultry exports to China and a restricted program for 39 other markets. The farm, housing about 6,000 birds, was placed under official interdiction; four municipalities - Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim - were declared zoosanitary emergency. Export certification to China will be temporarily suspended under the bilateral protocol for zoonoses. For the other markets, shipments are limited to the radius around the outbreak (municipality, 10 km, or 25 km, depending on the country). The restrictions apply to certifications dated Sept 21, after sample collection confirmed the Newcastle focus. Producers must verify country-specific import requirements. The Ministry states poultry products remain safe for consumption. This is Brazil's second commercial Newcastle case; the first was July 17, 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, resolved by July 25, 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル政府、ニューカッスル病検出により全国の鶏肉輸出を中国向けに停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はほぼない。貿易制限は発生しているが、IHR(2005)が対象とする人間の公衆衛生事象には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽のニューカッスル病による農業・貿易上の問題であり、ヒトの感染症危機管理の観点からは公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。中国は輸出先国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Menina de 8 anos morre de meningite bacteriana em SP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8-year-old girl dies of bacterial meningitis in São Paulo.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl, Maria Isadora Souza Nascimento, died from bacterial meningitis in São Paulo state, Brazil. She had been hospitalized in the ICU at Santa Casa de São Carlos after a confirmed diagnosis and died on Oct 19, 2026, as reported by the São José do Rio Pardo municipal government. Maria Isadora attended Escola Estadual Tarquínio Cobra Olyntho in São José do Rio Pardo. Public health authorities activated surveillance, notified close contacts, and offered chemoprophylaxis as indicated. The region has recorded at least four meningitis cases this year, including a May death in São Carlos, a death in Araras/Limeira, and a September recovery in Casa Branca. Physicians emphasize vaccination as the primary preventive measure. Vaccines in Brazil’s National Immunization Program include meningococcal C conjugate, pneumococcal 10-valent conjugate, and the pentavalent vaccine (Hib, DTP, hepatitis B).

triage.headline_ja: サンパウロ州で8歳少女が細菌性髄膜炎で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単発の細菌性髄膜炎による死亡例だが、同地域で年間複数例の発生が報告されており、クラスター化の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は細菌性髄膜炎（原因菌不明）による個別死亡例。疾患名にHepatitis BとHaemophilus Influenzaeが付与されているが、これはブラジルの定期予防接種プログラム（五種混合ワクチン）に関する言及であり、本事例の直接の原因病原体ではない。地域内で年間複数の髄膜炎関連死亡が報告されている点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde promove qualificação sobre AVC , arboviroses e sarampo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health promotes training on stroke, arboviruses, and measles.
article.articleSummary: On October 20, 2026, the Municipal Health Department conducted a training session on stroke and arboviral diseases and measles for physicians, nurses, and family-and-community medicine residents within the municipal network. The Mariana Battaglini Base Hospital physician led the stroke care segment, while infectious disease specialist Francisco Inaldo Júnior updated attendees on measles and arboviruses—diseases transmitted by arthropods such as mosquitoes and ticks. Ninety health professionals participated, with a new cohort scheduled for Thursday, October 22. The trainings for doctors and nurses occur every two months, focusing on topics relevant to clinical practice and improving population health. The initiative aligns with UN Sustainable Development Goals 3 (Health and Well-being), 16 (Peace, Justice and Institutions), and 17 (Partnerships for the Goals).

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、脳卒中・アルボウイルス感染症・麻疹に関する研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: これは医療従事者向けの定例研修に関する記事であり、実際の麻疹アウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、いずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は疾病発生ではなく、医療従事者向けの定期研修（2ヶ月ごと実施）に関する報道。実際の麻疹症例やアウトブレイクの言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: Santa Bárbara conclui visitas para avaliação de densidade larvária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Santa Bárbara completes visits to assess larval density.
article.articleSummary: Santa Bárbara d'Oeste, Brazil—the Department of Vigilância em Zoonoses completed another phase of the ADL (Larval Density Assessment) for Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. Of 8,767 registered properties, 4,016 were inspected; 4,751 could not be assessed due to being closed, vacant, or access refusals. Among inspected sites, 31 contained larvae, yielding a Predial Index of 0.77% and a Breteau index of 0.77 per 100 properties. Although below 1.0 (satisfactory), the presence of breeding sites underscores the need for ongoing preventive measures given favorable climate. Larval habitats included plant pots and trays, buckets, cans, plastics, tires, and other containers, with movable receptacles about 69% of records. Neighborhoods flagged for closer monitoring include Residencial Furlan, 31 de Março, Vila Rica, Orquídeas, Vila Macknight, Jardim Conceição, Parque Olaria, and Conjunto Romano. All actions are free; residents are urged to remove breeding sites and seek care for dengue symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：サンタ・バルバラ市が幼虫密度調査の訪問を完了
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の日常的な幼虫密度調査報告であり、指数は良好基準を下回り、異常な流行拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な懸念を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。定例の蚊媒介ベクター監視活動の報告であり、症例急増等の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Leptospirosis cases surge 47% as dengue cases fall -- DOH | Claudeth Mocon-Ciriaco
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis cases in the Philippines rose 47% to 13,530 as of Oct 14, 2026, from 9,188 in the same period in 2025, with the case fatality rate dropping from 10.37% in 2025 to 5.41% in 2026, per the DOH. Dengue cases for Jan 4–Oct 14, 2026 reached 205,347, down 22% from 261,749 in the prior year; the recent 3–4 weeks show a 2% decline (22,095 Sept 17–30 vs 22,479 Sept 3–16). Dengue CFR is 0.38%; 11 provinces and Highly Urbanized Cities across nine regions remain flagged for localized increases. The DOH will strengthen patient navigation and referral coordination among DOH hospitals and partner facilities, supported by the Unified Leptospirosis and Dengue Case Tracker to monitor capacity and admissions. Vector control is intensified with weekly source reduction, ovi-larvi trapping, and targeted larviciding; risk communication and campaigns are underway, alongside the Enhanced 4S Strategy and Alas Kwatro Kontra Mosquito efforts in outbreak areas.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症の症例が47%急増、デング熱は減少 ― フィリピン保健省（DOH）
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症の増加は例年の雨季・洪水に伴う季節的傾向とみられ、致死率はむしろ低下している。デング熱も減少傾向にあり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは認められないため、フルリスク評価の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: DOHによる国内の定例サーベイランス報告。レプトスピラ症の増加は季節的要因（雨季の洪水等）による可能性が高く、デング熱は減少傾向であり、致死率も双方とも改善している。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Halts Poultry Shipments to Top Buyer China After Disease
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Brazil has halted all poultry shipments to China, its biggest buyer, after confirming a case of viral, highly contagious Newcastle disease. The self-embargo with China is part of a sanitary protocol agreed between the two countries and is now being implemented, according to an official. The report does not provide laboratory confirmation details, the Brazil location of the case, case counts, or the infection source. The action is described as a bilateral precautionary measure affecting immediate poultry trade between Brazil and China, with no timeline for resumption given in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、疾病発生後に最大の輸入国である中国への鶏肉出荷を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり人への健康被害情報がなく、貿易停止は二国間の衛生プロトコルに基づく予防的措置に留まるため、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病はヒトへの病原性が極めて低い家禽疾病であり、本記事は貿易・経済影響が中心。中国は輸入停止措置を取った側であり、発生地はブラジルのみと判断。詳細な発生場所や症例数は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Foco de doença de Newcastle é confirmado em granja de Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a turkey farming operation in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. Detected during active surveillance by Cidasc, with 133 regional farms undergoing monitoring. Samples were processed at the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo and the diagnosis was confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock. Although the virus was detected, the birds currently show no clinical signs or mortality. Authorities will treat the site as an outbreak, executing eradication and disinfection, and will remain on site until the focus is eliminated, in line with OIE guidance and market transparency commitments. The Mexican government has suspended poultry imports from Brazil in response. The ministry notes that meat and eggs from inspected establishments remain safe for consumption. Suspect cases—respiratory or neurological signs, or sudden high mortality—should be reported to Cidasc; products can be identified by sanitation inspection seals on packaging.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でニューカッスル病の発生が確認
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のみに影響する動物疾患であり、臨床症状や死亡例もなく、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響は認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患でありヒトへの感染性・病原性は極めて低い。メキシコが家禽輸入を停止したが、これは農業・貿易分野の影響であり公衆衛生上のリスクとは異なる。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle: China suspende aves de 14 frigoríficos de SC; México bloqueia todo o Brasil | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: China suspends poultry from 14 Santa Catarina slaughterhouses; Mexico blocks all of Brazil | Rádio Itatiaia
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggering swift sanitary actions. China imposed a regional embargo on Santa Catarina, suspending imports from 14 approved facilities (Cooperativa Aurora 5, Seara 5, MBRF 3, JBS Aves 1), about 23% of Brazil’s 61 export-ready establishments. The move reflects regionalization, preserving Paraná’s production. China remains Brazil’s top poultry buyer, taking roughly 10% of exports from January–September 2026 (about 420,000 tonnes). In contrast, Mexico enacted a full ban on Brazilian poultry, blocking all products including meat, viscera, fertilized eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, raptors, and even tourist-purchased pets. Mexico was a leading destination for Brazilian turkey in 2026, with 6,825 tonnes exported January–April (up 319.7% in volume, 627.4% in revenue to about R$153.5 million), over 99% of shipments being fresh meat. MAPA and industry groups emphasize this is an animal-health issue and food safety remains assured.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：中国がサンタカタリーナ州の食肉処理場14カ所からの鶏肉輸入を停止、メキシコはブラジル全土からの輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病による貿易制限であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響は報告されていないため、フルリスク評価の対象外と判断する。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽(七面鳥)のニューカッスル病発生に伴う動物衛生・貿易問題であり、ヒトへの感染や健康影響は記事中で言及されていない。中国・メキシコは発生地ではなく輸入停止措置を取った国であるため、発生地域としての対象国には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo suspende exportação de carne de aves de todo o País para a China após detectar Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government suspends export of poultry meat from the entire country to China after detecting Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggers immediate export suspensions. About 6,000 birds were on the infected farm; the premises were quarantined and birds will be culled. The outbreak prompted a zoosanitary emergency in four municipalities: Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The Ministry suspended poultry meat exports to China and Malaysia; Santa Catarina-origin shipments are banned by seven markets (Kazakhstan, Chile, Tajikistan, Ukraine, Eurasian Union, European Union, Uzbekistan) and restricted to the affected radius for 39 others (radius varying by protocol). The temporary ban for certification dates to Sept 21, after sample collection confirmed the focus. Exporters with already issued certificates must verify country-specific requirements. No information on the source of infection; domestic consumption of inspected products remains safe. This is the second commercial Newcastle case in Brazil, after 2024 Anta Gorda.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、ニューカッスル病検出後、中国向け全国の鶏肉輸出を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽（七面鳥）の動物疾病であり、人への感染・公衆衛生上の重大な影響は報告されていない。貿易制限は発生しているが、ヒト感染症としてのEBS基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場で検出されたニューカッスル病による家禽輸出停止措置であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。動物衛生・貿易影響案件としての位置づけが妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: restrição de embargo chinês a SC reduz impacto no setor avícola, diz governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Chinese embargo on Santa Catarina reduces impact on the poultry sector, government says.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak detected at a poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, affecting 6,526 birds with 26 infection cases and no deaths. The event began on September 21, with active surveillance sampling of asymptomatic birds yielding positive screening results on October 14 and formal confirmation on October 18 by the Federal Livestock Defense Laboratory of São Paulo (LFDA-SP). Virological sequencing identified a virulent avian paramyxovirus with a F2 cleavage site motif 112-RRQKR-116 and F1 residue 117, showing 97.35% identity to pigeon PMV-1 (KX097024.1). Brazil is conducting an epidemiological investigation and implementing control measures, including culling and disinfection of the farm. The outbreak prompted bilateral export controls: China’s embargo was narrowed from national to Santa Catarina units; Brazil will not certify poultry exports to China starting Oct 19, while other states may resume. Mexico suspended purchases; a 90-day window aims for WOAH freedom declaration.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：中国によるサンタカタリーナ州への禁輸措置縮小で養鶏業への影響軽減、政府発表
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの養鶏場で確認されたニューカッスル病（家禽の感染症）であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはほぼなく、死亡例もなく防疫措置（殺処分・消毒）が実施済みで、貿易上の影響（中国・メキシコの禁輸）は限定的かつ既に管理下にある。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患でありヒトへの重篤な健康影響は報告されていない。中国の禁輸措置は国全体からサンタカタリーナ州単位に縮小され、影響は限定的。WOAHへの清浄性回復申請（90日）が予定されており、ブラジル政府が主体的に対応している。

article.articleHeadline: Choléra en RDC: 2 330 cas notifiés à la 41ème semaine épidémiologique - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cholera in the DRC: 2,330 cases reported in the 41st epidemiological week - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Cholera in the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 2,330 cases in week 41, a slight decline from week 40, with eastern provinces accounting for about 80% of cases. Response teams have been deployed to Tshuapa province, and a synchronized vaccination campaign with the Republic of the Congo is being prepared along the Congo River corridor to strengthen prevention and control. Separately, measles cases fell to about 385 in week 41 from more than 680 the previous week, moving toward the target of fewer than 500 weekly cases. Vaccination against measles and rubella is being conducted in three blocks as part of outbreak control, with discussion of deactivating the measles incident management system pending epidemiological evaluation and criteria. Findings were presented at a weekly multisectoral coordination meeting at INSP Kinshasa chaired by Director-General Mwamba Kazadi Dieudonné.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のコレラ:疫学週41週目に2,330例が報告 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コレラ・麻疹ともに継続的な発生状況の定期報告であり新規性は低いが、複数州にまたがる持続的な流行でワクチン接種対応が続いているため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: コンゴ共和国との合同ワクチン接種計画に言及があり国際的拡大の懸念はあるが、全体として既存の対応継続を示す定期報告の性質が強い。

article.articleHeadline: Trichy corpn deploys additional workers to fight dengue
article.articleSummary: Dengue prevention intensified in Tiruchirappalli (Trichy) as the city prepares for a possible outbreak. The Trichy corporation deployed 20 domestic breeding checkers (DBCs) in addition to the existing 60 workers per zone, across all 65 wards, for fever screening and anti-dengue drives. A fever survey through doorstep verification is underway citywide. Officials warned that penalties for poor solid-waste management will be intensified, urging residents to segregate waste at source and hand it to corporation workers to prevent illegal disposal. Residents were also asked to ensure hygiene of items stored on properties, notably tyres and storage tanks, to curb mosquito breeding. As of Tuesday morning, the city recorded moderate rainfall: Airport 17.3 mm, Junction 16.6 mm, Trichy town 13.4 mm, Ponmalai 6.8 mm, Thuvakudi 12.1 mm, Samayapuram 10.4 mm. Rains have lashed the city nightly in recent days.

triage.headline_ja: トリチー市当局、デング熱対策で追加作業員を投入
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地方都市における通常の季節性デング熱予防対策であり、異常性や重症例の報告はなく、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 地方自治体による予防的な蚊対策の強化であり、流行拡大や重症例の報告はない。降雨によるデング熱媒介蚊の繁殖リスクへの事前対応と見られる。

article.articleHeadline: Studies On Dengue Vaccine Have Started In Tamil Nadu: Minister Arun Raj
article.articleSummary: 2026-10-20: Dengue vaccine research has started in Kadayanallur, Tenkasi district, Tamil Nadu—the first in-country study—assessing safety and effectiveness for the Indian context with the aim of near-term availability. The initiative follows dengue incidence in Tamil Nadu after the rainy season, emphasizing prevention and surveillance. To counter ongoing monsoon risks, government hospitals are stocked with essential medicines, oxygen reserves are secured, and ambulance services are ready, with generator-backed power coordinated with the Electricity Department. Nursing vacancies have been filled (7,724) to bolster staffing. Additional directives require 24/7 readiness of essential personnel—including electrical staff, water technicians, lift operators, and sanitation workers—and ensure maintenance of lifts and firefighting equipment during emergencies.

triage.headline_ja: タミル・ナードゥ州でデング熱ワクチンの研究開始:アルン・ラージ大臣
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチン研究開始と医療体制整備に関する通常の行政ニュースであり、異常な公衆衛生事象や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性デング熱への対応としてのワクチン研究開始と医療インフラ整備に関する行政発表であり、異常なアウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nova vacina combate 21 tipos de bactéria que causa pneumonia e meningite | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New vaccine combats 21 types of bacteria that cause pneumonia and meningitis | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Anvisa approved Capvaxive, a 21-valent pneumococcal conjugate vaccine developed by MSD (Merck Sharp & Dohme). The vaccine protects against 21 serotypes of Streptococcus pneumoniae and is given in a single dose for adults 18 and older to prevent invasive pneumococcal disease and pneumonia. Approval is valid for 36 months, with two injectable presentations: 0.5 mL prefilled syringes in a single-dose format and boxes containing 10 units. Pneumococcal disease can range from mild infections such as otitis media and sinusitis to severe pneumonia, meningitis, and sepsis. Capvaxive is indicated mainly for those over 50 at higher risk, though no schedule was given for arrival to private clinics or to the SUS. The SUS currently offers Pneumo 20, a vaccine protecting against 20 serotypes. The approval relied on foreign regulatory authority equivalence with the FDA.

triage.headline_ja: 肺炎と髄膜炎を引き起こす細菌21種に対抗する新ワクチン | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 新規肺炎球菌ワクチンの承認に関する規制・製品ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 疾病発生ではなく新ワクチン承認に関する報道のため、感染症イベントのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: China suspende importações de produtos avícolas de Santa Catarina após foco de Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China suspends imports of poultry products from Santa Catarina after a Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompts China to suspend imports of poultry products from 14 Santa Catarina facilities (5 Aurora Cooperative, 5 Seara, 3 MBRF, 1 JBS Aves), per GACC records. Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry had not yet publicly confirmed the measure, and ABPA did not comment. China was informed on Oct 19; bilateral sanitary protocol allows auto-suspension of all Brazilian poultry exports, but authorities aim to regionalize to limit impact. The 14 facilities include slaughterhouses and depots. China imported about 10% of Brazil’s poultry exports from Jan–Sept 2026, roughly 420,000 tonnes; Brazil has 61 facilities approved to export to China, with Paraná as the leading producing state. Separately, Mexico suspended all Brazilian poultry imports after the Santa Catarina Newcastle focus, via Senasica, deactivating animal-health certificates and barring meat, viscera, songbirds and ornamental birds, and avian genetic material such as fertile eggs and day-old chicks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けサンタカタリーナ州産の家禽製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。貿易制限は発生しているが、ヒト感染症サーベイランスとしてのシグナル基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の商業用七面鳥農場で確認された家禽のニューカッスル病発生であり、ヒト感染症ではない。中国・メキシコは輸入停止措置を取った国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: México cierra la puerta al pollo y el huevo de Brasil ante el brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico closes its doors to Brazilian poultry and eggs amid the Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mexico closes its doors to Brazilian poultry and eggs amid Newcastle disease outbreak. As of 20 October 2026, Mexico’s Secretariat of Agriculture, via Senasica, suspended all poultry imports from Brazil, including chicken, due to a Newcastle disease outbreak detected at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The ban applies to commercial imports and items in travelers’ luggage to prevent entry. It blocks imports of chicken meat, poultry byproducts, fertilized eggs, day-old chicks, songbirds, ornamental birds, raptors for sale, and pets from Brazil. The Directorate General of Animal Health deactivated Zoosanitary Requirements to stop shipments. Brazil’s MAPA confirmed the outbreak and said the farm was closed with control and eradication measures to be implemented. Newcastle disease is a contagious viral infection affecting many birds; it can cause nervous signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality, and poses no human risk.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉・卵の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きんに限定される動物疾患であり、記事中でも『人にリスクはない』と明記されている。ブラジル当局が農場を閉鎖し防疫措置を実施済みで、メキシコの輸入停止も予防的対応にとどまり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類に特異的なウイルス感染症で、人への健康リスクは報告されていない。メキシコの対応は貿易上の予防措置であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Pode atingir humanos? Entenda a doença registrada em granja de perus de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Can it affect humans? Learn about the disease reported at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, affecting 6,000 birds. Active surveillance identified the focus on 21 September, with LFDA laboratory confirmation on 18 October. The prior Brazilian outbreak occurred on 17 July 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, which was closed by the OIE 90 days later. The event has impacted markets as Brazil is a major poultry producer/exporter; China and Mexico temporarily suspended imports (China limited to Santa Catarina products). Newcastle disease is a viral illness causing respiratory, nervous, and digestive signs in birds, with mortality potentially reaching 100% in a flock. There is no treatment; depopulation will be performed to prevent spread. Human infection is rare and usually mild conjunctivitis from close contact with infected birds; turkey meat remains safe for consumption, with no product recalls planned.

triage.headline_ja: 人体に影響する可能性は？SC州の七面鳥農場で確認された疾病について
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病はブラジルの七面鳥農場で確認され中国・メキシコが輸入を一時停止したが、ヒトへの感染は稀で軽度の結膜炎に留まるため、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威とは言えず経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は主に家禽の動物衛生・貿易上の問題であり、ヒトへの感染は稀かつ軽症（結膜炎）とされる。中国・メキシコの輸入停止措置はあるが、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクはなく、七面鳥肉の安全性にも影響なしとされている。中国は発生地域（Santa Catarina州）に限定して輸入停止しているため、発生国はBrazilのみとして検証。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones de pollo de Brasil por un brote de Newcastle y restringe la entrada de carne, huevo fértil y aves vivas para proteger la producción nacional
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian chicken due to a Newcastle disease outbreak and restricts the entry of meat, fertile eggs, and live birds to protect domestic production.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry and related products, including meat, offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, and live birds, as well as items carried by travelers, after Brazil confirmed a Newcastle disease outbreak. The measure, announced Oct 19 by Mexico’s Secretariat of Agriculture (Sader) and SENASICA, aims to protect domestic poultry production with no lifting date yet. The outbreak was confirmed Oct 18 in a commercial turkey farm of about 6,000 birds in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Brazil is Mexico’s second-largest poultry supplier, with 128,632 tonnes imported Jan–Jul 2026. The restriction covers both commercial imports and traveler shipments and involved inactivating relevant Zoosanitary health requirement documents. Newcastle disease is a viral infection affecting domestic and wild birds, causing respiratory, digestive, and nervous signs, reduced production, and mortality; human infections are rare and typically mild. Consumption of inspected Brazilian poultry is considered safe for now.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ブラジルのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止、食肉・受精卵・生鳥の入国を制限し国内生産を保護
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで確認されたニューカッスル病の発生を受け、メキシコが輸入停止・渡航者持込制限を実施しており、IHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ヒトへの感染はまれで軽症とされており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は限定的。主に家禽産業・貿易への影響が中心の動物衛生イベントであるが、国際貿易制限が発生しているためIHR基準上はピックアップ対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Regional Chinese CDC Calls Plague Info Confidential as Public Suspicions Grow After Suspected Russia Case
article.articleSummary: Plague rumors spread after a suspected Russian case, with social-media claims of two fatal pneumonic plague patients in Shanghai and Chongqing, both allegedly arrived from Russia earlier this month. A regional Chinese CDC staffer warned that plague information would be confidential as an official secret. In Shuangliu District, Chengdu, Sun Jingyang recalls a fever-clinic visit on Oct 11, with a hospital doctor allegedly asking about plague symptoms; local CDC reportedly conducted telephone fever screenings but no testing order was issued. Shuangliu CDC officials deny any plague investigation beyond rumors, noting confidentiality policies if cases or deaths occur. Dr. Feng of China’s disease-control sector claims plague has already spread in parts of China and that a pandemic risk is high. Russia denies Shipilova died of pneumonic plague; Rus. authorities list pneumonia of unknown origin. WHO will monitor and a drill in Irkutsk involved Chinese-Russian institutes.

triage.headline_ja: 地方中国CDC、ロシアでの疑いペスト症例後に公衆の疑念が高まる中、ペスト情報を機密扱いと発表
triage.triage_reason: 肺ペストに関する未確認情報ながら、中国・ロシア両国にまたがる噂の拡散とCDCの情報統制、WHOの監視対応など社会的関心・国際的懸念が高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はSNS上の噂と未確認情報に基づくもので、中国・ロシア双方の当局が公式には肺ペストを否定している。確定診断情報がなく、続報での事実確認が必要。ロシア（Irkutsk）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia continua contagem de larvas do Aedes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia continues counting Aedes larvae.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia, Brazil, continues Aedes aegypti larval surveillance in residences, as UVZ (Zoonosis Surveillance Unit) of the Health Secretariat presses toward week’s end ahead of spring–summer. The larval density index (ADL) is obtained by sampling about 600 homes per region across five city regions (roughly 3,000 properties total), chosen by lottery. Sampling occurs three times yearly—in January, July, and October. This year’s ADLs were 8.2 (January) and 3.5 (July); last October’s value was 0.3. Dengue leads the arboviruses here with 2,235 cases notified, 130 positives, and 0 deaths; chikungunya has 33 cases notified with 0 positives; Zika: 0 cases. Vaccination against dengue is available at UBSs (Basic Health Units) from 7:30 to 15:30, with seven units providing extended hours to 17:30 at Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, and Santa Clara. Residents should allow entry; contact UVZ at (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974 for questions.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディア市、ネッタイシマカの幼虫調査を継続
triage.triage_reason: 通常の蚊媒介感染症サーベイランス活動を伝える地方行政の定例報告であり、死亡例もなく異常な増加も確認されていないため、シグナルとしての基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・オルトランディア市における定期的な蚊幼虫サーベイランス活動とデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱の症例報告の通常業務を伝えるもの。死亡例0、症例数も特段の急増を示す記述はなく、行政の定例広報に近い内容。

article.articleHeadline: एटा के हत्सारी गांव में डेंगू का कहर, स्वास्थ्य विभाग सक्रिय, सात मरीज पॉजिटिव
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue ravages Hatsari village in Etah; health department active, seven patients test positive.
article.articleSummary: Dengue outbreak reported in Hatsari village, Aliganj block, Etah district, Uttar Pradesh, with seven Hatsari residents testing positive and one GadhoLi resident (Devaki, 26) also infected. Affected individuals include Anand (18), Ramswaroop (70), Ramshankar (60), Haripyari (60), Bharat Singh (62), Snehlata (50) and Monika (12). Health authorities screened 19 suspected Hatsari cases; seven positives were confirmed locally, plus the GadhoLi case, for a total of eight dengue infections. Chief Medical Officer Dr. Rajendra Prasad and District Malaria Officer Lokman Singh visited Hatsari, directing ongoing patient monitoring; a prior health camp offered screening and care. Seven patients were admitted to the Medical College Infectious Ward. Preventive guidance urged eliminating standing water around homes, regularly changing water in coolers and other vessels, and adopting mosquito-bite precautions.

triage.headline_ja: エタ県ハトサリ村でデング熱が猛威、保健当局が対応、7人陽性
triage.triage_reason: インド国内の一村落における小規模なデング熱発生であり、地方の保健当局が通常の対応（患者監視・予防啓発）を行っている事例で、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクはなく、季節性のローカルな感染症事例と判断される。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタル・プラデーシュ州エタ県の一村落（ハトサリ村・ガドーリ村）で8例のデング熱感染が確認された小規模な局地的事例。地元保健当局が通常の監視・予防対応を実施中であり、季節性のベクター媒介感染症として典型的な事例。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms 9th Ebola case as US issues travel advisory
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kenya: nine confirmed cases linked to a single cluster. The latest patient, a 24-year-old man, tested positive on Oct 19 while in quarantine and was isolated for treatment. Of the nine cases, three are healthcare workers and the others are relatives who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda two weeks ago. There is no evidence of transmission beyond the cluster. Eight patients under treatment are improving and stable. Kenya has received 500 doses of medicines. Contact tracing covers 134 of 135 identified contacts (99.3%), with numbers expected to grow. Preparedness includes distributing medical supplies to 12 high-risk and 16 high-risk counties and establishing a dedicated Ebola laboratory at Kenyatta National Hospital Infectious Disease Unit to relieve the main lab. No transmission in quarantine facilities; travel restrictions are not imposed; US travel advisory Level 3. Quarantine contacts since Oct 6 will complete 21-day monitoring and may return home from Oct 25 if well.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9例目のエボラ感染確認、米国が渡航勧告を発令
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患の国際的拡大（DRC→ウガンダ経由→ケニア）が確認され、米国が渡航勧告(レベル3)を発令するなどIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 患者はDRCからウガンダ経由でケニアに入国した親族であるが、記事の主題は『ケニアでの確認例』であり、DRC・ウガンダでの発生自体は本文中で明示されていないため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCもverified_locationsには含めなかった。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa atualiza restrições de importadores após foco de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MAPA updates importer restrictions after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farming operation in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. On 20 October 2026, Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture (Mapa) announced updated temporary trade restrictions by partner countries. Mexico suspended imports of all Brazilian poultry products, including live birds, poultry meat and giblets, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, canaries and ornamental or predatory birds intended for sale, and companion birds. For Santa Catarina, China and Chile imposed measures: China halted imports of poultry meat from the state; Chile restricted fertile eggs, SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh poultry meat, and poultry-meat-containing products. China’s restriction is limited to Santa Catarina after negotiations with the Brazilian government, avoiding a nationwide suspension. Mapa continues coordinating with importing-country authorities, provides technical information on the outbreak and control measures, and will issue updates as official confirmations occur.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受け、MAPAが輸入国の制限措置を更新
triage.triage_reason: 家きん(七面鳥)でのニューカッスル病発生に伴い複数国が輸入制限を課しているが、人への健康影響は報告されておらず公衆衛生上の深刻度は低い。貿易影響の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案は家きん(七面鳥)のニューカッスル病であり、人への感染・健康被害は報告されていない。メキシコ・中国・チリは発生国ではなく輸入制限を課した貿易相手国であるため、発生地域としては除外した。農業・貿易分野のイベントであり、公衆衛生シグナルとしての優先度は低いが、輸入制限の拡大動向は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Aos 90 anos, Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega passa por cirurgia de marcapasso depois que uma infecção viral virou inflamação no coração
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: At 90 years old, Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega undergoes pacemaker implantation after a viral infection led to myocarditis.
article.articleSummary: A 90-year-old Brazilian television presenter, Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega, underwent pacemaker implantation at Hospital Albert Einstein in São Paulo on October 20, 2026, after a viral infection progressed to post-viral myocarditis. The procedure, postponed by one day to adjust medications, was confirmed by his wife, physician Renata Nóbrega. He remains stable and recovering well following hospitalization begun on October 16 for fatigue. His first public appearance since admission showed him in hospital attire speaking on the phone with Raul Gil. De Nóbrega has been a long-time SBT figure since 1987, with prior stints at Record, Globo and Band, and is father of six. The report underscores myocarditis following a viral illness and the subsequent need for cardiac support via a pacemaker.

triage.headline_ja: 90歳のカルロス・アルベルト・デ・ノブレガ、ウイルス感染が心筋炎に進行しペースメーカー植込み手術を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 個人の医療事例に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の脅威や集団感染を示す情報はないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 著名人個人の健康状態に関する記事であり、感染症の集団発生やアウトブレイクを示す内容ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Angola: Le MINSA forme des techniciens et des gardes-frontières à Zaire sur Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Angola: MINSA trains technicians and border guards in Zaire on Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola preparedness in Angola: In Mbanza Kongo, Zaire Province, over 40 health technicians and border guards began a three-day MINSA training focused on management, diagnosis, and treatment of suspected Ebola cases at border municipalities with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The program covers infection prevention and control and dignified, safe burial procedures, with participation from the Migration and Foreigners Service (SME), veterinary services, and Angola’s National Institute of Medical Emergencies (INEMA). The session also informs attendees about smallpox (varicella/variola) currently affecting the DRC. Zaire’s provincial health director Afonso Maria Sabino stressed knowledge dissemination to other border staff and noted two positive smallpox cases in Zaire that have since recovered. Organized with IOM, the effort involves eight specialists across five municipalities—Luvo, Cuimba, Nóqui, Soyo, and Quêlo—sharing a 310-km border with DRC’s Congo Central region.

triage.headline_ja: アンゴラ：保健省（MINSA）がザイール州で技術者・国境警備員にエボラ対応研修を実施
triage.triage_reason: 記事はアンゴラにおけるエボラ対応の備え研修を主題としており実際の新規アウトブレイク第一報ではないが、DRCで天然痘（variola/varicella）が発生中との言及やザイール州での陽性例（回復済み）への言及があり、詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事は訓練・備え活動を報じるものであり、実際の新規発生の第一報ではない。DRCでの天然痘（variola/varicella）発生、及びアンゴラ・ザイール州での陽性2例（回復済み）への言及があるが詳細不明。アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。IOMとの協力による国境地域での対応能力強化が中心的内容。

article.articleHeadline: Governo impõe emergência zoossanitária após detectar Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government imposes a zoosanitary emergency after detecting Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease triggers a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in four Santa Catarina municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freita, and Nova Erechim—after a Newcastle disease focus was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The federal government declared the emergency, with confirmation reported on October 18 and official notification on October 19, published October 20. The affected establishment has been interdicted, with suspension of bird movements. Control, containment, and eradication measures will be implemented according to the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease. The disease, caused by a virulent avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1), affects domestic and wild birds. The occurrence in Santa Catarina was identified by the state veterinary service and confirmed by the Federal Agrodefense Laboratory in São Paulo. OMSA and Brazil’s trading partners have been notified.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病検出後、サンタカタリーナ州で政府が動物衛生緊急事態を発令
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病発生による動物衛生緊急事態であり、ヒトへの直接的健康被害は報告されていないが、政府による緊急事態宣言と貿易相手国への通知があり、家禽産業・貿易への影響が懸念されるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒト感染症ではなく家禽のニューカッスル病（APMV-1）に関する動物衛生イベント。São Pauloは検査確認機関所在地であり発生地ではないため除外。輸出大国ブラジルの家禽産業への貿易影響が今後の焦点となる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms new Ebola case, total at nine, health ministry says
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a new Ebola case, bringing total infections to nine. The latest case is a close family member of the first patient and has been quarantined. All nine cases belong to one cluster; as of Oct 20 there is no evidence of transmission outside this group. The first Kenyan case was identified earlier this month in a man who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died on Oct 5. Health authorities have traced 134 of 135 contacts and placed them in quarantine. The outbreak is centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread across borders. The US State Department has advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya due to health risks.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、新たなエボラ感染例を確認、累計9人に=保健省
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、DRCを起点とした国境を越えるエボラ出血熱の拡大が確認されており、米国政府が渡航注意喚起を出すなど国際的関心・影響も大きい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、アウトブレイクの起点・中心はDRCであり、対象国リストにはDRCのみが該当する。ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Governo suspende exportação de frango de SC à China após foco de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The government suspends chicken exports from Santa Catarina to China after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina state, Brazil prompts voluntary suspension of poultry exports to China after a case at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The ban covers only shipments originating in Santa Catarina. Mexico additionally embargoes Brazilian poultry products. The ABPA lists embargoed destinations including Chile, Kazakhstan, Peru, Ukraine, the European Union and the Eurasian Union for poultry meat, offal, live birds, and avian genetic material produced or slaughtered in Santa Catarina. Several neighbors and partners restrict imports from the affected radius; Japan, Saudi Arabia, Argentina, Canada, the United Kingdom, South Korea, and the United Arab Emirates limit purchases to the delimited area. Some buyers—South Africa, Argentina, the UK, and Vietnam—allow thermally processed poultry products. Measures follow sanitary protocols; inspections in abattoirs have intensified to detect disease signs. Newcastle disease causes respiratory and nervous signs with high mortality in affected flocks.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病発生を受け、政府が同州産鶏肉の対中国輸出を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生事案だが、ブラジル国内でのニューカッスル病発生により複数国が輸入規制・禁輸措置を講じ、政府対応と社会的関心（貿易停止）が顕著であるためフルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でヒトへの重大な健康リスクは低いが、複数国による輸入規制・禁輸措置により経済的・貿易的影響が大きいため、動物衛生当局との連携を含めた継続的な動向確認が望ましい。発生地域リストに含まれる他国（韓国、南アフリカ、日本、ベトナム等）は輸入制限を課す側であり、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: China embargou apenas a carne de Santa Catarina após foco de Doença de Newcastle, diz governo - Mundo | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China embargoed only Santa Catarina's meat after a Newcastle disease outbreak, the government says - World | Portal do Holanda
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in a turkey farm in Santa Catarina state, Brazil, prompted China to limit its embargo to poultry meat imports from the affected state. On Monday, reports of Newcastle disease at a turkey operation triggered the decision. The Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture said MAPA’s response prevented a nationwide suspension of Brazilian poultry exports. Brazil maintains an agreement with China to enact an initial self-embargo in cases of Newcastle disease or avian influenza, after which China will determine the scope of any broader embargo. The report provides no details on laboratory confirmation, case counts, or human risk, and there is no mention of other states affected. Importers should note that, at least for now, the embargo coverage remains limited to Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ニューカッスル病発生後サンタカタリーナ州の食肉のみ禁輸措置、ブラジル政府発表
triage.triage_reason: 動物（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病流行であり、ヒトへの健康影響や公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は報告されていない。貿易への部分的影響はあるが家畜疾病の通常の管理対応の範囲内。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽疾病であり人獣共通感染症ではない。中国はサンタカタリーナ州に限定して禁輸、ブラジル全体への拡大は回避されたと報告。China（1814991）は禁輸措置を行った側であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: China limita embargo a SC e México suspende compras do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: China restricts embargo on SC and Mexico suspends Brazil's purchases.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting temporary import restrictions by Mexico, China, and Chile. The farm houses about 6,000 birds. Samples collected Sept 21; laboratory testing yielded positive OMSA criteria for Newcastle disease on Oct 18; surveillance indicated no clinical signs yet. Sanitary measures include culling, cleaning, disinfection, and monitoring within a 42-day zone encompassing 133 farms across Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias for two incubation periods. Mexico halted imports of all Brazilian poultry products, while China limited restrictions to Santa Catarina-origin meat, and Chile banned SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh poultry, and related products from the state. From Jan–Sept, Brazil exported about 420,000 tonnes of chicken meat to China. Officials say recovery to disease-free status may occur after 90 days; OMSA requested shortening, not implemented.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：中国がサンタカタリーナ州への禁輸を限定、メキシコはブラジルからの輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場で確認されたニューカッスル病（家禽疾病）であり、人への健康被害は報告されていないが、複数国が輸入制限を課しており経済的・貿易的影響が拡大する可能性があるため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害の報告はない。中国・メキシコ・チリは貿易相手国として輸入制限を課しているが、発生国はブラジルのみ。公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いが、農業・貿易分野での影響拡大を監視する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Кения потвърди нов случай на ебола, с което общият брой на заразените в страната достигна девет
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirmed a new case of Ebola, bringing the total number of people infected in the country to nine.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kenya confirmed a ninth Ebola infection, raising the total in-country cases to nine. The first case was reported on 6 October 2026 in a Kenyan citizen who lives in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where Ebola has been active since May. A 40-year-old businessman died in Nairobi on 5 October. The United States Embassy in Nairobi elevated its travel advisory from Level 2 to Level 3, advising Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya due to health and safety risks. On 15 October, Kenyan health officials screened travelers arriving from Uganda at the border, reflecting ongoing border surveillance amid cross-border transmission risk with DRC and Uganda. Reuters is cited as the source confirming the latest case and updates.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで新たなエボラ感染例を確認、国内感染者数は9人に
triage.triage_reason: DRC発祥のエボラ出血熱がケニアへ越境拡大し、米大使館が渡航勧告をレベル3に引き上げるなど国際的懸念が高まっているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、DRCでは5月からエボラが継続的に発生しており発生源として明記されているためDRCを含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa suspende exportação de carne de aves do Brasil para China após foco de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MAPA suspends Brazil's poultry meat exports to China after Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture suspends all poultry meat exports to China after a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm near Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina. A temporary halt also covers exports to Malaysia. For products from Santa Catarina, restrictions extend to Kazakhstan, Chile, Tajikistan, Ukraine, the Eurasian Economic Union, the European Union, and Uzbekistan. The affected farm houses about 6,000 birds; official veterinary services activate the contingency plan, restrict nearby properties, and halt outbound birds from the site. A zoosanitary emergency is declared in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The establishment is quarantined and birds will be culled; consumption of inspected poultry remains safe. Export certificates issued since Sept 21 are suspended; exporters with existing certificates must follow importing-country requirements. This is Brazil's second commercial Newcastle outbreak; the first occurred July 17, 2024 in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル農務省、ニューカッスル病発生を受けて中国向け鶏肉輸出を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物感染症（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり貿易制限が発生しているが、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されていないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥農場）のニューカッスル病発生による動物衛生・貿易問題であり、ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは記載されていない。対象国リストの中で実際に発生しているのはブラジルのみで、他国（中国、マレーシア等）は輸出停止対象国として言及されているに過ぎない。

article.articleHeadline: CDC issues new travel notice as record Ebola outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Africa driven by Bundibugyo strain; as of 20 Oct 2026, 9,581 total confirmed cases and 4,605 deaths. The Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reports 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths; Uganda 20 cases, 2 deaths and 1 probable death; Kenya 8 cases and 1 death; France one imported case. Kenya’s first imported case occurred on 6 Oct 2026, arriving from the DRC via Uganda; France reported an imported case in June. Ituri province remains the epicenter and is described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in Africa. Two US aid workers contracted Ebola in the DRC and were evacuated to Germany for treatment in May and July 2026; both stable, with no US deaths. CDC travel notices: Level 4 for Ituri/Nord-Kivu; Level 3 for Haut-Uélé/Tshopo; Level 2 for the rest of DRC and Uganda; Level 1 for Kenya. Bundibugyo has 25–50% mortality and no vaccine or treatment. Symptoms include fever, headache, muscle pain, diarrhea, vomiting, abdominal pain, bleeding; transmission via blood/body fluids, contaminated objects, or certain animals.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、記録的なエボラ出血熱の流行拡大を受けて新たな渡航情報を発出
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,500人超の症例・4,600人超の死亡者を出す記録的規模のエボラ流行が継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへの越境・輸出例も確認されている。IHR4基準すべてに該当し、CDCが複数レベルの渡航勧告を発出していることからフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、米国、ドイツへの症例波及が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主たる発生地であるDRC（特にIturi州）のみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : deux guéris appelés à devenir des ambassadeurs auprès des malades réticents - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: two recovered called to become ambassadors to reluctant patients - ACP
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola survivors in Kisangani, Tshopo, in northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, were invited to become ambassadors to encourage other patients who still hesitate to seek treatment at the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). The ceremony awarded recovery certificates to patients admitted to the CTE; the two recovered thanked the healthcare staff and urged continued adherence to barrier measures to reduce transmission. Health official Jude Mapuku noted that two other former Ebola patients had returned home the previous weekend, underscoring recovery and discharge trends. Authorities reaffirmed that anyone displaying Ebola symptoms should present themselves at the CTE for appropriate care.

article.articleHeadline: Combate à dengue: Jacareí realiza ações nesta semana; veja cronograma
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fight against dengue: Jacareí carries out actions this week; see schedule.
article.articleSummary: Jacareí, Brazil, is conducting dengue-control actions this week, including house-to-house visits, fogging (nebulização), the Cata-Treco bulky-waste collection, and ongoing larval-density assessments (ADL) to eradicate Aedes aegypti breeding sites—the vectors of dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. House visits target Jardim Panorama, Parque Meia Lua, Cidade Salvador, and Jardim Maria Amélia, with inspectors identifying potential breeding containers and advising prevention. ADL sampling occurs quarterly citywide. Cata-Treco runs Tue–Fri in numerous neighborhoods (e.g., Parque Meia-Lua, Jardim Conquista, Lagoa Azul, and others); residents should place materials on the curb by 6:50 AM. Nebulization is planned for Conjunto 1º de Maio in areas with confirmed or suspected cases. Dengue vaccination is available for ages 10–14 at 19 health units. Reports of breeding sites: 156, online Atende Bem, Praça dos Três Poderes 73, or 0800-016-3010.

article.articleHeadline: Senacsa prohíbe temporalmente el ingreso de aves y productos avícolas desde Brasil por Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Senacsa temporarily bans the import of birds and poultry products from Brazil due to Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay's National Service for Quality and Animal Health (Senacsa) has temporarily banned imports of live birds, eggs, poultry products, and avian genetic material from the Brazilian state of Santa Catarina after Newcastle disease was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The ban, formalized as Resolution No. 1715 on October 20, 2026 in San Lorenzo, aims to reduce the risk of disease entry and protect Paraguayan poultry health. Brazil confirmed the outbreak on October 18 at a fattening turkey facility in Nova Itaberaba and notified outbreaks to the OIE. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting domestic and wild birds, with high morbidity and mortality and rapid spread. Exemptions exist only for products with official veterinary certification of virus inactivation and anti-recontamination measures per the OIE Terrestrial Code; such imports require Senacsa prior authorization. The ban remains until updated sanitary risk assessment is completed.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya detects 9th Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kenya: health ministry reports nine confirmed cases as of 20 October 2026. The first case, a businessman in his forties who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), marked the start of an outbreak that has seen eight additional cases, mostly linked to the initial patient, with the ninth case a 24-year-old man described as a close family member of the first case. He was confirmed positive on Monday, isolated at first sign of illness, tested and started on treatment immediately, and was already in quarantine when ill. All nine infections belong to a single cluster, with no evidence of transmission outside it as of 20 October 2026. Contact tracing has expanded to 134 of 135 contacts quarantined. The DRC outbreak has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths; the United States has issued a travel advisory for Kenya.

article.articleHeadline: China suspende importações de carne de aves de SC após foco da doença de Newcastle; México barra o país inteiro
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China suspends imports of poultry meat from Santa Catarina after a Newcastle disease outbreak; Mexico bans the entire country.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompted China to suspend imports of Santa Catarina poultry meat while continuing purchases from other states. The 6,000-bird flock will be sacrificed after confirmation by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense (LFDA-SP) from samples collected on Sept 21. A 10-kilometer control zone around the outbreak covers Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Águas Frias and Coronel Freitas, with 133 farms under monitoring. The Brazilian government maintains that inspected poultry meat poses no risk to consumers. A bilateral sanitary agreement with China allows suspensions to be limited to the affected state or countrywide. Mexico banned imports of all Brazilian poultry products, while Chile restricted only Santa Catarina, though with a broader product list. Mexico was Brazil’s seventh-largest poultry importer last year.

article.articleHeadline: Brasil suspende exportações de aves à China após confirmação da doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil suspends poultry exports to China after confirmation of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: One confirmed Newcastle disease case at a commercial turkey facility in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggers an auto-embargo with China, suspending all poultry shipments under an agreed sanitary protocol. The unit was closed and bird transport halted. Brazil also suspended poultry exports to Malaysia; Mexican authorities announced suspensions of Brazilian imports. Restrictions extend to Santa Catarina shipments to Kazakhstan and Chile, with tighter limits on processing units near the outbreak focus. Additional destinations—including Argentina, South Africa, Saudi Arabia, the United Kingdom, and South Korea—face stricter restrictions. The measures focus on trade controls and outbreak containment as of 20 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: 流感就診 上周超過12萬人次
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza-related medical visits exceeded 120,000 last week.
article.articleSummary: Influenza activity in Taiwan remains in the seasonal epidemic but is waning. Last week, influenza-related outpatient visits exceeded 120,000, with 159 new severe cases and 44 deaths. The Taiwan CDC extended publicly funded antiviral eligibility to November 15; about 4,000 contracted facilities stock antivirals. As of October 19, vaccination reached over 3.4 million doses (roughly 1.1 times last year). An 80-year-old woman with coronary heart disease, heart failure and COPD who traveled to Thailand in July developed flu, was hospitalized in Bangkok for a month at a cost of about TWD 600,000, and later completed vaccination in October. If vaccination coverage rises, the flu season may ease by early November. COVID-19 remains below the seasonal threshold for two weeks; last week, outpatient visits were 3,873 (−27.7%), with 25 local severe cases and 5 local deaths (season totals: 56 severe, 6 deaths).

Brazil's Agriculture Ministry (MAPA) says this localized action prevented a nationwide suspension of imports. Brazil has an auto-embargo pact with China to trigger a provisional self-embargo in Newcastle disease or avian influenza, with China defining the final scope later. China is the top importer of Brazilian chicken meat this year, and Santa Catarina accounts for more than 20% of Brazil's poultry exports (ABPA). Analysts expect limited long-term economic damage if containment is rapid. Mexico suspended Brazilian poultry imports; Chile also limited embargoes to Santa Catarina. Market updates continue.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms 9th Ebola case, says all infections linked to one cluster
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases, including one death, all within a single Nairobi cluster as of Oct 20, 2026. The latest patient is a 24-year-old relative of the first case, who tested positive on Oct 19 in quarantine and is isolated under treatment; eight others are recovering. Contact tracing reached 134 of 135 identified contacts (99.3%). No transmission outside the cluster, and no infections have occurred in quarantine facilities. Kenya has not imposed travel, trade, or public gathering restrictions. A dedicated laboratory at Kenyatta National Hospital Infectious Disease Unit now tests Ebola patients without disrupting other services. Contacts starting Oct 6 who remain symptom-free will return home Oct 25 after a 21-day monitoring period. The first case had lived in the DRC and arrived in Nairobi on Oct 3, dying two days later; Congo reports 9,000+ cases and 4,000+ deaths as of Oct 14.

article.articleHeadline: Influenza deja 22 muertos y provoca 27 brotes en escuelas de Puerto Rico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza leaves 22 dead and triggers 27 outbreaks in schools in Puerto Rico.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, influenza in Puerto Rico has caused 22 deaths and triggered 27 school outbreaks this season, with 11,266 total cases. In the latest update, 2,344 new cases were reported, and the territory remains below alert and epidemic thresholds. Of all confirmed cases, 76.6% are influenza type A, with the 10–14 years age group bearing the highest infection burden. School outbreaks are distributed across the Metro region (10), Arecibo (5), Caguas (5), Ponce (3), and Bayamón and Fajardo (2 each). The hospitalization rate stands at 6.9%. These figures reflect ongoing seasonal transmission in Puerto Rico, concentrated in educational settings, with continued public health surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms new Ebola case, bringing total infections to 9, health ministry says - WTOP News
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases, with a new case detected in quarantine among contacts of the first patient, bringing the outbreak total to nine. The first Ebola case in Kenya involved a man who traveled from Congo via Uganda, arriving in Nairobi on Oct 3, testing positive on Oct 5 and dying the same day.
