The first case occurred in early October in a person who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, and authorities continue surveillance and preparedness in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラウイルス病の9例目を報告、関連例外への感染拡大は確認されず
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR基準の深刻性・異常性・国境を越えた伝播（DRCからの渡航者が起点）の複数項目に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCとケニアが含まれているが、記事の主題となっている感染拡大・症例発生はケニア国内で起きており、DRCは初発患者の渡航元として言及されているのみでDRC国内での症例発生は確認されていない。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: SC reforça barreiras e monitora propriedades após caso de Newcastle no Oeste
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SC strengthens barriers and monitors properties after a Newcastle disease case in the West.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Santa Catarina confirmed a Newcastle disease focus on a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, in the state's western region. The property remains interdicted; access is limited to authorized staff from Cidasc and Mapa. The diagnosis was lab-confirmed during routine surveillance, with no clinical signs at detection. Control measures cover a 10-kilometer radius, with about 1,600 rural properties inspected and 133 poultry operations monitored, including possible visits and sampling. On-farm actions include sanitary elimination of birds, followed by cleaning and disinfection per protocols. Road surveillance is intensified through Olho Bom, deploying 40 pickups to monitor vehicles and cargo within the radius. Producers are urged to reinforce biosafety and report respiratory, neurological signs or unusual mortality. Meat and eggs from officially inspected establishments remain safe; consumers should check inspection seals SIM, SIE or SIF.

triage.headline_ja: SC州、西部でニューカッスル病の症例確認後、防疫体制を強化し農場を監視
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾患（家禽のニューカッスル病）であり、人への健康影響やヒトーヒト感染のリスクはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念も認められない。
triage.notes: 家畜（七面鳥）の動物衛生イベントであり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染リスクについて記載なし。地元当局（Cidasc, Mapa）による防疫対応が実施されており、管理可能な範囲内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em Santa Catarina: Cidasc intensifica vigilância após foco em Nova Itaberaba - BelosF7
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina: CIDASC intensifies surveillance after outbreak in Nova Itaberaba - BelosF7.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has been confirmed on a turkey-rearing farm in Nova Itaberaba, Western Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting intensified state surveillance. Cidasc mobilized teams to contain the outbreak within a 10-kilometer radius, with access to the affected property restricted to authorized Cidasc and MAPA staff. The next step is sanitary depopulation of the birds, followed by proper disposal of equipment and cleaning/disinfection of facilities to prevent further spread. About 1,600 rural properties around the focus will be monitored, with approximately 130 properties potentially subject to blood sampling, depending on technical criteria. Movement of vehicles and loads is tightened via the Olho Bom program, with 40 pickups aiding traffic control and sanitary barriers deployed. Authorities urge vigilance across the production chain and emphasize inspection seals on animal-origin products to reassure consumers about sanitary controls.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病：ノヴァ・イタベラバでの発生後、CIDASCが監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病はブラジルの七面鳥農場で確認された動物衛生事象であり、人への健康影響は報告されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められず、人間向けEBSの基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事象は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低い。貿易・輸出規制の可能性はあるが、人間の公衆衛生上の懸念は限定的。動物衛生当局（CIDASC・MAPA）による封じ込め対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Governo declara emergência zoossanitária após foco de Newcastle em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Declares a Zoosanitary Emergency After Newcastle Disease Outbreak in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak prompts Brazil to declare a zoosanitary emergency in Santa Catarina on 2026-10-20, after confirmation of a focus at a commercial poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba. The measure aims to intensify sanitary controls, prevent spread, and safeguard Brazil’s aviculture sector. The emergency is established for a defined period with mobilization of agro-defense agencies across strategic Santa Catarina localities to quickly contain risk to commercial flocks. Laboratory-confirmed diagnosis was achieved by the official veterinary service, leading to immediate suspension of bird movements at the affected facility. Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease governs containment, eradication, and disinfection at the site. Brazil notified international partners, including the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE). The virulent strain of avian paramyxovirus type 1 affects domestic and wild birds, causing respiratory, neurological, and digestive symptoms; diagnosis confirmed by federal labs.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病発生を受け、政府が家畜衛生緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 家禽におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの感染事例は報告されていないが、貿易・家禽産業への影響および国際通報（OIE）が行われているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒト感染症ではなく動物（家禽）における動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていない。商業養鶏場での発生であり、政府は家畜衛生緊急事態を宣言し、OIEへ通知済み。ヒトへの感染拡大リスクは記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Doença descoberta em granja de SC pode atingir humanos?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Disease discovered on a Santa Catarina farm could affect humans?
article.articleSummary: New Newcastle disease has been confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The facility houses about 6,000 birds; they remained on the property and were not designated for meat production. The farm was interdicted and poultry movement suspended. Diagnosis arose from routine sanitary surveillance, with samples collected from September 21 to October 14 and confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo on October 18. Minister André de Paula stated that consumption of officially inspected poultry products is safe for people. This is the first Newcastle disease focus in Brazil since July 17, 2024, in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul, with the RS emergency closed in August 2024. Economically, Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry products on October 20; Brazil also notified China of a voluntary export suspension of Santa Catarina-origin birds, restricted to the state after talks.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場で発見された疾病、人間にも影響する可能性は？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でニューカッスル病が確認され、メキシコが輸入停止、ブラジルも中国向け輸出を自主停止するなど貿易制限が既に発生しており、2024年以来の発生という異常性もあるためIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 本疾患は主に家禽の疾病でヒトへの感染は稀（軽度の結膜炎程度）とされ、政府も鶏肉製品の消費は安全と発表している。ただしメキシコ・中国との貿易制限が即座に発生しており、経済的・国際的な注目度が高いためピックアップと判定。発生地域はブラジル（サンタカタリーナ州）のみで、メキシコ・中国は貿易相手国としての言及であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: All you need to know about: Leptospirosis
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis, caused by Leptospira, is a zoonotic infection acquired when water or soil contaminated with urine from infected animals (rats, cattle, dogs, pigs) contacts broken skin or mucous membranes, or via drinking contaminated water. Transmission is not generally person-to-person; bacteria survive weeks to months in moist environments. Heavy rainfall and flooding raise exposure risk during monsoons. India is estimated to experience 100,000–1,000,000 cases annually, with a burden in coastal and flood-prone states. The National Centre for Disease Control lists Kerala, Tamil Nadu, Maharashtra, Gujarat and Karnataka as areas of concern; a Government programme spans 181 districts across 12 States and two Union Territories. Symptoms appear 2–30 days after exposure (often 5–14): fever, chills, headache, muscle pain (calves/lower back), red eyes, nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, fatigue. Severe disease (Weil’s) can cause kidney and liver damage, jaundice, bleeding, respiratory issues, meningitis, shock, or multi-organ failure. Early antibiotics (doxycycline, amoxicillin, or azithromycin) may be started on clinical suspicion before lab confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 知っておくべきこと：レプトスピラ症
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はレプトスピラ症の一般的な解説記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや急増を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は疾患の基礎知識・啓発を目的とした解説であり、インドでの既知の季節性流行（モンスーン期）に関する一般的背景情報を含むが、新規アウトブレイクや症例急増の報告ではないため対象国として特定しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma nuevo caso de ébola y total asciende a nueve, según Ministerio de Sanidad
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms a new case of Ebola and the total rises to nine, according to the Ministry of Health.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Kenya confirmed a new Ebola case, bringing the total to nine. The Ministry of Health said the latest case is a close family member of the first patient and had already been quarantined. All nine cases are linked to a single outbreak cluster, with no evidence of transmission outside this group as of today. Kenya remains on high alert as a major Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has crossed borders. The first Kenya case was identified earlier this month in a man who traveled from the DR Congo to Nairobi and died in a Nairobi hospital on 5 October. By Monday, 134 of 135 contacts had been traced and quarantined. The U.S. State Department warned Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya, elevating the travel advisory.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ新規感染確認、累計9人に（保健省発表）
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の大規模エボラアウトブレイクが国境を越えてケニアに拡大し、米国務省が渡航勧告を引き上げるなど国際的懸念が高まっているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 確認された9症例はすべてケニア（ナイロビ）で発生しているが、感染源はDRCで発生中の大規模アウトブレイクであり、記事内でも『DRCを中心とした大規模流行が国境を越えた』と明記されているためDRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: الولايات المتحدة ترفع مستوى تحذير السفر إلى كينيا مع تفشي إيبولا في نيروبي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The United States raises its travel advisory level for Kenya amid an Ebola outbreak in Nairobi.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Kenya, focused in Nairobi, with 9 laboratory-confirmed cases as of October 20, 2026, all within a single transmission cluster. The first case, a Kenyan businessman who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda to Nairobi, initiated secondary infections among relatives and healthcare workers. Kenyan health authorities report that 134 of 135 potential contacts have been traced, with no evidence yet of spread beyond the cluster. In response, the United States raised its travel advisory for Kenya from Level 2 to Level 3, advising Americans to reconsider travel plans due to health risks alongside crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, and road hazards. The outbreak has prompted intensified border health surveillance for travelers entering Kenya from the DRC and Uganda and ongoing contact-tracing efforts to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ナイロビでのエボラ出血熱流行を受けケニアへの渡航警告レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: ケニア・ナイロビでヒト-ヒト感染を伴うエボラ出血熱の集団感染が確認され、米国が渡航警告を引き上げるなど国際的対応が発生しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生・二次感染拡大が確認されているのはケニア（ナイロビ）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。初発患者がDRCから渡航した経緯があり、DRCが感染源として記事中で明示的に言及されているため参考情報として含めた。ただしDRC国内での症例確認は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا ..وزارة الصحة تسجيل تاسع إصابة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Ministry of Health records ninth Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed a ninth Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, bringing the national total to nine. The latest infection is a close family member of the first patient and was already under quarantine; Health Director-General Patrick Amoth said all nine cases belong to a single cluster, with no evidence of transmission beyond that cluster. The outbreak, linked to cross-border spread with the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), began earlier this month when a man traveling from the DRC to Nairobi died on October 5 in a Nairobi hospital. The United States State Department, late yesterday, advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel warning level due to health risks. Authorities have traced 134 of 135 contacts and placed them in quarantine as of Tuesday.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア保健省、エボラ出血熱の9例目感染を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という致死性の高い疾患がDRCからケニアへ国境を越えて拡大し、米国が渡航警告を引き上げるなど実際に渡航制限が発生しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ発生（9例目）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発端患者がDRCからナイロビへ渡航してきたこと、及び「DRCとの国境を越えた拡大に関連」と明記されていることから、DRCを発生源国として verified_locations に含めた。米国務省がケニアへの渡航再考を勧告し渡航警告レベルを引き上げている点から、既に国際的拡大・渡航制限の両方が現実化している。

article.articleHeadline: أمريكا ترفع تحذير السفر إلى كينيا بسبب إيبولا والمخاوف
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: U.S. raises travel advisory for Kenya over Ebola and concerns.
article.articleSummary: The United States has raised Kenya’s travel advisory to Level 3 due to Ebola and security concerns, with Level 4 travel prohibitions for Eastleigh and Kibera in Nairobi and parts of several counties. Kenya reports eight Ebola cases, including a new 49-year-old who cared for the first patient, who died in a Nairobi hospital on October 5 after arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. Six other patients are stable and receiving supportive care. Health authorities say 130 contacts have been identified, with 128 in quarantine; no signs of wide community transmission, and overall public risk remains low while containment and surveillance continue. The update also flags risks of kidnapping, terrorism, crime, civil unrest, and road safety, advising Americans to avoid affected zones. (As of October 20, 2026)

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱と治安上の懸念によりケニアへの渡航勧告レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の人から人への感染が確認され、死亡例も発生、米国が渡航制限を発令するなどIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発症・感染拡大の主たる舞台はケニア（対象国リスト外）。最初の患者はDRC経由ウガンダからナイロビに到着したとされるが、DRCでの発生確認ではなく渡航経路の記述に過ぎないため、DRCはverified_locationsに含めない。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل تزايداً في إصابات "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports a rise in Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a new Ebola virus disease case, bringing the total to nine, all within a single transmission cluster. The latest infection is a close family member of the first patient and was already under quarantine. Health Director General Patrick Amoth said all nine cases belong to one cluster and there is no evidence of transmission outside it as of October 20, 2026. Authorities traced 135 contacts; 134 have been monitored and quarantined. Kenya remains on high alert as the Ebola outbreak linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo crosses the border into the region. The first Kenyan case was detected earlier this month in a man who traveled from the DRC to Nairobi and died in a Nairobi hospital on October 5. Late Monday, the US State Department advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised its travel warning due to health risks.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ感染者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染がケニアに越境し、クラスター内感染が9例に拡大。米国務省が渡航警告を発出するなど国際的関心・影響が確認され、IHR基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアで9例目のエボラ感染確認、全例が単一クラスター内。感染源はDRCからの越境者で、DRC国内のアウトブレイクが前提となっている。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ記載。米国務省がケニアへの渡航再考を勧告するなど国際的な注目度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Governo decreta emergência zoossanitária após Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government declares a zoosanitary emergency after Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak triggers zoosanitary emergency in four municipalities across Santa Catarina on 2026-10-20, following confirmation of a focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The federal government ordered a 60-day emergency; the focus was confirmed by the Ministry of Agriculture on 2026-10-19. The affected establishment was quarantined and bird movements suspended; control and eradication actions will proceed under the official contingency plan. The outbreak was identified during an epidemiological investigation, with diagnosis confirmed by the Laboratório Federal de Defesa Agropecuária of São Paulo. Brazil has notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and trading partners. Newcastle disease is caused by a virulent avian paramyxovirus and affects domestic and wild birds.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病発生後、政府が動物衛生緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 商業七面鳥農場でのニューカッスル病確認を受け、ブラジル連邦政府が60日間の動物衛生緊急事態を宣言し、OIEおよび貿易相手国への通知も行われたため、貿易制限リスクと異常性の両方が該当しIHR基準を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 本事例はヒトへの感染ではなく家禽（七面鳥）に対するニューカッスル病の発生であり、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻性は低いが、貿易・検疫上の影響が大きいためピックアップ対象とした。ヒト健康リスクとしてのフルRRAは不要だが、家畜衛生・貿易影響の観点から継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Governo declara emergência em 4 cidades de SC por doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: State government declares a state of emergency in four cities in Santa Catarina due to Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's federal government declared a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in four Santa Catarina municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim—due to an Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba. Detection occurred on 18 October, with official confirmation on 19 October after investigation by Santa Catarina’s veterinary service and verification by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo. The farm was quarantined and poultry movement suspended. Control and eradication actions follow the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease. The government notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) and Brazil’s trading partners. The 60-day emergency is established by a Ministry of Agriculture portaria published in the Official Gazette."

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の4都市、ニューカッスル病によりブラジル州政府が非常事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり人への感染報告はないが、WOAHへの通報や貿易制限（家禽移動停止）が行われており、今後の拡大や貿易影響を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）農場でのニューカッスル病発生であり、人への感染は報告されていない。ブラジル政府はWOAHおよび貿易相手国へ通報し、農場の検疫・家禽移動停止などの措置を実施。動物衛生イベントとして経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Governo suspende exportação de carne de aves para a China após detectar Newcastle - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government suspends export of poultry meat to China after detecting Newcastle disease - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Brazil suspended exports of poultry meat to China after Newcastle disease was detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, housing about 6,000 birds. In response, China suspended imports of Santa Catarina poultry and revoked the eligibility of 14 local plants for Chinese shipments, including BRF, JBS Aves, Seara, and Aurora facilities across several cities. Separately, Brazil barred poultry exports to Malaysia; for Santa Catarina-origin meat, seven markets are paused (Kazakhstan, Chile, Tajikistan, Ukraine, Eurasian Economic Union, European Union, Uzbekistan). For 39 additional markets, exports are restricted to areas around the outbreak per bilateral protocols. The precautionary suspension, valid for certificates issued since Sept 21, follows the Newcastle focus and zoosanitary emergency declarations in Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim. Newcastle is a highly contagious viral disease causing respiratory signs in birds.

triage.headline_ja: 中国がニューカッスル病検出後、ブラジルからの鶏肉輸出を停止 - Folha Vitória
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家きん(七面鳥)に限定された動物疾病であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはほぼない。影響は貿易・畜産業に限定され、IHR/WPRO基準への該当は見られない。
triage.notes: 発生地域リストにはChina, Ukraine, Kazakhstan等が含まれるが、これらは輸入停止措置を取った貿易相手国であり、疾病発生地ではないため除外。実際の発生地はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州のみ。ニューカッスル病はヒトへの感染性は低く、主に家きん産業・貿易への影響事案。

article.articleHeadline: تسجيل تاسع إصابة بإيبولا في كينيا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninth Ebola case recorded in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola virus disease cases have been reported in Kenya, all within a single transmission cluster with no evidence of spread beyond it. The latest case is a close family member of the first patient, who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died on October 5. By October 20, health authorities had traced 134 of 135 contacts and placed them under quarantine. The outbreak remains centered near the Kenya–DRC border, with Kenya on high alert after the initial case earlier this month. Director-General of Health Patrick Amoth stated that all nine cases belong to one cluster and no transmission outside this group has been detected. The U.S. Department of State has advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and has raised the travel advisory level due to health risks.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9人目のエボラ出血熱症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のクラスター発生で死亡例・国際渡航制限（米国渡航勧告引き上げ）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はケニア（対象国リスト外）だが、初発患者はDRCから渡航しており、国境地帯での流行拡大が示唆されるためDRCを検証対象国として含めた。ケニア国内の詳細な公衆衛生対応状況や二次感染の有無については続報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Pensilvânia emite alerta por caso de sarampo congênito, doença ausente dos EUA há décadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Pennsylvania issues alert for a case of congenital measles, a disease absent from the U.S. for decades.
article.articleSummary: On October 19, 2026, the Pennsylvania Department of Health confirmed a congenital measles case, issuing a health alert; this marks a rare congenital measles case in the United States, which had been declared measles eliminated in 2000. Congenital measles occurs when an incompletely immune or unvaccinated pregnant woman acquires measles during pregnancy, risking fetal malformations and severe infant complications such as neurological, cardiac, and vision defects. The patient’s identity and municipality are not disclosed; case under investigation by the state health department. Measles outbreaks since elimination have been small and typically linked to travelers bringing the virus; congenital measles signals a setback tied to lack of MMR vaccination in pregnant women. High vaccination coverage remains essential; Brazil faced 2018-2019 outbreaks and later campaigns to reach the 95% target. The alert underscores importation risk and the need for vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ペンシルベニア州、数十年ぶりとなる先天性麻疹症例に警戒発令
triage.triage_reason: 米国での先天性麻疹は極めて稀な事例で注目に値するが、対象国（ブラジル等）での発生ではなく米国ペンシルベニア州の単発症例であり、国際的拡大の情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は米国ペンシルベニア州での先天性麻疹症例。ブラジルは過去の麻疹流行事例として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。対象国リストに米国は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni : sept élèves contaminés en deux semaines à Mangina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: seven students infected in two weeks in Mangina.
article.articleSummary: Seven confirmed Ebola virus disease cases among students in Mangina, Nord-Kivu's Mabalako health zone (Beni territory) over two weeks, including two secondary-school students from two institutes and five primary-school pupils across five schools. The Mangina Catholic Teachers' Union (SYNECATH) warns of inadequate prevention measures in several schools and calls for urgent mobilization of health authorities and local politicians to reinforce school-based prevention, including distribution of appropriate prevention kits and enhanced handwashing facilities. They request the health zone medical chief, response team, and local authorities to act quickly to strengthen protective measures in schools. Despite ongoing efforts, rapid reinforcement of protections is deemed essential to curb transmission and protect students and staff. The nationwide Ebola outbreak declared in May has 4,602 deaths among 9,552 confirmed cases (case fatality 48.5%), across eight of 26 provinces: Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Sud-Ubangi, and Nord-Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ベニ近郊マンギナで2週間に7人の生徒が感染
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（9,552症例、死亡4,602人、致死率48.5%）が8州に拡大しており、学校内感染も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 2026年5月に宣言された全国規模のエボラアウトブレイクの一環で、致死率48.5%と非常に高い。学校での感染拡大が確認されており、教員組合が予防対策の強化と保健当局・地方政治家の緊急動員を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении подтвердили девятый случай заболевания Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Confirms Ninth Case of Ebola Virus Disease.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed a ninth case of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD), bringing total infections to nine. The latest patient is a close relative of the initial case and has been placed in quarantine. All nine infections are linked to a single community, with no evidence of transmission beyond this group. The outbreak in Kenya follows a regional Ebola surge centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo, raising cross-border spread concerns. The first Kenyan case was detected earlier this month in a man who arrived from the DRC in Nairobi and died in a Nairobi hospital on October 5. Health authorities report that 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined as of October 20, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の9例目の感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国境を越えた拡大）し、DRC由来の地域的流行がケニアに越境した事例であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例の主たる発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事は『DRCを中心とした地域的流行』に言及しており、DRCでの継続的な感染拡大が本イベントの背景として重要なため、DRCのみを検証済み地域として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenijoje nustatytas devintas Ebolos atvejis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninth Ebola case detected in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Kenyan health authorities report the ninth case of Ebola virus disease in the country, within a single outbreak cluster that began with a case reported on October 6. The index patient—a businessman in his fifties who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo—died in Nairobi on October 5, triggering intensified surveillance. Eight additional infections were identified, mainly among close contacts. The ninth case is a 24-year-old man described as a close family member of the index case; infection was confirmed on Monday. He was isolated and began treatment immediately, already in quarantine when symptoms appeared. No evidence so far that the virus has spread beyond this cluster; contact tracing has expanded, with 134 of 135 contacts identified and isolated. The United States has urged reconsideration of travel to Kenya. In the DRC, authorities report over 9,000 Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9人目のエボラ出血熱患者を確認
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ患者から始まったクラスターが拡大し9例目を確認、米国が渡航再考を促すなど国際的な懸念が生じているためIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 主題はケニアでのエボラアウトブレイクであり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。記事中でDRCの状況（累計9,000例以上）に言及があるが、これは背景情報であり本記事の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Paraguay prohíbe temporalmente importaciones avícolas de Brasil ante brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraguay temporarily bans poultry imports from Brazil amid a Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak led Paraguay to temporarily ban imports of live birds, eggs, genetic material, and other poultry products from Santa Catarina, Brazil, following confirmation of an outbreak in a turkey farm at Nova Itaberaba. Non-banned products may enter only if certified to have undergone virus inactivation and anti-recontamination measures under the World Organisation for Animal Health Terrestrial Code; prior authorization from Senacsa and adherence to national import requirements are required. The measures remain until an updated sanitary risk assessment is available. Brazil reported the Newcastle outbreak in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Paraguay has had no Newcastle cases since 1997 and was declared free in 2000. Newcastle disease is highly contagious in birds, causing respiratory, nervous, and digestive signs with high mortality; transmission occurs via infected animals or contaminated water, feed, or equipment.

triage.headline_ja: パラグアイ、ニューカッスル病の発生を受けブラジルからの家禽類輸入を一時禁止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州でニューカッスル病の発生が確認され、パラグアイが家禽製品の輸入を一時禁止するなど、国際的な拡大リスクと貿易制限措置が同時に発生しているためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本事象は家禽（ニューカッスル病）の動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生影響は限定的。ただし国際貿易への影響（パラグアイによる輸入禁止）が生じているため、動物由来感染症としての監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: BREAKING: Ebola Hits FCT As FG Identifies 44 Contacts Of Infected Woman
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) after laboratory confirmation of a case imported from Uganda. Woman treated in a private Abuja hospital; now isolated. 44 close contacts identified to date, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers and travel contacts, with ongoing efforts to identify more exposures. Coordination by the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) and FCT Health Services Secretariat; hospital infection prevention and control measures reinforced. Nationwide facilities urged to stay alert and report suspected cases. Symptoms to monitor: fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting and diarrhoea; incubation 2–21 days. Transmission via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and contaminated objects. Past Nigeria Ebola experience (2014) and heightened readiness due to DRC outbreaks and a Kenya imported case; NCDC warns of international transmission risk. Public can call NCDC toll-free line 6232.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：エボラ出血熱がFCT（連邦首都圏）で発生、政府が感染女性の接触者44人を特定
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・アブジャでウガンダからの輸入エボラ症例が確認され、44人の濃厚接触者（医療従事者含む）が特定されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例の発生国はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）。感染源はウガンダからの輸入症例であり、DRCは過去の流行への言及に留まり、本記事の主題となる発生国ではないため、対象国リストに該当する verified_locations はなし。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا في كينيا.. الإصابات ترتفع إلى 9 دون انتشار مجتمعي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kenya... cases rise to 9 with no community transmission.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Kenya has reached 9 laboratory-confirmed cases as of 20 October 2026, with a new infection in a 24-year-old male relative of the first case, who was under quarantine as a known contact before symptom onset. All nine cases are linked to a single transmission chain that began when the initial patient arrived in Nairobi in early October from the Democratic Republic of Congo. The cluster includes several relatives and healthcare workers who cared for the index case. Health authorities maintain strict contact tracing and monitoring during the incubation period to detect new infections early and prevent wider spread. There are no indications of community transmission, and isolation, laboratory testing, and surveillance of contacts continue as Kenya coordinates its response with ongoing Ebola activity in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱、感染者9人に増加…市中感染なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCからケニアへ国境を越えて伝播し、9例のクラスターが確認されている。国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の重大性からIHR基準の複数に該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラクラスター（ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外）。指標症例はDRCから到着しており、DRCで『進行中のエボラ活動』が明記されているためDRCのみ対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle em SC: o que saber sobre transmissão e consumo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease in Santa Catarina: What to Know About Transmission and Consumption.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, on Oct 18, 2026. The property is quarantined by the Santa Catarina Official Veterinary Service, with suspension of bird movements and containment procedures. The outbreak affects Brazilian poultry exports; human infection risk is low, with conjunctivitis among exposed workers as a principal human symptom. Newcastle disease is a viral disease of birds causing respiratory, digestive, and neurological signs; transmission occurs via contact with infected secretions and contaminated materials. Food safety remains intact; properly cooked poultry and eggs are safe for consumption. Mexico suspended some Brazilian poultry imports; China and Chile restricted imports from Santa Catarina. Brazilian authorities negotiated to prevent broader restrictions, emphasizing sanitary controls and trade implications.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病：感染経路と消費について知っておくべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病で人への感染リスクは低く、主に貿易制限に関する動物衛生イベントであり、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は見られない。
triage.notes: 発生地域に含まれるMexico, China, Chileは輸入制限を行っている側であり、実際の発生国はBrazilのみ。人への感染は結膜炎程度と軽度で、食品安全性にも問題なしとされている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya : neuvième cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Ninth Case of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nine laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases detected in Kenya as of 20 October 2026, all within a single household in Nairobi. Kenya’s first case was reported on 6 October after a businessman who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) died in Nairobi; the DRC has an ongoing outbreak since May, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths. The ninth case is a 24-year-old man, a close family member of the first patient, who was already in quarantine when symptoms appeared. He was isolated, tested, and treated after a positive result. Contact tracing spans 135 contacts, with 134 identified and quarantined. There is no evidence of transmission beyond the household cluster thus far. The United States has urged citizens to reconsider travel to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ出血熱9例目
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生し、国境を越えた感染拡大・渡航制限（米国の渡航再考勧告）が既に生じており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの二次感染クラスター（9例目）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCの大規模な継続中アウトブレイク（9,000例超、4,381死亡）は事象の本質的背景として記載されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: IDAF realiza campanha de vacinação contra brucelose no Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IDAF carries out a brucellosis vaccination campaign in Acre.
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis vaccination campaign underway in Acre, Brazil, led by the Institute of Agricultural and Forest Defense of Acre (IDAF). The drive runs from October 1 to December 31 and mandates vaccination of female cattle aged 3 to 8 months. Producers may consult veterinarians for the RB51 vaccine option for older animals. Vaccination must be administered by a veterinarian registered in the National Program for Control and Eradication of Brucellosis and Tuberculosis (PNCEBT); the professional issues a vaccination certificate that must be recorded in IDAF’s system. Producers are urged to keep their herd records current and declare the herd during the campaign to prevent impediments in issuing the Animal Transit Guide (GTA) for herd movements. Brucellosis is a zoonosis that can be transmitted via contaminated milk and contact with infected birth products; campaign aims to reduce human and animal health risks in Acre.

triage.headline_ja: IDAFがアクレ州でブルセラ症ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アクレ州における定期的な家畜ワクチン接種キャンペーンの広報記事であり、異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 定期的な家畜衛生管理プログラム（PNCEBT）の一環であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil notifica países sobre caso de doença de Newcastle em aves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil notifies countries about a case of Newcastle disease in birds.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease virus detected in birds in Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Agriculture Ministry, with the Foreign Affairs Ministry, has notified international bodies and importers, and has officially informed the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) about the presence of the virus, even though the birds show no clinical signs. The Brazilian Animal Protein Association (BPA) reports ongoing transparency, distributing information to Brazilian and international importers and stressing Brazil’s robust control system to protect flocks and prevent spread. Several exporting countries have requested restrictions within a 10-km radius of the affected area. Brazil is working to maintain export continuity while awaiting responses on the measures to be adopted by importing nations. No symptoms in animals reported, and authorities emphasize monitoring and containment as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、鳥類のニューカッスル病発生について各国に通知
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の家禽でニューカッスル病が検出され、複数の輸出先国が一部地域の輸入制限を要請しているが、動物に臨床症状はなく人への健康影響は報告されていないため、貿易面での注視が必要な事案。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（動物）のニューカッスル病であり、人への感染や症状は報告されていない。輸出入に関わる貿易制限の動きがあるため経過観察が妥当。公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل الإصابة التاسعة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its ninth case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its ninth confirmed Ebola virus infection, with all nine cases connected to a single transmission chain and no evidence of spread beyond that cluster. The latest case involves a family member of the initial patient and was isolated prior to confirmation. Health authorities tracked 134 of 135 contacts and placed them under quarantine to contain transmission. Kenya’s first Ebola case occurred in early October in an individual who arrived from the Democratic Republic of Congo, and officials continue surveillance and preparedness as the outbreak unfolds in the region. Patrick Amoth, Director General of Health, confirmed containment efforts and emphasized that there is no detected secondary transmission outside the linked cluster.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルス感染症の9例目を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCから越境したエボラ感染がケニアで9例確認されており、致死率の高い感染症の国際的拡大事例としてIHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事の主題は感染源（初発患者の渡航元）としての言及のみであり、実際の感染拡大・症例発生はケニアで起きている。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: ABPA destaca preparação sanitária do Brasil após registro de Newcastle em Santa Catarina | Feed&Food
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ABPA highlights Brazil's sanitary preparedness after Newcastle disease registration in Santa Catarina | Feed&Food
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was registered in Santa Catarina, Brazil, identified without clinical signs in animals. On 20 October 2026, the Brazilian Association of Animal Protein (ABPA) highlighted the nation's sanitary preparedness to respond to avian disease events, citing a quick, coordinated response among the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA), the productive sector, and state sanitary defense services. Measures necessary are already in place or underway, with communications to relevant authorities and trading partners. ABPA stressed the value of pre-negotiated sanitary certificates and rapid reporting to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH, formerly OIE) and importing-country authorities, which has helped provide predictability in negotiations and facilitate trade. The association noted only a limited extent of trade suspensions so far, reinforcing confidence in the Brazilian sanitary system. The episode underscores Brazil’s role as a strategic global partner in food security, supplying products to markets on five continents.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病登録後、国の衛生対応力をABPAが強調
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽におけるニューカッスル病で、臨床症状は認められず、迅速な対応と限定的な貿易制限で管理されており、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（動物）の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響は報告されていない。ブラジル当局・ABPAは迅速な対応と透明性のある報告により貿易への影響を最小化したとしている。

article.articleHeadline: BREAKING: FG confirms Ebola case in FCT, identifies 44 contacts
article.articleSummary: One laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) with 44 close contacts identified for monitoring. The patient is a woman who recently arrived in Nigeria on an international flight from Uganda; she was admitted to a private hospital in the FCT and is now isolated after confirmation on Oct 20, 2026. Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, NCDC, and the FCT Health Services Secretariat are coordinating with other authorities to contain transmission, including intensified surveillance and infection prevention in the treating hospital. Contact tracing covers healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and airline passengers; exposed individuals are urged to report symptoms promptly. Symptoms to watch: fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting, diarrhoea; incubation 2–21 days. Public advised to wash hands, avoid contact with blood/body fluids of suspected cases; call NCDC toll-free 6232. The response follows a regional Ebola outbreak with import risk from Kenya/DRC, and Nigeria’s 2014 experience.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：ナイジェリア連邦政府、FCTでエボラ感染確定、接触者44人を特定
triage.triage_reason: 国際便で移動した患者がエボラ陽性と確定し、航空機乗客を含む44人の接触者調査が進行中であり、公衆衛生上重大かつ国際拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（FCT/アブジャ）での輸入エボラ症例であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアは地域的な感染源として言及されているが、記事の主たる発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: China, Chile e México restringem produtos do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: China, Chile and Mexico restrict Brazilian products.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil triggers temporary export restrictions by Mexico, China, and Chile on Brazilian poultry products. Mexico imposes the broadest ban, suspending imports of live birds, poultry meat and offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, and birds kept for sale or ornamentation from all Brazil. China and Chile restrict only to Santa Catarina—the outbreak origin. China suspends Santa Catarina poultry meat; Chile's measures cover a wider slate from Santa Catarina, including fertile and SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamentals, fresh poultry meat, eggs for human consumption, and meat products containing poultry meat. MAPA says negotiations with importers continue and that Brazilian authorities are providing technical information on the outbreak and control measures.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：中国、チリ、メキシコがブラジル産品を輸入制限
triage.triage_reason: 家きんのニューカッスル病によるブラジル産家きん製品の貿易制限であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクはほぼないため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当数が少なくフルRRA対象としない。
triage.notes: 本件は家きん（七面鳥）に限定された動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響は報告されていない。貿易制限のみが焦点であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de produtos avícolas do Brasil após caso de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends imports of Brazilian poultry products after Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has been confirmed at a commercial poultry farm in Peruz, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The 6,000-bird operation showed no clinical signs; the virus was detected during surveillance and laboratory-confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agropecuária Defense in São Paulo. The farm is quarantined to contain and eradicate the outbreak. Surveillance covers about 133 farms in four municipalities—Nove Taberaba, Coronel Freitas, Erechim, and Águas Frias. A 60-day zoosanitary emergency was declared to speed response. Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry products—chicken meat, live birds, and fertile eggs—following the finding; China is monitoring the situation. The Agriculture Ministry is informing partners; restrictions depend on each country’s protocols. Consumption of poultry meat and eggs from officially inspected establishments remains safe; producers should maintain biosafety and report suspicions to CDAS.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受けブラジル産鶏肉製品の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でニューカッスル病が確認され、これを受けてメキシコが鶏肉製品の輸入を停止、中国も状況を監視するなど、国際的な貿易制限・対応が既に発生しているためIHR基準（国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限）が2つ該当しPICKUPと判定。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（ニワトリ）を対象としたニューカッスル病の動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていない（感染確認農場では臨床症状なし）。ただし貿易制限（メキシコの輸入停止、中国の監視）という国際的な影響が生じているため、動物衛生・貿易影響の観点からPICKUPとした。公衆衛生上の直接リスクは低い点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil avoids nationwide China poultry ban after Newcastle disease case
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak at a turkey farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompted China to restrict poultry imports, with limits confined to Santa Catarina after negotiations by the Brazilian government. ABPA notes Brazil’s trade protocol allows such targeted measures rather than a nationwide suspension. Chile also imposed statewide restrictions, while Mexico halted poultry imports from the entire country to protect domestic production, as it is Newcastle disease–free. Brazil, the world's largest chicken meat exporter, relies on Santa Catarina for about 15% of its poultry output. The Agriculture Ministry said it remains in close contact with importing countries, providing outbreak data and control measures to facilitate safe trade resumption. A prior Newcastle disease outbreak in July 2024 occurred in Rio Grande do Sul, with China maintaining a nationwide embargo until January 2026 after that event. The current outbreak is described as highly contagious among birds, affecting turkeys.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、ニューカッスル病発生後も中国による全国的な鶏肉輸入禁止を回避
triage.triage_reason: 家禽（七面鳥）に限定した動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は報告されていない。主に貿易・検疫上の問題として扱われている。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の高病原性疾患でヒトへの感染はまれかつ軽度（結膜炎程度）とされ、公衆衛生上の脅威は限定的。本件は家禽貿易・検疫に関する経済的影響が主眼であり、EBS対象としての優先度は低い。中国・チリ・メキシコは輸入制限を課した国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تعلن تسجيل الإصابة التاسعة بفيروس إيبولا وتؤكد حصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports the ninth case of Ebola virus and confirms containment.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine cases of Ebola virus disease, bringing the total confirmed infections in the country to nine. The newest case is linked to the index patient who brought the virus to Nairobi from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC); health authorities say all nine cases belong to a single linked outbreak cluster, with no evidence of transmission beyond this group. The response includes intensified border and public-venue surveillance, contact tracing, routine testing, isolation, and care at facilities prepared in Nairobi. The health ministry notes the outbreak began earlier this month with a man who arrived in Nairobi from the DRC and died on October 5, prompting thorough exposure tracking. International concern prompted the US travel advisory to Kenya. Officials urge reporting fever, severe bleeding, and muscle pains, and stress daily public updates and regional laboratory collaborations to accelerate confirmation and prevent spread while infections remain contained within close contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラウイルスの9例目の感染を報告、封じ込めを確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラという重篤な疾患の国際的拡大事例であり、IHR4基準全てに該当し、米国の渡航勧告発出など社会的・国際的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき案件。
triage.notes: 実際の症例発生国はケニア（ナイロビ）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは感染源（index patient の出発国）として言及されているが、DRC国内での発症・アウトブレイクではないため除外。米国の渡航勧告発出は国際的懸念の強いシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms 9th Ebola case as authorities trace 135 contacts - Blueprint Newspapers Limited
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kenya confirms a ninth Ebola case within a single cluster linked to the first case detected earlier in October. The latest patient is a 24-year-old man who is a close family member of the initial case; he developed symptoms in quarantine, tested positive on Monday, and was isolated and started on treatment immediately. The first case, a businessman in his forties who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, was reported on 6 October with illness and died in Nairobi on 5 October. Health authorities say all nine infections remain within one cluster and there is no evidence of transmission beyond that group. Contact tracing has expanded to 135 identified contacts; 134 have been traced and quarantined. The U.S. has issued a travel advisory to Kenya. Separately, DR Congo reports over 9,000 Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9例目のエボラ感染確認、当局が135人の接触者を追跡
triage.triage_reason: ケニアにおけるエボラ出血熱クラスターの拡大（9例目確認、死亡例あり）に加え、米国が渡航勧告を発出しており、IHR基準の大半に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラクラスター（対象国リスト外）だが、DRCでも同時期に9,000例超・4,381人死亡の大規模流行が継続中であることが明記されており、DRCを実発生国として記載。ケニア初発例もDRC滞在歴のある人物であり、両国間の疫学的関連が強い。

article.articleHeadline: CDC issues travel alert after Kenya confirms first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its first imported Ebola case on Oct 6, 2026, linked to a traveler from the DRC via Uganda, triggering a CDC Level 1 travel notice for Kenya as of 2026-10-20. The outbreak, driven by Bundibugyo Ebola with 25–50% mortality and no vaccine, has spread from the DRC to Uganda (local transmission previously; Uganda’s outbreak now over) and produced imported cases in Kenya and France. Total CDC tally: 9,581 confirmed cases and 4,605 deaths. Breakdown: DRC 9,552/4,602; Uganda 20 confirmed, 1 probable case, 2 deaths (1 probable); Kenya 8 confirmed, 1 death; France 1 imported case. Ituri and Nord-Kivu in the DRC are Level 4 travel areas; Haut-Uélé and Tshopo Level 3; remainder of DRC and Uganda Level 2. Two American aid workers treated in Germany (May 2026 Dr. Peter Stafford; July 2026 case), both stable; no US deaths. Ebola symptoms include fever, headache, GI symptoms; travelers urged to monitor for 21 days after leaving the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: CDC、ケニアで初のエボラ出血熱症例確認後に渡航警報を発令
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクがウガンダ・ケニア・フランスへ越境拡大し、CDCがケニアに渡航警報（Level 1）を発令。IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUnited States, France, Germany, Kenya, Ugandaが含まれるが、これらは対象国リスト外のため除外。アウトブレイクの主要発生源かつ対象国に該当するDRCのみverified_locationsに記載。累計9,581症例・4,605死亡という大規模流行で、致死率25-50%、ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo種）という点も深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Etah News: हत्सारी में सात डेंगू पॉजिटिव मिले, तीन की जा चुकी है जान
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Etah News: Seven dengue-positive cases found in Hatsari; three have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Hatsari village in AliGanj block, Etah district, Uttar Pradesh, reports dengue alongside viral fever. Eleven suspected cases were sent to a medical college for dengue ELISA testing, with seven positives. Health teams have screened and treated about 297 patients in the past three days, including roughly 70 on Tuesday. Three deaths have been reported in Hatsari, yet families have not produced death certificates confirming dengue. The deceased include 19-year-old Shivani (daughter of Virendra Singh) who died on 16 October, and 50-year-old Radheshyam who died in September; another death is also reported without clear dengue confirmation. Dengue-positive patients identified include Anand (18), Ramswaroop (70), Ramshankar (60), Haripyari (60), Bharat Singh (62), Snehlata (50), and Monika (12).

triage.headline_ja: エター州ニュース:ハツァリ村でデング熱陽性7人確認、3人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドの一村落におけるデング熱の季節性流行であり、死因のデング熱確定も未了（死亡診断書未提出）。局地的な事案で国際的拡大リスクは低いが、死亡例報告があり続報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドで季節性に流行する風土病であり、本件は単一村落（ハツァリ村、ウッタル・プラデーシュ州エター県）での局地的事案。死亡例3件はデング熱との因果関係が死亡診断書で確認されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: ABPA destaca ação rápida após foco da doença de Newcastle em SC | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ABPA highlights rapid action after Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggered rapid action by ABPA. The association notes MAPA (Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock), in collaboration with the productive sector and state sanitary defense services, prepared to handle sanitary events, with Newcastle disease detected in Santa Catarina without clinical signs in animals. A fast, coordinated response leveraged prior planning and experience. Sanitary measures have been adopted or are underway, with prompt communication to authorities and trade partners. Pre-negotiated sanitary certificates and swift reporting to the World Organisation for Animal Health (WOAH) and importing-country authorities contributed to predictability in trade. The limited import suspensions to date highlight the value of preparedness and trust in Brazil's sanitary system. ABPA expects negotiations to advance quickly to preserve export flows, reinforcing Brazil's role as a reliable global supplier of animal protein.

triage.headline_ja: ABPA、サンタカタリナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後の迅速な対応を強調 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）におけるニューカッスル病の発生で、臨床症状なく貿易への影響が限定的との報告だが、動物衛生イベントでありヒト感染症としての直接的な公衆衛生影響は不明。貿易制限の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽の動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトへの感染症リスクに関する記載はない。ABPA・MAPAによる迅速対応と貿易維持のための対策が主内容。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia alerta que vírus da gripe circula o ano todo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia warns that the influenza virus circulates year-round.
article.articleSummary: Influenza circulates year-round in Hortolândia, Brazil, with vaccination ongoing at seven UBS health centers. The municipality has administered over 65,000 doses (55% coverage), above state (52%) and national (51%) averages. The campaign, begun in March, targets pregnant women, people aged 60 and over, and children under six, with a 90% coverage goal for these groups. Seven UBSs offer extended hours (16:00–18:30) to facilitate access; Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém and Santa Clara open until 17:30, while Amanda I, Figueiras and Parque do Horto remain open until 18:30. This year, Hortolândia reports 36 influenza cases and 3 deaths. Coverage by group: pregnant women—target 1,990; 1,781 doses, 89%; seniors 60+—target 32,992; 17,824 doses, 54%; children under 6—target 16,619; 8,801 doses, 52%. If vaccination card is missing, go to a UBS to vaccinate and update records.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランジア市、インフルエンザウイルスは年間を通じて流行していると警告
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、異常性・国際的拡大リスク・社会的関心の高まりは見られない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・オルトランジア市における通常のインフルエンザワクチン接種状況の広報記事。36症例・3死亡の報告があるが、年間を通じた通常の流行状況の一部として言及されており、異常な集積や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: حالة تأهب قصوى بكينيا بعد تسجيل تاسع إصابة بـ "إيبولا" |
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya on high alert after reporting the ninth Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its ninth Ebola virus disease case on 20 October 2026, with all nine linked to a single cluster. The latest case is a close family member of the first patient and was already under quarantine. Health officials, led by Director-General Patrick Amoth, say there is no evidence of transmission beyond this cluster. The first Kenyan case was detected earlier this month in a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo to Nairobi and died in a Nairobi hospital on 5 October. The outbreak remains centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has crossed into Kenya, triggering heightened border-area alert. No secondary spread outside the cluster has been confirmed to date.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9例目のエボラ感染確認、最高レベルの警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境し二次感染（9例目）を記録、死亡例もあり国際的拡大のリスクが現実化しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染拡大だが、アウトブレイクの発生源・中心地はDRCであり対象国リストに該当。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Tiêm vaccine não mô cầu tăng cao, bác sĩ lưu ý nhóm đối tượng dễ mắc bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal vaccination on the rise, doctors warn high-risk groups.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease vaccination uptake surges in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. At Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City, demand rises as parents rush to immunize adolescents; concerns rise after a student death. Over a three-day period, vaccination visits increased 7–8 times the usual. In VNVC’s network, nearly 40,000 doses were given nationwide over four days, with about 15,000 doses in Ho Chi Minh City—125-fold higher than the same period previously. VNVC mobilized more than 12,000 staff to ensure vaccine supply and safety, with no price increases. Health officials emphasize protection for adolescents and young adults, noting waning antibodies around ages 9–10 and the value of booster doses. Vaccines cover serogroups A, B, C, Y, and W; prior BC vaccines may need supplementary coverage. A February 2025 fatal, lab-confirmed meningococcal septic shock case (serogroup W) underscores rapid progression; early fever, headache, and nausea are warning signs.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌ワクチン接種が急増、医師が罹患リスクの高い層に注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: 過去の学生死亡例をきっかけにワクチン需要が急増しているという報道であり、現在進行中の大規模アウトブレイクを示す情報はないが、髄膜炎菌感染症は重症化・ヒト-ヒト感染のリスクがあるため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は2025年2月に発生した致死的な髄膜炎菌性敗血症性ショック（血清群W）の症例を契機としたワクチン接種急増を報じたもので、新規の集団発生や症例急増を示すものではない。現時点での具体的な感染者数・流行状況の情報は不足している。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل إصابة جديدة بفيروس إيبولا وترفع الحصيلة إلى 9 حالات
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records a new Ebola virus case, bringing the toll to 9 cases.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records a new Ebola virus case, bringing the toll to nine. The Health Ministry said the latest infection is a close family member of the first patient, who had been in quarantine. Health Director-General Patrick Amoth said all nine cases belong to a single cluster, with no evidence of transmission outside that cluster as of 20 October 2026. Authorities have traced 134 of 135 contacts and placed them in quarantine. Kenya remains on high alert after Ebola activity in the region, linked to outbreaks centered in the Democratic Republic of Congo. The first Kenyan case, an imported traveler from the DRC to Nairobi, died in hospital on 5 October. The nine cases are connected within the same transmission chain, with ongoing surveillance to monitor and contain potential spread.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで新たなエボラウイルス感染例を記録、累計9例に
triage.triage_reason: エボラというIHR Annex2上重大な疾患で、DRCからの越境輸入例を起点としたクラスター内感染が継続しており、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスクの複数基準に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアにおけるエボラ感染クラスター（9例、単一クラスター内、接触者135人中134人を隔離済み）である。DRCは感染源国として言及されているが、DRC国内でのアウトブレイク拡大自体は記事の主題ではないため、対象国リスト上の『実際に発生している国』としては該当しない。ケニア自体は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空となる。続報でDRC国内の状況が主題化する場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle: o que se sabe sobre nova doença descoberta em granja? | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle: what is known about a newly discovered disease on a farm?
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was identified at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, on Sunday the 18th, prompting MAPA to implement control, containment, and eradication measures. The 6,000-bird facility is not for meat production. The Official Veterinary Service interdicted the site, suspending bird movements and keeping stock on site pending investigation. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral illness of birds caused by avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1). Symptoms include sneezing, labored breathing, drooping wings, twisted neck, loss of appetite, and greenish diarrhea. It is a zoonosis of lower importance; human infection is usually mild, often presenting conjunctivitis, mainly from direct contact or contaminated material. Poultry products remain safe when properly cooked. MAPA reported temporary export suspensions: Brazil-wide with Mexico (live birds, meat, eggs, day-old chicks, ornamentals/pet birds) and Santa Catarina with China and Chile, though national exports were not halted. The previous Brazilian Newcastle case was July 17, 2024 (Anta Gorda, RS); the Rio Grande do Sul emergency ended in August 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：農場で発見された新たな疾病について分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病（家禽の人獣共通感染症）が確認されたが、人への健康影響は軽微（結膜炎程度）で、過去にも発生例があり異常ではない。輸出の一時停止はあるが公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は主に動物衛生・農業貿易上の問題であり、人への感染は軽微（結膜炎程度）。メキシコ・中国・チリは輸出停止対象国であり発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Governo decreta emergência zoosanitária em quatro cidades após doença em aves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Decrees Zoosanitary Emergency in Four Cities Following Avian Disease
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak triggers a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in four Santa Catarina municipalities after confirmation at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. The municipalities are Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. Case confirmation occurred on 19 October, following detection on 18 October. The state Official Veterinary Service interdicted the farm and suspended avian movements to curb spread and eradicate the disease, in line with the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease. Brazil notified the OIE and trade partners as required. Confirmation was by the Federal Agricultural Defense Laboratory of São Paulo after an epidemiological investigation by the state service. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection affecting more than 200 bird species; human exposure carries low risk, with conjunctivitis possible. In birds, signs include sneezing, respiratory distress, wing droop, head/neck twisting, and greenish diarrhea; avoid contact and report to authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 政府、鳥類の疾病発生を受けサンタカタリーナ州4市に動物衛生緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病の家禽発生であり、人への健康リスクは低い（結膜炎程度）と明記されている。家畜防疫措置（移動停止・OIE通知）は実施済みで、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威や社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は動物疾病であり、人への感染は低リスクで軽度の結膜炎程度とされる。農場は隔離済みで、国の対応能力内と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: صحيفة عمون : حالة تأهب قصوى بكينيا بعد تسجيل تاسع إصابة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ammon News: Kenya on high alert after recording the ninth Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has recorded its ninth Ebola case, with the latest infection linked to a close family member of the first patient and already placed in quarantine. Health authorities say all nine cases belong to a single transmission cluster and there is no evidence of onward spread outside this group. The first case in Kenya was diagnosed earlier this month in a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Nairobi and died in a Nairobi hospital on October 5. As of today, 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined. Kenya remains on high alert as Ebola crosses borders from the DRC region. The U.S. State Department has advised Americans to reconsider travel to Kenya and raised the travel warning due to health risks.

triage.headline_ja: アモン・ニュース：ケニアでエボラ出血熱の9例目感染確認、最高レベルの警戒態勢へ
triage.triage_reason: DRCから越境したエボラ感染がケニアで9例確認され、死亡例もあり米国が渡航勧告を発出するなど国際的関心・影響が大きいため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 発症・感染拡大の主題国はケニアであり対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは最初の患者の渡航元として言及されているのみで、DRC国内でのアウトブレイクではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms ninth Ebola case amid concerns about regional spread
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola cases confirmed in Kenya, linked to an outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). A 24-year-old man in quarantine tested positive, bringing Kenya's total to nine; the index death occurred Oct 5 in Nairobi after travel from the DRC via Uganda. All nine cases belong to a single cluster; no evidence of transmission outside this group. Eight patients are stable and responding to treatment; 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined. Contacts in quarantine have remained well during the 21-day monitoring period and could be released around Oct 25. Kenya has not imposed travel, trade, or public gathering restrictions. In the DRC, there have been more than 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths since May, with Bundibugyo strain lacking a licensed vaccine or specific treatment, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、9例目のエボラ感染確認 地域拡大への懸念が高まる
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株、9000例超・死者約4000人）がウガンダ経由でケニアに波及し、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン未承認）がウガンダ経由でケニアに拡大した事例。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外し、DRCのみを含めた。ケニア国内では現時点で渡航・貿易制限は課されていないが、地域拡大リスクへの懸念が記事タイトルにも明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola In Nigeria: Otu onye ebutela ọrịa Ebola n'Abuja - Minista ahụike - BBC News Ìgbò
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria: One person brought Ebola virus disease to Abuja - Minister of Health - BBC News Igbo.
article.articleSummary: One person brought Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) to Abuja, Nigeria, according to Health Minister Ali Pate. As of October 20, 2026, investigators have identified 44 individuals who may have been exposed and are tracing contacts to prevent further transmission. President Bola Tinubu has directed the initiation of a plan to curb Ebola spread in Nigeria. The update also notes cross-border concerns, with Kenya reporting another imported Ebola case linked to travel from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The rapid response emphasizes contact tracing and containment to avert a wider outbreak centered in Abuja. No additional details on symptom onset, laboratory confirmation, or the index case’s travel history are provided in the brief.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアのエボラ：一人がアブジャにエボラウイルス病を持ち込んだ－保健大臣－BBCニュース イボ語
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア（アブジャ）への新規エボラ輸入例が確認され、ケニアでもDRC由来の輸入例が報告されるなど複数国にまたがる拡大懸念があり、保健大臣・大統領レベルの対応が取られているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）での輸入エボラ症例であり、ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは感染源として言及されているが、DRC国内での発生自体が記事の主題ではないため、ルールに従いverified_locationsには含めなかった。続報でDRC国内の発生状況が明確になれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Ministério da Saúde do Quénia confirma nono caso positivo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya's Ministry of Health confirms ninth positive case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Kenya: Kenya’s Ministry of Health confirms the ninth Ebola infection after the first case declared on October 6. The case is a 24-year-old man, a close relative of the first patient, who was in quarantine when ill. All nine infections arise from the same transmission cluster; no evidence of spread outside this group. Contact tracing expanded to 135 contacts, with 134 identified and quarantined. The United States has urged citizens to reconsider travel to Kenya. The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, described as the deadliest in the country, with 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 deaths. Kenya is the fourth country to report a case linked to the DRC outbreak, joining Uganda, France and the Netherlands. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated materials, including bedding and clothing. Uganda’s outbreak ended on August 26 with 20 cases (15 imported) and two deaths.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ケニア保健省が9例目の陽性症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の過去最悪規模のエボラ流行（9,277症例、4,478死亡）が複数国（ウガンダ、フランス、オランダ、ケニア）へ拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規症例確認だが、ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の発生源かつ対象国リストに含まれるため採用した。DRC国内の流行規模（過去最悪・9,277症例・4,478死亡）が国際的拡大の主因であり、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia registra su noveno caso de ébola y amplía medidas de prevención en cuarentena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its ninth Ebola case and expands preventive measures in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has nine Ebola cases, with a new positive confirmed in quarantine linked to the initial patient. Authorities report 9 cases in Nairobi since the first infection—traced to a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda and arrived in Kenya on Oct 3; he was diagnosed Oct 5 and died the same day. A total of 135 contacts has been identified across the nine patients, 134 of whom remain in quarantine; the new case is among those in contact with the first patient. There is, to date, no evidence of transmission beyond these known contacts. The first contact group will complete a 21‑day quarantine on Oct 25; asymptomatic individuals may return home. Community officials were urged to welcome them, as they pose no infection risk. Background: the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reported at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の9人目の症例を確認、検疫における予防措置を拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で4,000人以上の死者を出している大規模エボラ流行が国境を越えてケニアに拡大し、9症例・135人の接触者が確認されるなど、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの二次感染クラスターだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国は流行の発生源として具体的な死者数（5月以降4,000人以上）が明記されており、主題的に重要なため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Broj potvrđenih slučajeva ebole u Keniji porastao na devet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya has risen to nine.
article.articleSummary: Nine confirmed Ebola cases in Kenya as of 20 October 2026, after a second contact tested positive while in quarantine. Health authorities report no evidence of transmission outside the immediate circle of those who had contact with the first patient. A contact list of 135 people has been drawn up, with 134 in quarantine; the list will grow as new contacts are identified. The nine-case cluster includes the index patient and eight others—four relatives and four health workers who have also tested positive. Kenya’s first case was declared on 6 October: a man who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) via Uganda, arriving in Nairobi on 3 October. A relative took him to hospital; Ebola was confirmed on 5 October, and he died the same day. Ebola spreads by direct contact with bodily fluids or contaminated objects. The DRC is currently facing the deadliest Ebola outbreak to date, with more than 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで確認されたエボラ感染者数が9人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCからケニアへ国境を越えて伝播し、医療従事者を含む二次感染が確認されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ公衆衛生上の重大性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる事象はケニアでの感染拡大（渡航者由来）だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事内で『史上最悪のエボラ流行、5月以降4000人超死亡』と明記された現在進行中の重大な発生地として記載されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia eleva a nueve los casos de ébola, pero sigue sin reportar transmisión comunitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya raises the number of Ebola cases to nine, but still reports no community transmission.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Kenya reports nine laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, including a 24-year-old close contact of the index case who died; the cluster was imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo. There is no evidence of community transmission; all cases are within the same group. The latest patient was isolated promptly, tested, and started treatment after confirmation. Since the index case was detected on 5 October, 134 of 135 identified contacts have been located and quarantined. Living patients show improvement and remain under strict observation; Kenya has received 500 additional treatment doses. Twelve counties are at very high risk and sixteen at high risk; PPE supplies and a dedicated laboratory at Kenyatta National Hospital support the response. A 21-day quarantine for contacts started 6 September and was due to end by 25 September. The DRC outbreak involves eight provinces, with 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths reported by 16 October; Uganda's outbreak ended, and cases linked to DRC were reported in France and the Netherlands. Bundibugyo strain lacks specific treatment; two vaccines are in early human trials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の症例が9人に増加、依然として市中感染は報告されず
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模流行（9,552例、4,602死亡）が継続中で、ケニア・フランス・オランダへの国際的な波及が確認されており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当により本格的リスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行源として具体的データ（9,552例、4,602死亡）が記載されており対象国として含めた。フランス・オランダ・ウガンダも対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Experiência do setor avícola do Brasil irá permitir 'resposta rápida' ao foco de Newcastle, diz ABPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil's poultry sector experience will enable a 'rapid response' to the Newcastle disease outbreak, says ABPA.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak focus identified in Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Associação Brasileira de Proteína Animal (ABPA) says that the experience accumulated by authorities and the poultry productive sector, along with prior preparation for sanitary events, enabled a rapid and coordinated response. The statement highlights negotiations with importing countries to reduce the impacts of trade restrictions on Brazilian poultry exports. By leveraging established capabilities, Brazil aims to contain the Newcastle disease focus quickly while maintaining market access. The article emphasizes preparedness and swift action rather than detailing epidemiology, case counts, or laboratory confirmations. Dated 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル養鶏業界の経験がニューカッスル病発生への『迅速な対応』を可能にする、とABPAが発表
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病発生であり人への健康影響の記載はないが、貿易制限リスクが明確に言及されているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 動物（家禽）疾患であり、記事は貿易・産業対応に焦点を当てている。人への健康影響や症例数、検査確定等の疫学情報は記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking: FG confirms over 40 Ebola cases in Nigeria, issues directive
article.articleSummary: One laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease case in Nigeria’s Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, on October 20, 2026. Forty-four close contacts have been identified and are under active tracing, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and airline passengers. The response is coordinated by the Federal Ministry of Health and Social Welfare, the NCDC, and the FCT Health Services Secretariat; hospitals receive infection-prevention support and surveillance is intensified. All public and private facilities are on high alert; health workers should isolate suspected cases, follow strict infection-control protocols, and report promptly. Symptoms to watch include fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea; the incubation period is 2–21 days, and transmission occurs via direct contact with infected blood or body fluids. Background: import risk after a Kenya case linked to a Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak; Nigeria previously contained a 2014 outbreak. NCDC toll-free line: 6232 for information.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：ナイジェリア連邦政府、エボラ出血熱患者40人超を確認、指示を発令
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアの首都圏でエボラウイルス病の検査確定例が発生し、44人の濃厚接触者が特定されるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（首都圏アブジャ）でのエボラ確定例であり、対象国リストに含まれていない。DRCはケニア経由での輸入感染の背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地としての主体ではないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: O que é a doença de Newscastle, que interditou granja em SC e levou México a suspender compra de frango do Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Newcastle disease, which shut down a farm in Santa Catarina and led Mexico to suspend imports of Brazilian chicken.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, a highly contagious viral disease affecting domestic and wild birds, is caused by virulent avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1) per OMSA. A focus was confirmed by MAPA on October 18–19 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The facility was quarantined and bird movements suspended. The outbreak prompted Mexico to temporarily suspend imports of Brazilian chicken. MAPA says consumption of poultry under official inspection remains safe; all infected birds are culled to prevent further spread. The epidemiological investigation by Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service, confirmed by the LFDA-SP (an OMSA reference lab), under the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle. Human risk is very low; infection occurs mainly through direct contact with respiratory secretions, causing conjunctivitis in rare cases. Brazil will notify OMSA and trading partners; vaccination exists, with some broiler operations vaccinating as well.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場を閉鎖し、メキシコがブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止させたニューカッスル病とは何か
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのニューカッスル病発生によりメキシコが鶏肉輸入を停止するなど、既に国際貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当（異常性・国際的影響・貿易制限）が認められるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 本事例は主に家禽の動物衛生事象であり、人への感染リスクは非常に低いとされている。ただし国際貿易（メキシコの輸入停止）への影響が確認されているため、貿易・経済的観点からの監視継続が望ましい。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。
