article.articleHeadline: Brasile, focolaio malattia di Newcastle. La Cina sospende l'importazione di carne di pollo. Cosa sappiamo sul virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil, Newcastle disease outbreak. China suspends imports of chicken meat. What do we know about the virus?
article.articleSummary: China suspended imports of chicken meat from 14 Santa Catarina facilities in southern Brazil after detection of a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial turkey farm. The measure targets the state and aims to limit disruption to Brazil’s poultry sector, with 61 facilities nationwide cleared to export to China; Santa Catarina accounts for just over 20% of Brazil’s chicken exports. The affected site has been quarantined and bird movements halted; authorities began containment and eradication efforts and tightened farm controls in the area. Brazil’s agriculture ministry says there is no risk to human health and that meat and eggs from officially inspected plants remain safe to consume. Mexico had already halted imports of Brazilian avian products. Newcastle disease is an infectious disease of domestic and wild birds, named after Newcastle upon Tyne, first identified in 1927.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでニューカッスル病の発生、中国が鶏肉の輸入を停止。このウイルスについて分かっていること
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の家禽(七面鳥)でのニューカッスル病発生であり、当局は人への健康リスクはないと明言しており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。主な影響は貿易制限(中国・メキシコの輸入停止)に限定される。
triage.notes: 本事例は鳥類(七面鳥)の家禽疾病であり、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは記事中で明示的に否定されている。中国・メキシコは輸入停止措置を取った国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: US raises Kenya travel warning as Ebola outbreak spreads in Nairobi
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kenya, centered in Nairobi, linked to a Kenyan businessman who returned from the Democratic Republic of the Congo; as of Oct 20, 2026, Kenya has nine confirmed Ebola cases in one cluster, with no evidence of transmission beyond that group. Health authorities have traced 134 of 135 potential contacts. The first patient traveled Congo -> Uganda -> Nairobi; subsequent cases include his family members and healthcare workers. The event prompts a level-3 US travel advisory for Kenya, urging reconsideration of travel due to health risks, along with concerns about crime, kidnapping, terrorism, civil unrest, and traffic hazards. The outbreak remains ongoing; confirmed cases reported by Kenyan authorities. The situation highlights cross-border screening concerns for travelers and the need for contact tracing to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、ナイロビでのエボラ流行拡大を受けケニア渡航警告を引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラというIHR公衆衛生上の重大疾患がケニアで発生し、国際的な人の移動（コンゴ→ウガンダ→ナイロビ）と米国の渡航勧告引き上げを伴うため、IHR4基準すべてに該当しフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 発生国はケニアだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれていない。感染源とされるDRCは実際の発生地ではなく渡航経由地であるため、verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Saúde inicia com 2 mil doses vacinação contra chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health begins vaccination with 2,000 doses against chikungunya.
article.articleSummary: Sidrolândia, Mato Grosso do Sul, launched a pilot chikungunya vaccination with 2,000 doses available through Oct 29, amid an epidemiological alert as local incidence exceeds the state average. The vaccine targets people aged 18 through 59 years, 11 months and 29 days; eligibility is confirmed by health teams. Pregnant and immunocompromised individuals are contraindicated; breastfeeding women and others with specific health conditions should obtain professional guidance before vaccination. Preventive measures remain essential, including eliminating stagnant water, keeping water tanks closed, cleaning yards, and checking potential Aedes aegypti breeding sites. As of week 38 in 2026, Sidrolândia reported 223 probable chikungunya cases, ranking 20th in the state, up 81.3% from 123 in 2025. Statewide, Mato Grosso do Sul logged about 12,250 probable cases (444.4/100k), with Sidrolândia at 473.3/100k, signaling higher transmission and the need for intensified control.

triage.headline_ja: 保健局、チクングニア熱に対するワクチン接種を2000回分で開始
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内での局地的なチクングニア熱の症例増加とワクチン接種対応が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られず、情報も限定的なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 症例数が前年比81.3%増加し、州平均を上回る地域的な流行が見られるが、重症度や国際的影響に関する情報は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Newcastle leva três países a restringir produtos avícolas brasileiros e mobiliza fiscalização em 1,6 mil propriedades em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease prompts three countries to restrict Brazilian poultry products and mobilizes inspections at 1,600 properties in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggering international restrictions on Brazilian poultry products. Mexico suspended imports of all Brazilian poultry, while China and Chile limited measures to Santa Catarina-origin products (China: poultry meat; Chile: fertilized eggs, SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh poultry meat, and eggs for human consumption). An extensive containment operation targets roughly 1,600 rural properties within a 10-kilometer radius of the index farm; the facility is quarantined and access restricted. Aroad surveillance under the Olho Bom program mobilizes 40 pickup trucks to monitor transport of vehicles and loads; the operation may require sampling blood from over 130 properties. Depopulation of about 6,000 turkeys is planned, with disposal, cleaning, and disinfection of facilities. Since Oct 18, the case was lab-confirmed by Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service; consumption remains considered safe due to official inspections.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病により3カ国がブラジル産鶏肉製品を規制、サンタカタリーナ州の1600軒の農場で検疫体制を動員
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場で確認されたニューカッスル病（家禽の動物疾病）であり、人の健康被害は報告されていない。国際的な貿易制限は発生しているが、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められないためDISMISSと判定。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染・健康被害の報告はない。影響カテゴリも'animals'のみであり、公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性は低い。ただし国際貿易（メキシコ・中国・チリによる輸入制限）への影響があるため、農業・貿易分野での継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Reaches Nigeria: Abuja Case Triggers Emergency Hunt For 44 Contacts, Hospitals Put on Alert
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Nigeria confirmed a fresh Ebola case in the Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) after a woman arriving from Uganda was admitted to a private hospital and later laboratory-confirmed. At least 44 close contacts have been identified and are being traced; authorities seek others including healthcare workers and airline passengers. The patient is isolated and receiving care; hospitals nationwide are on heightened alert and infection prevention measures are being reinforced at facilities. No contacts have tested positive yet, and there is no confirmed community transmission. Symptoms include fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea. Early detection and isolation are emphasized to prevent wider spread; the case recalls Nigeria’s 2014 Lagos outbreak containment. The event occurs amid regional Ebola concerns and cross-border vigilance following a Kenyan case linked to a DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がナイジェリアに到達：アブジャの症例を受け緊急捜索、44人の接触者を追跡、病院に警戒指令
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ帰国者がナイジェリア・アブジャでエボラ陽性と確認され、44人の接触者追跡と病院の警戒体制が敷かれるなど、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 対象国リストにナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは含まれない。DRCは『ケニアの症例がDRCの流行に関連』という文脈で言及されているのみで、本記事の主題イベント（ナイジェリアでの症例）とは直接関係しないため verified_locations には含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Fe confirmó un caso importado de dengue y detectó el serotipo DEN-3 - Sin Mordaza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Fe confirmed an imported dengue case and detected the DEN-3 serotype - Sin Mordaza.
article.articleSummary: Santa Fe, Argentina: one imported dengue case confirmed in Week 40 (through Oct 10, 2026). A woman from the Rosario department had traveled to Peru before symptom onset; molecular testing identified Dengue Virus serotype 3 (DENV-3). Of 74 notifications since the 2026–2027 season began, 73 were discarded and one confirmed. Nationally, Week 39 reported no new dengue cases; since season start, 999 suspected, 4 confirmed, 6 probable/investigation, 595 discarded, 391 under study. Confirmed cases include three in Buenos Aires Province with travel to Brazil and Ecuador (all DENV-3) and a fourth in Buenos Aires City who traveled to Peru (serotype pending). A probable Santa Cruz case involves a Costa Rica tourist with DENV-2; inclusion in data pending. Transmission appears interrupted; vigilance remains seasonal. Prevention in Rosario emphasizes eliminating standing water, cleaning containers, insect-proofing homes, and using repellents. Dengue symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias/arthralgias, nausea, vomiting, fatigue, and rash; seek medical care if symptoms arise.

triage.headline_ja: サンタフェ州でデング熱の輸入症例を確認、血清型DEN-3を検出
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン・サンタフェ州における渡航関連の輸入デング熱症例であり、国内伝播は確認されていない。季節性のルーチンサーベイランス報告であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念や社会的関心の高まりは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Pandemic reopening reshaped pediatric respiratory pathogen positivity by
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, China, two hospitals analyzed 230,333 patient-period records representing 197,630 children tested from January 2018 through December 2023. After strict COVID-19 controls, influenza A positivity fell to 5.0% (Pandemic-I) from 19.2% pre-pandemic; influenza B to 0.5% from 6.5%; RSV to 12.3% from 21.8%; adenovirus to 1.1% from 18.4%; and Mycoplasma pneumoniae to 2.2% from 12.4%. Rhinovirus, CMV and bocavirus largely escaped suppression. When controls relaxed, influenza A rose to 25.0% (Pandemic-II) and 29.7% after reopening; M. pneumoniae rose to 7.4% (Pandemic-II) and 24.1% post-pandemic. RSV post-pandemic adjusted OR 1.31, highest increases in younger children (29 days–23 months OR 1.50; 2–4 years OR 1.86). Influenza B increased mainly among older children (5–9 years OR 1.21; 10–17 years OR 2.88). Mycoplasma pneumoniae post-pandemic surges strongest in 5–9 years (OR 3.32) and 2–4 years (OR 1.74). Inpatients showed different patterns than outpatients; results reflect test positivity, not community incidence, and are shaped by testing changes.

triage.headline_ja: パンデミック後の再開が小児呼吸器病原体陽性率の年齢分布を変化させた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は広州の2病院における2018-2023年の検査陽性率に関する学術的・回顧的分析であり、新規の異常なアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究報告であり、季節性呼吸器感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、マイコプラズマ等）のパンデミック前後の検査陽性率変化を後方視的に分析したもの。新規の感染症イベントやアウトブレイクの速報ではないため、シグナルとしては見送り。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: saiba identificar os sintomas e como proteger as aves da contaminação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle Disease: Learn to Identify the Symptoms and How to Protect Birds from Infection
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, a highly contagious avian viral infection affecting respiratory, nervous, and digestive systems, was genetically detected in a Santa Catarina, Brazil property during an active inspection, even though the birds showed no symptoms. Laboratory confirmation is required for diagnosis. Reported signs to watch include difficult breathing (panting, coughing, sneezing), neurological symptoms (difficulty walking, loss of balance, torticollis), reduced productivity, and mortality in severe cases. The virus spreads via direct contact and through contaminated water, feed, equipment, and surfaces, and can be shed in respiratory secretions and feces, enabling transmission from asymptomatic birds. Prevention relies on a rigorous biosafety program and vaccination guided by veterinarians, including restricted access, sterilization of equipment and clothing, protection of water and feed, and avoiding contact with wild birds. Suspected cases must be reported to the Official Veterinary Service; movements of birds and materials should be halted until investigation and confirmation. Notifiable disease in Brazil. Keywords: outbreak, surveillance, vaccination, biosafety.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：症状の見分け方と鶏の感染防止策について
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州の農場で無症状の鶏からニューカッスル病が遺伝子検出されたが、確定診断待ちで実際の発生規模や人への影響は不明。家禽の伝染性は高く監視継続が必要だが、現時点で社会的関心や深刻な影響を示す情報は不足している。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物衛生（家禽）に関する記事であり、人への健康影響は記載なし。ブラジルでは届出義務のある疾病であり、無症状鶏からの遺伝子検出段階で、臨床的確定・感染拡大の有無は不明。家禽貿易への影響も現時点では言及されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Brazilië beperkt uitbraak van de ziekte van Newcastle met gerichte exportbeperkingen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil limits outbreak of Newcastle disease with targeted export restrictions.
article.articleSummary: Brazil, the world’s largest poultry exporter, restricted exports after Newcastle disease was confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Santa Catarina. Authorities initially halted shipments to China, then narrowed measures to Santa Catarina-origin consignments. Saudi Arabia, South Korea, and the United Kingdom imposed stricter geographic restrictions; Malaysia and Mexico fully suspended Brazilian poultry. Kazakhstan and Chile followed Santa Catarina rules; Argentina and South Africa limited nearby-processing shipments. Analysts say the impact is manageable amid strong demand; ABPA president Ricardo Santin expects exports to grow, noting Santa Catarina accounts for about 23% of Brazilian chicken exports through September. Newcastle disease damages birds’ respiratory, nervous, and digestive systems; the virus was found in an asymptomatic turkey, leading to 6,000 birds culled. No evidence of foodborne transmission to humans. A 2024 outbreak spurred broader China/EU stops; this time a bilateral accord allows embargoes on China, with potential easing.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、ニューカッスル病の発生を受け対象を絞った輸出制限を実施
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、記事内でもヒトへの食品媒介感染の証拠はないと明記されている。影響は主に貿易・経済面であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 動物衛生（家禽）に関する事案であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の懸念は記事内で明確に否定されている（No evidence of foodborne transmission to humans）。影響は貿易制限の範囲にとどまり、アナリストも影響は管理可能と評価している。

article.articleHeadline: Novo foco de doença de Newcastle ameaça avicultura do Brasil; ouça o comentário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Newcastle disease outbreak threatens Brazil's poultry industry; listen to the commentary.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease has been confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, according to the Ministry of Agriculture. As of 2026-10-20, Cassiano Ribeiro notes that the confirmation of a Newcastle disease focus in this turkey farm triggers heightened alerts across Brazil's poultry sector. Newcastle disease is highly contagious and can cause severe economic losses in poultry operations. In line with international protocols, Brazil is suspending exports to partner countries pending containment. The finding underscores ongoing risks to Brazil's poultry industry and the importance of enhanced surveillance and biosecurity measures across farms. This has potential implications for shipments and market access.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで新たなニューカッスル病発生、同国の養鶏産業に脅威（解説を聞く）
triage.triage_reason: 七面鳥農場でのニューカッスル病（家禽疾患）の発生であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されず、主に貿易・産業への影響にとどまる。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類に特異的な疾患であり、ヒトへの感染は稀かつ軽症（結膜炎程度）。本記事は農業・貿易への影響が主題であり、公衆衛生危機管理としての優先度は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil declara emergencia zoosanitaria por brote de mal avícola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil declares a zoosanitary emergency due to an outbreak of avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil triggers a 60-day zoosanitary emergency across four municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. A commercial turkey facility in Nova Itaberaba, housing about 6,000 birds, was confirmed infected after an epidemiological investigation by the Official Veterinary Service of Santa Catarina. The facility has been closed, and poultry movements halted. Authorities plan control, containment, and eradication under Brazil's national contingency plan for avian diseases. The government notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and trade partners in line with international transparency commitments. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection of birds, capable of causing substantial poultry-production losses. Origin of the infection is undetermined; ongoing epidemiological investigations and surveillance of neighboring establishments are in progress. Consumption of inspected poultry products remains safe for the public.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、鳥インフルエンザ様疾病の発生により動物衛生緊急事態を宣言
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病発生であり動物衛生上の懸念はあるが、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクは報告されておらず、IHR基準・社会的関心も限定的。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 本疾患はニューカッスル病（家禽の高病原性ウイルス感染症）であり、見出し翻訳の『鳥インフルエンザ』は誤訳。ヒト感染事例の報告なし。家禽産業への経済的影響とOIE通報が中心の動物衛生イベント。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا ترصد الإصابة التاسعة بإيبولا وتتابع 134 مخالطاً من أصل 135 | سبق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya detects the ninth Ebola case and monitors 134 of 135 contacts | Sabq
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ministry of Health has confirmed a ninth Ebola infection, with all nine cases linked to a single transmission chain and no evidence of spread beyond that cluster. The newest case is a family member of the initial patient and was isolated prior to confirmation. Health teams have traced 134 of 135 contacts and placed them under quarantine as part of containment measures. The first case, reported earlier in October, was an imported infection from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and authorities say surveillance and monitoring continue as Ebola activity persists in the region.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ9例目を確認、135人中134人の接触者を追跡中

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma noveno caso de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms ninth Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its ninth Ebola case in Nairobi as of Oct 20, 2026, with 135 contacts identified and 134 in quarantine. The first case was announced on Oct 6; a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda to Nairobi arrived Oct 3, tested positive Oct 5, and died the same day. Since then, four relatives and four health workers have tested positive, bringing the total to nine linked infections. Authorities report no evidence of transmission beyond known contacts. The 135 identified contacts include 134 in quarantine, with the list expected to grow as more people exposed to any of the nine patients are identified. The initial group’s 21-day quarantine is due to end on Oct 25; asymptomatic individuals may return home. Congo’s outbreak has caused about 4,000 deaths since May, underscoring Ebola’s high contagion via bodily fluids and contaminated materials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の9人目の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCの既存エボラ流行から越境してケニアに到達し、二次感染（医療従事者・家族）が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が高く、フルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии подтвердили первый случай заражения Эболой в стране
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms first case of Ebola infection in the country.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first case of Ebola virus disease, with 44 close contacts identified. The patient, a woman who arrived in Nigeria by airplane from Uganda, is receiving care at a private clinic in Abuja. Authorities have urged healthcare facilities nationwide to heighten surveillance. The Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May 2026 and has become the largest on record, with more than 9,400 confirmed cases and over 4,500 deaths across eight provinces. Kenya reports nine Ebola cases. The Nigerian case represents an imported infection; authorities are tracing contacts and reinforcing infection prevention as part of ongoing containment amid the regional outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで国内初のエボラ出血熱感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模のエボラ流行が続く中、ナイジェリア（ウガンダからの輸入症例）やケニアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja as woman who arrived from Uganda tests positive
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case in Abuja after a woman arriving from Uganda tests positive. The patient developed symptoms on Oct. 7, was admitted Oct. 11 to a private hospital, and was diagnosed with Ebola. Health Minister Muhammad Pate said 44 contacts are being traced to contain the case. Uganda had previous cases but was later declared free; Kenya has reported Ebola cases recently (now 9 total). Nigeria's CDC says it is strengthening surveillance and preparedness, focusing on early detection, isolation and referral, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protection of health care workers. Bundibugyo virus has spread beyond Congo, with more than 9,000 infections and over 4,300 deaths, underscoring cross-border risks.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ症例を確認 ― ウガンダから入国した女性が陽性
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染がウガンダ由来でナイジェリアに越境し、既に複数国（ケニア、コンゴ由来株）で拡大しているとされ、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）でのエボラ確認症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。記事中でBundibugyoウイルスがコンゴ（DRC）由来で越境拡大しており9000人以上感染・4300人以上死亡と言及されているため、DRCのみ対象国として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking: Nigeria records first Ebola case of Africa's latest outbreak
article.articleSummary: Nigeria records its first Ebola case in Africa's latest outbreak, in a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja. The patient was admitted to a private hospital and, after several days, the diagnosis was confirmed. She is in isolation and receiving care. Contact tracing has begun, with 44 close contacts identified to date, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travel contacts. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May, and has spread to several countries, including Uganda and Kenya, which on Tuesday reported its ninth Ebola case. The DRC epidemic has become the deadliest in its history, with 4,381 deaths out of more than 9,000 confirmed cases. Nigeria’s case represents imported exposure; authorities are monitoring and tracing potential exposures to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 速報：ナイジェリアでアフリカ最新のエボラ流行による初の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点とする大規模エボラ流行（4,381人死亡、9,000人超感染）がウガンダ・ケニアに続きナイジェリアへも越境拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリアでの輸入症例を報じているが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の起点かつ最大の被害国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nigeria confirme un premier cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms a first case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria reports its first Ebola virus disease case, in Abuja. The patient, a woman who recently arrived in Nigeria on an international flight from Uganda, was admitted to a private hospital where her diagnosis was confirmed. The Nigerian Health Minister said 44 close contacts have been identified and that public and private health facilities have been urged to maintain maximum alert, with teams tracing and monitoring exposed individuals, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers encountered during the journey. Separately, the Democratic Republic of the Congo is in the midst of its 17th Ebola outbreak since May, now the deadliest in the country’s history, with more than 9,000 cases and about 4,381 deaths reported by health authorities. In Kenya, nine Ebola cases have been recorded since early October, including one death; a Kenyan who lived in the DRC is believed to have infected eight others.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ輸入症例が確認されたほか、DRCでは史上最悪規模（9000例超、死者4381人）の流行が継続中であり、ケニアにも感染拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し国際的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの初症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事中で大規模流行として実質的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: U.S. Embassy in Kenya raises travel advisory level, cites Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, the U.S. Embassy in Kenya raised its Travel Advisory to Level 3 due to increased Ebola risk tied to the Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in Central and East Africa. The advisory, from Level 2, cautions travelers to reconsider Kenya visits because of health risks, crime, kidnapping, terrorism, unrest, and traffic safety. CDC-listed notices point to BVD-affected areas; Kenyan MOH confirmed an imported BVD case in Nairobi and other linked cases, with nine Ebola cases in one cluster (eight improving, one death). WHO previously declared the Uganda–DRC BVD outbreak a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. In the DRC, over 9,000 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,602 deaths as of Oct 18; Uganda reported 20 cases and 2 deaths with no active cases. France had one recovered case; no US cases were reported, and the overall risk to travelers remains low.

triage.headline_ja: 米国大使館、ケニアの渡航勧告レベルを引き上げ、エボラ懸念を理由に挙げる
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダで大規模なエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）流行がWHOによりPHEIC宣言されており、ケニアへの輸入例やフランスでの症例も発生するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限（米大使館の勧告引き上げ）が現実に起きているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダで発生中のブンディブギョウイルス病（BVD/エボラ）流行とそれに伴うケニアへの渡航勧告引き上げ。ケニア・ウガンダ・米国・フランスは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみが対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nigéria: Úrady zaznamenali prvú nakazenú ebolou v krajine - Svet SME
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: Authorities recorded the first Ebola-infected person in the country - Svet SME
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria has recorded its first Ebola case: a woman who recently flew from Uganda to Abuja and is now in isolation as authorities initiate contact tracing. The patient was admitted to a private hospital and diagnosed after several days of treatment, with laboratory confirmation. Kenya reported its ninth Ebola case: a 40-year-old Kenyan who travelled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda and died in Nairobi after arriving on 6 October; eight additional Kenyan cases were relatives of the index patient or healthcare workers who treated him, with no evidence of transmission beyond this group. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreaks exceed 9,000 cases with about 4,381 deaths. Ebola spreads through direct contact with bodily fluids of an infected person or contaminated objects.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：同国初のエボラ感染者を当局が確認 - Svet SME
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC発生源からウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニアでの輸入症例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは発生源として明記されているため含める。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola au Nigeria: Jean Kaseya appelle à une mobilisation urgente de la communauté internationale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Nigeria: Jean Kaseya calls for urgent mobilization by the international community.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya urged immediate international mobilization to contain Ebola Bundibugyo in Nigeria, following confirmation of a case and a briefing with Nigeria's Health and Welfare Minister Muhammad Ali Pate. Early notification is praised as saving lives, and Africa CDC had warned of regional spread when the outbreak was declared on 15 May 2026. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is now the most geographically widespread in Africa, crossing three regions and affecting several countries, with Democratic Republic of the Congo reporting a case fatality around 50%. Africa CDC has begun supporting Nigeria, intensified its response in the DRC and Kenya, and kept heightened vigilance in Uganda. The call emphasizes immediate, flexible funding, medical supplies, diagnostics, trained responders, and strengthened community surveillance to prevent further spread or prolonged transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでのエボラ出血熱：ジャン・カセヤ氏が国際社会に緊急動員を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo型エボラがナイジェリアで確認され、DRC・ケニア・ウガンダなど複数国に拡大。致死率約50%で国際的拡大リスクが高く、Africa CDCが緊急国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ確認だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは致死率約50%と明記されており対象国リストに含まれるため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Exclusive - Kanwar Dhillon down with stomach infection, advised to take proper care in the Mumbai heat
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Indian television actor Kanwar Dhillon, best known for Udne Ki Aasha, is down with a stomach infection. He attributes the illness to the Mumbai heat and back-to-back outdoor shoots, saying dehydration can worsen stomach issues. He is taking medication and plans to rest and stay hydrated during an off day. He also stresses the importance of diet in hot weather. Dhillon leads the show with a demanding bank of episodes, and his comments reflect the strain of outdoor filming in October heat. There is no laboratory-confirmed detail or disclosed infection source in the report, and there is no mention of imported or exported cases. Recovery time is linked to rest, hydration, and dietary management.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: FG identifies 44 contacts, seeks passengers' cooperation
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Nigeria: 44 contacts identified after laboratory confirmation of a case in Abuja on Oct 20, 2026. The patient, who arrived from Uganda, developed symptoms on Oct 7 and sought care Oct 11; she is now isolated and receiving treatment. Contact tracing covers healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travel companions; authorities urge all contacts to provide information and follow guidance. In light of Kenya’s imported Ebola case linked to a DRC outbreak, Nigeria’s NCDC has intensified surveillance, laboratory testing, isolation, referral systems, infection prevention and control, and coordination with state and international authorities. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids of a symptomatic person or contaminated materials; typical symptoms include fever, severe headache, weakness, muscle pain, vomiting and diarrhoea, with 2–21 days from exposure to onset. Public urged calm, hand hygiene, avoid contact with body fluids, and to call 6232 for information.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリア連邦政府、44人の接触者を特定し乗客の協力を要請
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダから到着した渡航者がナイジェリアでエボラ陽性と確認され、ケニアでも輸入例が報告されるなど複数国への拡大兆候がありIHR基準を複数満たすため、フルリスク評価に進むべき事案と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（ウガンダからの輸入症例）での確認例であり、対象国リストに含まれるDRCはケニアの輸入例の背景（感染源）として言及されているのみで、記事の主題として発生国と確認できないため除外した。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in Nigeria: one lab-confirmed case in Abuja, a female with travel history to Uganda; she is isolated and receiving care, with 44 contacts identified and under tracing. In Kenya, total Ebola infections rise to nine, all within a single cluster; the latest case is a close family member of the first patient and is quarantined. As of Tuesday, 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and placed in quarantine. Kenya's first case emerged earlier this month in a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) to Nairobi and died on October 5. The outbreak is centered in the DRC and has spread across borders, with authorities intensifying surveillance, laboratory confirmation, and contact tracing to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱の感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点としたエボラ出血熱がケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当、社会的関心の高さからフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはNairobi、Abuja、Uganda等が含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの起点であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。ケニア・ナイジェリアでの越境感染事例は注視すべきだが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Retrospective Pará cohort links tuberculosis death to age, HIV and mixed
article.articleSummary: In Pará, Brazilian Amazon, a population-based retrospective cohort of 52,066 notified TB cases (2012–2022) identified 1,032 TB-attributed deaths. Using cause-specific Cox proportional hazards and Fine-Gray competing-risk models, older age markedly increased mortality: each additional decade raised the hazard by 50% (adjusted HR 1.50; 95% CI 1.45–1.55; p<0.001), with a similar Fine-Gray estimate (HR 1.49; 95% CI 1.44–1.54). Male sex also associated with higher mortality (HR 1.16; 95% CI 1.01–1.32; p=0.035). TB-HIV/AIDS coinfection increased hazard by 64% (HR 1.64; 95% CI 1.32–2.03; p<0.001), and unknown/unrecorded TB-HIV status was linked to higher mortality (HR 1.38; 95% CI 1.20–1.58). Alcohol use (HR 1.53) and smoking (HR 1.30) elevated risk; pulmonary plus extrapulmonary TB had HR 3.00 (95% CI 2.29–3.92). Incarceration showed an inverse association (HR 0.42; 95% CI 0.27–0.65). Authors caution causal interpretation; results describe associations within the 52,066 retained Pará cases.

triage.headline_ja: パラ州のレトロスペクティブコホート研究：結核死亡と年齢、HIV、混合感染の関連
triage.triage_reason: 過去10年間（2012-2022年）の結核死亡リスク要因を分析した学術的レトロスペクティブ研究であり、新規アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジル・パラ州における2012-2022年の結核症例を対象とした統計的コホート研究であり、リスク因子（年齢、HIV共感染、飲酒、喫煙等）と死亡率の関連を分析した学術論文。急性のアウトブレイクやサーベイランス上のシグナルには該当しない。対象国リストにBrazilは含まれるが、研究の性質上シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола добралась до Нигерии: заболевшую госпитализировали в Абудже
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has reached Nigeria: the patient who fell ill was hospitalized in Abuja
article.articleSummary: Ebola has reached Nigeria, with the first confirmed case detected in Abuja. A woman who arrived by air from Uganda is the patient, currently under observation at a private clinic in Abuja. Health authorities have traced 44 contacts and urged healthcare facilities to heighten vigilance and monitor for symptoms. The Ebola outbreak began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with more than 9,400 reported cases and over 4,500 deaths across eight provinces. Kenya had previously reported nine cases. This Nigerian case represents an imported infection linked to travel from Uganda; authorities are conducting contact tracing and surveillance to prevent local transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがナイジェリアに到達：発症者はアブジャに入院
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（9,400例超、4,500人超死亡）がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアへの輸入症例として拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（Abuja）への輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の発生源であるDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。国際的な感染拡大（ケニア、ナイジェリアへの越境）が確認されており、渡航制限の実施有無については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Aus Uganda eingereist: Erster Ebola-Fall in Nigeria nachgewiesen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Arrived from Uganda: First Ebola case in Nigeria confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Datelined Lagos, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, traced to a traveler from Uganda. On October 20, 2026, Health Minister Muhammad Pate announced that an Ebola virus infection was detected in a person who arrived from Uganda and was initially brought for treatment to a private hospital in Abuja with illness symptoms before the diagnosis was confirmed. This marks Nigeria's first documented Ebola case after outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Uganda, and Kenya. Officials have identified 44 contacts to monitor and contain potential transmission. Uganda had declared itself Ebola-free by late August following several Congo-imported cases. The confirmation underscores the need for prompt laboratory confirmation, isolation, and contact tracing to prevent cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダから入国した者からナイジェリア初のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダからナイジェリアへ越境伝播した初症例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアにおけるウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例であり、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）には該当しない。DRCは過去の流行経緯として言及されているのみで、本記事の発生地域としては主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Bleeding eye virus found in new country as outbreak behind 4,600 deaths spreads
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo's fast-moving Ebola outbreak has spawned confirmed cases in a fifth country, Nigeria, where a case in Abuja was confirmed today after a patient arriving from Uganda tested positive. The patient was admitted to a private hospital in Abuja; authorities began tracing 44 contacts. In the DRC, authorities report 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. Kenya has 9 cases; Uganda 20; a single case has been identified in France, though Uganda was later declared free of the virus. Ebola symptoms include bleeding from ears, eyes, nose or mouth. The update reflects cross-border spread from the DRC outbreak and ongoing international monitoring as cases are imported or exported between nations.

triage.headline_ja: 出血性目の病気ウイルスが新たな国で確認、4,600人の死者を出した流行が拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）発のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが9,552症例・4,602死亡に達し、ナイジェリア・ケニア・フランスへの国際的な越境拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC発のエボラアウトブレイクであり、他国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、フランス）は輸入症例の発生地として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria bekræfter sit første tilfælde af ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms its first case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in several years. A woman in Abuja, who had travelled from Uganda, was admitted to a private hospital after arrival, treated for several days, and laboratory-confirmed with Ebola. She has been isolated and is receiving care. Authorities have identified 44 close contacts and are monitoring exposed individuals, including healthcare workers, patients, and relatives, as part of ongoing contact tracing. The incident follows a large Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo that has spread across borders, with the outbreak affecting Nord-Ubangi province near the Central African Republic; Kenya has nine cases this week, and Uganda was previously declared Ebola-free by the WHO in August. The DR Congo outbreak has caused over 4,000 deaths as of early October.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の初症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでのエボラ初症例確認に加え、DRCでの大規模流行（死者4,000人超）が複数国へ越境拡大しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されているDRCの大規模流行（4,000人超死亡、周辺国への越境拡大）は対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nigeria enregistre son premier cas d'infection au virus Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria records its first case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first imported Ebola virus disease case from Uganda; a woman traveling to Abuja, diagnosed and isolated after admission to a private hospital. Contact tracing has identified 44 close contacts for monitoring, including health workers and caregivers involved during travel and care. The Nigerian health ministry confirmed the laboratory-confirmed Ebola case and ongoing medical management. This follows the ongoing large Ebola outbreak that began in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 9,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, spreading to several countries, notably Uganda. Kenya also reported a ninth Ebola case on Tuesday as the outbreak continues. This event marks Nigeria’s first Ebola case since the outbreak began in Africa, highlighting cross-border transmission risk and the need for surveillance and infection control.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラウイルス感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの輸入例としてナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、44人の接触者が追跡されている。コンゴ民主共和国で続く大規模流行（9,000例超、死者4,381人）が複数国に越境拡大している点で、IHR基準・WPRO基準の多くに該当する。
triage.notes: 主要な新規事象はナイジェリア（対象国外）での輸入症例だが、記事の主題にはコンゴ民主共和国での大規模流行の詳細な統計（症例数・死者数）が含まれるため、DRCを検証済み発生地域として計上。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии выявили первый случай заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Ebola infection detected in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case: a woman who arrived by air from Uganda is being treated in a private clinic in Abuja. Health authorities have traced 44 contacts and urged heightened vigilance across the national health system, with monitoring of those contacts under way. The Nigerian health ministry provided the information to The Cable, with TASS cited. The case is imported from Uganda. In the wider region, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 8,500 cases and 4,500 deaths, while Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month. Authorities continue to monitor and follow up on contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの輸入例としてナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、44名の接触者追跡が行われている。地域的にDRCで8,500例超の大規模流行が継続中であり、国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初輸入症例（ウガンダ由来）だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは現在進行中の大規模流行（8,500例超、4,500人超死亡）が具体的数値とともに言及されており、地域リスクの一部として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importação de aves do Brasil após foco da doença de Newcastle em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Suspends Poultry Imports from Brazil After Newcastle Disease Outbreak in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of poultry products from Brazil after confirmation of Newcastle disease in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The measure by the Secretariat of Agriculture and Senasica aims to protect Mexico’s avian industries, as the country is disease-free. The ban covers meat and viscera, live birds (chickens, turkeys, ducks, geese), ornamental birds, and avian genetic material including fertile eggs and day-old chicks up to three days old, affecting both commercial imports and travelers’ luggage. Brazil’s MAPA confirmed the outbreak on Oct 18, 2026, at a commercial farm raising turkeys and broilers in Nova Itaberaba. Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service interdicted the property, restricted animal movements, and suspended regional poultry transport under a containment plan. Newcastle disease is a viral, acute, highly contagious infection of domestic and wild birds; symptoms include respiratory problems, nervous signs, and reduced egg production; mortality can reach 100% in unvaccinated flocks. In humans, conjunctivitis may occur.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後、ブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽における既知の風土病であり、人への健康影響は軽微（結膜炎程度）。貿易制限は発生しているが、公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクや国際的なヒト感染拡大の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: 本イベントは主に家禽産業・貿易に関する問題であり、ヒトの感染症リスクは低い。ブラジル国内の家禽産業当局が既に封じ込め対応を実施中。メキシコは輸入停止措置を取った側であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigéria confirma seu primeiro caso de ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms its first case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a woman who flew from Uganda to Abuja and was hospitalized in a private facility, with 44 close contacts identified and monitoring under way. Health authorities said the diagnosis was confirmed after several days of treatment. Nigeria has ordered all health centers to stay on high alert. Since May, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has faced its 17th Ebola outbreak, now the deadliest in the country’s history, with over 9,000 cases and more than 4,381 deaths. As of 20 Oct 2026, Kenya has recorded nine Ebola cases, including one death, linked to a Kenyan citizen who resided in DR Congo and allegedly transmitted the virus to eight others. Nigerian officials are tracing the 44 contacts, including health workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers exposed during the Abuja patient’s journey.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが初のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（史上最悪、9000例超・4381人死亡）を背景に、ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的な感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はDRC（史上最悪の第17次アウトブレイク）であり、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCでの継続的流行が国際拡散の起点となっている点は重要。

article.articleHeadline: From Nursing to Entrepreneurship: A US-based Ghanaian's journey through caregiving, salon business and COVID-19
article.articleSummary: Nana Akua, a Ghanaian nurse and entrepreneur in Atlanta, recounts balancing a full-time nursing career with running a hair salon while caring for an ailing mother. The COVID-19 pandemic hit hardest, forcing a three- to four-week shutdown that cost her some clients. An aunt manages the salon in her absence, highlighting reliance on family support. Staffing has been a major hurdle: several braiders were dismissed for allegedly siphoning clients or contacting them with competing home-based services, while some workers showed loyalty by directing tips to the salon. Akua emphasizes discipline, a strong customer base, and careful recruitment as keys to success in the United States. She also urges Ghanaians with vocational skills intending to start businesses in America to prioritise time management and punctuality, noting Americans’ strict regard for schedules. Interview on GhanaWeb TV’s Diaspora Connect.

triage.headline_ja: 看護から起業家へ:米国在住ガーナ人女性の介護・美容サロン経営・COVID-19を通じた歩み
triage.triage_reason: 個人の人生・起業に関する人間的関心記事であり、公衆衛生上の感染症イベントとしての情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: COVID-19は過去の一時的な事業への影響として言及されているのみで、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。米国アトランタの個人ビジネス記事であり、対象国(ガーナ含む)での感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Rotary Club of Accra-Airport launches "Arise for Polio 2026'
article.articleSummary: Polio eradication gains momentum as the Rotary Club of Accra-Airport launches ARISE FOR POLIO 2026 in Ghana, aiming to ensure no child suffers polio again. Polio can cause permanent paralysis and death but is preventable by vaccination. Global progress shows wild poliovirus endemic only in Afghanistan and Pakistan, with eradication progress at 99.9%. The campaign stresses multi-sector partnership: Ghana Health Service (GHS/EPI), WHO, UNICEF, Gates Foundation, Gavi, US-CDC, the Pediatric Society of Ghana, civil society, polio survivors and the media, to raise awareness and mobilize support. Rotarians frame “Together, We Finish the Fight” and call on governments, businesses and individuals to donate to the PolioPlus Fund and strengthen collaborations. The effort underscores that polio anywhere threatens children everywhere, reinforcing the 2026 theme: One day. One focus: ending Polio for good.

triage.headline_ja: アクラ空港ロータリークラブが「2026年ポリオ撲滅運動（アライズ・フォー・ポリオ）」を開始
triage.triage_reason: ガーナにおける実際の症例発生ではなく、ロータリークラブによる啓発・資金調達キャンペーンの告知記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナでの野生型ポリオウイルス症例発生を報じるものではなく、ロータリークラブによる啓発・募金活動の開始を伝える内容。野生株流行国はアフガニスタン・パキスタンのみと明記されており、ガーナは対象国リストに含まれるが本件は実際の発生事例ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 'As pessoas não precisam ter medo', diz ABPA sobre caso de doença de Newcastle no Brasil; ouça o comentário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'People don't need to be afraid,' says ABPA about a case of Newcastle disease in Brazil; listen to the commentary.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease case in Brazil is cited in the article's title, with ABPA urging calm. The body, however, centers on Brazil’s agribusiness logistics revolution driven by electric vertical takeoff and landing (eVTOL) cargo aircraft for distributing agrochemicals and fertilizers. The focal point is the Center-West region, where Skyros—an oversized aerial platform—was introduced by Urandir Fernandes de Oliveira at the 86th Expogrande Expo in April 2026. The piece notes ongoing shifts in how inputs are applied and the potential speed gains enabled by eVTOL technology. It also mentions that the organization has highlighted negotiations with importer countries to reduce the impacts of trade restrictions. No epidemiological data, case counts, or clinical details are provided in the body beyond the referenced disease in the title.

triage.headline_ja: 「人々は恐れる必要はない」―ブラジルでのニューカッスル病症例についてABPAがコメント
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでニューカッスル病（家禽の疾病）の症例が言及されているが、記事本文は農業物流（eVTOL）の話題が中心で、疫学データや症例数、臨床情報が全く提供されていないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルの農業団体ABPAが輸入国との貿易制限緩和交渉に言及しているが、ニューカッスル病自体の症例数・発生地域・発生時期などの詳細情報は記事本文に含まれていない。米国フロリダ州はBluedotが誤って付与した発生地域と判断し除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak of Newcastle disease confirmed in South Brazil
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil. The federal government declared a 60-day state of animal health emergency for Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim after detection at a Nova Itaberaba turkey slaughterhouse. The outbreak was confirmed on Oct 19 by the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock; the facility was shut down and poultry transport suspended. Control, containment, and eradication measures will follow the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease. WOAH and Brazil’s trading partners have been notified in line with international health transparency commitments. Newcastle disease, affecting domestic and wild birds, is caused by virulent avian paramyxovirus serotype 1 (APMV-1). Diagnosis was established by epidemiological investigation and confirmed at a federal lab in São Paulo. No case/death counts are provided in the report.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南部でニューカッスル病の発生が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 家きんにおけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの感染症例は報告されていないが、貿易規制（家きん輸送停止、WOAH通知）が発生しているため動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事象は家きん（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病（APMV-1）の発生であり、ヒト感染症例の報告はない。ブラジル連邦政府は60日間の動物衛生非常事態を宣言し、施設閉鎖・家きん輸送停止等の措置を実施。WOAHおよび貿易相手国への通知済み。人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの直接的リスクは低いが、農業・貿易への影響があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: sintomas, contágio e medidas de prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: symptoms, transmission, and prevention measures.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease is a viral infection affecting poultry in Brazil. Veterinarian Marcos Rezente explains that symptoms include respiratory distress (coughing, sneezing), nasal discharge (rare), nervous signs (torticollis, disorientation), and progressive production losses with mortality in advanced cases. Transmission occurs mainly via respiratory droplets and secretions, including direct bird-to-bird contact, contaminated surfaces, and fecal shedding. Biosafety measures to prevent spread include regular vaccination, constant health monitoring, maintaining clean and disinfected environments, and isolating sick birds. Despite Newcastle cases, Brazilian poultry meat is considered safe, with all animals inspected before slaughter to ensure product quality. The expert stresses strict biosafety adherence and ongoing monitoring as essential for rapid disease control. As of 20 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：症状、感染経路、予防対策
triage.triage_reason: 動物（家禽）の疾患に関する一般的な教育・予防啓発記事であり、具体的な発生事例や異常な流行の報告がないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は獣医師によるニューカッスル病の一般的な解説であり、ブラジルでの具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではない。人への感染リスクも言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии подтвержден первый случай заражения вирусом лихорадки Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Ebola virus infection confirmed in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: First case of Ebola virus disease (EVD) confirmed in Nigeria. A female patient, who traveled by air from Uganda, has been diagnosed and isolated in a private medical facility in Abuja; 44 contacts have been identified. Nigerian authorities are urging maximum epidemiological readiness across the health system. The development follows a May 2026 Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, described as the largest in its history, with over 9,400 confirmed infections and more than 4,500 deaths reported to date. Earlier reports noted Kenya’s first Ebola death. Emphasis remains on surveillance for imported cases and rapid containment to prevent further spread. As of 2026-10-20, focus centers on contact tracing, isolation, and cross-border vigilance to mitigate international transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラウイルス感染症の初症例が確認

article.articleHeadline: Brasil enfrenta desafios nas exportações de carne devido a vírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil faces challenges in meat exports due to a virus.
article.articleSummary: Brazil faces export hurdles after the detection of a virus in its poultry, prompting suspensions of boneless chicken breast shipments to Mexico and China. Mexico’s National Customs Agency data show Brazil’s boneless chicken breast exports to Mexico rising from 90,000 tonnes in 2022 to an estimated 196,000 tonnes in 2025, but import suspensions threaten profitability for producers who expanded capacity to meet growing demand. The virus detection has not established a disease in the country, yet it requires adherence to international market rules, including temporary export suspensions until control is achieved. Experts stress the need for greater sanitary investments to maintain Brazil’s position as a major protein exporter. Commentator Miguel Daúde warns that government funding is currently lacking, and private efforts must be complemented by public support to sustain the sector.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、ウイルスの影響で食肉輸出に課題に直面

triage.notes: 記事は家禽に検出されたウイルスによる貿易上の影響（メキシコ・中国向け輸出停止）を主題とした経済・貿易記事であり、ヒトへの感染や発症については言及がない。ウイルスの種類（例：鳥インフルエンザ等）が特定されておらず、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは不明。メキシコ・中国は輸入停止国であり、発生地域はブラジルのみと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria meldet Ebola-Fall: 44 Kontaktpersonen identifiziert
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports an Ebola case: 44 contacts identified.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, a confirmed Ebola case is reported in Abuja, Nigeria, with the patient having traveled to Uganda. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate stated the patient is in isolation and receiving medical care, and contact tracing is underway, with 44 contacts identified to date. The report situates the event within a broader pattern of Ebola spreading from the Democratic Republic of Congo to neighboring countries, underscoring cross-border transmission risk. Authorities are monitoring exposure in both Nigeria and Uganda as investigations continue. The case represents an imported infection linked to the DRC region, highlighting the ongoing need for rapid isolation, tracing, and coordination among affected countries to prevent further spread.

Nigeria is the latest to report an Ebola case after Kenya confirmed its first case earlier this month; Kenya now has nine cases. article.articleHeadline: Confirman foco de enfermedad de Newcastle en el sur de Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in southern Brazil.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Government of Brazil declared a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in the municipalities of Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas and Nova Erechim after detecting an outbreak in a commercial turkey processing facility in Nova Itaberaba. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock confirmed the outbreak on Monday, Oct 19, with poultry movements suspended and the facility closed. Control, containment and eradication measures will be implemented according to the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease. The government notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and Brazil’s trading partners in line with international transparency commitments. Newcastle disease affects domestic and wild birds and is caused by the virulent avian paramyxovirus serotype 1 (APMV-1), per OIE criteria. The outbreak was detected during an epidemiological investigation by the state’s Official Veterinary Service and confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル南部でニューカッスル病の発生が確認される

article.articleHeadline: Eerste ebolabesmetting vastgesteld in Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola infection confirmed in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease has been confirmed in a woman in Abuja, Nigeria—the first confirmed West Africa case in the current outbreak, which has so far heavily affected the Democratic Republic of Congo. The patient, who recently arrived in Nigeria on a flight from Uganda, is hospitalized in a private clinic, isolated, and undergoing contact tracing. Uganda has reported several infections linked to the outbreak; in the DRC thousands have died from the Bundibugyo variant, for which no approved treatment exists. Since the start of October 2026, nine additional infections have been reported in Kenya. The Nigerian case marks the outbreak's first introduction into West Africa, underscoring ongoing international spread via travel and the need for vigilant surveillance, isolation, and rapid public health response.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms ninth Ebola case amid concerns about regional spread - British Caribbean News
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a ninth Ebola case in a single cluster linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak. A 24-year-old man, already in quarantine, tested positive and was isolated at the first signs of illness; he is a close family member of Kenya's first Ebola patient, who traveled from the DRC via Uganda and died at a Nairobi hospital on October 5. Eight patients are stable and responding to treatment; 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined, with most remaining well during the 21-day monitoring and potentially returning home from October 25. No transmission outside the cluster; no infections in quarantine facilities. Kenya has kept borders open with travel, trade, and public gatherings continuing. In the DRC, more than 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths since May; Bundibugyo strain lacks a licensed vaccine or specific treatment, making containment challenging, per ECDC.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Agriculture declares a zoosanitary emergency in four municipalities in Santa Catarina after an outbreak of Newcastle disease -- District Politics is now PDNews, news about Politics and Health of the Federal District.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil triggers a 60-day zoosanitary emergency across Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The emergency follows confirmation of a Newcastle disease focus at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba. Diagnostic confirmation occurred Oct 18 and was publicly announced Oct 19, with immediate control measures including quarantine of the affected property and a complete suspension of movement of live birds and related inputs. Actions follow the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease to contain, eradicate, and prevent spread. The disease is a severe infectious illness of production birds and wild birds, caused by virulent strains of avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1), per OIE. Validation was by LFDA-SP, and Brazil notified the OIE and partner countries as required.

The developments highlight cross-border transmission risks from the DRC outbreak, ongoing investigations, and regional surveillance.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola chega à Nigéria: autoridades identificam 44 contatos de paciente infectada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola reaches Nigeria: authorities identify 44 contacts of an infected female patient.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirmed its first imported case of Ebola linked to the ongoing Africa-wide outbreak, in a female patient who arrived in Abuja on an international flight from Uganda and was diagnosed after care at a private hospital. Health authorities isolated the patient and launched contact tracing, identifying 44 close contacts, including health workers, patients, caregivers, and travel-related contacts. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has spread to other countries, with DRC reporting over 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths, and Kenya reporting its ninth case. Nigeria's case heightens concerns about international spread; measures include rigorous contact tracing, patient isolation, and monitoring exposed individuals to limit transmission.

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: restrição de embargo chinês a SC reduz impacto no setor avícola, diz governo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: Chinese embargo restriction on SC reduces impact on the poultry sector, government says.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, involving 6,526 birds with 26 cases and no deaths since onset on 21 September 2026; outbreak confirmed 18 October 2026. Active surveillance samples from asymptomatic birds were positive in screening on 14 October, with confirmatory testing by LFDA-SP on 18 October and a virulent virus sequence identified (112-RRQKR-116 in F2, F at position 117 in F1). Brazil’s National Plan is guiding control measures, including culling at the farm and disinfection; ongoing epidemiological investigation and restricted measures until no new foci appear. China suspended poultry product imports only from Santa Catarina (14 approved units affected, 61 total exporters), reducing anticipated economic impact versus a full-country ban. Mexico suspended Brazilian poultry imports; bilateral protocol may trigger broader negotiations to ease restrictions. Certification references the 21 September surveillance date, potentially affecting shipments produced after that date. A 90-day timeline may enable Brazil to request WOAH/OIE recognition as disease-free if no new foci emerge.

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma su primer caso de ébola y activa vigilancia sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms its first case of Ebola and activates health surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak, begun May in the Democratic Republic of Congo, has led to thousands of infections and deaths; isolated cases have appeared in Uganda, Senegal, and Kenya. Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, the fifth country to report a case, after a woman from Uganda tested positive in Abuja following arrival on an international flight and several days of care at a private hospital before confirmation. Nigeria has identified 44 close contacts, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers who interacted with her during the trip. Authorities urge hospitals nationwide to stay vigilant, promptly report suspected cases, and reinforce prevention measures. Kenya reports nine cases, including one death, highlighting cross-border risk amid international travel. Ebola transmits via direct contact with blood and body fluids or contaminated materials; early symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pain and malaise; diagnosis requires medical assessment and lab testing.

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma primer caso de ébola mientras Kenia los eleva a nueve
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms first case of Ebola as Kenya raises the number to nine
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case: a woman who arrived in Abuja by international flight from Uganda; 44 close contacts identified; health authorities urge heightened surveillance across public and private facilities. Kenya raises nine Ebola cases, all within a single cluster with no evidence of community transmission; the latest patient is a 24-year-old male, a known contact of the initial case, isolated and treated after testing positive; the case was imported from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). Since May, the DRC is contending its 17th Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with over 9,000 cases and about 4,381 deaths reported; no specific treatment exists yet, though two vaccines in human trials have shown safety. France and the Netherlands each report one imported case connected to the outbreak in the DRC. All cases described are linked to or imported from the DRC outbreak.
