triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中（2026年5月以降、第17次流行、バンディブギョ株）のエボラ流行が輸入症例としてウガンダ経由ナイジェリア、DRCから直接ケニア、さらにフランス・オランダへ拡大していることを報告。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが発生国に該当（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、フランス、オランダは対象国リスト外のため除外）。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria bevestigt eerste ebolageval gekoppeld aan uitbraak in Centraal-Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case linked to outbreak in Central Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) case confirmed in Nigeria linked to the Central Africa outbreak. A Nigerian woman who recently returned from Uganda developed symptoms after arriving home and tested positive; she was isolated following symptom onset on October 7, 2026. Initial treatment occurred in a private clinic, but her condition worsened and laboratory tests confirmed Ebola infection. Health teams have identified 44 close contacts and are actively monitoring their movements, focusing on healthcare workers, patients, caregivers and travelers. This marks Nigeria’s first Ebola infection tied to the ongoing regional outbreak that began about five months ago, which has infected more than 8,000 people and caused at least 4,000 deaths, mainly in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Uganda has reported cases, with travel-related infections in Kenya and France. Nigeria’s last Ebola case was in Lagos in 2014. Officials stress rapid detection and isolation to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、中央アフリカの流行に関連した初のエボラ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカ（主にDRC）で8000人以上感染・4000人以上死亡という大規模流行があり、ウガンダ、ケニア、フランスに続きナイジェリアでも輸入例が確認されたことから、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高く、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事本文中でナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、フランスへの感染拡大が言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCが流行の主要発生地であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă sanitară - Ebola ajunge în Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public Health Alert - Ebola Arrives in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a woman who recently arrived from Uganda on an international flight was admitted in a private Abuja hospital, with diagnosis confirmed after several days. Nigerian authorities, on Oct 20, 2026, urge all public and private health facilities to maintain maximum alert. The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its 17th Ebola outbreak since May, now the deadliest in Central Africa, with about 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths reported by Congolese authorities. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said 44 direct contacts have been identified and public-health teams are tracing and monitoring exposed individuals, especially health workers, patients, caregivers, and travel-associated contacts. Since early October, Kenya has recorded nine Ebola cases and one death, involving a Kenyan resident in DRC who infected eight others.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生警報 - エボラ、ナイジェリアに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当する可能性が高く、DRCでは9,000例・4,381人死亡という過去最悪規模のエボラ流行が継続中で、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニアでの輸入症例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の震源地であるDRC（対象国リスト該当）のみをverified_locationsに記載。DRCは2026年5月以降17回目のアウトブレイクで中央アフリカ史上最悪規模とされ、国際的な波及（ナイジェリア、ケニアへの輸出例）が確認されている点が特に重大。

article.articleHeadline: Ministério da Saúde investiga morte de criança de 8 anos com suspeita de meningite na Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health investigates the death of an 8-year-old child with suspected meningitis in Bahia.
article.articleSummary: An 8-year-old girl in Luís Eduardo Magalhães, western Bahia, died with suspected meningitis after headaches and abdominal pain on Oct 15, followed by disorientation and seizures on Oct 16; death confirmed later. Samples were collected for laboratory analysis; results have not been disclosed. The Ministry of Health and Bahia State Health Secretariat (Sesab) say no confirmed diagnosis yet and an epidemiological investigation is underway to confirm or rule out meningitis. The death record cites meningoencephalitis as the cause; the Instituto Médico Legal collected brain, heart, spleen, liver and lung samples to identify the infectious agent. The ministry reports no officially registered meningitis cases in the municipality per CIEVS, though the case prompted preventive care for contacts, including a 1-year-3-month-old sister who was briefly hospitalized with flu-like symptoms and later released. Published 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、バイーア州で髄膜炎疑いの8歳児の死亡を調査
triage.triage_reason: 単一の疑い症例で確定診断前の段階であり、病原体や感染拡大の有無が不明なため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 死亡例が1件報告されているが、確定診断（髄膜炎・髄膜脳炎の病原体）は未判明で検査結果待ちの段階。接触者（妹）はインフルエンザ様症状で入院後に退院しており、関連性は不明。地域の疫学調査結果の続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: México suspendió las importaciones avícolas de Brasil por un brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspended poultry imports from Brazil due to a Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of poultry products from Brazil after a Newcastle disease outbreak was confirmed at a farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The ban covers meat and offal from poultry, fertilized eggs, chicks up to three days old, and live birds, including ornamental and predatory species, with restrictions applying to both commercial shipments and tourist entries. Authorities say the measure aims to preserve Mexico’s status as Newcastle-free, and reopening will depend on Brazil’s health information regarding outbreak control. Newcastle disease affects the respiratory, nervous, and digestive systems in birds. Brazil accounts for about 30% of Mexico’s poultry meat imports, a share tied to external purchases rather than total domestic consumption. The decision highlights bilateral trade risk and ongoing vigilance over avian diseases affecting the Mexican market as of 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの家禽輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）でヒトへの直接影響はないが、貿易制限が発生しており経過観察が必要。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は不明。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類の疾病であり、ヒトへの感染症リスクは極めて低い。本件は家禽貿易・農業経済への影響が主であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての優先度は低いが、IHR基準の貿易制限・国際的拡大に該当するため動物衛生分野でのモニタリング対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in Abuja, begins tracing 44 contacts
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirms an imported Ebola case in Abuja from a traveler who recently arrived from Uganda. The woman developed symptoms on 7 October, was admitted to a private Abuja hospital on 11 October, and tested positive for Ebola. Health authorities identified 44 possible contacts and have begun tracing to prevent further transmission. The case emerges amid a regional Bundibugyo virus outbreak; Kenya reports nine confirmed cases, and the World Health Organization notes the virus has spread beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo with neighboring countries affected. Nigeria’s Centre for Disease Control has intensified surveillance and preparedness, including early detection, isolation and referral of suspected cases, laboratory testing, infection prevention and control, and protection of healthcare workers. Uganda had prior Ebola activity but was declared free; no deaths or additional Nigerian cases are reported in the article.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ出血熱の症例を確認、44名の接触者追跡を開始
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）の国境を越えた拡大が確認され、ナイジェリアへの輸入症例発生を含む地域的アウトブレイクであり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国外）での輸入症例だが、背景となるブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ関連）のアウトブレイクはDRCで発生し近隣国（ウガンダ・ケニア）に拡大しているため、DRCのみを対象国として記載。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil detecta la enfermedad de Newcastle en aves de granja comercial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil detects Newcastle disease in commercial poultry.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Brazil detected a Newcastle disease focus at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The facility, housing about 6,000 birds, was closed and immobilized, with containment and eradication measures and animal movement suspended. Authorities notified the World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) and trading partners. Brazil’s Agriculture Ministry said consumption of inspected poultry remains safe. The Brazilian Association of Animal Protein (ABPA) said clinical signs were observed, with no confirmed disease in confined birds. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious viral infection in birds, causing respiratory, nervous, and digestive symptoms with high mortality; transmission occurs via contact with infected animals, contaminated water, feed, vehicles, or clothing. In 2024, China halted imports from Rio Grande do Sul; Mexico suspended Brazilian poultry imports after Nova Itaberaba outbreak. Minister André de Paula stated that products under sanitary inspection pose no human health risk. No date for import resumption.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、商業養鶏場でニューカッスル病を検出
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のみに影響するニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染・公衆衛生への直接的影響はほとんどなく、既に封じ込め措置が取られているためフルRRAの必要性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類に高致死性だが人への感染リスクは極めて低い（まれに軽度の結膜炎程度）。中国・メキシコへの言及は過去の貿易停止措置に関するもので、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 中國豬價崩盤 養豬場出現大量倒閉潮 | 中國豬價暴跌 | 養豬場倒閉潮 | 非洲豬瘟
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China's pig prices crash; a wave of pig-farm closures | China's pig prices plummet | wave of pig-farm closures | African swine fever
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are driving a severe downturn in China’s pig sector, with Henan province hardest hit. In October 2026, national live pig prices fell below 5 yuan per jin, after earlier dips to about 4 yuan in March–April. The crisis is linked to ASF spread, leading to cash-flow problems, unpaid wages, and weakened biosecurity that trigger widespread culling and a second wave of farm closures in October. Large-group farms have halted operations, selling off thousands of pigs; slaughterhouses report heavy throughput as producers exit. In Henan, a local farmer notes that the number of pig-raising households has dropped from about 100 last year to roughly 2 in some areas. Credit constraints for feed and inputs aggravate the crisis, delaying any rebound until ASF is reduced and production shrinks.

triage.headline_ja: 中国の豚肉価格が暴落、養豚場の倒産ラッシュが発生 | 中国豚肉価格急落 | 養豚場倒産ラッシュ | アフリカ豚熱
triage.triage_reason: 中国で継続しているアフリカ豚熱(ASF)による経済的影響（豚肉価格暴落・養豚場倒産）を報じる内容で、人の健康被害の報告はなく、新規性・異常性も乏しいため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物衛生・経済影響（豚肉価格・養豚業の倒産）に関するものであり、人の感染症事例の報告はない。ASF自体は中国で既に数年前から流行している既知の状況であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: Eerste ebolabesmetting in Nigeria sinds nieuwe uitbraak in Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola infection in Nigeria since a new outbreak in Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria reports the first Ebola infection in Abuja since Africa-wide outbreaks began. The patient is a woman who had traveled to Uganda, where authorities declared Ebola-free in late July after 20 cases, largely involving people from the Democratic Republic of Congo seeking help there. The Nigerian health minister said she is in isolation and receiving good care, and a contact-tracing operation has identified 44 contacts so far. The Nigerian case follows a major outbreak primarily in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with about 9,500 cases and more than 4,600 deaths since mid-May, the deadliest in the country’s history. Ebola has also been detected in nine people in Kenya. Symptoms include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; case fatality exceeds 50%. The Nigerian case is imported, linked to exposure in Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでの新たなエボラ流行以来、ナイジェリアで初の感染例
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪のエボラ流行（約9,500症例、4,600人超の死亡）がナイジェリア・ケニアへ拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべて及びWPRO基準全てに該当するため。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCでの大規模流行が本記事の主題であり、対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن تسجيل أول حالة إصابة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announces first case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria’s Health Ministry confirms the first Ebola virus infection in Abuja, linked to a woman who arrived from Uganda. Symptoms began on 7 October; she was hospitalized in Abuja on 11 October and diagnosed with Ebola. Health Minister Mohammed Pate said 44 contacts have been identified for monitoring. Uganda had previously reported Ebola cases but later declared a clearance. Nigeria now follows Kenya in reporting Ebola cases earlier this month; Kenya has nine cases to date. Nigeria’s Centre for Disease Control had intensified surveillance after Ebola’s appearance in Kenya, prioritizing early detection, isolation, referral, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk reporting, and health‑care worker protection. The report also notes global concern over transmission of the rare Bundibugyo virus outside Congo, which has infected over 9,000 and killed more than 4,300.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラウイルス感染の初症例を発表
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、ウガンダ・ケニアでの発生と関連した国際的な感染拡大の懸念があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域にDRCが含まれるが、記事ではBundibugyoウイルスが『コンゴ以外で』感染拡大している旨が記述されており、DRC国内での発生を示すものではないため除外した。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Πρώτο περιστατικό Έμπολα εμφανίστηκε στη Νιγηρία
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The first Ebola case appeared in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria in Abuja, a female patient who recently traveled by international flight from Uganda and was treated in a private clinic; diagnosis confirmed after several days. Nigeria's government ordered heightened alert across all public and private health facilities, with 44 close contacts already identified. Meanwhile, the Democratic Republic of Congo is dealing with its 17th Ebola outbreak since May, the deadliest in its history, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths. Kenya reported its ninth confirmed Ebola case; the first case was announced on October 6 in Nairobi after a businessman who had lived in Congo died there, with most new cases linked to close contact with the first patient. The United States issued a travel advisory urging U.S. citizens to avoid travel to Kenya and to reconsider plans to visit eastern Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際的エボラ拡大事例であり、ナイジェリア・ケニアでの新規症例、DRCでの大規模進行中アウトブレイク、米国の渡航勧告発令など複数の深刻な指標が揃っている。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアとケニアでのエボラ症例だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは記事内で進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（9,000例超、4,381人死亡）として具体的数値とともに言及されており、対象国リストに該当するためverified_locationsに含めた。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Breaking news- FG confirms ebola case in FCT
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola virus disease confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (FCT). A female patient who traveled from Uganda developed symptoms on October 7 after returning by international flight and was laboratory-confirmed; she is isolated in a private hospital. Forty-four contacts are identified and being traced, with surveillance at entry points strengthened. The case follows Ebola activity in the Democratic Republic of Congo and cases in Kenya; the Nigeria CDC had reported no confirmed cases as of October 6, 2026, a status now updated. Delays in diagnosis were noted, prompting calls for heightened alert among public and private facilities. Authorities, including the Ministry of Health, FCT Health Secretariat, Africa CDC, and partners, are coordinating to contain spread, emphasizing hygiene and monitoring for fever, weakness, headache, and diarrhoea to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 速報:ナイジェリア連邦政府、FCT(連邦首都地区)でエボラ出血熱の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリアで確認され、濃厚接触者44名の追跡が行われているなど、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が高くIHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（ウガンダからの輸入症例）であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCでのエボラ活動は背景情報として言及されているのみで記事の主題ではないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola: Nigeria registra su primer caso y Kenia el noveno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Nigeria reports its first case and Kenya the ninth case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in Abuja after a patient arriving from Uganda tested positive; the case was hospitalized and 44 contacts are being traced. Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases; 135 contacts have been identified, with 134 in quarantine. The first Kenyan case was registered October 6—a man who traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo via Uganda to Nairobi—and he tested positive on October 5 and died the same day. Since then, four relatives and four health workers have also tested positive. No evidence of transmission beyond known contacts. A 21-day quarantine is underway for contacts, with the first group expected to complete by October 25. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is experiencing its deadliest outbreak, with at least 4,000 deaths since May.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：ナイジェリアで初の症例、ケニアで9例目を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で続く大規模エボラ流行（5月以降4,000人超死亡）がウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準複数該当・社会的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の中心はDRCで続く大規模流行（4,000人超死亡）であり、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際伝播が報告されているが、これら3か国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外した。DRCのみ対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن رصد أول إصابة بفيروس إيبولا في العاصمة أبوجا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announces the first Ebola virus case detected in the capital, Abuja.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease confirmed in Nigeria's capital Abuja—the first case detected in the city. The patient is a woman who recently arrived from Uganda; she began symptoms on 7 October and was admitted to a private hospital on 11 October, with laboratory tests confirming infection. Health authorities led by Minister Mohammed Ali Pate began rapid contact tracing, identifying 44 contacts to date, including healthcare workers, patients, escorts, and travel-related contacts; investigations continue to identify additional exposures. The government has urged hospitals to boost preparedness, accelerate detection and isolation, enforce infection prevention measures, and report suspected cases immediately. The case occurs amid regional activity linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, associated with Democratic Republic of Congo outbreaks and reported in nearby countries, including Kenya. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated surfaces/tools; early detection and containment are critical. No further confirmed cases have been announced yet.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、首都アブジャで初のエボラウイルス感染例を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの新規都市（アブジャ）での初症例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと接触者追跡の進行中である点から、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）での初エボラ症例。DRCやウガンダ・ケニアは感染経路や地域的背景として言及されているのみで、記事の主題国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。ナイジェリア自体は対象国リストに含まれていないため、該当国なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria reportó el primer caso de ébola en Abuja tras la llegada de una mujer desde Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reported the first Ebola case in Abuja following the arrival of a woman from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case was confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria—the first in the capital—after a woman arrived from Uganda tested positive. She developed symptoms on October 7 and was hospitalized October 11 before diagnosis. Health Minister Muhammad Pate said 44 contacts are being traced to contain the virus. Nigeria is sharpening surveillance and response, focusing on early detection, isolation, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protection of health workers. Uganda had previously reported Ebola but was declared free; Nigeria becomes the latest country to report an Ebola case after Kenya, which confirmed its first cases earlier this month and now has nine. The case highlights ongoing concerns about Ebola transmission beyond Congo.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから到着した女性の症例によりアブジャで初のエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダから入国した女性を介してナイジェリア首都アブジャに拡大し、ケニアに次ぐ複数国への国際的拡大を示す重大事例であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）、ウガンダ、ケニアでのエボラ発生であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRC（コンゴ）は背景的言及（'beyond Congo'）に過ぎず、実際の発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC seeks urgent global support after Nigeria confirms first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola Bundibugyo case in Abuja, a woman who recently travelled from Uganda. Symptoms began Oct 7; she sought treatment Oct 11 and laboratory confirmation followed on Oct 20. Nigeria has identified 44 contacts and initiated tracing; the patient is in isolation. Africa CDC says the outbreak is the most geographically widespread Ebola event in history, with cross-border spread across three African regions. The Democratic Republic of Congo continues to face severe transmission, with mortality near 50%. Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases and one death as of Oct 20, linked to the initial Kenyan traveler from the DRC who died Oct 5; the latest case was quarantined before testing; no evidence of wider transmission yet. Declared a cross-border emergency on May 15, 2026, has prompted calls for solidarity: funding, supplies, diagnostics, trained responders, strengthened community surveillance; coordinated action among WHO, World Bank, Gavi, UNICEF, and partners.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例確認後、緊急の国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当し、複数国（DRC・ナイジェリア・ケニア）にまたがる越境エボラ流行で死亡率も高く、国際支援要請が出ているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダにも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCは継続的な重篤な感染拡大の中心地として記載されており対象国に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : un premier cas au Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: First Case in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria since 2014: a woman recently arrived in Abuja from Uganda, admitted to a private hospital where diagnosis was confirmed; 44 close contacts identified as public-health teams trace exposed healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers. Nigeria's Health Minister urged heightened alert across all health facilities. The Democratic Republic of Congo is experiencing its 17th Ebola outbreak, now the deadliest in its history, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths. Kenya reports its ninth Ebola case linked to exposure from the Congo outbreak; the United States warns citizens to reconsider travel to Kenya. Uganda had previously declared the outbreak eradicated by late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. There is currently no vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo virus driving the present outbreak, with laboratory-confirmed high case-fatality in DRC. Africa CDC calls for immediate, flexible funding, diagnostics, trained responders, and strengthened community surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアで初の症例
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで2014年以来初のエボラ症例が確認され、濃厚接触者44人を追跡中。同時にDRCでは過去最悪規模（9000例超、死亡4381人）の流行が継続し、ケニア・ウガンダにも波及、米国が渡航警告を発出するなど国際的拡大とIHR複数基準に該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・DRC・ケニア・ウガンダにまたがる多国間エボラ流行だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、米国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行は過去最悪規模であり、継続的な監視と国際支援の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Doença do frango: ES fica fora de embargos após caso de Newcastle, diz associação - Folha Vitória
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chicken disease: Espírito Santo remains free of embargoes after Newcastle disease case, says association - Folha Vitória.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, is not directly impacting Espírito Santo (ES) poultry exports. The Espírito Santo association Aves states ES does not export chicken meat to Mexico, China, or Chile, which announced restrictions on Brazilian poultry after the Santa Catarina case. Mexico suspended Brazilian poultry imports; China and Chile restricted products from Santa Catarina, with China negotiating to confine the embargo to that state to avoid broader disruption. Despite no direct trade impact, Aves urges ES producers to reinforce biosafety, including restricted farm access, cleaning and disinfection of facilities, equipment and vehicles, strict sanitary protocol compliance, and prevention of contact between production and wild birds. The association underscores collaboration between producers and health authorities to protect ES poultry health and industry sustainability.

triage.headline_ja: 鶏肉病:アゾレス空港協会によると、サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生後もエスピリトサント州は禁輸措置の対象外
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病（鳥の疾病）が発生し、メキシコ・中国・チリが輸入制限を実施。家きん疾患であり人への直接的健康影響は確認されていないが、国際貿易への影響と今後の拡大動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、人獣共通感染症としてのヒトへの健康影響は記事内で言及されていない。主な懸念は国際貿易（輸出禁輸）への影響であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、家畜衛生当局間の対応状況や感染拡大の有無について継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms Ebola Case
article.articleSummary: Laboratory-confirmed Bundibugyo Ebola case in Nigeria: a woman diagnosed in Abuja after developing symptoms on October 7 and admitted to hospital on October 11. Authorities have traced 44 contacts as the Health Ministry coordinates containment. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya appealed for urgent international support, calling the outbreak the most geographically widespread Ebola crisis in history, spanning three African regions. Mortality is approaching 50% in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where the outbreak began in eastern DRC in May; Africa CDC is mobilising support for Nigeria while expanding response in DRC and Kenya and maintaining vigilance in Uganda. The patient’s East Africa travel history underscores regional surveillance and exposure investigations, though it cannot confirm where infection occurred. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments; containment relies on isolation, contact tracing, infection prevention, and early supportive care. Early reporting saves lives.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 複数のIHR基準（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、WHO/Africa CDCが国際支援を要請する歴史上最も地理的に広がったエボラ危機とされているため、フルRRAへの移行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの新規確定例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは発生源かつ継続対応中の国として含めた。ケニア・ウガンダ・モザンビークも言及されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: O que é a doença de Newcastle, infecção identificada em perus em Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What is Newcastle disease, an infection identified in turkeys in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease, caused by virulent avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1), was confirmed this week in a commercial turkey operation in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, per MAP. The outbreak prompted suspension of poultry export shipments to China, Chile, and Mexico and the establishment was interdicted. Newcastle affects domestic and wild birds, causing respiratory signs (sneezing, wheeze), nervous and digestive symptoms (wing droop, twisted neck, depression, inappetence, greenish diarrhea) with potentially up to 100% mortality depending on virulence (Embrapa). Human infections are possible but typically mild conjunctivitis after close contact with infected birds’ secretions, not via food. Prevention emphasizes keeping birds isolated from other species, restricting visitor access—especially from areas with sanitary problems—vaccinating according to MAP guidance, and thorough disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病とは何か、サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥で確認された感染症
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの商業用七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病（APMV-1）が確認され、中国・チリ・メキシコへの家禽輸出が停止されるなど貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（異常性・国際的懸念・貿易制限）に該当するため。
triage.notes: ヒトへの感染は家禽との密接な接触後の軽度結膜炎に限られ、食品を介した感染はないとされる。主たる影響は家禽産業および貿易制限であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in patient who arrived from Uganda
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria reports a laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Abuja in a female patient who arrived from Uganda. The patient is in isolation at a private hospital and has received several days of care; 44 contacts have been identified and are under investigation through ongoing contact tracing. The Ugandan government says there is no Ebola in Uganda. Nigeria notes that Ebola was previously contained in 2014. The current Bundibugyo strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared mid-May, has become the world's second-largest, prompting Kenya to report nine cases this month linked to a Congo traveler who died in Nairobi on 5 October. Africa’s top public health agency has begun mobilising support for Nigeria; head Jean Kaseya notes the Bundibugyo outbreak is the most geographically extensive in history.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから到着した患者のエボラ出血熱感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で拡大中のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がナイジェリアやケニアへ越境伝播しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の中心はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの越境感染事例だが、これら3か国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクが対象国リストに該当するため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case: Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms one Ebola case in Abuja after laboratory confirmation; the female patient travelled from Uganda and is in isolation with quality medical care, while contact tracing is under way with 44 contacts identified. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, North Ubangi becomes the eighth Ebola-affected province; the National Institute for Biomedical Research confirms two cases, including one death, in North Ubangi, a border area with the Central African Republic. The outbreak is the worst in Congo's history and has crossed borders, with cases reported in Uganda and seven infections in Kenya this month. Provinces currently affected include North Kivu, Ituri, Haut-Uele, Tshopo, Sud-Kivu, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. Ongoing surveillance and response work continues across the region.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ症例を確認:保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ史上最悪のエボラ流行が国境を越えてナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアに拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの症例報告があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。コンゴ民主共和国は複数州（北ウバンギ含め8州）に拡大しており、史上最悪規模の流行と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Paraná tem risco de prejuízo bilionário após doença avícola ser encontrada em Santa Catarina - Ric.com.br
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Paraná faces the risk of multi-billion-dollar losses after an avian disease is detected in Santa Catarina
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was detected at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, risking multi-billion-dollar losses for Paraná, the country’s leading poultry producer/exporter. Case confirmation followed an Oct 18, 2026 MAPA disclosure, with epidemiological work by Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service and LFDA-SP confirmation; the farm was interdicted. The sector has already faced penalties as importers react. Mexico, the eighth-largest Brazilian chicken buyer, suspended all imports, reporting 153,957 tonnes imported Jan–Aug 2026 worth US$338.2 million. Chile and China also suspended Santa Catarina poultry purchases. Paraná exported 1,604,954 tonnes Jan–Aug 2026, valued at US$3.017 billion, up 20.4% in volume and 23.5% in revenue. Newcastle disease is a viral avian paramyxovirus type 1 infection; humans may experience mild conjunctivitis with close contact. It poses no foodborne transmission; poultry mortality can reach 100% in confinement; no animal treatment.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州で家禽疾病発見後、パラナ州が数十億ドル規模の損失リスクに直面
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病の検出により複数国（メキシコ、チリ、中国）が輸入停止措置を取るなど貿易制限が発生し、社会的・経済的関心が高いため。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病によるもので、人への健康影響は軽度の結膜炎程度にとどまる。主な懸念は貿易制限・経済損失であり、公衆衛生上の重大性は低いが、農業・貿易政策面での関心が高いためPICKUPと判定。メキシコ・チリ・中国は輸入停止措置を取った国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Health minister Ali Pate confirms new Ebola case in Nigeria, traces 44 contacts
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case for 2026. A female patient who recently arrived from Uganda was admitted to Nizamiye Hospital in Life Camp, FCT, where the diagnosis was confirmed at a private facility. Forty-four contacts have been traced to the carrier. The health ministry will liaise with the Nigerian Centre for Disease Control to manage the situation, with resources being distributed to track and trace the virus to prevent its spread across Africa’s most populous country. The infection involves the Bundibugyo strain, for which no known cure exists. The patient’s health status (critical or mild) was not disclosed. Health authorities note that Ebola outbreaks have affected the Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya and other African nations in recent months. Nigerians are advised to call NCDC toll-free line 6232 to report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: 保健相アリ・ペイト氏、ナイジェリアで新たなエボラ症例を確認、濃厚接触者44人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダから入国した患者がナイジェリアでエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）陽性と確認され、44人の接触者が追跡されている。人口大国での輸入症例かつ治療法のない株であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（ウガンダからの輸入症例）であり、対象国リストにナイジェリア・ウガンダは含まれない。DRCやケニアは背景情報として言及されているのみで、本イベントの発生地ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Još jedna zemlja prijavila slučaj ebole: Potvrđeni brojni kontakti za zaraženom
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another country reported a case of Ebola: Numerous confirmed contacts of the infected.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in Abuja, from a woman who traveled from Uganda. Health authorities identified 44 contacts for surveillance as the patient remains in isolation and receives care. Symptoms began on October 7, and she was admitted to a private Abuja hospital on October 11, where Ebola was laboratory-confirmed. Nigeria’s case follows Kenya reporting nine cases this month, with Ebola spreading beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo. Authorities are actively monitoring contacts to curb transmission amid concerns about the rapid spread of Bundibugyo ebolavirus, which has infected more than 9,000 people and caused more than 4,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: 別の国でもエボラ感染例を報告：感染者の多数の接触者を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を起源とするエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ・エボラウイルス）の大規模流行が、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアへと国際的に拡大しており、致死率の高さと感染拡大のリスクからIHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア初のエボラ症例とケニアでの9例報告だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれない。ただし、これらの症例の起源であるDRCでの大規模流行（9,000人以上感染、4,300人以上死亡）が明示的に言及されており、これを発生地域として扱う。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ебола се шири ван Конга, први случај у Нигерији, индентификована 44 контакта
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads beyond Congo, first case in Nigeria, 44 contacts identified.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has reached Nigeria, with the first case confirmed in Abuja in a woman who arrived from Uganda. Nigerian Health Minister Mohammed Ali Pate said the patient is in isolation receiving appropriate care, and that contact tracing has identified 44 contacts to prevent further spread. The illness began with her first symptoms on October 7 and she was admitted to a private Abuja hospital on October 11, where Ebola was subsequently laboratory confirmed. This marks another country in the region reporting a case after neighboring Kenya earlier this month, which has recorded nine infections. The outbreak context centers on the broader spread of Ebola beyond the Democratic Republic of Congo, linked to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; global totals cited as over 9,000 cases and more than 4,300 deaths. The Nigerian authorities are monitoring contacts to curb secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴを越えて拡大、ナイジェリアで初の症例確認、接触者44人を特定
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC発の大規模流行の文脈で複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、出血熱の起源・主流行地はDRCであり、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie - Erster Ebola-Fall in Nigeria nachgewiesen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic - First Ebola Case in Nigeria Confirmed.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive and is isolated in a clinic in Abuja, according to Health Minister Pate. The current outbreak began in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has since recorded more than 9,000 infections and at least 4,500 deaths. Africa CDC calls it the fastest-growing Ebola epidemic in history. Separately, Kenya has reported nine cases as the outbreak spreads, while Uganda had declared itself Ebola-free in August. This update was reported on 20 October 2026 by Deutschlandfunk.

triage.headline_ja: エピデミック - ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点とするエボラ流行が9,000人以上の感染・4,500人以上の死亡を記録し、ナイジェリア・ケニアへ国際的に拡大している。IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高いためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、流行の主体は5月からDRCで継続中のエボラ流行（9,000例超、4,500人超死亡、史上最速拡大とAfrica CDCが指摘）。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外し、対象国であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Πρώτο κρούσμα Έμπολα στη χώρα - 9 κρούσματα στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: First Ebola case in the country - 9 cases in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a woman in Abuja who recently arrived on an international flight from Uganda, diagnosed after several days in a private clinic. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said the government placed public and private health facilities on maximum alert, with 44 close contacts identified. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak in its history continues since May, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths reported by Congo health authorities. Kenya also reported its ninth Ebola case as of 20 October 2026; the first case was documented on 6 October after the Nairobi death of a businessman who had lived in the DRC, with eight additional cases confirmed, most among close contacts of the initial case. The United States has issued a travel advisory urging citizens to reconsider travel to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：国内初のエボラ症例確認 - ケニアでは9例に
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（9000例超・4381人死亡）が継続し、ナイジェリアへの初流入、ケニアでの二次感染拡大、米国の渡航勧告発出まで至っており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生事案。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・DRCにまたがるエボラ流行を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア（初症例、ウガンダ渡航歴）とケニア（9例目、DRC渡航歴関連）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCの流行は2026年5月から継続中で、これが地域全体の感染源となっている点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός στη Νιγηρία: Καταγράφηκε το πρώτο κρούσμα Έμπολα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarm in Nigeria: the first Ebola case has been recorded.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria (Abuja) in a woman who recently arrived on a flight from Uganda; treated in a private clinic for several days before the diagnosis. Health authorities, led by Minister Mohammed Ali Pate, ordered maximum alert across public and private facilities and have identified 44 close contacts. The Democratic Republic of Congo is facing its 17th Ebola outbreak, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths reported to date. In Kenya, the ninth Ebola case was announced, following the first case on Oct 6 after a Nairobi businessman who had lived in the DRC died; eight additional cases have been confirmed, most among contacts of the initial patient (~40 years old). The United States issued a travel advisory urging Americans to avoid or reconsider travel to Kenya. Published 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: 警報:ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例が記録される
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア初のエボラ症例に加え、DRCでは大規模な継続的流行、ケニアでも複数症例が確認されており、米国が渡航勧告を発出するなど国際的拡大と渡航制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・DRCの3か国のエボラ状況を扱っているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア（初症例）とケニア（進行中の流行、米国渡航勧告対象）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。DRCは17次流行として継続中で9,000例超・4,381人死亡と深刻な影響が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolavirus verspreidt zich steeds verder: eerste geval in Nigeria, al negen besmettingen in Kenia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebolavirus is spreading further: first case in Nigeria, already nine infections in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) is now reported in Nigeria, the first case outside Central and East Africa, with the patient arriving on an international flight from Uganda and treated for several days in a private clinic in Abuja after a confirmed diagnosis. In Kenya, a ninth Ebola infection has been confirmed; eight other cases are linked to a Congo-origin man who died in Kenya two weeks earlier, all within his entourage and with no evidence of spread beyond that group. The most recent case is a family member of the index patient. As of October 20, 2026, the outbreak had been confined to Congo and Uganda previously, with Congo reporting about 4,381 deaths and more than 8,000 infections, and Uganda around two dozen infections and two deaths. The Congo–Uganda outbreak is the deadliest on record, though new Congo cases have been declining.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスがさらに拡大：ナイジェリアで初の症例、ケニアでは感染者が9人に
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ・ウガンダ発のエボラ出血熱がケニア（9例）とナイジェリア（中央・東アフリカ以外で初）に国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はコンゴ（起源）、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアだが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria records first Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first known Ebola case in the current outbreak, linked to a Bundibugyo Ebolavirus infection imported from Uganda. A woman who recently flew to Abuja began symptoms on October 7 and was admitted October 11; laboratory confirmation followed as authorities began tracing 44 contacts. The outbreak originated in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo near the Ugandan border; Uganda has reported infections, and Kenya has nine known cases in a cluster, while most cases and deaths remain in DRC. The current outbreak has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,300 deaths, a fatality rate near 50%. Uganda had 20 cases and two deaths this year and was declared Ebola-free in August by WHO after 42 days without a confirmed case; Nigeria’s case could challenge that status. Context notes the 2014-16 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC発の大規模アウトブレイク（9000例超、致死率約50%）がウガンダ・ケニアに続きナイジェリアにも輸入例として拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニア、アンゴラも含まれるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。アウトブレイクの起源かつ最多症例・死亡数を抱えるDRCのみを対象国として計上。ウガンダの『エボラ終息宣言』撤回の可能性にも留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia suma nueve casos de ébola tras confirmación de nuevo contagio; Nigeria anuncia el primero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya adds nine Ebola cases after confirmation of a new infection; Nigeria announces the first case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports nine Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases after confirming a new infection, bringing the national total to nine. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), the INSP reports 97 new cases and 41 deaths in the past 24 hours, raising totals to 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths, with 20 recoveries since the outbreak began. On 17 May, the WHO designated the DRC-Uganda Ebola outbreak as a public health emergency of international concern. Kenya says all nine cases originate from a single transmission cluster; the latest case is a close relative of the first patient and has been quarantined. The first Kenyan case, identified earlier this month, involved a man who traveled from the DRC to Nairobi and died on 5 October. Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, in Abuja, a woman who arrived on an international flight from Uganda; she is in isolation as containment measures are activated.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで新たな感染確認によりエボラ感染者が9人に増加、ナイジェリアも初の感染例を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ出血熱がケニア（9例）、ナイジェリア（初例）へ国際的に拡大しており、WHOはDRC-ウガンダ流行を国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）に指定済み。IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行とその国際的拡大（ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ）。ケニア・ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case, traces 44 contacts in Abuja
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja with 44 contacts identified for tracing as of 2026-10-20; the public, especially airline passengers who may have shared a flight with the patient, is urged to provide information and follow health guidance. The case comes amid cross-border concerns after Kenya reported an imported Ebola case linked to a Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak, with Bundibugyo virus identified in Kenya. Nigeria’s NCDC is strengthening surveillance, laboratory testing, isolation, referral services, and infection prevention, coordinating with state and international partners. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or other body fluids of symptomatic individuals or contaminated materials; incubation is 2–21 days; symptoms include fever, severe headache, weakness, muscle pain, vomiting and diarrhoea. Authorities urge calm, handwashing, avoidance of body fluids, and not sharing unverified information. Public can call the NCDC toll-free 6232 (24/7) for information or to report suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ症例を確認、接触者44人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準における重大な公衆衛生上の影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスクを満たし、WPRO基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・国際支援の必要性が高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国外）での症例確認だが、感染源となったDRCの進行中アウトブレイクが明記されているため、DRCのみ対象国として記載。ケニアは輸入症例の確認国だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue persists, doctors caution against infections as monsoon sets in
article.articleSummary: Chennai faces ongoing dengue prevalence with co-circulating influenza and other respiratory viruses as monsoon brings heavy rains. Doctors report a 15–25% overlap of dengue and influenza, prolonging fever to 10–12 days and occasional atypical dengue with hepatitis or brain involvement, though recovery remains good. A government physician notes a spike in fever with thrombocytopenia recently; mortality is low; infections may be dengue, chikungunya, or leptospirosis. Routine testing is not routinely performed in government settings. Suresh Kumar and Sowmya Sridharan say flu cases declined since mid-October, but dengue remains high; some severe dengue requiring hospitalization with dehydration and organ dysfunction, though earlier presentation improves outpatient outcomes. For children, give paracetamol as prescribed and seek help for warning signs. Prevention emphasizes avoiding waterlogging and contamination, and using nets and repellents. Flu vaccination is advised; trivalent vaccine is in short supply, quadrivalent available.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱が持続、モンスーン到来で医師らが感染に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性のデング熱・インフルエンザ流行に関する通常の医療情報であり、国際的な異常事態や渡航制限等の懸念は見られないが、複数病原体の混在流行と重症例の存在から経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 毎年の季節性感染症（デング熱、インフルエンザ、レプトスピラ症等）の流行報告であり、地域の医療従事者向け注意喚起の性質が強い。国際的な脅威度は低いが、複数病原体の重複流行と重症化例の存在から継続的な監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Poultry-exposed people around Poyang Lake showed varied avian influenza
article.articleSummary: Serological surveillance of avian influenza antibodies among poultry-exposed populations around Poyang Lake, Jiangxi, China (2018–2025) found subtype-specific antibody reactivity but did not establish human infection or local circulation. Analyzing 2,437 sera from backyard poultry keepers, household members and live poultry market workers in Jiujiang (1,599) and Nanchang (838), using hemagglutination-inhibition assays with thresholds of ≥1:40 for H5N6/H9N2 and ≥1:20 for H3N8/H5N8/H5N1/H7N9/H10N3. H5N6: 108/2,437 (4.43%); H9N2: 107/2,437 (4.39%). H7N9: 25/914 (2.74%) during 2018–2020. H3N8: 22/1,523 (1.44%) during 2021–2025, including 9/100 in Nanchang in 2024 (9.0%). H10N3: 4/1,523 (0.26%), all from Jiujiang in 2024. H5N8: 4/314 (1.27%) in 2020; H5N1: 0/600 in 2024–2025. Peaks: H5N6 in Jiujiang (2021) and Nanchang (2022); H9N2 in Jiujiang (2021) and Nanchang (2023). Authors call for ongoing serosurveillance with poultry/environmental data to inform risk.

triage.headline_ja: 鄱陽湖周辺の家禽曝露者における鳥インフルエンザ抗体反応の多様性
triage.triage_reason: 血清疫学調査であり、ヒト感染や局所的な流行は確認されておらず、急性の公衆衛生リスクを示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2018〜2025年にわたる血清学的サーベイランス研究であり、実際のヒト感染例は報告されていない（H5N1は0/600）。継続的なサーベイランスの必要性を著者が指摘しているのみで、現時点での緊急対応は不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms imported Ebola case in FCT, begins contact tracing
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola virus disease confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (FCT); a woman who recently travelled from Uganda is in isolation after laboratory confirmation. Symptoms began on October 7 and worsened by October 11. She arrived by flight from Uganda and was admitted to a private hospital for several days before diagnosis. Forty-four contacts have been identified and are being traced and monitored as authorities strengthen entry-point surveillance and engage partners including the Ministry of Health, the FCT Health Secretariat, and the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention. Nigerians are urged to seek care for fever, weakness, headache, or diarrhoea and to report suspected cases to health authorities; NCDC toll-free 6232 is available. The government cites Nigeria's 2014 Ebola experience for preparedness. Regional context: Ebola outbreaks in the DRC and Kenyan cases (total seven, including healthcare workers) raise importation concerns; FAAN has activated enhanced airport surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、FCTで輸入エボラ症例を確認、接触者追跡を開始
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリア連邦首都特別区で確認され、44名の接触者追跡が進行中であり、国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクを伴う重大事案であるためフルRRAへ進めるべきと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアにおける輸入エボラ症例であり、DRCやウガンダ、ケニアは地域文脈としての言及に留まるため、対象国リストに含まれるDRCも本イベントの発生国としては除外した。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن تسجيل أول حالة إصابة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports its first case of Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola virus infection case in Abuja, linked to a woman who arrived from Uganda. Symptoms began on 7 October, she was hospitalised on 11 October, and laboratory confirmation followed. Authorities are tracing 44 contacts and intensifying containment measures. Uganda had previously reported Ebola cases but later declared the country outbreak-free. Kenya had earlier announced its first case this month, with 9 cases reported to date. Nigeria’s Centre for Disease Control said surveillance has been intensified in response to Kenya’s case, focusing on early detection, isolation, referral, laboratory confirmation, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and protecting health workers. The report also references concerns about Bundibugyo ebolavirus spreading outside Congo, noting the rare virus associated with more than 9,000 infections and over 4,300 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、初のエボラウイルス感染症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ケニアに続きナイジェリアでも初確認され、国境を越えた拡大が確認されているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生国はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアだが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ民主共和国はBundibugyoエボラウイルスの発生源として言及されており、対象国として唯一該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in patient who arrived from Uganda By Reuters
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case has been confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria, involving a female patient who arrived from Uganda. The patient is in isolation at a private hospital; 44 contacts have been identified and are under tracing. Lab confirmation prompted Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate to say Nigeria has containment experience from 2014. The case centers on the Bundibugyo Ebola strain linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak that began in mid-May. Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June (mostly imported from Congo) and Kenya reported nine cases this month linked to a Congo traveler. Uganda was declared free of the virus by WHO in August. Africa CDC has mobilized support for Nigeria. The event highlights cross-border transmission risks and the need for rapid tracing and isolation.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから到着した患者のエボラ感染を確認（ロイター）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）が該当し、WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCのエボラ流行（5月中旬開始、Bundibugyo株）が国境を越えた伝播の起点として記述されているためDRCのみを検証済み地域として計上した。

article.articleHeadline: В Нигерии подтвердили первый случай заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First case of Ebola infection confirmed in Nigeria.
article.articleSummary: First case of Ebola infection confirmed in Nigeria, with the patient in Abuja. A woman who had recently traveled to Uganda is isolated and under medical observation, receiving appropriate care. Health authorities have begun contact tracing, identifying 44 people potentially exposed; investigations into further transmission continue, and no additional confirmed cases have been reported in Nigeria at this time. The development marks Nigeria’s first documented Ebola case. In related context, the United Nations recently warned of a rapid Ebola spread, noting around 2,500 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with half occurring in a 20-day period. The outbreak persists in a conflict-affected region, and the UN condemned attacks on medical workers. No information on infection sources beyond travel history is provided.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの初のエボラ症例確認に加え、DRCでの進行中の大規模流行（約2500人死亡）と関連しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の全項目該当、国際的関心の高さからフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCについては記事内で現在進行中の大規模流行（約2500人死亡）が明示的に言及されており、独立した重大な公衆衛生イベントとして含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma un caso de ébola que afecta a una mujer que llegó desde Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An imported Ebola case has been confirmed in Nigeria, in a woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda. She was admitted to a private hospital and treated for several days before Ebola was laboratory-confirmed, with officials not detailing the woman's prior travel history beyond Uganda. The case follows cross-border transmission linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared on May 15 and described as the worst in the DRC's history and the second deadliest globally. The DRC outbreak also affected Uganda, where the World Health Organization later declared the Uganda outbreak over after 20 confirmed infections, including 15 imported from the DRC, with two deaths, on August 26. The Nigerian incident underscores ongoing risks of imported Ebola cases from East Africa amid the regional outbreak dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでウガンダから到着した女性のエボラ出血熱感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中の史上最悪規模とされるエボラ流行がウガンダを経てナイジェリアへ越境感染した事例であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 直接の感染確認国はナイジェリア、経由国はウガンダだが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であるDRCのアウトブレイクは記事の主題に深く関連するため verified_locations に含めた。ナイジェリア国内での二次感染の有無や渡航制限措置の詳細は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case with 44 contacts
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case confirmed in Nigeria: A woman arriving from Uganda tested positive for Bundibugyo ebolavirus and is isolated in a private Abuja hospital, with 44 close contacts under monitoring. Confirmation date: October 20, 2026. This marks Nigeria’s first case in the current regional outbreak. Authorities are intensifying surveillance with Africa CDC and partners. Context: DR Congo’s outbreak has >9,500 confirmed cases and >4,600 deaths since May (case fatality ~48%). Kenya reports 9 cases linked to a single cluster with 1 death; Uganda had 20 cases and 2 deaths but was declared Ebola-free in August. Nigeria last recorded Ebola in 2014 (West Africa).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱患者を確認、濃厚接触者44人
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準中3つが該当し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの国際的拡大が確認されている地域的エボラ流行の一環であり、コンゴ民主共和国では9,500例超・致死率約48%と深刻な状況が続いているためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ民主共和国は同一地域流行の震源地として9,500例超・死者4,600人超という実質的な進行中の発生状況が具体的に記述されているためverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja in a female traveler from Uganda; laboratory tests validated the diagnosis, and the patient is isolated and receiving care with 44 close contacts identified for tracing. This is the first West African case linked to the East Africa Ebola crisis. Ebola is a rare, deadly virus; early symptoms include vomiting and diarrhoea and can progress to organ failure and bleeding, with transmission via contact with infected bodily fluids. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, ongoing since May, has about 4,600 deaths and over 9,500 cases, caused by Bundibugyo, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists (trials underway). Uganda reported deaths and declared itself free in August; Kenya has at least nine infections. Nigeria has strengthened surveillance and may require health declarations for travelers from affected regions. In 2014, Nigeria contained an Ebola outbreak with eight deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、東アフリカ由来のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中の大規模エボラ流行（死者約4,600人）が東アフリカからナイジェリアへ初めて越境した事例であり、IHR4基準すべてに該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、感染源である流行はDRCで現在進行中（Bundibugyo株、承認済みワクチン・治療法なし）。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria, primo caso di Ebola ad Abuja: la paziente è rimasta 9 giorni in ospedale senza diagnosi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria, first Ebola case in Abuja: the patient remained in hospital for 9 days without a diagnosis.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case since 2014, in Abuja, linked to a woman who arrived by air from Uganda. The patient, infected with the Bundibugyo strain (no approved vaccine or therapy), was hospitalized in a private Abuja clinic for nine days before laboratory confirmation on October 20. Symptoms began October 7; she was admitted October 11 and confirmed positive on October 20, with 13 days of illness prior to confirmation. Authorities identified 44 contacts, including healthcare workers and fellow travelers, and have begun extensive tracing and alerts across public and private facilities. The case is described as contained, with the patient isolated and transmission risk under monitoring. This follows a Nairobi Ebola case tied to movement from Congo to Uganda. Congo’s outbreak exceeds 9,500 cases with over 4,600 deaths; Uganda had about 20 cases and was declared free on July 28. WHO and Africa CDC had not commented by publication.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャで初のエボラ出血熱症例：患者は診断のつかないまま9日間入院
triage.triage_reason: 2014年以来ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例が確認され、ウガンダからの渡航歴を有する輸入例であり、44人の接触者調査が進行中であるため、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）での輸入エボラ症例であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれない。DRCの流行は背景情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主たる発生地ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie: Nigeria meldet ersten Fall
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic: Nigeria Reports First Case.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case reported in Nigeria amid ongoing Central Africa outbreak. A woman who recently flew from Uganda to Nigeria was admitted to a hospital; diagnosis later confirmed after several days, prompting government to urge highest alert across health facilities. The current outbreak began in mid-May in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 9,000 cases and more than 4,380 deaths reported there. Kenya reported its ninth case on Tuesday. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids; symptoms include fever, muscle pains, diarrhea, and may progress to internal bleeding and organ failure. Over the past 50 years, Ebola has killed more than 15,000 people in Africa. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo variant; unlike Zaire variant, there is no approved vaccine or treatment yet, though several candidates are in trials.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：ナイジェリアが最初の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: 中央アフリカでのエボラアウトブレイク（DRC発、9000例超・4380人超死亡）が複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な国際的公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題である発生源はDRC（対象国リストに含まれる）。ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアは感染拡大先として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Bundibugyo変異株でワクチン・治療法未承認という点も国際的懸念を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria records first Ebola case as outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in Africa's latest Bundibugyo outbreak, a woman who travelled from Uganda to Abuja; she is isolated and receiving care, with 44 close contacts identified for monitoring. Kenya confirms its ninth Ebola case in the outbreak; the latest is a 24-year-old man, a close family member of the first Nairobi case, who was isolated at first sign, tested positive, and already in quarantine. The outbreak, centered in DRC since May, has expanded across Africa, with Uganda affected and the African Union/Africa CDC warning of an extremely serious threat as the Bundibugyo outbreak becomes the most geographically widespread in history. DRC reports 4,381 deaths from over 9,000 cases; mortality nearing 50%. The U.S. warns travelers to Kenya amid ongoing transmission; Nigeria last registered an Ebola case in 2014.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認、感染拡大が進行中
triage.triage_reason: DRCを起点としたエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが史上最も地理的に拡大しており、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへの越境感染、致死率約50%、米国の渡航警告など複数のIHR基準・WPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC発のアウトブレイクがウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大したことを報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア・ウガンダ・ナイジェリアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Beni : le rôle des leaders communautaires nécessaire pour éradiquer Ebola dans un temps record - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: the role of community leaders is necessary to eradicate Ebola in record time - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo — Ebola response hinges on community leaders, say members of the Urban Youth Council after a guided tour of the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) in Beni. They stress leaders' role in enforcing provincial governor Evariste Somo Kakule’s measures to strengthen outbreak response and combat misinformation. International Medical Corps, which runs the ETC-Beni, reports progress: about twenty patients recover per week, with eight discharged on Oct 19, 2026. Melchior Muhindo Kyokwe urges leaders, private and public healthcare workers, and uniformed personnel to speak a unified message: Ebola-positive patients should be treated, not hidden. Patrick Kyana, honorary vice-president of the Youth Council, reiterates that the ETC is not a morgue but a proper care facility. The visit follows North Kivu’s STOP EBOLA day on Oct 19, 2026, to boost collective awareness and adherence to prevention measures.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラをいち早く根絶するために地域コミュニティ指導者の役割が必要 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州ベニで進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する内容であり、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）とWPRO基準を複数満たし、国際支援（International Medical Corps）も関与しているため、フルリスク評価の対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事はベニのエボラ治療センター（ETC）における地域リーダーの役割と啓発活動に焦点を当てており、既存のアウトブレイク対応の進捗（週20人程度の回復者）が報告されている。新規感染拡大や国際的拡大に関する具体的情報はなく、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta sanitário: doença é confirmada em granja de perus em SC - Boca do Povo News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Alert: Disease Confirmed at a Turkey Farm in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The facility houses about 6,000 birds not intended for meat production; the farm is interdicted and bird movements suspended. Diagnosis followed samples taken between 21 September and 14 October by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo, with confirmation on 18 October during surveillance. Officially inspected poultry products are deemed safe for human consumption. This is Brazil’s first Newcastle disease focus since the 17 July 2024 Anta Gorda, RS outbreak, whose sanitary emergency ended in August 2024. Trade reactions include Mexico suspending Brazilian poultry imports on 20 October, while China agreed to limit the voluntary suspension of bird exports to Santa Catarina after negotiations with Brazil.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生警報：サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場で疾病確認
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でヒトへの直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、ブラジルでの発生確認とメキシコの輸入停止・中国との輸出制限交渉という貿易影響が生じており、動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 動物疾病（家禽）であり、ヒトへの感染・公衆衛生影響についての言及は記事中になし。主な懸念は家禽産業と国際貿易（メキシコの輸入停止、中国との輸出制限交渉）への影響。人獣共通感染症としてのリスク評価情報は不明。

article.articleHeadline: SAG suspende importación de carne de ave y huevos desde Brasil por brote de virus Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: SAG suspends imports of poultry meat and eggs from Brazil due to Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Chile's Agricultural and Livestock Service (SAG) has suspended imports of poultry meat and eggs from the Brazilian state of Santa Catarina after a Newcastle disease outbreak. The border measure bans a wide range of avian products, including fertile eggs, day-old chicks, quail, ornamental birds, shell eggs for consumption, and fresh, refrigerated, or frozen meat, effective for shipments produced or slaughtered on or after September 20, 2026. The prohibition follows an official notification to Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture, Livestock and Food Supply (MAPA). Exemptions apply only to Santa Catarina-origin shipments; imports from other Brazilian states already recognized by Chile continue under normal protocols. Some avian products from the affected area may still enter if they undergo specified thermal treatments, notably cooked meats, fats for human use, and animal-feed meals. Newcastle disease is highly contagious among birds; it is not a human zoonosis, so consumption of chicken or eggs does not constitute a human health risk.

triage.headline_ja: SAGがニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの鶏肉・卵の輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、記事内でも人獣共通感染症ではなく人の健康リスクにはならないと明記されている。人への公衆衛生上の脅威ではなく、貿易上の措置にとどまるためEBSシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は動物衛生・貿易関連のイベントであり、人の健康への直接的影響はないため、ヒト感染症EBSの観点からは低優先度。チリは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bunia : 28 guéris après un mois de fonctionnement d'un centre de traitement - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bunia: 28 recovered after one month of operation of a treatment center - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Bunia, Ituri province, northeastern DRC, 28 patients with Ebola virus disease recovered after one month of operation of the Ebola Treatment Center at Rwankole General Reference Hospital. Dr. Claude Idringi, medical director, said early arrival and proper care improve survival, countering rumors that admission means death; delays caused by self-medication or traditional healers lead to more advanced disease and higher mortality risk. Samples from patients are sent to a reference laboratory with results in 24–48 hours. Water supply issues at the center were reported, with steps underway to secure a durable solution. The intervention is supported by International Medical Corps (IMC) aiding the government in outbreak response. Despite challenges, there is optimism for stabilizing the outbreak thanks to ongoing efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ブニアでのエボラ出血熱：治療センター運営開始から1か月で28人が回復 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イツリ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する続報であり、重篤な疾患・国際的拡大リスク・渡航貿易制限リスクを伴うため、IHR基準上複数該当しフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本記事は治療センターでの回復者数に関する前向きな続報だが、根本にあるエボラアウトブレイクは継続中であり、国際医療支援団体(IMC)が関与している。水供給の問題や伝統医療への依存による受診遅延が懸念材料として挙げられている。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma el primer caso de ébola en su territorio de una...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms the first Ebola case on its territory of a...
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case on its soil, the Bundibugyo strain linked to outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Kenya. A Nigerian woman who developed symptoms on October 7 after returning from Uganda is isolated and receiving high-quality medical care. She had at least 44 close contacts, with authorities tracing their movements as exposure risks are assessed among healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers from the trip. Nigeria is implementing contact tracing to contain the case. Uganda had declared itself Ebola-free by late July after reporting two deaths and 20 cases. The DRC outbreak, first declared in May, has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths, with expansion to an eighth province the day before the Nigeria case was reported.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから帰国した女性によるエボラ初症例を自国領土で確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC（9,500例超・4,600人死亡、8州目へ拡大）由来のエボラ(Bundibugyo株)がウガンダを経てナイジェリアに越境し、同国初の症例が確認された。IHR基準を複数満たし、国際的拡大の実例であるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしDRCのアウトブレイク（症例数・死亡数・拡大州数）が記事中で具体的に言及されており、同国の状況が主題の一部として扱われているためDRCのみ列挙した。濃厚接触者44人の追跡状況や管理能力（国際支援の要否）については続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case as outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: Outbreak driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus centers in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (Crude CFR 48.3%) reported as of Oct 11. Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in Abuja, after the patient arrived from Uganda; authorities are tracing 44 contacts. Kenya reports a ninth case, all within a single cluster linked to the first patient; no evidence of transmission beyond these known contacts. The Kenyan cluster arises from a traveler who moved from the DRC through Uganda to Nairobi; 135 contacts identified, 134 in quarantine; four relatives and four healthcare workers infected. The U.S. has no cases and the overall risk remains very low. WHO and partners provide assistance (~$70,000 in supplies) and stress preparedness; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus, though early supportive care can improve survival. Nigeria’s case does not yet indicate community transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アフリカでのエボラ流行拡大に伴い初の感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国を中心に致死率48.3%のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が進行中で、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアへ国際的な人の移動を介した感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ、米国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として計上。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事中に明記されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria bestätigt ersten Ebola-Fall | Wissenschaft
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case | Science
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, a woman who travelled by plane from Uganda to Abuja and has laboratory-confirmed infection with the Bundibugyo variant. She is in isolation and receiving medical care; 44 contacts—healthcare workers, other patients, caregivers and travel contacts—have been identified for tracing. Nigeria’s Health Ministry and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control are coordinating with regional authorities to strengthen infection prevention and control and prevent further spread, and the government has urged all facilities to heightened vigilance. Nigeria is the fourth African country to report Bundibugyo variant cases since the outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May. DRC reports 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths; Kenya 8 cases and 1 death; Uganda 20 cases and 2 deaths, with Uganda ending its outbreak in August after more than 42 days without a new case. This underscores cross-border transmission risk from Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、初のエボラ出血熱感染例を確認｜科学
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ由来でナイジェリアに越境感染し、起源国であるDRCでは9,552例・4,602人死亡という甚大な被害が継続しており、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるため。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はナイジェリアでの初症例確認だが、同国は対象国リストに含まれない。一方、本アウトブレイクの起源かつ最大の被害国であるDRC（9,552例、4,602人死亡）は対象国リストに含まれ、記事内で実質的なデータとともに言及されているため verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Najeriya ta tabbatar da bullar cutar Ebola
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola outbreak in Abuja after detecting the virus in a woman who traveled from Uganda. The patient developed symptoms on October 7, was admitted to a private hospital on October 11, and Ebola testing followed. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said authorities have begun tracing 44 contacts and will implement measures to curb transmission. Uganda initially announced an outbreak but later said there was no virus in the country. Nigeria follows Kenya, which earlier this month reported Ebola, with Kenya reporting nine confirmed cases to date. Nigeria’s NCDC has intensified surveillance and contact tracing in response. Meanwhile, outbreaks in Congo have raised global concern, with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths reported so far.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアがエボラ出血熱の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がウガンダ・ケニアからナイジーリアへ拡大し、コンゴ民主共和国では9000例・4300人超の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）でのエボラ確定例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は具体的な症例・死亡者数が記載されており対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Πρώτο κρούσμα Έμπολα στη Νιγηρία - Σε κατάσταση συναγερμού οι υγειονομικές αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola case in Nigeria - Health authorities on high alert.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria: a woman who recently arrived in Abuja on an international flight from Uganda, admitted to a private clinic and diagnosed after several days; Nigeria's health ministry placed public and private health facilities on maximum alert. Meanwhile, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports its 17th Ebola outbreak, the deadliest in the country's history, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths, and 44 close contacts identified. Kenya confirms its ninth Ebola case; the country had reported its first case on October 6 after the Nairobi death of a businessman who had lived in DRC, with eight more cases confirmed since, most linked to the initial patient. The United States issued a travel advisory urging to avoid travel to Kenya or reconsider trips. Overall, Nigeria faces an imported Ebola case; Kenya and DRC continue active outbreaks as of 2026-10-20.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例確認 - 保健当局が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの史上最悪規模の継続的流行に加え、ケニアでの複数例確認とナイジェリアへの輸入症例、米国の渡航勧告発出など、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当し、国際的拡大と社会的関心の高さが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・DRCにまたがる複数国でのエボラ流行を報じているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア（輸入症例）とケニア（活発な流行、米国渡航勧告対象）は対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めていないが、国際的拡大のリスク評価上は重要な情報として触れた。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em aviário de perus mobiliza operação sanitária em SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease at a turkey farm mobilizes a sanitary operation in Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Linha Garibaldi, interior of Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. Detected during active surveillance by Cidasc and laboratory-confirmed. A containment operation was organized with hundreds of professionals; monitoring extends to Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas and Águas Frias, covering 133 farms in the area. The Brazilian Association of Animal Protein (ABPA) states that poultry meat and eggs from establishments inspected by the Official Veterinary Service remain safe for the public. As of 2026-10-20, authorities continue sanitary measures to limit spread and protect regional poultry production. Containment measures focus on preventing further spread and protecting poultry supply.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病、サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥飼養施設で確認され衛生作戦が動員される
triage.triage_reason: 動物の感染症（ニューカッスル病）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、家禽産業への影響と貿易制限の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 本イベントは家禽（七面鳥）における動物疾病であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。貿易・輸出への影響可能性があるため家禽産業の観点から監視継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Bafwasende : les autorités politico-administratives et éducatives appelées à fermer temporairement les écoles. - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Bafwasende: political-administrative and educational authorities urged to temporarily close schools. - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Bafwasende, Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of Congo, triggers calls by government and education authorities to temporarily close schools. Datelined Kisangani, 20 October 2026, the president of the local education union urged suspending school activities in Bafwasende after repeated Ebola-attributed deaths in the community. The measure aims to protect students and teachers amid ongoing transmission and fatalities. Reportedly, more than seven Ebola-confirmed patients escaped from the General Reference Hospital of Bafwasende, where they were hospitalised. The escapes are linked to a disinformation campaign fostering the belief that health workers administer harmful substances, contributing to deaths. Authorities at local, provincial, and national levels were urged to take action, with school closures serving as an interim public health precaution.

triage.headline_ja: バファセンデでのエボラ出血熱：政治・行政および教育当局に学校の一時閉鎖が要請される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱による死亡例の継続、感染確定患者の病院からの逃亡、デマによる対策妨害が確認されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: 確定患者7名以上が病院から逃亡し、健康従事者が有害物質を投与しているという偽情報が蔓延していることが感染拡大・対策困難化の要因となっている。地域・州・国レベルでの対応強化が要請されている。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Πρώτο κρούσμα στη Νιγηρία - Αυξάνονται τα περιστατικά στην Κένυα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: First case in Nigeria - Cases increasing in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria reports its first Ebola case, a woman who arrived in Abuja by flight from Uganda and was treated in a private clinic; 44 close contacts identified; public and private health facilities urged to maintain high alert. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is enduring its 17th Ebola outbreak since May, with more than 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths. Kenya reports nine Ebola cases by 20 October 2026, after the first case on 6 October tied to Nairobi’s death of a businessman who had lived in DRC; eight additional cases confirmed, most among close contacts of the initial patient, aged around 40. The United States has issued a travel advisory urging its citizens to avoid Kenya and reconsider travel there.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアで初の症例確認、ケニアでは感染者増加
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ流行が国際的に拡大し、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境伝播や米国の渡航勧告発出に至っており、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニアへの越境感染を中心に報じているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行継続中の主要発生国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Scrub typhus spreading its tentacles in Goa
article.articleSummary: Scrub typhus is circulating across Goa, per GMC hospital-based study (April 1, 2024–March 31, 2025) with a 29.38% positivity from 3,071 samples; 827 positives. North Goa: 513/1,768 (29.02%); South Goa: 314/1,047 (29.99%). Geographically, Tiswadi (222/667; 33.28%) and Mormugao (100/303; 33.0%) were hotspots; other districts ranged from 30.87% in Ponda to 16.28% in Dharbandora. Males accounted for 64.45% of positives; adults 18–60 years comprised 80.17%; children under 18: 4.59%. Transmission by infected larval mites; initial symptoms mimic dengue, malaria, or leptospirosis, with potential for severe complications if untreated. Cases peak during monsoon (July–September), September being highest. No human vaccine exists; study urges integration of scrub typhus diagnostics into routine fever workups and strengthened surveillance in Goa. Published October 2026 in the International Journal of Community Medicine and Public Health.

triage.headline_ja: ゴア州でツツガムシ病が触手を広げている
triage.triage_reason: 過去1年間の病院ベース研究データの発表であり、新規アウトブレイクではなく既知の風土病に関する疫学論文のため、緊急対応の必要性は低い。
triage.notes: ベクター媒介性の風土病（ツツガムシ病）に関する学術研究報告であり、モンスーン期の季節性流行パターンを示す恒常的な公衆衛生課題。新規の異常事態ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Fe confirmó el primer caso de dengue de la temporada
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Fe confirmed the first dengue case of the season.
article.articleSummary: Imported dengue fever case confirmed in Santa Fe province, Argentina: a Rosario woman who had traveled to Peru developed symptoms on return, with laboratory confirmation of dengue virus serotype DEN-3 and favorable evolution. The finding is reported in the provincial epidemiological bulletin for week 40/2026. Separately, the Ministry of Health notes the 2026-2027 dengue season began with low confirmed cases, with no significant deviation from the same period of the prior season and well below epidemic maxima. In addition, a Santa Cruz resident who traveled to Costa Rica is reported as infected, while nine travel-history–negative cases are classified as probable and under investigation.
