Suspected dengue symptoms include fever ≥38°C, headache and/or retro-orbital pain, muscle and/or joint pain, nausea, vomiting and/or diarrhea, malaise, and rash. People with symptoms should seek evaluation at a health center and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: サンタフェ州、今シーズン初のデング熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンへの輸入症例（ペルー渡航歴）とフィリピン（サンタクルス在住者がコスタリカ渡航）に関する散発的な輸入例であり、季節的な流行も例年と比べ逸脱がなく、対象国での発生でもないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はアルゼンチン（サンタフェ州、サンタクルス）での輸入デング熱症例であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン等）での発生ではない。発生地域にフィリピン（Calabarzon等）が含まれるが、記事サマリー上はサンタクルス居住者がコスタリカに渡航した輸入例であり、フィリピン国内での発生ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma un caso de ébola que afecta a una mujer que llegó desde Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms a case of Ebola in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an imported Ebola case in Abuja, a woman who arrived from Uganda. She is isolated in a private hospital; 44 contacts—health workers, patients, caregivers, and travel contacts—have been identified, with intensified tracing and surveillance. The private facility is receiving support to strengthen infection prevention and control. The case involves the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak; there is no vaccine or specific treatment yet, though two vaccines are in human trials and could take months. The RDC outbreak began May 15 and, as of Oct 18, has 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths across eight provinces. Uganda has reported cases tied to RDC (20 total, including 15 imported, 2 deaths); exported cases include France (1), the Netherlands (1), and Kenya (9).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでウガンダから到着した女性のエボラ出血熱感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに越境輸入され、既に複数国（フランス、オランダ、ケニア）にも拡大しているため、国際的拡大リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・フランス・オランダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景として言及されているDRCの大規模流行（9,552症例、4,602死亡）が本イベントの発生源であり、対象国としてDRCのみ該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : 75 cas confirmés d'Ebola et 32 décès enregistrés au 19 octobre - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: 75 confirmed Ebola cases and 32 deaths recorded as of October 19 - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Tshopo province, northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 75 confirmed cases and 32 deaths reported as of 19 October 2026. Of the 75 cases, 43 are alive and 32 have died; two new recoveries on 19 October bring total recovered to 35. No new health zones (seven of 23, 30%) or new health areas (33 of 442, 7%) were added. Among 1,204 identified contacts, 1,041 are being followed (83%). There are 16 suspected cases, including three community deaths. Weekly trend shows a peak of 11 confirmed cases in week 38, a drop to five in week 39, and an increase to 12 by week 42. Data from the DPS, Kisangani, published 20 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: トショ州:10月19日時点でエボラ確定75例、死亡32人 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクが継続しており、致死率が高く(死亡32/確定75)、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 週次推移で週42に確定例が12例と再増加しており、流行拡大の兆候に注意が必要。接触者追跡率は83%で一定程度管理されているが、新規保健圏・保健地域の増加はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma el primer caso de ébola en su territorio de una mujer que había viajado a Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria Confirms Its First Case of Ebola Within Its Borders in a Woman Who Had Traveled to Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, confirmed in Nigeria—the first case on Nigerian soil—in a woman who had traveled from Uganda. The Nigerian Ministry of Health said she developed symptoms on October 7 after returning from Uganda. She is in isolation and receiving care; a private facility initially treated her. The patient had close contact with at least 44 people, now being traced, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travel companions. Authorities are actively tracing and monitoring exposures as part of containment. Uganda had declared itself free of the virus by late July, after reporting two deaths and 20 cases. The Bundibugyo strain circulates in the region and has affected the Democratic Republic of Congo and Kenya. The Congo outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 9,500 cases and 4,600 deaths with ongoing spread to additional provinces.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認、ウガンダから渡航した女性
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア初のエボラ症例確認かつ国境を越えた感染拡大（ウガンダ由来）に加え、DRCで9,500例超・4,600人超の死亡を伴う大規模流行が継続中であり、IHR基準の複数項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは本記事内で具体的な流行状況（症例数・死者数・拡大地域）が詳細に記述されており、同一のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）流行の一部として主題性があると判断し含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nigérie oznámila první případ nákazy ebolou u ženy, která přiletěla z Ugandy
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announced the first case of Ebola infection in a woman who had arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case on its soil, in Abuja. The patient, an imported case from Uganda, flew internationally and was diagnosed after several days in a private hospital; 44 contacts have been identified. Health authorities urged all public and private facilities to maintain maximum alert and to trace exposed health workers, patients, and caregivers. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the 17th Ebola outbreak since May is the deadliest in its history, with more than 9,000 infections and 4,381 deaths across eight of 25 provinces. Uganda has 21 confirmed cases and three deaths; Kenya reports nine. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Ebola spreads via direct contact with body fluids; symptoms include fever, vomiting, and diarrhea, with potential internal and external bleeding. Nigeria previously contained the 2014 Lagos outbreak (19 cases, seven deaths).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから帰国した女性に初のエボラ出血熱感染例を発表
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最悪規模（感染9000人超、死亡4381人）のエボラ流行が継続中であり、ウガンダ・ケニアに加えナイジェリアへの国際的な輸入例も確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し緊急のフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアでの輸入例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は記事内で2016年5月以来の第17次流行として詳細に言及されており、対象国として該当するためverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン・特効薬のないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、国際的な警戒レベルは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Tanganyika : la coupure d'électricité paralyse la Regideso et complique la riposte au choléra à Kalemie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tanganyika: the power outage paralyzes Regideso and complicates the cholera response in Kalemie.
article.articleSummary: Cholera resurgence in Kalemie, Tanganyika province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, amid a two-week electricity outage that has paralyzed Regideso water distribution, exacerbating water access and sanitation risks. Authorities, led by Governor Christian Kitungwa Muteba, held a multisector meeting to assess the outbreak and outline response measures. The most affected health zones are those lacking potable water supply from Regideso, underscoring the link between water access and cholera transmission, which occurs through contaminated water or food. Beyond public health response, restoring electricity is pivotal to restoring reliable clean-water delivery. Works continue at the Bendera hydroelectric plant to re-energize Regideso and curb transmission. SNEL Kalemie notes ongoing efforts to feed the grid and reduce the epidemic's spread. Coordination across sectors aims to synchronize interventions and quickly restore safe water; until then, cholera control remains constrained by the water shortage.

triage.headline_ja: タンガニーカ州:停電がレジデソ社を麻痺させ、カレミエでのコレラ対応を困難にしている
triage.triage_reason: DRCカレミエでのコレラ再燃と給水インフラの機能不全が確認されるが、規模・重症度等の詳細情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: コレラはDRCで地域的に既知の疾病であり突発的異常事態ではないが、停電による水衛生インフラ崩壊が感染拡大を助長している点が懸念材料。症例数・死亡者数等の定量情報が記事内に無いため重症度評価は不明。

article.articleHeadline: China suspende importações de aves de SC após confirmação de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China suspends poultry imports from SC after confirmation of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed in a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggering import restrictions by China and Chile limited to Santa Catarina state. China halted poultry meat imports generally, while Chile restricted a broad range of products (fertile eggs, SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh poultry meat, eggs for human consumption, and meat-containing products). Mexico had already suspended imports of live birds, meat and giblets from Brazil. The Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture notes these measures are targeted and underscores ongoing talks with other importers, supplying technical information on the outbreak and control measures to enable transparent communication and a safe resumption of trade in accordance with each market’s sanitary requirements.

triage.headline_ja: 中国、ニューカッスル病確認後にサンタカタリーナ州産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 家きんのニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州産品の輸入が複数国で制限されているが、ヒトへの公衆衛生影響は確認されておらず、動物衛生・貿易面の事案にとどまる。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家きん疾患であり、ヒトへの重篤な健康影響は報告されていない。中国・チリ・メキシコによる輸入制限は貿易・経済面の影響であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。ブラジル農務省は技術情報提供により貿易再開に向けた対応を進めている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 10 symptoms, safety tips every Nigerian should know
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Abuja, Nigeria. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) defines Ebola Viral Disease case definitions (Version 2, May 31, 2026); no new advisory posted yet. Warning signs: sudden fever plus at least three of headaches, lethargy, loss of appetite, muscle/joint pains, stomach pain, difficulty swallowing, vomiting, breathing difficulties, diarrhea, or hiccups. Unexplained bleeding is a red flag if travel to DRC, Uganda, or any country reporting Ebola within the last 21 days. The 21-day window covers travel to affected countries, contact with a confirmed/probable case, or contact with sick or dead animals or bushmeat. Protective measures: regular hand hygiene, avoid contact with blood or body fluids of the ill or dead, avoid bushmeat and wild animals, seek prompt medical care and share travel/exposure history, call NCDC toll-free 6232 (24/7). Stay calm and rely on official information.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：すべてのナイジェリア人が知っておくべき10の症状と安全対策
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリア・アブジャでエボラ出血熱の症例が確認されたとの報道であり、エボラはIHR(2005)附属書2で即時通報対象となる重篤な感染症であるため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）でのエボラ症例確認であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。DRC・ウガンダは渡航歴の文脈で言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではない。続報でナイジェリアでの感染拡大状況や対象国への波及があれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Avicultura espera que embargos por Doença de Newcastle sejam limitados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The poultry industry expects embargoes for Newcastle disease to be limited.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak detected at a poultry farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggers temporary export suspensions. MAPA reports 26 infected birds among 6,526, with four municipalities—Nova Itaberaba, Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim—declared zoosanitary emergency. The outbreak began with samples collected Sept 21 and was confirmed Oct 18; a precautionary suspension was announced Sept 19. China and Chile imports from Santa Catarina are halted, while all Brazil-origin chicken shipments to Mexico are suspended, reflecting bilateral regionalization protocols. Authorities anticipate regionalized embargoes and rapid restoration of flows as negotiations progress. Brazil exported about 4.4 million tonnes of poultry meat from Jan–Sep 2026, with China the top buyer (420.8k tonnes), followed by Japan, UAE, Saudi Arabia, the EU, South Africa, Philippines, Mexico (170.9k), South Korea, and Singapore. A 2024 Newcastle case in Rio Grande do Sul informed the response.

triage.headline_ja: 養鶏業界、ニューカッスル病による禁輸措置が限定的であることを期待
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場で確認されたニューカッスル病の発生であり、家禽間の伝播・貿易禁輸措置に関する内容で、人の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は報告されていないため見送りとする。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾患であり、人への感染リスクは極めて低い。本記事は貿易・輸出禁輸措置に関する経済的影響が主題であり、公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての重要性は低いと判断。China、Mexico等は輸出先国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria records first Ebola case as outbreak spreads
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria recorded its first Ebola case, while Kenya reported its ninth case. The outbreak, first declared in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May, has spread to other African countries. The report emphasizes the deadly viral hemorrhagic fever and tracks its continental spread since the DRC declaration, noting Nigeria's confirmation marks the disease's reach into Africa's most populous country and Kenya's ongoing burden of cases. The excerpt does not provide additional specifics on total case counts beyond Kenya's nine, laboratory confirmation, infection source, clinical symptoms, or other country-level details. No information on responses, containment, or exported cases is provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アウトブレイク拡大の中で初のエボラ症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月に宣言されたエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクがナイジェリア（初症例）、ケニア（9例目）へと拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。アウトブレイクの起源であるDRCのみを含めた。続報で感染源・対応状況・渡航制限の有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: El Ministerio de Salud de la Nación confirmó un caso de dengue en una persona residente en Santa Cruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The National Ministry of Health confirmed a dengue case in a person residing in Santa Cruz.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Argentina’s Health Ministry confirmed a dengue case in a Santa Cruz resident. Laboratory-confirmed infection, imported from travel to Costa Rica, is dengue virus serotype 2 (DENV-2). No evidence of local transmission in Santa Cruz during the analyzed season. The case appears in National Epidemiological Bulletin No. 830 (week 40, Oct 4–10). In the same week, two additional confirmed dengue cases were reported nationally—one in Santa Fe (travel to Peru) and the Santa Cruz case; total six imported dengue cases for the 2026–2027 season, with nine probable cases under investigation. The bulletin notes no autochthonous Santa Cruz cases to date. Dengue symptoms include fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgias, and rash; travelers should seek care and avoid aspirin or ibuprofen.

triage.headline_ja: アルゼンチン国家保健省、サンタクルス州在住者のデング熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチンでの渡航関連（コスタリカ）輸入デング症例であり、地域内伝播の証拠なし。対象国（Philippines等）はBluedotの地名重複による誤付与で記事主題と無関係。
triage.notes: 発生地域にPhilippines(Calabarzon, Santa Cruz)が含まれるが、これは地名の重複によるBluedotの誤付与であり、記事はアルゼンチン国内の輸入症例（渡航先：コスタリカ、ペルー）に関するもの。対象国リストにアルゼンチン・コスタリカ・ペルーは含まれないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Senacsa prohíbe importación de aves y derivados desde Santa Catarina por enfermedad de "Newcastle"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Senacsa bans the importation of birds and derivatives from Santa Catarina due to Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Paraguay's Senacsa imposed a sanitary blockade on Brazil's Santa Catarina after Newcastle disease was detected in a poultry farm. Administrative Resolution No. 1715 bans the import of live birds, fertile eggs, and genetic material from Santa Catarina, restricting trade to that state. The outbreak center comprises a farm with about 6,000 turkeys; 26 birds tested positive for Newcastle disease by Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock, which ordered sanitary culling and declared a 60-day emergency, with roughly 130 poultry farms under surveillance in the region. Santa Catarina accounts for 23% of Brazil's poultry meat exports and 60% of turkey production. The last Santa Catarina Newcastle case was in 2024; nationwide records date to 2006. The virus causes respiratory and nervous signs with high mortality, and the circulating strain commonly affects pigeons and synanthropic birds near sheds. Strong biosecurity and prompt reporting to Senacsa are essential.

triage.headline_ja: セナクサ(パラグアイ検疫当局)、ニューカッスル病によりブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州からの家禽および派生品の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病(ニューカッスル病)でヒトへの健康影響はなく、貿易制限が発生しているが人への公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は不明なためWATCHとする。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽の動物疾病でありヒト感染症ではないため、公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは低い。対象国リストにパラグアイは含まれないため除外。ブラジルは発生国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: La Nigeria ha segnalato il primo caso di ebola dopo 12 anni: è legato all'epidemia partita dalla Repubblica Democratica del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria has reported its first case of Ebola after 12 years: it is linked to the outbreak that originated in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case since 2014, linked to the Congo-originated East Africa outbreak. The patient is a woman who traveled to Uganda and returned to Abuja, currently isolated in hospital. Nigeria has identified 44 close contacts. This marks the first West African transmission tied to the Congo outbreak, which has caused more than 9,500 cases and over 4,600 deaths—the worst Ebola outbreak in DRC history. In addition to the DRC, smaller clusters have been reported in Kenya and Uganda, though Uganda reported no cases by July. Ebola spreads through contact with bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and, in severe cases, internal and external bleeding. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a less common strain with no licensed vaccines or proven treatments; containment relies on rapid detection, isolation, and care, with experimental therapies under study.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが12年ぶりにエボラ出血熱の初症例を報告：コンゴ民主共和国発の流行に関連
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来の東アフリカ・エボラ流行（9,500例超、4,600人超死亡）が初めて西アフリカ（ナイジェリア）に越境輸入され、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし本アウトブレイクの起源かつ最大の被害国であるDRCの状況が記事の主要な内容であるため含めた。ナイジェリアでの初症例確認は国際的拡大の明確な証拠であり、WHOへの通知基準を満たす可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm nach Flug: Infektion bei Frau bestätigt!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert after flight: infection in woman confirmed!
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria, a woman who recently flew from Uganda to Abuja. Laboratory results identify Ebola virus of the Bundibugyo strain; she is in isolation and receiving care at a private hospital. Nigeria’s Ministry of Health is coordinating with the National Centre for Disease Control and other authorities to contain the infection, and contact tracing has begun, identifying 44 contacts including medical staff, other patients, caregivers, and travel contacts. The government has urged all public and private health facilities to maintain high vigilance and strengthen infection prevention and control. The current outbreak began mid-May in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, which reports 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. Kenya has 8 cases (1 death); Uganda 20 cases (2 deaths), with Uganda having ended its outbreak in August after 42 days without a new case. The Nigerian case is imported.

triage.headline_ja: 飛行機搭乗後にエボラ警報:女性の感染が確認される
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでウガンダからの輸入エボラ症例が確認され、国際的拡大の可能性と公衆衛生上の重大性からIHR基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入エボラ症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは現行アウトブレイクの発生源として言及されており対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ウガンダ・ケニアも言及されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Erster Ebola-Fall in Nigeria bestätigt: Maßnahmen ergriffen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola case in Nigeria confirmed: measures taken.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, the Bundibugyo variant, with the patient in isolation and receiving medical care; contact tracing has identified 44 contacts, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers. The government and partners coordinate with the National Center for Disease Control and regional authorities to curb spread as the outbreak extends from the Democratic Republic of Congo across borders, with Kinshasa reporting the virus has reached a eighth province. Kenya reports eight cases and one death; Uganda reports 20 confirmed cases linked to a DRC patient, with two deaths, and Uganda declared the outbreak ended in August after over 42 days with no new cases. Four African countries are affected: DRC has 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths. Nigeria’s response includes heightened vigilance across all health facilities and strengthened infection prevention and control. Keywords: Ebola, Bundibugyo, outbreak, Nigeria, DRC, Kenya, Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例確認：対策を実施
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラアウトブレイクが複数国（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）に拡大し、ナイジェリアで初症例が確認されたこと、DRCで9,552例・4,602死亡という深刻な被害が出ていることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの症例にも言及しているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCはアウトブレイクの発生源国として本文で主題的に言及されているため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Πρώτο κρούσμα Έμπολα, σε κατάσταση συναγερμού οι υγειονομικές αρχές | Ειδήσεις
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: First case of Ebola, health authorities on high alert | News
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case, a woman who recently flew from Uganda and was treated in an Abuja private clinic before laboratory confirmation; the government orders maximum alert across public and private health facilities, with 44 close contacts identified. The Democratic Republic of the Congo is amid its 17th Ebola outbreak since May, with over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths cited by health authorities. In Nigeria, 44 close contacts have been traced. Kenya confirms its ninth Ebola case, after first case announced on 6 October following the Nairobi death of a businessman who had lived in the DRC; eight additional cases have since been confirmed, most linked to close contact with the initial patient, aged about 40. The United States has issued a travel advisory urging avoidance or reconsideration of travel to Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア:エボラ出血熱の初症例、保健当局が厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がナイジェリア（初症例）、ケニア（9例目）、コンゴ民主共和国（大規模流行、死者4,381人）で同時進行しており、米国が渡航勧告を出すなど国際的拡大・渡航制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ケニア・コンゴ民主共和国の複数国にまたがるエボラ出血熱流行を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenijoje nustatytas devintas Ebolos atvejis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ninth Ebola case detected in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Nine Ebola virus disease (EVD) cases detected in Kenya, all within a single transmission cluster tied to the first case who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where a major outbreak has persisted since May. The index patient died in Nairobi on Oct 5. The ninth case, a 24-year-old man described as a close family member of the index case, was confirmed on Monday. He was isolated at symptom onset and began treatment immediately; he was already in quarantine when ill. Contact tracing expanded with 135 contacts identified; 134 have been located and isolated. Currently, there is no evidence of spread beyond this cluster. The United States has urged citizens to reconsider travel to Kenya, elevating travel advisory levels due to health risks. In the DRC, authorities report over 9,000 EVD cases and about 4,381 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の9例目の症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の大規模エボラ流行（9,000例超、死者4,381人）が国境を越えてケニアに波及し、米国が渡航勧告を引き上げるなど国際的関心も高いため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの9例のクラスターだが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であり現在も9,000例超の大規模流行が継続中のDRCは対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Emergencia en la República Democrática del Congo por mortífero brote de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Emergency in the Democratic Republic of the Congo due to deadly Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola has triggered a national emergency, with over 4,500 deaths and more than 10,000 infections. As of 20 October 2026, authorities report 4,561 fatalities and ongoing transmission across eight provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, Ubangi-Sud, and Ubangi-Nord. About 925 patients remain hospitalized in isolation, with 2,530 discharged. The outbreak is the deadliest Ebola episode in DRC history, with a case fatality around 48.2% and rapid geographic spread challenging early detection and care. Kenya reports eight infections nearby, highlighting cross-border risk. There is no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo; response centers on early detection, isolation, clinical management, and contact tracing. Symptoms include fever, muscle pain, fatigue, headache, sore throat, diarrhea, vomiting, rash, liver/kidney complications, and possible internal bleeding; incubation 2–21 days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行により緊急事態宣言
triage.triage_reason: DRC史上最悪のエボラ流行（死者4,500人超、致死率48.2%）が8州に拡大し、ケニアへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ケニアでの感染報告があるが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。有効なワクチン・治療法がないブンディブギョ株による流行であり、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Nigéria registra 1º caso de ebola em meio a surto na Rep. Dem. do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria records first case of Ebola amid outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case on 20 Oct 2026, a woman who arrived in Abuja on a flight from Uganda. She underwent several days of treatment in a private hospital before laboratory confirmation, with the Health Minister Muhamad Ali Pate announcing nationwide alert. Nigeria previously faced Ebola in 2014 (20 cases, 8 deaths); the WHO declared the country free on 20 Oct 2014 after 42 days with no new infections. The Democratic Republic of the Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak began in May and has spread to Kenya (9 cases) and Uganda (outbreak ended in August). As of 20 Oct 2026, the DRC outbreak has 9,552 confirmed cases and 4,602 deaths across eight provinces, led by Ituri with 6,960 cases and 3,217 deaths. Nigeria has identified 44 close contacts for monitoring, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and exposed travelers.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行の最中に初の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（9,552症例、4,602死亡）が国境を越えてナイジェリアに波及しており、IHR基準の複数（重篤性・異常性・国際拡散）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行とその国際的拡散（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのみ対象国として列挙。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle coloca 1,6 mil propriedades sob vigilância em SC e interrompe exportação de frango para China
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease puts 1,600 farms under surveillance in Santa Catarina and halts chicken exports to China.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease detected at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, triggers intensified control and a 10-km ring surveillance around the outbreak. As of 2026-10-20, about 1,600 rural properties with poultry will be inspected, with blood analysis potentially required for around 130 flocks. The affected property is quarantined, with access restricted to authorized teams from Cidasc and the Ministry of Agriculture. Next steps include sanitary depopulation of the birds, proper disposal of contaminated materials, and thorough cleaning and disinfection. Concurrently, Santa Catarina’s chicken exports to China are suspended, affecting 14 exporting establishments in the state. Officials emphasize consumer safety, noting officially inspected poultry remains safe to eat. Newcastle disease is a contagious viral infection in birds, with severity varying by strain.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病によりサンタカタリーナ州の1,600農場が監視下に置かれ、中国への鶏肉輸出が停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は主に家禽の疾患でありヒトへの健康影響はほとんどないため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。輸出停止という貿易制限は発生しているが、人獣共通感染症としてのリスクは限定的でEBSのシグナルとしての優先度は低い。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、ヒトへの感染・健康影響の報告はない。中国は輸出停止の対象国として言及されているのみで、疾患発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Nigeria confirmó su primer caso y crece la preocupación por la expansión del brote - Sin Mordaza
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Nigeria confirms its first case and concern grows over the spread of the outbreak - Sin Mordaza
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case: a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja, hospitalized for several days before laboratory confirmation; authorities raised high-alert status and identified 44 close contacts, including healthcare workers, for tracing. Kenya reports a new Ebola infection, raising total confirmed cases to nine; the latest patient is a 24-year-old who is a close contact of the initial Kenyan case and was isolated upon symptom onset. The nine cases in Kenya are linked to a single cluster, with no evidence of community transmission outside that group. The Democratic Republic of Congo remains the epicenter since May, reporting over 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths, the deadliest Ebola outbreak in the country’s history. France and the Netherlands have each reported one case. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, with no approved specific treatments; two vaccines are in human trials. Emphasis remains on early detection, isolation, and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ナイジェリアが初の症例を確認、感染拡大への懸念が高まる - Sin Mordaza
triage.triage_reason: DRCを震源地として9000例超・4381人死亡という史上最悪規模のエボラ流行が、ナイジェリア・ケニア・フランス・オランダへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たす重大事案である。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・フランス・オランダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは2026年5月以降のエピセンターとして記事の主題に含まれるため included。

article.articleHeadline: First Ebola case reported in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, a woman who flew from Uganda and was treated in an Abuja private hospital. Laboratory tests identify Bundibugyo strain, the predominant variant in the current outbreak that began mid-May in the Democratic Republic of Congo; this strain has no vaccine or targeted treatment, and early symptoms can mimic malaria, risking delayed isolation. The patient is in isolation; 44 contacts—medical staff, other patients, nursing staff and travel contacts—have been identified. The hospital is receiving support to strengthen infection prevention and control; authorities urge all health facilities to maintain high vigilance. Nigeria becomes the fourth African country affected by this Bundibugyo outbreak. In DRC, 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths; Kenya has 8 cases (1 death); Uganda has 20 cases, traced to a Congo-origin patient, with Uganda declaring the outbreak over in late August after more than 42 days without a new case.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブジョ株）アウトブレイクがナイジェリアに拡大し、既に4カ国で確認されるなど国際的拡大・深刻な公衆衛生影響が明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは本アウトブレイクの発生源として記事の主要な主題であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria meldt eerste ebolageval in meer dan tien jaar terwijl bundibugyo-uitbraak zich uitbreidt over Afrika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports first Ebola case in more than ten years as Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak spreads across Africa.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case in over a decade, an imported Bundibugyo ebolavirus infection from Uganda. Symptoms began Oct 7; the patient was hospitalised Oct 11 in Abuja and is isolated, with 44 contacts traced and monitoring ongoing for healthcare workers and caregivers. Africa CDC says the Bundibugyo outbreak is the most geographically widespread Ebola event in history, spanning three African regions and multiple countries, with Nigeria expanding operations and DRC and Kenya increasing efforts. In the DRC, the outbreak began over five months ago, with 9,552 confirmed infections and 4,602 deaths (about 48% CFR). Kenya has linked infections to a traveler from Congo via Uganda to Nairobi; Europe has also reported cases. No approved vaccines for Bundibugyo; Moderna is testing an experimental vaccine funded by CEPI. Africa CDC calls for immediate global support: funding, medicines, diagnostics, trained personnel, and strengthened community surveillance. Nigeria last faced Ebola in 2014 when a Liberian traveler arrived in Lagos.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、10年以上ぶりにエボラ出血熱の症例を報告、ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクはアフリカ全域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目該当（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に加え、WPRO基準も全5項目該当。DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（致死率約48%）と複数国への拡大、国際支援要請がありフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回のアウトブレイクの発生源・最大の被害国であり対象国リストに含まれるため記載。Africa CDCは本アウトブレイクを史上最も地理的に広範囲なエボラ事例と評価し、国際的な資金・医薬品・診断・人材支援を要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Prisons Boss Patience Baffoe-Bonnie Demands Contagious Disease Allowance for Prison Staff
article.articleSummary: Patience Baffoe-Bonnie, Director General of the Ghana Prisons Service, on 2026-10-20 urged the government to create a contagious disease allowance for prison officers who work with inmates whose health status is unknown. She argues officers face routine exposure in overcrowded, confined prison environments where close contact and limited information about inmates’ medical conditions heighten transmission risk of infectious diseases, notably tuberculosis and other contagious conditions. The proposed allowance would recognize occupational hazards and provide compensation for potential health consequences simply by performing duties. The appeal underscores welfare and safety concerns within Ghana’s correctional system, aiming to boost morale, attract and retain personnel, and ensure effective operations. The article does not report specific cases, outbreaks, laboratory confirmations, or explicit infection sources beyond general risk, and there is no stated government action as of 2026-10-20."

triage.headline_ja: 刑務所長パシェンス・バフォー=ボニー氏、刑務所職員への感染症手当を要求
triage.triage_reason: 具体的な症例・アウトブレイク報告はなく、刑務所職員の待遇改善を求める政策的要望に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報がない。
triage.notes: 結核等の感染リスクに言及しているが、具体的な症例報告やアウトブレイクの事実はなく、職員手当要求という労働政策の話題が中心。感染症サーベイランスの観点ではシグナルとして取り上げる根拠に乏しい。

article.articleHeadline: Maripá de Minas Promove Ação Itinerante para Intensificar Vacinação contra a Febre Amarela
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Maripá, Minas Gerais Promotes Itinerant Outreach to Intensify Yellow Fever Vaccination
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination drive underway in Maripá de Minas, Minas Gerais, Brazil, as the municipal health department launches the 'Health in the Neighborhood' campaign using a mobile unit (Vacimóvel) to actively reach residents from October 20–22. The schedule runs 8:00–10:00 and 13:00–15:00 at strategic points: October 20 at Vila Mariana and Morro do Cemitério (morning) and Praça São Sebastião (afternoon); October 21 at Praça da Várzea in front of CRAS (morning) and Bairro Bela Vista (afternoon); October 22 at Bairro Giacominio Trezza (morning) and the square in front of Fisioterapia (afternoon). Residents should bring photo ID and their vaccination card for verification and updating. The campaign aims to broaden yellow fever immunity by delivering vaccines directly to neighborhoods.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州マリパ・デ・ミナス市、黄熱病ワクチン接種強化のため巡回活動を実施
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病の通常のワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する告知記事であり、発生・流行の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は予防接種キャンペーンの告知であり、黄熱病の症例発生や流行についての言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia alerta população que vírus da gripe circula ao longo do ano todo - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia warns residents that the influenza virus circulates year-round - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia, Brazil reports year-round circulation of influenza. By 2026-10-20, the city’s vaccination campaign at seven Basic Health Units (UBSs) has administered over 65,000 flu doses (about 55% coverage), higher than state (52%) and national (51%) levels. Seven UBSs have extended hours (16:00–18:30) to boost access, with other centers operating until 17:30 or 18:30. This year has seen 36 notified influenza cases and 3 deaths. The campaign began in March, prioritizing pregnant women, seniors 60+, and children under six, with a target of 90% coverage for these groups. Residents can update vaccines and check which are missing in their UBS system. The message emphasizes that influenza circulates year-round and protection is needed through the upcoming spring/summer and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: オルトランディア市、インフルエンザウイルスは年間を通じて流行していると住民に注意喚起 - Portal Veloz
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザのワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常な流行拡大や重篤性の急増は見られない。
triage.notes: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンの案内記事であり、対象国リストに含まれないブラジルの一地方自治体の話題のため、verified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Nigèria confirma el primer cas d'Ebola al país
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms the first case of Ebola in the country.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, linked to outbreaks affecting the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Kenya. The patient is a woman who developed symptoms after traveling to Uganda. She arrived in Nigeria on 7 October and was hospitalized in a private facility, receiving treatment for several days before the diagnosis was confirmed. She is now isolated and under medical care. Nigerian health authorities have begun contact tracing and identified 44 contacts, including healthcare workers, other patients, caregivers, and contacts connected to the travel. The Congo outbreak has killed over 4,000 people this year, making it the second-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. This case constitutes an imported Ebola case into Nigeria, highlighting ongoing cross-border transmission risks.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが国内初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで輸入エボラ症例が確認され、コンゴ民主共和国の大規模流行（死者4000人超）と関連した越境感染リスクが示されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するためフルRRAへの移行が適切。
triage.notes: 確認された症例自体はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）で発生しているが、記事の核心はコンゴ民主共和国での大規模エボラ流行（死者4000人超、史上2番目に致死率の高い流行）との関連性にあるため、DRCを検証済み地域として含めた。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれず、記事内でも主要発生国としては扱われていない。

article.articleHeadline: Três países já restringiram importação de peru do Brasil após detecção de doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three countries have already restricted imports of turkey from Brazil after detection of Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus confirmed at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The virus, affecting domestic and wild birds, led to quarantine of the facility housing about 6,000 turkeys, with movement restrictions on birds. Confirmation came from LFDA-SP after investigation by the Santa Catarina Official Veterinary Service. Authorities will implement control, containment and eradication under the Contingency Plan for Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease, including epidemiological surveillance in a restriction zone covering Nova Itaberaba and nearby Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim and Águas Frias, monitoring ~133 properties with visits, clinical assessments and sampling. No product recalls or bird returns yet. Official consumption of inspected poultry remains safe. Mexico suspended imports of live birds, meat and by-products from Brazil; China restricted poultry meat from Santa Catarina; Chile restricted SC-origin eggs and poultry products.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルからの七面鳥輸入、ニューカッスル病検出後に既に3カ国が制限
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州の七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病が確認され、メキシコ・中国・チリが輸入制限を実施。国際的な貿易制限が発生しており、IHR基準の国際拡大・貿易制限の2項目に該当するためフルRRA対象とする。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病であり、ヒトへの感染報告はない。公衆衛生上の深刻性は低いが、複数国が輸入制限を課しており動物衛生・貿易面でのシグナルとして記録。中国・メキシコ・チリは輸入制限実施国であり発生国ではないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nigeria confirme un cas d'Ebola à Abuja, 44 contacts placés sous surveillance
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms a case of Ebola in Abuja, 44 contacts placed under surveillance.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in Abuja on 20 October 2026: a woman who recently arrived in Nigeria from Uganda is hospitalized in a private facility. Diagnosis was confirmed after several days; the patient is isolated and receiving care. Federal authorities identified 44 close contacts, including healthcare workers and fellow travelers, and have placed them under surveillance as a high-alert precaution for health facilities nationwide. Nigeria cites its 2014 Lagos Ebola experience to reassure the public. The case arises amid the Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo since May. Kenya reported its first imported Ebola case on 6 October, reaching eight cases by 18 October; Uganda declared an outbreak end in August. Authorities did not specify the virus species or the patient’s exact travel route.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ出血熱症例を確認、接触者44人を監視下に
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来の輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリアで確認され、濃厚接触者44人が監視下に置かれるなど、公衆衛生上の深刻性・異常性・国際拡散リスクのIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリア（対象国外）での輸入症例だが、背景としてDRCでの継続的なブンディブギョ型エボラ流行（5月以降）が言及されているため、DRCのみを対象国として抽出した。ウガンダ・ケニアは言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak breidt zich uit over Afrika: eerste besmetting vastgesteld in Nigeria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreading across Africa: first infection confirmed in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak escalates across Africa with the Bundibugyo variant; Nigeria reports its first infection after a patient traveled by international flight from Uganda to Abuja, with 44 contacts traced and the patient isolated in a private hospital. Uganda, where the outbreak began in May, has 20 infections and 2 deaths and was declared Ebola-free in August after 42 days with no new cases. Kenya reports its first Ebola death this month and ten total cases, linked to travel through Uganda and the DRC. The Democratic Republic of Congo remains hardest hit, with over 9,000 infections and about 4,000 deaths, concentrated in the eastern region as the outbreak expands. The Bundibugyo variant has no approved vaccine; transmission occurs via bodily fluids and contaminated objects, including after death. Described as the fastest-growing Ebola outbreak in history.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ全土でエボラ出血熱の流行が拡大：ナイジェリアで初の感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち複数（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、DRCを中心に感染者9000人超・死者4000人規模という重大なエボラ流行であるため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリアに言及しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。DRCが流行の中心であり、感染者数・死者数ともに最大規模である。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case linked to East Africa
article.articleSummary: Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a female patient who travelled from Uganda to Abuja; laboratory confirmation, patient isolated and receiving care, with 44 close contacts identified for tracing. Nigeria is the first West African state to report a case linked to the East Africa Ebola crisis; it previously contained a 2014 outbreak that caused eight deaths. Symptoms include vomiting and diarrhoea with potential organ failure; transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids. The ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which began in May, has about 4,600 deaths and over 9,500 cases, caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, a relatively rare variant with no approved vaccine or treatment (trials underway). Uganda reported cases and two deaths and later declared itself free in August after the last patient was discharged. Kenya has reported at least nine infections; the US advised reconsidering travel to Kenya. Nigeria’s NCDC has heightened surveillance, with travel declarations for travelers from affected countries; others exempt. In 2014, Nigeria’s outbreak ended with eight deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、東アフリカ関連のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模エボラ流行（約4,600人死亡、9,500人超感染）がウガンダ経由でナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大したことが確認され、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでのエボラ症例確認だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・米国は対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは今回のアウトブレイクの震源地として記事中で詳述されており、対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めた。Bundibugyo株は希少変異株でワクチン・治療法未承認のため、流行の制御可能性に懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC calls for urgent global support as Nigeria confirms Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case, prompting Africa CDC to urge urgent international support. Director-General Jean Kaseya called for immediate funding, medical supplies, diagnostics and trained emergency responders after discussions with Nigeria’s Coordinating Minister of Health and Social Welfare, Muhammad Pate. He stressed that early reporting saves lives and strengthens public health responses. Africa CDC has begun mobilising support for Nigeria while intensifying response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Kenya, and maintaining heightened vigilance in Uganda. The outbreak is described as the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in history, affecting multiple countries across three African regions. In the DRC, the case fatality rate is approaching 50%. Africa’s health security is linked to global health security; the agency urged prompt, flexible financing and stronger community-based surveillance to prevent spread to more countries or prolongation of the outbreak. ACT NOW.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC、ナイジェリアでのエボラ症例確認を受け緊急の国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準のうち3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、史上最も地理的に広範なエボラ流行としてアフリカCDCが緊急国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア、DRC、ケニア、ウガンダ等複数国にまたがるエボラ流行を報じているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。DRCでは致死率約50%と報告され、多国間拡大が懸念されている。

article.articleHeadline: Mutirão contra a dengue identificou 94 criadouros no sábado (17) em Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anti-dengue campaign identified 94 breeding sites on Saturday (the 17th) in Limeira - Portal Veloz
article.articleSummary: Limeira authorities conducted a dengue-control drive in Parque Residencial Belinha Ometto, Geada, Jardim Águas da Serra, and Jardim Residencial Village. On Saturday, Oct 17, 2026, from 7:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m., 71 agents inspected 2,048 properties and identified 94 Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Of these, 70 contained water and 10 harbored larvae, signaling ongoing vector-carrying risk. The effort focused on eliminating containers that can accumulate water to reduce mosquito proliferation. Residents were urged to cooperate to remove potential breeding habitats. The campaign supports public-health objectives to prevent dengue and protect community health. The report does not mention confirmed human cases; emphasis remains on vector control through environmental sanitation across four Limeira neighborhoods, underscoring the need for continued community participation.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラで17日(土)にデング対策活動を実施、94か所の発生源を特定 - Portal Veloz
triage.triage_reason: 通常の地域的なデング媒介蚊対策活動の報告であり、確定症例の言及もなく、異常性・重大性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は地方自治体によるルーティンの蚊媒介対策活動の報告であり、人の感染症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La Nación / Senacsa prohíbe importación de productos avícolas de Santa Catarina por Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Nación / Senacsa prohibits the import of poultry products from Santa Catarina due to Newcastle disease.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay's National Animal Quality and Health Service (Senacsa) temporarily bans the import of live poultry, eggs, poultry products, and avian genetic material from Santa Catarina, Brazil, following detection of a Newcastle disease focus. The prohibition, established by Resolution No. 1715/2026 on 20 October 2026, remains until Senacsa completes an updated sanitary risk assessment per international protocols. Exemptions apply to products that bear official veterinary certification showing viral inactivation and anti-recontamination measures in line with the OIE Terrestrial Code. The measure responds to a regional scenario, with authorities urging officials at regional health offices, entry points, producers, and the public to report any signs of sick or dead birds to trigger protocols and prevent spread. The last sanitary alert, on 24 February 2026, referenced Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza in commercial poultry in Buenos Aires Province, Argentina. The aim is to safeguard national production and maintain sanitary control.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ナシオン／セナクサ（パラグアイ家畜衛生局）、ニューカッスル病によりブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州産の家禽製品の輸入を禁止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物衛生事象であり、現時点で人への感染報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されていない。貿易制限は発生しているが、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに該当は限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州でのニューカッスル病発生を受けたパラグアイの家禽製品輸入禁止措置に関するもの。人への感染事例の記載はなく、動物衛生（家禽貿易）上の対応が中心。過去のアルゼンチンでのHPAI警報は参考情報として言及されているのみで、本記事の主題ではない。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importación de pollo brasileño por brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico suspends Brazilian chicken imports due to Newcastle disease outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil's Santa Catarina prompted Mexico to suspend imports of Brazilian poultry. Mexico's Secretaría de Agricultura y Desarrollo Rural (Sader) announced a ban on entry of poultry meat, offal, game birds, ornamental birds, and avian genetics such as fertile eggs and day-old chicks up to three days old to shield Mexico from infection. The outbreak was confirmed at a commercial broiler farm in Santa Catarina, Brazil. Newcastle disease, according to the World Organisation for Animal Health, causes nervous-system signs, reduced egg production, and high mortality in birds, but poses no risk to humans. The import suspension aims to prevent virus introduction via poultry products, despite no human health threat.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、記事中でも人間への健康リスクはないと明記されている。貿易制限は発生しているが、公衆衛生上の脅威ではないためIHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれも実質的に該当しない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は人獣共通感染症ではなく、人体への健康影響はないと明記されている（WOAH情報）。動物衛生・貿易上のイベントであり、公衆衛生危機管理の対象としての優先度は低い。発生地域はブラジル・サンタカタリーナ州のみで、メキシコは輸入停止措置を取った国であり発生国ではない。

article.articleHeadline: China limita importações de carne de aves de Santa Catarina após surto de doença de Newcastle - BH 24 Horas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China restricts imports of Santa Catarina poultry meat after Newcastle disease outbreak - BH 24 Horas
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompts China to suspend imports of poultry meat only from Santa Catarina, not nationwide. The confirmed focus is a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, with about 6,000 birds to be culled to contain spread. The restriction, announced by Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture (Mapa) after government negotiations with China, avoids cutting Brazilian exports entirely; Brazil has 61 establishments eligible to ship chicken to China. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease affecting domestic and wild birds; initial detection occurred in July 2024 at a broiler farm in Anta Gorda, Rio Grande do Sul. Mexico has fully banned Brazilian poultry imports, Chile restricted Santa Catarina to certain products. Mapa notes ongoing communications with importers; Embrapa says human infection is rare and usually mild conjunctivitis from exposure to infected birds.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病の発生を受け、中国がサンタカタリーナ州産鶏肉の輸入を制限
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は主に家禽の疾患であり、ヒトへの感染は稀で軽症（結膜炎程度）とされる。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められず、主に貿易・農業上の対応事案である。
triage.notes: 発生国はブラジル（サンタカタリーナ州）。中国・メキシコ・チリは輸入制限措置を取った国であり、感染発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。ヒト感染は稀かつ軽症とされており、公衆衛生イベントというより家禽疾患・貿易影響事案として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: Reuters: нигерийские власти подтвердили первый случай заражения Эболой
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Reuters: Nigerian authorities confirmed the first case of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease case. A woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda has a laboratory-confirmed infection and is receiving care in a private clinic. Authorities have identified 44 contacts and urged all health facilities nationwide to operate with heightened vigilance. The Ebola outbreak that began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo has expanded to eight provinces, with more than 9,400 infections and over 4,500 deaths. Kenya has reported nine related cases. The Nigerian case is imported from Uganda, prompting broadened surveillance and contact-tracing across the country. As of 20 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ロイター：ナイジェリア当局がエボラ出血熱の初感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続く大規模エボラ流行（9400例超、死者4500人超）が国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアにまで拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで2026年5月から続くエボラ流行（8州、9400例超、死者4500人超）とその国際的拡大（ウガンダ経由でナイジェリアに輸入例、ケニアでも9例）。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外し、対象国であるDRCのみを計上した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Epidemie breitet sich nun weiter aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic is now spreading further.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to widen, with Nigeria reporting its first case. A woman who recently flew from Uganda tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain; she is in isolation and 44 contacts—including medical personnel, other patients, caregivers, and travel contacts—have been identified. The hospital is receiving support to strengthen infection prevention and control; the government urges all public and private health facilities in the country of about 220 million to maintain high vigilance. Cross-border transmission is evident: Kinshasa said the virus has reached an eighth province; Kenya has recorded a new case, bringing its total to eight cases, including one death. Nigeria is now the fourth African country with Bundibugyo-strain cases. National totals cited: DR Congo reports 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths; Kenya eight cases (one death); Uganda 20 confirmed cases linked to a Congo patient, with two deaths. As of 20 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行がさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で続くエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行がナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへ国境を越えて拡大し、死者数も多いためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
