article.articleHeadline: Νιγηρία: Επιβεβαιώθηκε το πρώτο κρούσμα Έμπολα - Σε επιφυλακή οι υγειονομικές αρχές
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria: The first Ebola case has been confirmed - health authorities on alert.
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria: a woman who recently traveled from Uganda tested positive in Abuja on Oct 20, prompting heightened alert across public and private health facilities. Forty-four close contacts have been identified as authorities pursue rapid contact tracing to curb transmission. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola situation remains grave as the country endures its 17th outbreak since May, with more than 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths to date. Meanwhile Kenya reports its ninth Ebola case; Nairobi officials said the initial patient—a 40-something businessman who had lived in DRC—died on Oct 6, with eight additional cases arising, most linked to the first case. The United States issued a travel warning for Kenya. The convergence of outbreaks underscores the need for intensified regional surveillance and coordinated public health response in Nigeria, Kenya, and the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア：初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認 - 保健当局が警戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がナイジェリア・ケニア・DRCで同時多発的に発生し、米国がケニアへの渡航警告を発令するなど国際的な拡大・渡航制限リスクが明確であり、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア（渡航歴ありの初症例）、ケニア（9例目、米国が渡航警告発令）、DRC（17回目のアウトブレイク、9000例以上・4381人死亡）の3カ国にまたがるエボラ状況を報告。ナイジェリア・ケニア・米国・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms First Ebola Case As Congo Outbreak Spreads To Three African Regions
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case after laboratory tests detect the Bundibugyo strain in a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja; she is isolated at a private hospital, and 44 contacts have been identified for tracing. Nigeria points to its 2014 containment experience as it steps up surveillance. Uganda disputes any active outbreak. The Congo-led Bundibugyo outbreak declared in May is the second-largest in history, with more than 9,500 cases and at least 4,600 deaths (EC/DC). Uganda reported 20 related cases in May–June; WHO said Uganda was free in August. Kenya has nine cases linked to Congo, and the United States has advised visitors to Kenya to reconsider travel. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment; trials are underway. Ebola spreads via contact with infected bodily fluids, with vomiting and diarrhea among common symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが初のエボラ症例を確認、コンゴの流行がアフリカ3地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが9,500例・4,600人超の死者を出し、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへ越境拡大。IHR4基準全てに該当し、国際的な渡航制限（米国のケニア渡航再考勧告）も生じているためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで発生したエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の流行とその越境拡大（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCが流行の起点であり対象国リストに該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Santa Fe confirmó un caso importado de dengue en Rosario: había viajado a Perú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Santa Fe confirmed an imported case of dengue in Rosario: he had traveled to Peru.
article.articleSummary: An imported dengue case was confirmed in Rosario, Santa Fe: a woman who had traveled to Peru tested positive for DENV-3 and recovered favorably. Since the start of the 2026-2027 season, the province recorded 74 dengue alerts, 73 ruled out, and one imported case confirmed. Nationally, in epidemiological week 39 no new dengue cases were reported; since season start, 999 suspected cases, with four confirmed, six probable/investigating, 595 discarded, and 391 under study. Among confirmed cases, three were Buenos Aires residents with travel to Brazil and Ecuador (all DENV-3), and a fourth in Buenos Aires City who had traveled to Peru (serotype not yet determined). A probable Santa Cruz case, a Costa Rica tourist, had DENV-2 and was not yet included in the national tally. Transmission appears interrupted, but intensified surveillance is urged due to Ae. aegypti and seasonal climate. Rosario recommends eliminating standing water and cleaning containers.

triage.headline_ja: サンタフェ州、ロサリオで輸入デング熱症例を確認：ペルーへ渡航していた
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン国内での輸入デング症例であり、国内伝播は中断していると報告されている。対象国リストに該当する発生国もなく、公衆衛生上の重大性・異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にフィリピン・ブラジルが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題はアルゼンチン（ロサリオ）での輸入症例であり、ブラジルは旅行歴としての言及のみ、フィリピンへの言及はない。対象国としての該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: விருத்தாசலத்தில் டெங்கு தடுப்பு பணிகள் தீவிரம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue prevention measures intensified in Virudhachalam.
article.articleSummary: In Virudhachalam municipality, Tamil Nadu, dengue and malaria prevention measures were intensified on 20 October 2026 in the 17th ward and the North Periyar Nagar and Tiruvalluvar Nagar areas. Mosquito control teams conducted fumigation and targeted clean-up to prevent breeding around streets and homes. Residents were urged to remove stagnant water and breeding items such as old tyres, coconut husks, and discarded containers; larvicidal treatments were applied to water storage tanks and drains. The operation was led by Municipal Commissioner Nagaraj, with Health Officer Arrumugam and health inspectors Selvam and Velmurugan, supported by sanitation workers and dengue-control staff. Authorities will continue weekly ward-level deep cleaning across all wards. Businesses and residents must keep surroundings clean, avoid water stagnation, cover water tanks, and promptly remove items that harbor mosquitoes; action may be taken against shops contributing to breeding.

triage.headline_ja: ヴィルダーチャラムでデング熱予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 通常の自治体によるデング・マラリア予防の定期的な防除活動に関する報道であり、異常な発生や症例急増の記述がないため、シグナルとして取り上げる根拠に乏しい。
triage.notes: 記事はタミル・ナードゥ州ヴィルダーチャラム市における日常的な蚊媒介性疾患の防除活動（燻蒸、清掃、幼虫駆除）を報じたものであり、具体的な症例数や感染拡大の情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Review finds norovirus and rotavirus in 18% of pediatric diarrhea cases
article.articleSummary: Systematic review and meta-analysis of norovirus and rotavirus among children under five with diarrhea in lower-middle-income countries after Rotavirus vaccine introduction. Forty-five eligible studies (n=35,704) found a pooled prevalence of norovirus or rotavirus of 18% (95% CI 15–21%). Rotavirus alone was 24% (95% CI 19.6–28.3%), norovirus 13% (95% CI 11–15%). Rotavirus data required vaccine introduction timing; norovirus studies were not year-restricted. Most evidence came from cross-sectional studies; 11 reports were large-scale surveillance. Detection methods included RT-PCR (23 studies), RT-PCR plus ELISA (19), and ELISA plus multiplex RT-PCR (3). India contributed 20 studies; Bangladesh and Ethiopia four each; Nigeria three. Regional pooled estimates ranged from 11% in the Middle East to 26% in Southern Africa. Genotype data (43 studies, n=9,889; 1,840 genotypes): norovirus GII predominance (76%), GII.4 53%; rotavirus G3P[8] 39%, G1P[8] 17%, G2P[4] present. Limitations include high heterogeneity and geographic/language biases, with India disproportionately represented.

triage.headline_ja: ロタウイルスワクチン導入後、小児下痢症例の18%でノロウイルスとロタウイルスが検出されたとするレビュー
triage.triage_reason: 単一のアウトブレイクではなく、複数国・複数研究を対象とした系統的レビュー・メタアナリシスであり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術的なメタアナリシス研究の紹介であり、特定の発生イベントではないため、対象国での実際の発生事例として扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em SC: ministro explica medidas e fala sobre segurança dos alimentos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina: Minister explains measures and discusses food safety.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease was confirmed at a commercial turkey production facility in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, housing about 6,000 turkeys. The finding arose from active surveillance; samples collected Sept 21–Oct 14 and laboratory confirmation by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo (LFDA-SP) led to interdiction of the property, suspension of bird movements, and planned depopulation of the flock with cleaning, disinfection, and adherence to World Organisation for Animal Health (OIE) protocols. A monitoring zone covers Nova Itaberaba and neighboring Coronel Freitas, Nova Erechim, and Águas Frias, targeting about 133 properties for epidemiological surveillance, with visits, clinical assessments, and sample collection. There is no human health risk from consuming officially inspected poultry products. MAPA will inform trade partners; any restrictions will follow bilateral sanitary protocols, with ongoing updates as investigations proceed.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病：大臣が対策と食品安全性について説明
triage.triage_reason: 家きん（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病であり、人への健康リスクはないと明記され、監視・隔離・淘汰など標準的な動物衛生対応が既に実施されているため、公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 動物衛生事案（七面鳥のニューカッスル病）であり、人への感染リスクは明示的に否定されている。貿易上の影響（二国間衛生協定に基づく制限の可能性）はあるが、公衆衛生イベントとしてのRRAは不要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: México suspende importaciones avícolas de Brasil por brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico Suspends Poultry Imports from Brazil Due to Newcastle Disease Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspends temporarily imports of poultry products from Brazil after Brazil confirms a Newcastle disease outbreak at a commercial farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The measure, announced by the Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development (Sader) via the National Service of Health, Safety and Agro-Food Quality (Senasica), aims to protect domestic poultry production and prevent introduction of the virus. Restrictions remain while zoosanitary information is received and sanitary assurances are evaluated. Affected products include poultry meat and offal, fertile eggs for reproduction, day-old chicks up to three days old, game and ornamental birds, and birds of prey for sale; the act also covers certain pets and travelers' shipments. Newcastle disease is a viral infection of birds that requires surveillance and control to limit spread; Mexico asserts its sanitary status and will reassess. As of July 2026, Brazil was Mexico's second poultry supplier, with imports totaling 128,632 tonnes.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジルからの家禽輸入を一時停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾患であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の影響はほぼないため、IHR・WPRO基準の該当性は低い。貿易制限は発生しているが人の健康リスクとしてのシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽の動物疾患（ニューカッスル病）に関する貿易上の措置であり、ヒトの公衆衛生上の直接的リスクは認められない。メキシコは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: تأكيد أول إصابة بحمى إيبولا في نيجيريا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: First Ebola fever case confirmed in Nigeria
article.articleSummary: First Ebola virus disease case confirmed in Nigeria as of 20 October 2026. A woman arriving from Uganda was admitted to a hospital in Abuja. Nigerian health authorities identified 44 contacts of the patient. The federal government urged all health-system agencies to maintain heightened vigilance. The Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo since May, with more than 9,400 cases and over 4,500 deaths. The virus has also spread to neighboring countries, with infections and fatalities reported in Kenya and Uganda. Source: The Cable (Nigerian newspaper).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの輸入第1例確認に加え、DRCでの大規模な継続流行（9,400例超、死亡4,500例超）と複数国への拡大が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクが高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入第1症例（対象国リスト外）だが、同時に言及されているDRCでの継続流行（対象国に該当）を verified_locations に含めた。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case amid concerns about continental spread
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case: a woman who traveled from Uganda developed symptoms on Oct 7, was admitted Oct 11, and tested positive. 44 contacts are under tracing. The imported case comes amid a regional outbreak in East and Central Africa; the Democratic Republic of Congo has reported over 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths since May, described by ECDC as second-largest epidemic on record. Kenya has nine confirmed infections linked to one cluster from a traveler who moved from the DRC via Uganda; the index case died in Nairobi on Oct 5. Kenya’s latest case is a 24-year-old man in quarantine; eight of nine patients are stable. 135 contacts identified in Kenya; 134 located and quarantined, with most completing the 21-day monitoring and expected to return home after Oct 25. Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; Kenya keeps borders open for travel and commerce.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、大陸規模の拡大懸念の中で初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に9000例超・死者約4000人規模のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続し、ウガンダ・ケニア経由でナイジェリアへも越境拡大しておりIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダでの症例だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回のアウトブレイクの震源地として対象国リストに含まれるため記載。ブンディブギョ株にはワクチン・特異的治療法が存在しない点にも留意。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Announces First Case of Ebola in Current Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak ongoing with Bundibugyo strain. Nigeria reports its first case in the current outbreak: a woman who recently flew from Uganda to Abuja, diagnosed several days after starting treatment at a private hospital; she is in isolation and 44 contacts have been identified. The epicenter remains eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with over 4,600 deaths since mid-May. The virus has crossed borders to Uganda (about 20 cases, 3 deaths) and, this month, Kenya, which on Oct. 20 reported a ninth positive case since Oct. 6 after a Congo-origin patient who died; all positives had been in quarantine. In Nigeria, experts say single cases are containable with prompt isolation and contact tracing, though health workers may have been exposed due to the patient’s prior treatment. Notable imported/exported cases include a American doctor evacuated to Germany and a French doctor who recovered in France.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、現在のアウトブレイクにおける初のエボラ症例を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数国（DRC、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、死者数4,600人超、国際的な医療従事者の退避事例もあり、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はナイジェリアでの初症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。震源地であるDRCのみ対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms 1st Ebola Case in 2026
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case of 2026: a woman who flew in from Uganda was diagnosed on Oct. 20 and isolated in a private hospital. Forty-four close contacts are being traced as authorities heighten nationwide surveillance and urge facilities to promptly identify and isolate suspected cases; Nigeria’s risk assessment cites high importation risk due to regional transmission and cross-border movement. The Congo outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, remains among the largest in history with about 9,552 cases and roughly half deaths. There are no approved vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; Congo is using vaccines cleared for Zaire. Africa CDC director-general Dr. Jean Kaseya says the outbreak is the most geographically extensive, with intensified responses in Nigeria, Congo, and Kenya and vigilance in Uganda. Uganda reports 20 cases this year; Kenya notes eight linked cases with 134 quarantined contacts.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、2026年初のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ(DRC)でのBundibugyoウイルスによる大規模エボラ流行（約9,552症例、致死率約50%）が継続し、ナイジェリアへの輸入例も発生するなど国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ(DRC)でのBundibugyoウイルスによるエボラ大流行を中心に、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアへの波及を報告しているが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。承認済みワクチン・治療法が存在しない点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en RDC - L'INSP rassure sur le mécanisme de suivi des fonds de la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola in the DRC - INSP reassures on the mechanism for tracking funds for the outbreak response.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak response funding is under scrutiny, with INSP assuring a permanent tracking mechanism. Africa CDC warned that out of $962 million disbursed by donors for Ebola responses, only a little over $200 million could be traced to field implementers, leaving more than $700 million whose destination is unclear. At a Kinshasa coordination meeting (Oct 14), INSP Director-General Dieudonné Mwamba Kazadi outlined a system in which all government and partner funds are tracked, with partners asked to report committed, received, and spent amounts and sectors financed. About 30 partners have reported, with disclosed totals between $250-$300 million and receipts just over $200 million; roughly $100 million has been spent and another $100 million remains for the second-generation plan. An online tool enables weekly declarations, and weekly meetings with Africa CDC and WHO review progress. This transparency effort spans eight Ebola-affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国:エボラ出血熱対応資金の追跡メカニズムについてINSPが説明
triage.triage_reason: DRCで複数州（8州）にまたがる進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続しており、国際的な資金援助（9億6200万ドル）と透明性確保の必要性が示されていることから、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルリスク評価が妥当と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事本文は資金追跡の透明性に関する内容だが、背景にはDRC国内8州にまたがる進行中のエボラアウトブレイクがあり、既存の重大イベントとして継続監視・評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 'As pessoas não precisam ter medo', diz ABPA sobre caso de doença de Newcastle no Brasil; ouça o comentário
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "People don't need to be afraid," says ABPA about a case of Newcastle disease in Brazil; listen to the commentary.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Santa Catarina, Brazil triggers temporary suspension of chicken meat exports to several markets, according to ABPA. ABPA president Ricardo Santin and host Raphael Salomão discuss the case, urging the public not to fear. The response emphasizes rapid industry action and monitoring to contain spread. As of 20 October 2026, authorities have halted shipments of poultry products to some trading partners while investigations continue. Related updates note that Brazil’s poultry sector expects a swift, coordinated response to the Newcastle focus. However, imports from Santa Catarina may face temporary restrictions from major buyers. China has already suspended imports of poultry products from Santa Catarina following the Newcastle focus. The article highlights ongoing international trade repercussions and the importance of transparent reporting and rapid containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: 「人々は恐れる必要はない」とABPAがブラジルのニューカッスル病症例についてコメント
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンタカタリナ州で家禽のニューカッスル病が発生し貿易制限が生じているが、動物疾病であり人への健康影響の報告はなく公衆衛生上の深刻性は低い。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽疾病で人への感染リスクは極めて低い。中国は輸入停止措置を取ったのみで発生国ではないため除外。貿易・経済面での影響が主で、公衆衛生イベントとしての緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 17ᵉ épidémie de maladie à virus Ebola : quelle analyse faire de la
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak: what analysis should be made of it.
article.articleSummary: Five months after the May 15, 2026 declaration of the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, official figures as of October 17 show spread across eight provinces and 66 health zones, with more than 9,000 confirmed cases, 4,561 deaths, and 2,530 recoveries. Despite enhanced surveillance, patient care, and community mobilization, ongoing transmission and difficulties in contact tracing remain major concerns. The analysis outlines how the outbreak response should be evaluated and identifies key challenges to slow the spread and protect populations. Guests discussed include Dr. Hyppolite Kalambay, Africa CDC country director for the DRC; Dr. Laddy Yangotikala Senga, physician and Kisangani deputy; and Luc Malembe, political actor from Ituri. The article emphasizes strengthening surveillance, case management, and community engagement to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 第17次エボラウイルス病流行：どのような分析が必要か
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ出血熱が8州66保健地域に拡大し、9,000人超の確定症例・4,561人の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際拡大リスクが認められるためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 致死率が高く（約50%）、8州66保健地域に拡大中で接触者追跡に課題があるため、継続的なモニタリングとフルリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mapa suspende exportação de carne de frango à China após caso de doença de Newcastle - Ric.com.br
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MAPA suspends chicken meat exports to China after Newcastle disease case - Ric.com.br.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Brazil's MAPA suspended exports of chicken meat to China and Malaysia after a Newcastle disease case in a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. The Dipoa circular to exporters announced the measure; Mexico had already suspended Brazilian poultry imports. China remains a major buyer: Jan–Aug 2026 imports total 379,757 t (US$1.043 B), with Paraná shipments at 190,165 t (US$558.908 M). Paraná leads national poultry production/export; prolonged suspensions could mean billions in losses. Deral data show Paraná exported 1,604,954 t Jan–Aug 2026, up 20.4% YoY, and revenue US$3.017 B (+23.5%). Adapar intensified sanitary surveillance and live-bird movement checks across Paraná to support MAPA negotiations with importers. Newcastle disease is a viral avian disease (APMV-1); in humans it may cause mild conjunctivitis; meat is not a transmission route; mortality in poultry can reach 100% in confinement; no cure.

triage.headline_ja: MAPA、ニューカッスル病発生を受けて中国向け鶏肉輸出を停止 - Ric.com.br
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、ヒトへの影響は軽度の結膜炎に限られるため公衆衛生上の深刻なリスクは低く、主に貿易・経済上の影響にとどまる。
triage.notes: 中国・マレーシア・メキシコは輸出停止先として言及されているが、発生地はブラジル（サンタカタリーナ州・パラナ州）であるため、これらの国はverified_locationsに含めない。ヒトへの健康影響は軽微（結膜炎程度）で、鶏肉を介した感染経路もないとされる。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms Ebola Case in Abuja
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms a single Ebola case in Abuja: a woman who arrived on an international flight from Uganda and was treated for several days at a private hospital before laboratory tests confirmed Ebola. She is isolated and receiving care; her name, age, and virus strain are not public. Authorities have identified 44 close contacts—including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travel contacts—and are tracing them. The hospital is bolstered by infection prevention and control support. The case underscores Africa CDC’s warning of the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in history, with responses ongoing in DR Congo and Kenya; Nigeria’s confirmation adds to concerns about cross-border transmission. Patients typically present with fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea. Public urged to monitor symptoms and practice hand hygiene; report suspected exposures via NCDC line 6232 (24/7).

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの渡航者がナイジェリアでエボラ確定、44名の接触者追跡中であり、Africa CDCが史上最も地理的に広範なエボラ流行と警告している国際的拡大懸念のある事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（アブジャ）でのエボラ確定症例であり、感染源はウガンダからの渡航者。DRC・ケニアは背景情報としてAfrica CDCの流行拡大警告の文脈で言及されているのみで、記事の主題地域ではないため対象国リストには該当なし。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアはいずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms imported case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease
article.articleSummary: One imported case of Ebola Bundibugyo virus disease has been confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (Abuja). The patient, a woman with recent travel to Uganda, developed symptoms on 7 October four days after arriving in Nigeria, sought care on 11 October, and laboratory-confirmed infection on 20 October. She is in isolation and receiving medical care; investigations aim to determine the infection source and her full travel/exposure history. Nigeria has identified 44 contacts who are being monitored; infection prevention and control measures are being strengthened at the private facility involved. The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control activated its incident management system to coordinate response. WHO and partners are supporting case investigation, contact tracing, IPC, and PPE provision. The Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak began on 15 May 2026; Kenya reports nine linked cases. WHO urges sustained surveillance, no travel/trade restrictions, and ongoing risk assessment with ready response capabilities.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ・ブンディブギョウイルス病の輸入症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウ）アウトブレイクを背景に、ウガンダ渡航歴のある女性がナイジェリアで輸入症例として確認され、ケニアでも関連症例が報告されるなど複数国にまたがる拡大が確認されているためIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、感染源とみられるDRCでの進行中アウトブレイク（2026年5月15日発生）が対象国リストに該当するため含めた。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 【海外】「変形ペスト菌」流出懸念の中で中露の感染症演習を報じた「大紀元」 - 世界日報DIGITAL
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Overseas: The Epoch Times reported China-Russia infectious-disease drills amid concerns of leakage of 'deformed plague bacteria' - World Journal Digital.
article.articleSummary: An unnamed 28-year-old female researcher at Irkutsk Oblast’s Pest Control Institute died on Oct 2 from unknown pneumonia; officials said lab samples showed no work-related microbes. About 200 people who had contact were quarantined, and several Irkutsk hospitals were isolated as authorities address a suspected plague exposure. Pneumonic plague, caused by Yersinia pestis, is highly lethal and requires early antibiotic treatment. The U.S. CDC acknowledged reports of a suspected fatal pneumonic plague in Irkutsk Oblast, and the State Department urged Russia to share information promptly; the WSJ warned Moscow about potential violations of international health obligations if details are withheld; the WHO asked for more information on Oct 7. Some observers fear a lab-engineered “deformed plague bacteria” with heightened infectivity and antibiotic resistance may have leaked, though no confirmation. A China–Russia joint drill near the Heilongjiang border in August, with the Irkutsk institute director participating, suggests cross-border outbreak preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: 【海外】「変形ペスト菌」流出懸念の中で中露の感染症演習を報じた「大紀元」 - 世界日報DIGITAL
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・イルクーツクでの原因不明肺炎死亡例が肺ペストの疑いとされ、約200人が隔離、病院封鎖、WHO・米国政府が関与するなど国際的関心が高く、人為的改変菌の流出懸念も報じられているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 事件発生地はロシア・イルクーツク州であり、対象国リストに含まれない。中国（黒竜江省）は共同演習参加のみで、感染症発生地ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。情報源は意見・メディアウォッチ記事であり、未確認情報（『変形ペスト菌』流出説）を含む点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: 尼日利亚确认了一起与东非相关的埃博拉病例Australia ChinaTown News 中文华人新闻 - NEWS.CHINA.COM.AU 这里是生活在墨尔本咱自家人的地盘！把客场当主场，视异乡为故园。澳洲唐人街 - 中华澳网 China Town News澳洲唐人街;澳大利亚华人社区和主流新闻媒体
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms an East Africa-related Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-20, Nigeria confirmed an East Africa–related Ebola virus disease case in Abuja: a female patient who traveled from Uganda tested laboratory-confirmed and is in hospital isolation. Authorities began contact tracing, identifying 44 close contacts to prevent spread. Nigeria becomes the first West African nation to report a case linked to the East Africa Ebola crisis, after containing the 2014 outbreak. Ebola virus disease causes vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure and can involve bleeding; transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids. The European CDC reports the Congo (DRC) Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak since May, with at least 4,600 deaths and over 9,500 cases. Uganda has reported cases and deaths; Kenya has at least 9 infections. The United States advised reconsidering travel to Kenya and raised its travel warning. Nigeria's NCDC issued health declarations for travelers from Ebola-affected countries; others exempt. Nigeria previously contained the 2014 outbreak with at least 8 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが東アフリカ関連のエボラ症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべてに該当し、西アフリカ初の東アフリカ由来エボラ症例確認・国際的な渡航制限措置・進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（DRC含む）という重大性からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（Abuja）でのウガンダ渡航歴を持つ患者のエボラ確定例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、記事中で言及されたDRC（Bundibugyo株、5月以降4,600人超死亡・9,500人超感染）のアウトブレイクは対象国リストに該当し、本イベントの背景として重要であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola registra su primer caso en el país más poblado de África
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic records its first case in Africa's most populous country.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case: a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja and was hospitalized; 44 close contacts identified and surveillance under way. The Congo outbreak, ongoing since May, remains centered in Ituri and accounts for roughly three-quarters of confirmed cases, with more than 9,000 infections and about 4,381 deaths as of 20 October 2026. Nord-Ubangi reports two new cases in Wapinda near the Central African Republic border; Bas-Uele and adjacent areas are affected. Kenya reports nine cases linked to a single transmission cluster, including one death; the latest case is a relative of the first patient and is in quarantine. The Bundibugyo virus lacks a vaccine or treatment. Public health actions include alerts to facilities, restrictions on gatherings, and a U.S. travel advisory for Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行、アフリカ最大の人口を持つ国（ナイジェリア）で初の症例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9000例超、死亡4381人）に加え、ナイジェリア・ケニアへの国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア（初症例、44名の濃厚接触者）、ケニア（9例・死亡1例、米国渡航勧告）、中央アフリカ共和国国境地域での拡大も報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCのイトゥリ州、北ウバンギ州（ワピンダ）、バスウエレ州での継続的な感染拡大が主題。ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyoウイルス株であることも重大性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 'A questão é mais complicada': analista avalia risco para frango de SC com doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 'The issue is more complicated': An analyst assesses the Newcastle disease risk to Santa Catarina's chickens.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed Oct 18 in a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, prompting regionalized trade restrictions on Brazilian poultry. China limited the suspension to Santa Catarina, while Mexico embargoed Brazilian poultry nationwide. Fernando Iglesias of Safras & Mercado says regionalization reduces overall Brazil export risk, but warns that additional restrictions on Santa Catarina’s product remain possible. Potential losses could reach about US$139 million if both markets barred shipments nationwide; actual impact uncertain due to regionalization. Sanitary response will shape recovery; Brazil will notify MAPA and follow protocols to eradicate the outbreak, drawing on 2024 Newcastle in Rio Grande do Sul and 2025 high-pathogenic avian influenza in the state. Recovery timelines echo precedents: Mexico could take around 21 days to resume, China about 26 days in 2024. Santa Catarina may face further barriers as other markets consider embargoing its poultry; duration depends on trade decisions and disease evolution.

triage.headline_ja: 「問題はより複雑だ」：アナリストがニューカッスル病によるサンタカタリーナ州の鶏肉へのリスクを評価
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病による貿易制限の経済的影響に関する記事であり、人間の公衆衛生への直接的な影響は記載されていない。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、人間への感染リスクはごく限定的（まれに結膜炎程度）。記事の主題は貿易制限とその経済的影響であり、公衆衛生危機としての性質は乏しい。中国・メキシコは貿易制限を行った国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirmó un caso de ébola en Abuja y el brote de la cepa Bundibugyo llega a África occidental
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirmed a case of Ebola in Abuja and the Bundibugyo strain outbreak reaches West Africa.
article.articleSummary: As of 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case in Abuja, a woman who arrived on an international flight from Uganda tested positive for the Bundibugyo strain after symptom onset on 7 October and hospital admission on 11 October. She remains isolated and under treatment; authorities are tracing 44 contacts, including health workers, other patients, caregivers and travelers. Nigeria notes this as a contained case; no vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo, though two vaccine candidates are in human trials. Ebola spreads via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids and is not airborne; incubation can reach 21 days. The Bundibugyo outbreak originated in the Democratic Republic of Congo (declared 15 May), the second deadliest with about 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths as of 16 October, with linked cases in France and the Netherlands. In Kenya, a ninth case—a 24-year-old male relative in quarantine—remains in the same transmission cluster; 134 of 135 contacts are located.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャでエボラ出血熱の症例を確認、ブンディブギョ株の流行が西アフリカに到達
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが国際便を介してナイジェリアに波及し、ケニア・フランス・オランダにも関連症例があり、致死率も高く国際的拡大リスクが明確なためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: アウトブレイクの起点はDRC（2026年5月15日宣言、約9,552症例・4,602死亡）。ナイジェリア（アブジャ）、ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、オランダは関連症例が報告されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Uganda seeks Nigerian woman's travel history from FG
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Ministry of Health says there are no confirmed active Ebola cases in Uganda and is seeking detailed travel history from Nigeria about a Nigerian woman who tested positive. The woman reportedly travelled to eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo for business before transiting through Uganda in early October. Preliminary information indicates she showed no symptoms in Uganda but developed them after arriving in Nigeria, where infection was confirmed. The location of exposure remains under investigation; Nigeria's Federal Government said the patient had recently arrived from Uganda on an international flight and was admitted to a private hospital in the Federal Capital Territory for several days. Uganda notes differing accounts of her itinerary and will work with relevant agencies to strengthen screening at entry points. Public health guidance emphasizes hand hygiene, ongoing contact tracing, isolation, and infection prevention to limit Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：ウガンダ、ナイジェリア人女性の渡航歴について連邦政府に照会
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ感染例がDRC・ウガンダを経由した渡航歴を持ち、複数国にまたがる感染拡大・越境伝播の可能性があるためIHR基準を2つ以上満たす。
triage.notes: 確認された感染者はナイジェリアで発症・診断されており、ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし感染源として東部DRCへの渡航歴が明記されているため、DRCを発生関連国として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: 44 identified contacts to stay isolated for three weeks - Minister
article.articleSummary: 44 contacts of Nigeria’s confirmed Ebola patient in Abuja remain in isolation for at least three weeks, treated as imported rather than community transmission for now. The patient, an unidentified woman who recently arrived from Uganda, was asymptomatic on entry and developed symptoms after arrival; she is being treated in a private Abuja hospital. The 44 contacts—healthcare workers, patients, caregivers and travel contacts—are quarantined at a designated facility as authorities trace potential infections. Travel manifest and risk-based border surveillance guide exposure assessment; travel history is emphasized in suspected cases. The involved variant is Bundibugyo, with bleeding possible but less prominent than in some other strains. The regional outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo persists with over 8,700 cases and more than 4,200 deaths; Kenya’s first imported case occurred on Oct 6 with a ninth case by Oct 20, and Uganda reported 20 cases in May–June 2026 before ending its outbreak after 42 days.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：特定された接触者44人、3週間の隔離を継続 - 大臣
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来の輸入症例がナイジェリアで確認され、濃厚接触者44人が隔離されるなど国際的な拡大が実証されており、背景にあるコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）の大規模流行（8,700例超、死者4,200人超）も継続している。IHR基準で複数該当するためフルリスク評価へ進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（非対象国）の輸入症例だが、同系統のエボラ流行が継続しているDRC（対象国）の疫学情報（症例数・死亡者数）が具体的に記載されているため、関連情報として記録。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 遊泰染流感 嬤進加護花60萬才回台
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Trip to Thailand, contracted influenza; grandma ends up in ICU after spending NT$600,000 to return to Taiwan.
article.articleSummary: Influenza remains prevalent in Taiwan, with last week’s outpatient visits at 123,000, 159 severe cases and 44 deaths. An almost 80-year-old grandmother who had never been vaccinated contracted influenza during a trip to Thailand, required ICU care abroad for over a month, and returned home at a cost exceeding NT$600,000, illustrating the vaccination urgency for high-risk groups. Community circulation is dominated by Type A influenza, with A(H1N1) accounting for 92.7%. CECC spokesperson Lin Ming-cheng estimates the season could end in early November, depending on vaccine uptake, and notes an extension of public-funded antiviral influenza drugs to November 15. Domestic COVID-19 activity has fallen below the epidemic threshold for two weeks, with 3,873 outpatient visits last week (−27.7%), 25 local severe cases and 5 deaths. Flu vaccines administered about 3.4 million (up 1.1x); COVID vaccines about 1.07 million (up 1.4x) since Oct 1.

triage.headline_ja: タイ旅行でインフルエンザ感染、高齢女性がICU入院後60万台湾ドルかけて台湾帰国
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19の通常の流行状況報告であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。対象国（タイ）は個人旅行者の感染経路として言及されているのみで、発生地ではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は台湾国内の季節性インフルエンザ・COVID-19流行状況。タイは個人の旅行先として言及されているのみで、タイ国内での感染拡大事例ではないためverified_locationsから除外。台湾は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle: China suspende compras de carne de aves de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease: China suspends purchases of poultry meat from Santa Catarina.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a commercial turkey farming operation in Nova Itaberaba, western Santa Catarina, Brazil. The Brazilian Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA) reports temporary trade restrictions by importing partners: Mexico halted imports of all Brazilian poultry products (live birds, meat and offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental or pet birds); China restricted only Santa Catarina, limiting imports to poultry meat; Chile suspended Santa Catarina shipments including fertile and SPF eggs, day-old chicks, ornamental birds, fresh poultry meat, and products containing poultry meat. MAPA notes the China restriction followed negotiations, avoiding a nationwide ban, and states ongoing coordination with importing-country authorities, plus provision of technical information on the outbreak and control measures to enable safe trade resumption. Market monitoring continues, with updates to be issued as confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病：中国がサンタカタリーナ州産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽（七面鳥）農場でのニューカッスル病発生に伴う貿易制限の事例であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への影響は報告されていないためIHR・WPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽の動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）に関する貿易制限の報道であり、ヒト感染症としての公衆衛生リスクは記載されていない。中国・メキシコ・チリは輸入制限を行った側であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Brasil confirmó un brote de Newcastle en zona de Santa Catarina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brazil confirmed an outbreak of Newcastle disease in the Santa Catarina region.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, near Misiones, Argentina, on a commercial broiler farm. This is Brazil’s first outbreak in two years. The Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA) confirmed after epidemiological work by Santa Catarina’s Official Veterinary Service and laboratory analysis at the Federal Lab of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo. The facility was closed and live bird movements suspended; control, containment, and eradication measures are being executed under Brazil’s contingency plan for avian influenza and Newcastle disease. First samples were collected Sept 21, 2026 during active surveillance in asymptomatic birds; positive results were reported on Oct 14, prompting further sampling and genetic sequencing that identified a virulent Newcastle virus. Trade impact includes Mexico suspending Brazilian poultry meat imports; other countries imposed preventive restrictions. MAPA states inspected products remain safe to eat and market reopenings depend on sanitary guarantees.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、サンタカタリーナ州でニューカッスル病の発生を確認
triage.triage_reason: 商業養鶏場でのニューカッスル病（強毒株）発生がブラジルで2年ぶりに確認され、メキシコ等が家禽輸入を停止するなど貿易制限が実際に生じているため、IHR基準（異常性・貿易制限）に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 本事案は家禽のニューカッスル病（動物疾患）であり、ヒトへの直接感染報告はない。発生地域リストにあるアルゼンチン・メキシコは対象国リストに含まれず、記事の主題発生国はブラジルのみ。貿易面での国際的影響が確認されているため、動物衛生・貿易影響の観点からモニタリングを継続する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Le Nigeria annonce un premier cas de virus Ebola à Abuja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria announces its first case of the Ebola virus in Abuja.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case, a woman who arrived in Abuja on an international flight from Uganda; 44 close contacts are being traced and a nationwide alert has been issued. The Democratic Republic of Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak, declared in May, has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths. Kenya reports its ninth case; Ebola spreads via contact with bodily fluids and causes severe fever hemorrhagic illness. The United States warns citizens against travel to Kenya. Uganda had declared the outbreak eradicated by late August after 20 cases and 2 deaths. The current Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, though a clinical trial is underway. Africa CDC director-general Jean Kaseya called for immediate, flexible funding, diagnostic capacity, and strengthened surveillance to curb what is described as the most geographically widespread Ebola outbreak in history across three regions of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、アブジャで初のエボラウイルス感染例を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCでの大規模アウトブレイク（9000例超、4381人死亡）がナイジェリア・ケニアにも拡大し、米国が渡航警告を出すなど国際的拡大・渡航制限の両方が確認され、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行とその国際拡大（ナイジェリア、ケニア、ウガンダ）。対象国リストの中ではDRCのみが該当。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダ・米国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia suma su noveno contagio de ébola, mientras el Congo supera los 9500 afectados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its ninth Ebola case, as Congo surpasses 9,500 cases.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its ninth Ebola case, a 24-year-old male who is a relative of a 40-year-old man who died Oct 5 in Nairobi; the patient was isolated when symptoms appeared. The index case traveled from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to Nairobi via Uganda on Oct 3. Kenya is tracking 135 contacts; 134 have been located and placed under a 21-day observation, with most potentially finishing by Oct 25. Eight patients remain alive and stable; Kenya received 500 additional doses of an Ebola treatment and opened a testing lab at Kenyatta National Hospital; PPE distributed to health workers in 12 high-risk counties and 16 others. No travel restrictions have been imposed; authorities emphasize surveillance and public information campaigns. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths (as of Oct 18), across eight provinces including Nord-Ubangi; 2,550 recoveries. Vaccines or specific treatments are not yet approved; two vaccines are in early trials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで9人目のエボラ感染確認、コンゴの感染者数は9500人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行は9,552例・4,602死亡（致死率約48%）に達し、ウガンダ経由でケニアへも越境感染が発生しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるエボラ大流行（Bundibugyo株、8州に拡大）。ケニア・ウガンダは越境感染経路として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria Confirms 1st Ebola Case in 12 Years - Truth Nigeria
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms 1st Ebola case in 12 years: a laboratory-confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) case in Abuja involving a woman who arrived from Uganda. Symptoms began Oct 7; she was hospitalized Oct 11; laboratory-confirmed Oct 20. Authorities launched contact tracing for 44 potential exposures; the patient is isolated. Symptoms include fever, severe headache, muscle pain, weakness, vomiting and diarrhoea; bleeding can occur. Transmission is via direct contact with blood or bodily fluids of a symptomatic patient or contaminated objects; incubation is 2 to 21 days. Public health agencies (NCDC, FCT Health Services Secretariat) urge high alert, isolation of suspected cases, and strict PPE; 44 contacts are being monitored. This occurs amid regional Central Africa Ebola activity, including a Kenya-imported case linked to the DRC outbreak; Nigeria’s 2014 Lagos outbreak is recalled as precedent.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、12年ぶりに初のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダから入国した女性がアブジャでエボラ出血熱と検査確定され、12年ぶりの国内症例かつ44名の接触者調査が行われており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が高い。
triage.notes: 本事例はナイジェリア（アブジャ）で発生し、ウガンダからの輸入症例。記事中でDRCやケニアの流行状況は地域的背景として言及されているに過ぎず、本事例の発生国ではないため対象国リストには該当なし。ナイジェリア自体も対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Africa CDC Chief Calls For Urgent Global Support After Nigeria Confirms Case
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak prompts urgent global support after Nigeria confirms case. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya says the outbreak, declared May 15, 2026, is now the most geographically widespread Ebola event, affecting multiple countries across three African regions; DRC mortality is approaching 50%. Nigeria reports a confirmed case in the Federal Capital Territory, a woman who arrived from Uganda; laboratory tests identified Ebola Bundibugyo. Symptoms include fever, severe weakness, headache, vomiting and diarrhoea. She is isolated; 44 contacts have been traced, with surveillance of healthcare workers, patients, caregivers and travel contacts. Nigeria’s NCDC and FCT Health Services Secretariat coordinate with authorities, intensifying infection prevention in the treating hospital. Africa CDC is mobilising support for Nigeria while expanding response in the DRC and Kenya, and maintaining vigilance in Uganda. It appeals for immediate international financing, medical supplies, diagnostics and trained personnel from WHO, World Bank, Gavi, CEPI, UNICEF and others.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ:アフリカCDC長官、ナイジェリアの症例確認を受け緊急の国際支援を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで致死率約50%に及ぶエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)の流行が地理的に最も広範囲化し、ウガンダからの渡航者を介してナイジェリアに輸入例が確認されるなど国際拡大が現実化しており、Africa CDCが緊急の国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでのエボラ流行拡大に言及しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola llega a Nigeria: confirman primer caso del virus en el país tras brotes en Congo, Kenia y Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola arrives in Nigeria: first case of the virus confirmed in the country after outbreaks in Congo, Kenya and Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Ebola confirmed in Nigeria: a woman who arrived from Uganda tested positive in Abuja, marking the country’s first case and prompting health authorities to trace 44 contacts. The patient fell ill around Oct 7 and was admitted Oct 11 to a private hospital. Nigeria’s Health Minister Muhammad Pate said authorities are tracing all contacts to contain the transmission. Uganda had previously reported Ebola cases but was declared free. Kenya reported its first Ebola case earlier this month and has since recorded nine infections. Africa CDC Director-General Dr. Jean Kaseya called the outbreak an extremely grave threat, noting a case fatality rate near 50%. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak has become geographically the most extensive in history, spanning multiple countries across three African regions. Nigeria’s CDC says it has intensified surveillance and preparedness—emphasizing early detection, isolation and referral, lab diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and health worker protection.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、ナイジェリアに到達：コンゴ、ケニア、ウガンダでの発生後、同国初の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 複数国（コンゴ、ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）にまたがるエボラ出血熱の拡大が確認され、致死率約50%とAfrica CDCが『極めて深刻な脅威』と警告しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ（DRC）由来とされるブンディブジョ・エボラウイルスの広域流行について述べているが、主症例地はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアであり、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCのみ対象国として該当。

article.articleHeadline: 沒打疫苗!嬤遊泰染流感 慘噴60萬
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unvaccinated! Grandma who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza, racked up NT$600,000 in medical bills.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan reports ongoing influenza activity during the season, urging vaccination before travel. An 80-year-old grandmother who traveled to Thailand contracted influenza, was admitted to a Thai intensive care unit for a month, and incurred over NT$600,000 in medical bills after not taking the free influenza vaccine. Domestic influenza activity remains high but is easing; last week saw 123,820 influenza-like illness outpatient visits (down 5.4% from the prior week), plus 159 new influenza-related severe cases and 44 deaths. Publicly funded influenza and COVID-19 vaccines began on Oct 1; by Oct 19, about 3.4 million flu shots and 1.07 million COVID-19 shots had been administered, with strong uptake among seniors aided by the Health Coins program. The Taiwan CDC urges those aged 65+ and individuals with chronic diseases to vaccinate promptly, especially with holidays and gatherings increasing transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ワクチン未接種!祖母がタイ旅行でインフルエンザに感染、医療費60万元の大出費
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況とワクチン接種呼びかけに関する記事であり、個人の旅行先感染事例の紹介にとどまる。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は季節性インフルエンザの通常の流行状況を報じるものであり、台湾(対象国外)とタイでの個人症例を扱う。タイでの発生は旅行中の罹患であり、特異なアウトブレイクではない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case of current outbreak -- DW
article.articleSummary: Nigeria has confirmed the first known Ebola case of the current outbreak, detected in a woman who arrived by international flight from Uganda to Abuja. The patient developed symptoms on October 7, was admitted October 11, and Ebola was diagnosed after testing. Health authorities are tracing 44 contacts and implementing containment measures. The broader outbreak is centered in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo near the Uganda border and is linked to the Bundibugyo ebolavirus species, with more than 9,000 confirmed cases and over 4,300 deaths since it began in May—the second largest and fastest-spreading on record. Earlier this year Uganda reported 20 infections and two deaths and was declared Ebola-free at the end of August after 42 days with no cases. Kenya has nine cases linked to a single index patient. The Nigeria case is imported.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、現在のエボラ流行における最初の症例を確認 -- DW
triage.triage_reason: DRCを中心に9,000例超・4,300人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行があり、ウガンダ、ケニアに続きナイジェリアへも国際的な飛び火が確認された。IHR基準の複数該当かつ重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでも症例が確認されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な流行地はDRC東部（ウガンダ国境付近）であり、Bundibugyoエボラウイルス種による流行。

article.articleHeadline: Emergencia sanitaria: Brasil detectó un brote de Newcastle en una granja de pavos y México suspendió las compras de pollo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Public health emergency: Brazil detected a Newcastle disease outbreak at a turkey farm, and Mexico suspended chicken purchases.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease confirmed at a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, housing about 6,000 turkeys. Immediate movement restrictions were imposed and 133 properties in the region were placed under monitoring to contain the outbreak. Confirmation followed analysis of samples collected September 21–October 14 by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo. The eradication plan includes culling affected birds, cleaning and disinfection of facilities, and other sanitary measures, led by Brazil’s Ministry of Agriculture and the Santa Catarina Official Veterinary Service. Minister André de Paula said surveillance will determine whether the virus circulates beyond the farm; the 133 properties under follow-up do not equal 133 confirmed foci. Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian poultry (meat, live birds, fertile eggs, and related products) to protect its industry. Newcastle is highly contagious in birds; human risk is mild, mainly conjunctivitis, and inspected products are considered safe.

triage.headline_ja: 公衆衛生緊急事態：ブラジルで七面鳥農場においてニューカッスル病の発生を検出、メキシコは鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病の発生が確認され、メキシコが家禽製品の輸入を停止するなど貿易制限が生じているが、ヒトへの健康リスクは軽度（結膜炎程度）とされ、周辺133農場の監視結果など続報が必要な段階。
triage.notes: 本事例は主に動物衛生（家禽）に関するもので、ヒトへの健康リスクは軽度とされている。メキシコによる輸入停止という貿易措置が既に発生しているため、今後のウイルス拡散状況（133農場の監視結果）を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirmó su primer caso de ébola en una mujer llegada de Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in Abuja amid the Bundibugyo variant outbreak. A woman who recently traveled from Uganda developed symptoms on October 7, was hospitalized on October 11, and was laboratory-confirmed, with isolation and medical supervision ongoing. Authorities identified 44 contacts—healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and fellow passengers—receiving active monitoring to detect secondary transmission. Nigeria’s NCDC has strengthened surveillance to guard against cross-border spread; no travel restrictions have been announced. The regional outbreak began in May 2026 in the Democratic Republic of Congo, reporting 4,381 deaths and more than 9,000 confirmed cases. Kenya reported its first Ebola cases in early October and now totals nine; Uganda had prior infections but was declared Ebola-free before the traveler’s case. The event underscores the need for rapid contact tracing, case isolation, and infection prevention to contain spread across West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから入国した女性のエボラ感染を初確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPRO基準も全て該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・アンゴラは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。地域アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRCのみ対象国として計上。Bundibugyo株による大規模アウトブレイク（DRC発、4,381名死亡、9,000例超）が背景にあり、国境を越えた複数国への拡大が継続している点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Yellow fever: Three deaths confirmed, 15 under investigation in Upper West
article.articleSummary: Three yellow fever deaths in Ghana’s Upper West Region have been scientifically confirmed, with 15 suspected deaths under investigation. Confirmed deaths followed laboratory-confirmed cases after samples tested in Ghana and confirmed at a WHO-accredited lab in Dakar, Senegal. Suspected institutional deaths: Wa East (3), Sissala West (3), Sissala East (3), Nadowli-Kaleo (1); suspected community deaths: Sissala East (4), Wa West (1). Outbreak investigations cite fever, jaundice, and bleeding. Authorities have activated national and regional emergency operations centres, deployed rapid response teams, strengthened surveillance, and educated residents. A targeted emergency vaccination campaign is planned for Wa West, Sissala West, and Sissala East. Ghana had about 450 suspected yellow fever cases nationwide from June–September 2026, with 74 in Upper West and three confirmed regionally at the time. Public advised to seek care for fever/jaundice/bleeding, avoid self-medication, remove stagnant water, use nets and insecticide-treated nets; stay calm and rely on official updates.

triage.headline_ja: 黄熱病:アッパーウエスト州で3人の死亡確認、15人が調査中
triage.triage_reason: ガーナのアッパーウエスト州で黄熱病による死亡者がWHO認定ラボで確認され、緊急ワクチン接種キャンペーンや緊急事態対応センターの活動化など公衆衛生対応が進行しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: セネガル(ダカール)はラボ確認地点として言及されているのみで、発生国はガーナのみ。ガーナ全体で2026年6-9月に約450例の疑い例が報告されており、アウトブレイクは継続中とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Frenó México entrada de carne aviar brasileña por brote de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mexico halts Brazilian poultry meat imports due to Newcastle disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mexico halted imports of Brazilian poultry meat and related products as of 20 October 2026 due to a confirmed Newcastle disease outbreak. The outbreak was detected in turkeys on a commercial poultry facility in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil. The ban covers poultry meat, offal, fertile eggs, day-old chicks, cage birds, ornamental birds, game birds, and pets from Brazil, and applies to travelers’ belongings, in order to protect Mexico’s poultry industry, which is Newcastle-free. Newcastle disease is an acute viral infection that is highly contagious and potentially lethal to domestic and wild birds. Human infections are very rare and not a public health concern, typically occurring only in people with direct, prolonged exposure to high concentrations of virus without protection. The article centers on trade restrictions and outbreak confirmation, with no reported human health impact.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病の発生によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生上の貿易制限事例であり、ヒトへの健康影響は報告されていないが、貿易制限が発生しているため動向を注視する。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の動物疾病であり、ヒトへの感染は極めて稀かつ公衆衛生上の懸念は低いと記事内に明記されている。メキシコはブラジルからの輸入停止措置を取ったのみで、メキシコ国内での発生はない。

article.articleHeadline: Foco da doença de Newcastle no Brasil mobiliza monitoramento em 133 granjas - Ciência - Aqui
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease focus in Brazil mobilizes surveillance in 133 poultry farms - Science - Here.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease focus in Nova Itaberaba, Western Santa Catarina, Brazil, triggers surveillance across 133 poultry farms after a commercial turkey finishing farm housing about 6,000 birds confirmed the outbreak. The Official Veterinary Service ordered the facility closed, suspended bird movement, and initiated sanitary culling of the entire batch with subsequent disinfection; activity resumption depends on compliance and absence of new cases. Active investigations span Nova Itaberaba, Nova Erechim, Coronel Freitas, and Águas Frias. Diagnosis was confirmed by the Federal Laboratory of Agricultural Defense in São Paulo (LFDA-SP), an OMSA reference lab. Despite no clinical signs in the flock, authorities emphasize enhanced biosafety. Newcastle disease is caused by avian paramyxovirus type 1 (APMV-1). In humans, transmission occurs by contact and may cause transient conjunctivitis. Food safety remains assured for officially inspected poultry and eggs bearing SIM, SIE, or SIF seals.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでニューカッスル病発生、133養鶏場で監視体制強化
triage.triage_reason: 家禽でのニューカッスル病発生事例であり、ヒトへの影響は軽微（一過性結膜炎程度）だが、ブラジルは主要家禽輸出国であるため国際貿易制限リスクの観点から継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本疾患は主に家禽に影響する動物衛生イベントであり、ヒトでの重症化例は報告されていない。当局により隔離・淘汰・消毒等の対応が既に実施されており、現時点で国際的拡大の兆候は確認されていないが、貿易制限（輸出停止等）の可能性があるため経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: CDC Hà Tĩnh khuyến cáo phòng ngừa bệnh do não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hà Tĩnh CDC recommends meningococcal disease prevention.
article.articleSummary: Hà Tĩnh CDC urges meningococcal disease prevention after a cluster of four meningococcal group B cases at a secondary school in Ho Chi Minh City, including one death. Meningococcal disease is an acute infection caused by Neisseria meningitidis, transmitting mainly via respiratory droplets from close contact; asymptomatic carriers can spread. Early symptoms are nonspecific—fever, headache, fatigue, sore throat—but can rapidly progress to meningitis, septicemia, multi-organ failure, or death, with potential lasting deafness or neurological damage. Dr. Nguyen Chi Thanh, Hà Tĩnh CDC Director, notes serogroups A, B, C, Y, W cause invasive disease and transmission thrives in crowded settings. Vaccination is important but vaccines cover different serogroups; consult vaccination centers for the appropriate vaccine. Besides immunization, emphasize hygiene, ventilated spaces, handwashing, and limiting close contact in schools and workplaces. Seek urgent care for fever with severe headache, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, or meningocutaneous rash.

triage.headline_ja: ハティン省CDC、髄膜炎菌感染症の予防を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の中学校で髄膜炎菌B群感染症のクラスター（4例、うち1例死亡）が発生し、CDCが注意喚起を行っている。重症例・死亡例があり、学校という集団生活環境でのヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるため精査が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はハティン省CDCによる一般的な予防啓発だが、発端はホーチミン市の中学校での髄膜炎菌B群クラスター（4例、1死亡）。学校という閉鎖的集団環境での感染拡大リスクがあり、続報（症例数の推移、他地域への拡大有無）の確認が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms first Ebola case amid concerns about continental spread
article.articleSummary: First Ebola case in Nigeria confirmed in Abuja: a woman who travelled from Uganda showed symptoms Oct 7, was admitted Oct 11, and laboratory-confirmed; 44 contacts are being traced. In Kenya, the ninth Ebola case is a 24-year-old man already in quarantine after close contact with the first Kenyan patient who travelled from the DRC via Uganda and died in Nairobi on Oct 5. All nine infections belong to one cluster; no transmission outside this group as of Oct 20. Eight patients are stable; 134 of 135 contacts have been traced and quarantined, with most likely to complete the 21-day monitoring and return home from Oct 25. No infections in quarantine facilities; Kenya remains open for travel and business. In the DRC, more than 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths since May; Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda had previous cases but was declared free.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアが初のエボラ症例を確認、大陸規模の拡大懸念
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,000例以上・死亡約4,000人という大規模流行が継続しており、ウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアへ越境拡大していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン・特効薬未承認）が発端となり、ウガンダ経由でケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大した事例。ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、発生源であるDRCの流行状況が国際拡大の中心であるため記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirms Ebola case in patient who arrived from Uganda
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms an Ebola case in a patient who arrived from Uganda; the patient is in isolation in a private Abuja hospital, with 44 contacts identified and under tracing. Uganda says there is no Ebola in the country. Nigerian minister Pate notes Nigeria contained Ebola in 2014 and has the capacity to respond. The Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in mid-May and has grown into the world's second-largest outbreak. Uganda reported 20 cases in May and June, mostly imported from Congo, and was declared free of the virus by the WHO in August. Kenya has reported nine Ebola cases this month, all linked to a traveler from Congo. Africa's top public health agency says this Bundibugyo outbreak is the most geographically extensive in history, affecting countries across three regions of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから到着した患者にエボラ感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国を起源として複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）に拡大しており、アフリカ史上最も地理的に広範な流行とされ、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）を起源とするBundibugyo型エボラ流行の多国間拡大。ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外したが、エボラ流行自体はDRCを起点に複数国へ拡大している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: نيجيريا تعلن تسجيل أول إصابة بفيروس إيبولا | القاهرة الاخبارية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports the first Ebola virus infection | Cairo News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Nigeria reports its first Ebola virus disease infection: a woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda on an international flight. She was hospitalized at a private facility, treated for several days before confirmation, and is currently isolated. Contact tracing has identified 44 direct contacts to date, with health teams monitoring exposed healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and fellow travelers. Enhanced infection prevention and control measures are in place at the hospital, with immediate support provided. Africa CDC Director Jean Kasia had warned that Ebola threatens neighboring countries as the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues its outbreak. The report underscores regional vigilance as Ebola circulates in nearby areas, prompting intensified surveillance and cross-border preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラウイルス感染の初症例を報告 | カイロ・ニュース
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの国際便で入国した女性がナイジェリア初のエボラ症例として確認され、44人の接触者が追跡されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はナイジェリア（対象国外）での輸入症例であり、ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での既存アウトブレイクは文脈として言及されているが、本記事の主題イベント（ナイジェリア初症例）の発生国ではないため、verified_locationsには含めない。国際的な感染拡大リスクを示す重要な事例として監視継続が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Governo Ronaldo registra 1.050 casos confirmados de chikungunya em Feira de Santana em 2026 e prepara implantação do método Wolbachia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ronaldo government records 1,050 confirmed chikungunya cases in Feira de Santana in 2026 and prepares deployment of the Wolbachia method.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil, recorded 1,050 laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases with 1,868 notifications from January through mid-October 2026, a sharp rise from 2025’s 30 notifications and 18 confirmations by late October. The municipality intensified Aedes aegypti control, including home visits and removal of standing water, and plans to deploy Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes to reduce transmission of chikungunya, dengue, and Zika. The initiative, coordinated by the Municipal Endemics Control Center, complements ongoing vector surveillance and community outreach; officials emphasize resident participation to eliminate containers and permit field teams. Wolbachia is described as a supplementary tool, not a substitute for water-source elimination or surveillance. New staff are being hired to bolster operations, and epidemiological surveillance has expanded training to improve case identification and notification. Dengue saw 3,347 suspected cases with 318 confirmations in Jan–Oct 2026 and one dengue death; 2025 totals were 2,676 and 256, respectively.

triage.headline_ja: ロナウド市長政権、2026年にフェイラ・デ・サンタナでチクングニア熱1,050例の確定症例を記録、ウォルバキア法導入を準備
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バイア州の一自治体における季節性蚊媒介感染症（チクングニア・デング・ジカ）の症例増加であり、前年比で大幅増加しているものの、国際的拡大や渡航貿易制限のリスクは低く、自治体レベルで対応可能と見られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 前年比で症例数が大幅増加（チクングニア確定例18→1,050）しているが、自治体の媒介蚊対策（ウォルバキア法含む）で対応中であり、国際的な懸念事象ではなく地域の季節性アウトブレイクと判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma su primer caso de ébola en una mujer que llegó de Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms its first case of Ebola in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola case in a woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja. Authorities traced 44 close contacts who were exposed to the patient, who is isolated and under observation after receiving care at a private hospital. As of 2026-10-20, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 9,000 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths; Kenya reports 9 infections and 1 death in the same outbreak. The Bundibugyo Ebola strain, with about 50% fatality and no approved treatment or vaccines, dominates this crisis. This year, two vaccines for the outbreak strain entered human trials. France and the Netherlands reported infections but limited impacts. The World Health Organization continues to monitor what is described as one of Africa’s fastest-spreading outbreaks, with a historical note to the 2014–2016 outbreak that killed about 11,000 people.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから到着した女性にエボラ出血熱の初症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（9000人超の感染、4381人死亡）が拡大し、ナイジェリアでも輸入症例が確認されるなど国際的拡大が進行しており、IHR基準複数該当・WPRO基準も複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: DRCにおけるエボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株、致死率約50%）が主たる発生源であり、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの波及が報告されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico suspends chicken imports from Brazil over Newcastle disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil leads Mexico to suspend imports of chicken meat, live birds, and fertile eggs from Brazil to prevent spread. Mexico's Senasica halted commercial imports and tourist-carried products. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious avian respiratory infection causing neurological disorders, reduced egg production, and high mortality; it poses no serious risk to humans. Brazil first detected the outbreak at a southern commercial turkey farm on Sunday, with confirmation at a commercial broiler farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, on Monday; facilities were closed and control measures implemented. Brazil exports about 30% of its chicken production, and in 2025 Mexico was Brazil's seventh-largest poultry buyer. This is the second suspension in 17 months after avian influenza outbreaks in 2025. Analysts say the outbreak is unlikely to cause lasting damage if contained quickly; the last Newcastle outbreak was July 2024 in Rio Grande do Sul. Reports: Noticias DW, Reuters.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ニューカッスル病流行を受けブラジルからの鶏肉輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病でヒトへの重大リスクはなく、既知の疾病であり異常性も低い。貿易制限は発生しているが人の公衆衛生危機ではないためフルRRAの対象外。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、人への健康リスクはないと記事中で明記されている。貿易上の影響（メキシコの輸入停止）はあるが、公衆衛生上の緊急事態には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: "إيبولا" يصل إلى نيجيريا.. إصابة في أبوجا وتعقب 44 مخالطاً
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola reaches Nigeria; a case in Abuja and 44 contacts traced.
article.articleSummary: On 21 October 2026, Nigeria reported a laboratory-confirmed Ebola case in Abuja in a woman who arrived from Uganda. Symptoms began on 7 October after arrival; she was treated at a private clinic on 11 October and is in isolation. On 20 October, tests identified Ebola virus of the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain. Nigeria has traced 44 contacts and activated the National Public Health Emergency Operations Center with WHO support to reinforce isolation, screening, and infection control. Ugandan authorities say the patient travelled through Uganda after a visit to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo; there is no active outbreak in Uganda. Ebola transmits by direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated objects; symptoms include fever, weakness, headache, vomiting, and diarrhea within 2–21 days. The WHO notes Nigeria is the fifth country to report Bundibugyo since the Congo outbreak began on 15 May, and does not recommend travel restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: 「エボラ」がナイジェリアに到達…アブジャで感染確認、接触者44人を追跡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（ブンディブギョ株）が国境を越えてナイジェリアに波及し、国際的拡大が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の双方で複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 確定症例はナイジェリア（アブジャ）で発生しているが、同国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源である東部DRCでの流行（2026年5月15日開始、ブンディブギョ株）が本事象の根幹であり、DRCを発生国として計上。ウガンダは経由地であり同国内でのアクティブな流行はないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞出現伊波拉首例　疫情擴散多國非洲疾管官員示警 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports first Ebola case; outbreak spreading to multiple countries, African disease-control officials warn.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 21, 2026, Nigeria confirmed its first Ebola case since 2014: a woman who arrived in Abuja from Uganda; after several days in a private hospital she was diagnosed and isolated, with 44 close contacts traced. Kenya reported its 9th Ebola case—the 24-year-old male relative of the first deceased case—also in isolation. Africa CDC says Ebola Bundibugyo has the widest geographic spread in history, spanning three regions across Africa, with the Democratic Republic of the Congo outbreak (May–present) recording >9,000 confirmed cases and about 4,381 deaths; case fatality near 50% in DRC. International action urged: funding, medical supplies, and healthcare personnel. Uganda reports no active cases. The United States issued a health-risk travel advisory for Kenya on the same day.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアでエボラ出血熱の初症例確認、アフリカ複数国へ感染拡大、アフリカ疾病対策官が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR4基準すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常事態、国際拡大、渡航制限発生）し、WPRO基準も全て該当するためフルリスク評価に進めるべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）での大規模アウトブレイク（9000例超、死者4381人、致死率約50%）が中心であり、ナイジェリア・ケニア・ウガンダへの波及が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。米国はケニアへの渡航勧告を発出。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू के इन गंभीर लक्षणों को भूलकर भी न करें अनदेखा, सेहत के लिए हो सकता है खतरनाक
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't ignore these serious dengue symptoms; they could be dangerous for your health.
article.articleSummary: Across India, dengue cases are rising this year, with New Delhi reporting a spread of dengue fever transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes. Dengue involves four serotypes that influence antibody responses and can progress to severe forms—DHF or DSS—though these are uncommon; children are at higher risk. Early recognition and treatment per WHO can reduce mortality to below 1%. Severe dengue usually appears 3–7 days after onset, with high fever, headache, retro-orbital pain, joint and muscle pains, fatigue, nausea, vomiting, rash, and loss of appetite, then may advance to abdominal pain, breathing, persistent vomiting, blood in urine, fluid leakage, bleeding gums or nose, liver involvement, and a drop in platelets, often requiring ICU care and interventions such as IV fluids, oxygen, and sometimes blood products. For milder dengue, rest, hydration, and platelet monitoring are advised; coconut water is suggested, along with a diet including giloy, papaya, kiwi, pomegranate, beetroot, and leafy greens.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱のこれらの深刻な症状を見逃さないで。健康に危険を及ぼす可能性があります
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の症状と対処法に関する一般向け健康啓発記事であり、具体的な症例数やアウトブレイクの詳細、異常な拡大等の情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の季節性流行に関する一般的健康啓発コンテンツであり、具体的な症例数・発生規模・緊急対応の必要性に関する情報が欠如しているため、DISMISS判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh não mô cầu: Bệnh diễn biến nhanh, không nên bỏ qua dấu hiệu ban đầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease: Rapid progression, do not ignore early signs.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease, caused by Neisseria meningitidis, can be carried in the nasopharynx of healthy individuals but may invade blood or meninges, triggering septicemia and meningitis with severe complications. In Vietnam, teenagers are a key at-risk group, and crowded settings such as boarding schools, dormitories, and barracks facilitate transmission. Early signs include fever, headache, myalgia, nausea/vomiting; rapid deterioration can occur, with severe headache, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, seizures, and petechial or purpuric rashes that may appear anywhere, including the legs. Not all patients show classic signs; urgent medical evaluation for sudden deterioration is essential. Even with antibiotics, mortality is 10–15%, and about 20% of survivors have long-term sequelae (hearing loss, brain injury, neuro disorders). Public health targets close contacts for prophylactic antibiotics based on exposure risk; vaccination with MenACWY (A, C, W, Y) and MenB protects against different groups. Carriage does not equal disease; promote vaccination planning and hygiene.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性疾患：急速に進行する病気、初期症状を見逃さないで
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な疾患啓発・教育記事であり、特定の発生・アウトブレイクを報じるものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は髄膜炎菌性疾患に関する一般的な医学啓発記事であり、ベトナムでの具体的な発生事例・アウトブレイクの報告ではない。特定の症例数や集団発生に関する情報がないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: ヒッタイト王国の粘土板文書131枚がトルコで発掘される、3400年前の流行病や当時の兵站などが明らかに
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 131 clay tablets from the Hittite Kingdom unearthed in Turkey reveal a 3,400-year-old epidemic and the logistics of the era.
article.articleSummary: 131 royal clay tablets dating to c.1375–1355 BCE from the Hittite kingdom, found at Kayalıpınar in central Türkiye near Samuha, illuminate ancient governance and military logistics. Written in Hittite and Hurrian, the tablets document a fever outbreak that spread among cities, with infants and young children most affected; one tablet notes a princess's death from fever and the ensuing funeral rites. The royal archive records health of princes and princesses into adulthood, reflecting belief that illness reflected divine will and priests monitored royal offspring. Military correspondence shows a general requesting soldiers, horses, and chariots, highlighting provisioning and accountability across distant garrisons. A separate bird-divination diary traces the routes of a traveling omen-caster. Turkish Culture and Tourism Minister Mehmet Nuri Ersoy states the documents reveal 3400-year-old state governance, military development, belief-world, and royal-family life.

triage.headline_ja: ヒッタイト王国の粘土板文書131枚がトルコで発掘される、3400年前の流行病や当時の兵站などが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 3400年前の歴史的出来事に関する考古学記事であり、現代の公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は古代ヒッタイト王国時代（紀元前1375-1355年頃）の粘土板文書発見に関する考古学的・歴史的報道であり、現代の感染症流行事例ではない。発生地域に記載されたトルコ・インドは現代の公衆衛生事象とは無関係。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亚通报首起伊波拉病例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case. On 2026-10-20, a female patient who arrived in Abuja from Uganda—where Ebola outbreaks have spread after the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared a large outbreak in May—has tested positive for Ebola. She was admitted to a private hospital for treatment and confirmed infected after several days. The patient is in isolation under medical care. Contact tracing has started, with 44 close contacts identified to date. Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said authorities will monitor and manage potential exposure, as the case represents an imported Ebola infection from East Africa into Nigeria. No further details on symptoms or severity were provided; the government is coordinating surveillance and public health measures to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、エボラ出血熱の初症例を通報
triage.triage_reason: ナイジェリアでの初のエボラ輸入症例であり、DRCでの大規模流行・ウガンダへの拡大という国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは今回の流行の発生源として本文で明示的に言及されているため含めた。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれず除外。

article.articleHeadline: Doença de Newcastle em SC leva países a restringir produtos de aves
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease in Santa Catarina leads countries to restrict poultry products.
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease outbreak confirmed at a farm in the western region of Santa Catarina, Brazil, prompting the federal government to declare a 60-day zoosanitary emergency across municipalities in western Santa Catarina. The measure aims to address the occurrence and alert Brazil’s poultry sector. The confirmation has international repercussions, with more countries announcing restrictions on Brazilian poultry products after the outbreak. The event underscores the vulnerability of Brazil’s aviculture and export markets to Newcastle disease and the potential disruption to international trade. As of 2026-10-20, authorities have issued the emergency declaration and are monitoring the affected region as the situation develops.

triage.headline_ja: サンタカタリーナ州のニューカッスル病、各国の家禽製品輸入制限を招く
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病ではあるが、国際貿易制限（渡航・貿易制限リスク）が既に発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とブラジル養鶏産業への重大な影響があるためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒト感染症ではなく家禽の動物疾病（ニューカッスル病）であり、公衆衛生上の直接リスクは低いが、国際貿易制限と養鶏産業への影響が大きいため経過観察・評価対象とする。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Nigeria ghi nhận ca bệnh đầu tiên trong đợt bùng phát mới nhất
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Nigeria reports first case in the latest outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria reports the first Ebola case in the current outbreak, a woman who arrived in Abuja on an international flight from Uganda and was treated at a private hospital for days before confirmation. Health authorities have initiated contact tracing, identifying 44 close contacts, including health workers, patients, and caregivers, with ongoing monitoring of those at risk along the patient’s travel path. The outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of the Congo in May and has spread to Uganda and Kenya; DR Congo reported 4,381 deaths among more than 9,000 confirmed cases as of 20 October. Kenya also reported its 9th case on the same day. Ebola transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids of infected or deceased individuals; early detection, isolation, and infection-control measures are crucial. Vietnam’s Civil Aviation Authority urges enhanced screening of travelers from Ebola-affected regions to prevent importation.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：ナイジェリアが最新の流行で初の症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する可能性が高く、コンゴ民主共和国を起点とした多国間（ウガンダ、ケニア、ナイジェリア）への国際的拡大が確認されており、致死率も高いためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア、ウガンダ、ケニアでの発生が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ベトナムは渡航者スクリーニング強化を実施しているのみで実際の発生国ではないため除外。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は今回の流行の起点であり、9,000例超・死亡4,381例が報告されているため対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: A Doença de Newcastle, detectada no Brasil, traz risco para os humanos?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Newcastle disease, detected in Brazil, poses a risk to humans?
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease (NDV) detected in a turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina, Brazil, as of 2026-10-20, marking a focal outbreak. Although lab tests confirmed the virus, the birds were asymptomatic at detection. NDV is a highly contagious avian virus (Orthoavulavirus javaense) that mainly affects birds and can cause up to 100% mortality in flocks. Transmission occurs mainly through direct contact with contaminated secretions; the virus survives on surfaces days to weeks and can spread via contaminated clothing. In commercial farms, introduction can infect virtually all birds within two to six days. Human infection is possible but extremely rare and generally mild, with flu-like or conjunctival symptoms; risk is mainly for workers handling birds, mitigated by PPE.
