China and Mexico have suspended some Brazilian poultry imports; authorities in SC have started quarantine, culling of infected and exposed animals, disposal, and disinfection. This outbreak triggers management communication.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルで検出されたニューカッスル病、人への感染リスクはあるか？
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの七面鳥農場でニューカッスル病（家禽ウイルス）が検出されたが、ヒトへの感染は極めて稀で軽症とされ、現地当局が検疫・殺処分で対応済み。公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: China・Mexicoはブラジル産鶏肉の輸入を一部停止した国として言及されているのみで、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外。本事例は主に家禽産業・貿易への影響であり、ヒトへの感染リスクは記事内で明確に「極めて稀で軽症」と記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola se ceba con los niños en el Congo: mueren hasta el 80% de los menores de cinco años contagiados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is taking its toll on children in the Congo: up to 80% of those under five who are infected die.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo) with 9,552 confirmed cases and over 4,600 deaths. No vaccine yet. Children under five face the highest mortality, around 60–70% overall, exceeding 80% in treatment centers such as Butembo (North Kivu). From June to September 2026, 24 of 30 pediatric admissions, most under five, died from Bundibugyo Ebola virus. MSF cites rapid disease progression and limited access to pediatric care as drivers, noting gaps in dosing guidelines, pediatric formulations, and infection prevention and control (IPC) measures in non-specialized centers. Hospitals report shortages of PPE and insufficient staff training. Urges strengthening IPC, PPE, and pediatric-focused care to preserve essential services and curb transmission. The outbreak began in Ituri (May) and has extended to Kivu and Tshopo regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが子供たちを襲う：感染した5歳未満児の最大80%が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラ流行が継続・拡大し9,552例・4,600人超の死亡と深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、IHR基準・WPRO基準とも複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ワクチン未確保、小児死亡率の高さ、PPE・IPC体制の不備が指摘されており、国際支援の必要性が高い。複数州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo）への拡大が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Agentes encontram larvas em dez criadouros durante visitas a imóveis em Limeira
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Agents find larvae in ten breeding sites during visits to properties in Limeira.
article.articleSummary: During a dengue-control operation in Limeira, 71 agents visited 2,048 properties on Saturday, October 17, 2026, identifying 94 Aedes aegypti breeding sites. Of these, 70 contained water and 10 harbored larvae. The effort ran from 7:30 a.m. to 12:00 p.m. across Parque Residencial Belinha Ometto, Geada, Jardim Águas da Serra, and Jardim Residencial Village. Teams surveyed residences to locate and eliminate potential mosquito breeding grounds; the report did not detail which containers housed the breeding sites or quantities per neighborhood. City hall urged residents to remove containers that can accumulate water to aid ongoing dengue prevention and control. Residents were urged to remove standing water around homes.

triage.headline_ja: リメイラ市内の住宅訪問で10カ所の孵化場所から幼虫発見
triage.triage_reason: 日常的な蚊防除活動の報告であり、症例報告や健康被害の記述がなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱予防のための蚊幼虫駆除活動の定例報告であり、実際の感染例・患者数の記載なし。ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれるが、イベント自体が通常の防除活動であるため発生地域としては計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Parrot Fever Hits Thailand: Health Experts Urge Caution
article.articleSummary: Thailand confirms its first human case of parrot fever (psittacosis) in a bird owner in Bangkok. Local health authorities verified the diagnosis in early 2026; the patient reportedly contracted the illness late last year and has made a complete recovery after early antibiotic treatment. Parrot fever spreads when people inhale dust from dried bird droppings or feathers, typically in enclosed spaces, and human-to-human transmission is extremely rare. The case underscores risks for aviary workers, poultry farmers, and dedicated bird owners, especially those who keep birds in poorly ventilated environments without protective gear. Prevention focuses on a clean, well-ventilated space; wetting cages before cleaning; wearing masks and gloves during cage maintenance; and thorough handwashing. If birds appear unwell or fever/dry cough develops after bird exposure, seek medical care promptly and inform physicians about exposure.

triage.headline_ja: オウム病がタイで確認：専門家が注意を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 単発のヒト感染例であり、患者は早期治療により完治、ヒト-ヒト感染も極めてまれなため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 鳥類飼育者における散発的なオウム病感染例であり、既に回復済み。ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは極めて低く、継続的な監視以上の対応は不要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا" يودي بحياة 4561 شخصا في الكونغو وإصابات كينيا ترتفع إلى 8
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 4,561 people in Congo, and Kenya's cases rise to 8.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to hit the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 4,561 deaths from 9,455 confirmed infections as of October 17, 2026, according to the Ministry of Health, a case fatality rate of 48.2%. In Kenya, Ebola cases rose to eight after a new infection was confirmed among 38 tested, according to the Director-General of Health Patrick Amoth. The latest case is linked to a man believed to have been in contact with the first case identified in the country, with authorities tracing contacts. Kenya previously reported the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain earlier this month; the patient died after arriving from the Democratic Republic of Congo via Uganda. The outbreak has regional concern since there is no vaccine or specific treatment for this strain, and Africa CDC warns of potential spread to neighboring countries.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴで4561人死亡、ケニアの感染者は8人に増加
triage.triage_reason: DRCで多数の死者を伴う大規模アウトブレイクが継続し、ケニアへの越境拡大も確認されており、IHR基準の複数(深刻性・異常性・国際拡大)に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。Africa CDCが近隣国への拡大を警告している点は留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola hits Nigeria, 44 contacts under surveillance
article.articleSummary: Imported Ebola virus disease case confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory, Abuja, with 44 contacts under surveillance. The patient, a woman who travelled from Uganda in Eastern Africa, developed symptoms on Oct 7, sought care Oct 11, and was laboratory-confirmed on Oct 20, 2026. She is in isolation; contact tracing underway, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers. The Nigeria Ministry of Health, Nigeria Centre for Disease Control, FCT Health Secretariat, WHO, and Africa CDC coordinate, with private hospitals receiving support to strengthen infection prevention and control. Africa CDC warns of regional implications of the Bundibugyo outbreak, which already affects Kenya (9 confirmed cases) and the Democratic Republic of the Congo; mortality rate in DRC approaching 50%. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood or body fluids or contaminated materials; incubation 2-21 days; early symptoms resemble malaria. Africa CDC calls for urgent international support to contain cross-border spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がナイジェリアで発生、接触者44人を監視下に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当し、複数国（ウガンダ・ケニア・DRC・ナイジェリア）にまたがるエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）の国際的拡大事例であり、Africa CDCが国際支援を要請している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは地域拡大の主要被害国として言及されており、致死率約50%と深刻な状況のため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda seeks details of Nigeria's confirmed Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease case confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (Abuja) involves a woman who recently arrived in Nigeria after traveling from Uganda and is in isolation following laboratory confirmation. Uganda's Ministry of Health, through Director General Prof. Charles Olaro, has asked Nigeria to provide detailed travel records and clinical history to guide further investigations and determine if additional contact tracing is needed; Uganda notes the woman's transit through Uganda in early October did not establish she contracted the virus there. Nigerian authorities say exposure remains under investigation, with the traveler having visited the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo for business. Preliminary information suggests she developed symptoms after arriving in Nigeria, while the exposure location is uncertain. Uganda reports no confirmed active Ebola cases, and both countries plan to strengthen screening and public health measures at points of entry and share information.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、ナイジェリアで確認されたエボラ感染症例の詳細情報を要請
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラウイルス病の確定症例が国境を越えた渡航歴を伴って発生しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性からIHR基準に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 確定症例はナイジェリア(対象国リスト外)で発生。感染者はDRC東部への渡航歴があるが、DRCでのエボラ発生を示すものではなく、感染経路調査中のため対象国リストに基づきverified_locationsは空とした。ウガンダは経由地であり活動性症例は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞出現首起伊波拉病例 非洲疫情再擴大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case as Africa's outbreak widens.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, a female patient who arrived in Abuja from Uganda, as Africa's Ebola outbreak widens. The index case traveled by international flight from Uganda, where the outbreak has spread following a May declaration of a large Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. Nigerian Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said the patient was admitted to a private hospital, later laboratory-confirmed for Ebola after several days. The patient is isolated and receiving medical care, with aggressive contact tracing underway; 44 close contacts have been identified to date. This marks an imported Ebola case in Nigeria and underscores regional spread of the outbreak across several African countries.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例を確認、アフリカの流行がさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラアウトブレイクがウガンダを経てナイジェリアへ国際便で拡大し、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大な国際公衆衛生事象である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例とウガンダでの流行拡大だが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の起点として明記されているDRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Una peste con 5.500 años de historia todavía amenaza Mongolia: cómo las marmotas mantienen vivo el riesgo de contagio
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A plague with a 5,500-year history still threatens Mongolia: how marmots keep the risk of contagion alive.
article.articleSummary: An international team led by Ruairidh Macleod (University of Oxford) detected Yersinia pestis DNA in the remains of 18 individuals buried near Lake Baikal, SE Siberia, dating to about 5,500 years ago, linking a plague outbreak to ordinary handling of tarbagan marmots by hunter-gatherers. Marmots served as reservoir hosts; fleas transmitted the bacterium among animals and to humans when people worked with or consumed them. Ancient DNA shows Baikal-area strains lacked the ymt gene, which emerged later (1686–951 BCE) enabling flea-borne spread, suggesting initial transmission via direct contact or alternative vectors. The subterranean marmot nests supported persistence, with Y. pestis surviving over 400 days in nest material. In Mongolia, marmot hunting and consumption (boodog) maintains risk; 2020 linked deaths occurred after eating raw marmot organs, and a more recent adolescent death followed a hunt. Historical outbreaks include 1910–1911 Manchuria (~60,000 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: 5,500年の歴史を持つペストが今もモンゴルを脅かす：旱獺（マーモット）が感染リスクをどう維持しているか
triage.triage_reason: 記事は考古学的研究と歴史的背景を主題とした内容であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の急性イベントを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事は5500年前の考古学的発見とペスト菌の進化史、モンゴルでの旱獺食習慣による散発的リスクを論じる歴史・科学解説記事であり、現時点での発生国（モンゴル）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。中国の内モンゴル自治区・満洲里が発生地域として挙げられているが、記事本文はモンゴル国及びバイカル湖地域（ロシア）に関する内容で、中国国内での現在の発生を示す記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: China e Chile suspendem compra de frango de SC após doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China and Chile suspend purchases of chicken from Santa Catarina after Newcastle disease
article.articleSummary: China and Chile temporarily suspended imports of poultry meat from Santa Catarina, Brazil, after confirmation of Newcastle disease at a commercial turkey farm in the state’s interior. Mexico then restricted Brazilian poultry purchases. The virus identification raised exporter concern, though authorities characterized the case as isolated and containment steps by the Ministry of Agriculture and Livestock (MAPA), CIDASC, and the local secretariat were already in place. Brazil has led global poultry exports for 18 consecutive years. Newcastle vaccination is mandatory for long-cycle poultry (e.g., breeders) in Brazil, while vaccination for broilers is optional, though many firms vaccinate as a precaution. ABPA president Ricardo Santin stated that sanitary actions were transparent and will be communicated to importing countries under established protocols. There is no transmission risk or harm to poultry consumption from the outbreak.”}{

triage.headline_ja: 中国とチリ、ニューカッスル病発生によりサンタカタリーナ州からの鶏肉購入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 家禽のニューカッスル病発生によりブラジル産鶏肉の輸入停止が中国・チリ・メキシコに広がっており、貿易制限という国際的影響が生じているため、経過を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥農場）における動物衛生イベントであり、人への感染リスクや公衆衛生への直接的影響は報告されていない。中国・チリ・メキシコは輸入停止国であり、発生国ではないためverified_locationsから除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 非洲伊波拉疫情持續蔓延　奈及利亞首都出現首例確診病例 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in Africa continues to spread; Nigeria's capital reports its first confirmed case - OwlNews.
article.articleSummary: On 20 October 2026, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease case in Abuja, a woman who flew from Uganda. After lab confirmation, she has been isolated and Nigerian health authorities activated public health measures to prevent further spread. Nigeria, Africa’s most populous country with over 200 million people, previously faced Ebola in 2014 (July–October). Separately, the Democratic Republic of Congo declared an Ebola outbreak on May 15 this year, caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus. There is currently no approved vaccine or specific therapy for this strain. The WHO noted in August that this outbreak is the second-largest on record. Following that, Uganda and Kenya have also reported infections of the same virus type, highlighting ongoing regional transmission and concern.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカでのエボラ出血熱の流行が継続；ナイジェリアの首都で初の確定症例が報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで発生し、ウガンダ・ケニアを経てナイジェリアの首都にまで拡大したことが確認されており、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）が複数該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断した。
triage.notes: 記事はナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアでの感染拡大を主に報じているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。出血熱の発生源であるDRC（コンゴ民主共和国）のみを対象国として記載した。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞出現首起伊波拉病例 非洲疫情再擴大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria reports its first Ebola case as Africa's outbreak expands again.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease (EVD) case as Africa's outbreak expands. A female patient in Abuja, who had traveled by air from Uganda, was diagnosed after several days of illness and is now in isolation and receiving medical care in a private hospital. Nigeria's Health Minister Muhammad Ali Pate said contact tracing is underway, with 44 close contacts identified. The broader outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has spread to several African countries, including Uganda. The case underscores continued cross-border transmission as authorities bolster surveillance, isolation, and contact-tracing measures to contain imported infections.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ症例確認、アフリカでの流行がさらに拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症がDRCを起点に複数国へ越境拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアでの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の発生源であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil Poultry Exporters Face Uneven Trade Curbs After Newcastle Case | EconoTimes
article.articleSummary: Newcastle disease case in Santa Catarina, Brazil, confirmed Oct. 18 at a commercial turkey farm in Nova Itaberaba, prompting culling, disinfection, and monitoring of 133 nearby properties. Mapa said on Oct. 20 it is updating trading partners as control measures proceed. China limits its ban to Santa Catarina, allowing exporters in other states continued access; Mexico suspended specified poultry imports from across Brazil (chicken meat, offal, fertile eggs, and chicks up to three days old) as of Oct. 19. The cost to exporters depends on ban scope and duration. Santander analysts estimate China accounts for about 10% of Brazil’s chicken exports; longer restrictions could push sellers to seek other markets or sell more domestically, pressuring prices and margins. A 2024 Rio Grande do Sul outbreak precedent saw exports fall about 100,000 metric tons (25%), then recover. MBRF Global Foods SA shares slipped >4% on Oct. 19, while JBS fell ~1%.

triage.headline_ja: ニューカッスル病確認後、ブラジルの鶏肉輸出業者が国によって異なる貿易制限に直面
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家禽（七面鳥）におけるニューカッスル病の発生であり、人への健康被害は報告されていない。主な影響は貿易制限と市場への経済的影響であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は家禽（七面鳥）のニューカッスル病発生による貿易制限の影響に関する記事であり、人の健康リスクは言及されていない。中国・メキシコは発生地域ではなく、輸入規制を課した国として言及されているため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Nigeria confirma un caso de ébola en una mujer que llegó de Uganda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria confirms a case of Ebola in a woman who arrived from Uganda.
article.articleSummary: A woman in Abuja, Nigeria, tested positive for Ebola after arriving from Uganda. She developed symptoms on October 7 and was admitted to a private hospital on October 11, where Ebola was confirmed; date of entry into Nigeria remains unclear. Health authorities are tracing 44 contacts. Uganda’s ministry says the patient transited Uganda and is Nigerian, with business travel to eastern Congo; nationality not disclosed. Uganda reports no active cases. TheBundibugyo Ebola outbreak is the most geographically widespread in three African regions, with over 9,500 infections and more than 4,600 deaths globally. Kenya reported its first case earlier this month, with nine infections since. Nigeria’s CDC has intensified surveillance and established a task force focusing on early detection, isolation, laboratory diagnosis, infection prevention and control, contact tracing, risk communication, and health worker protection, amid concerns of imported/exported cases and ongoing spread.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア、ウガンダから入国した女性のエボラ出血熱感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダ由来のエボラ出血熱がナイジェリアに輸入され、ケニアでも感染例が報告されるなど複数国への国際的拡大が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: 本記事の主たる発生国はナイジェリア（輸入症例）およびウガンダ（アウトブレイク発生地）であり、いずれも対象国リストに含まれない。コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）は患者の渡航歴（ビジネス渡航先）として言及されているのみで、感染確認や発生地としての記載はないため verified_locations には含めなかった。ケニアでも感染例が報告されているが対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞首起伊波拉病例！　非洲疫情擴大
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria's first Ebola case! Ebola outbreak expands across Africa.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria confirms its first Ebola virus disease case as of 20 October 2026. The patient is a woman who recently flew from Uganda to Abuja, Nigeria's capital. She sought care at a private hospital, where laboratory testing confirmed Ebola virus infection. She is isolated and receiving medical treatment. Health authorities have launched contact tracing and identified 44 close contacts to date. The outbreak began in May with a large cluster in the Democratic Republic of Congo and has since spread to several African countries, including Uganda. With Nigeria reporting its first case, the outbreak extends into West Africa, highlighting the need for rapid surveillance and thorough contact follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリアで初のエボラ出血熱患者確認！アフリカでの感染拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC発の大規模クラスターからウガンダを経てナイジェリアへ国境を越えて拡大しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本アウトブレイクの発端地として記事内で明示的に言及されているため含めた。国境を越えた拡大が続いており、今後の続報（感染者数・接触者追跡状況・国際対応）の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Morte de menina de 8 anos é investigada como suspeita de meningite no oeste da Bahia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of an eight-year-old girl is being investigated as a suspected case of meningitis in western Bahia.
article.articleSummary: An eight-year-old girl, Angela Sofia Paranaguá de Araújo, died at the Luís Eduardo Magalhães UPA in western Bahia on 2026-10-16 with a suspected bacterial meningitis. An epidemiological investigation is ongoing, awaiting the definitive autopsy report and death certificate. Laboratory analyses have been sent, with results not yet available. Close contacts (classmates, family, healthcare workers) received antibiotic prophylaxis; no isolation was indicated. The case was registered in the Sinan system and notified to state health authorities; Cievs was informed. From January–October 2026, four suspected meningitis cases were recorded in Luís Eduardo Magalhães: two ruled out, one confirmed as Streptococcus pneumoniae infection in the first half of the year, and Angela’s case still under investigation. Contact vaccination status has been checked.

triage.headline_ja: バイーア州西部で8歳少女の死亡、髄膜炎疑いで調査中
triage.triage_reason: 単発の小児死亡例（髄膜炎疑い）であり、接触者への予防投与等の通常の公衆衛生対応がなされている。地域的な散発事例であり、アウトブレイクを示唆する情報はない。
triage.notes: 原因菌（肺炎球菌）は過去の確定例に基づく推測であり、今回の死亡例自体はまだ確定診断が出ていない。地域の年間髄膜炎疑い例数（4件）は特段多いとは言えず、通常の疫学対応がなされている。

article.articleHeadline: United States pledges additional life-saving health assistance in response to Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-21, the United States pledged an additional $267 million in direct life-saving health and humanitarian assistance for the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Total US Ebola-related aid reaches about $887 million, with more than $780 million from the State Department, fulfilling a G7 commitment to add up to $500 million more. In coordination with the CDC and governments of the DRC, Uganda, and others, the response funds 292 metric tons of humanitarian supplies, 8.6 million health screenings, 184,000 pieces of disease-prevention equipment, 23 Ebola treatment centers, and support to 235 health facilities. The package complements $350 million in humanitarian aid to the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan as part of $1.8 billion to UN OCHA announced on May 14, under a five-year global health memorandum of understanding with the DRC and the America First Global Health Strategy; it reiterates a call for burden sharing.

triage.headline_ja: 米国、エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応として追加の救命医療支援を約束
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し米国が大規模な追加支援（2.67億ドル）を表明しており、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的対応の必要性が確認されるためフルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCにおける既知のエボラアウトブレイクへの米国の資金支援発表が主題。ウガンダ・南スーダンへの支援も言及されているが、アウトブレイクの主体はDRCであり、対象国リストにはDRCのみ該当。米国は対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Official data reveal Bundibugyo outbreak growth and uneven outcomes
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda shows 689 confirmed cases and 139 deaths in the DRC across 29 health zones through 11 June 2026, with a crude observed case‑fatality ratio of 20.2% (95% CI 17.2–23.4%). Ituri province accounted for 646 DRC cases (93.8%), CFR 17.6% (CI 14.8–20.8%). Uganda reported 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths by 10 June. Apparent doubling times were 10.5 days (21–27 May) and 10.3 days (4–10 June), with 7.4 days (28 May–3 June), reflecting reported case growth rather than true transmission. Operational constraints included 71.8% contact follow‑up by 10 June and test positivity between 26.6% and 68.5% across four time points. Data derive from DRC situation reports 001–028 (14 May–11 June 2026) and Ugandan figures, intended for near‑real‑time description, not transmission quantification.

triage.headline_ja: 公式データがブンディブギョ・ウイルス病アウトブレイクの拡大と不均一な転帰を明らかに
triage.triage_reason: DRCとウガンダにまたがるブンディブギョ・ウイルス病（エボラ関連ウイルス性出血熱）のアウトブレイクで、致死率20.2%、死者139人に達し、国際的拡大とヒト-ヒト感染の懸念があるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedotの疾患名タグ（Coccidioidomycosis）は誤りで、実際はブンディブギョ・ウイルス病（フィロウイルス科、エボラ関連）のアウトブレイク。ウガンダも発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内でイトゥリ州に集中（646例、93.8%）。接触者追跡率71.8%、検査陽性率26.6-68.5%と対応能力に課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue: confirmaron el primer caso de 2026, importado por una mujer de Rosario que viajó a Perú
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: the first case of 2026 has been confirmed, imported by a woman from Rosario who traveled to Peru.
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Argentina: Santa Fe Province confirms the first dengue case for the 2026/2027 season, an imported infection in a woman resident of the Rosario department who had traveled to Peru before symptom onset. Laboratory tests identified dengue virus serotype DEN-3; the patient recovered uneventfully. Since the start of the year, Santa Fe reported 74 dengue notifications (including dengue in pregnancy), with one confirmed case to date and others pending. The national weekly epidemiological snapshot (week 39, 2026) recorded no new dengue cases, though 999 suspected cases have been notified nationwide since the season began. Of these, four have been confirmed: three in Buenos Aires Province linked to travel to Brazil and Ecuador with DEN-3; one in Buenos Aires City with travel to Peru (serotype not yet determined). Authorities stress ongoing vigilance for acute febrile syndromes and continued surveillance to prevent autochthonous transmission and monitor imported cases.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：2026年最初の症例確認、ペルー渡航歴のあるロサリオ在住女性の輸入例
triage.triage_reason: アルゼンチン国内における輸入症例の通常のサーベイランス報告であり、対象国での発生でもなく、異常性や国際的拡大のリスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 発生国はアルゼンチンで、対象国リストに含まれない。ブラジル・ペルー・エクアドルは患者の渡航歴として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Kenya: Is it under control as nine cases confirmed?
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-20, Kenya reports nine confirmed Ebola cases, its first outbreak, linked to a traveller from DR Congo who died two weeks earlier. The first patient's four relatives, three health workers and a hospital cleaner have tested positive, all linked to him. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is involved; it is relatively rare and has no approved vaccine or treatment, though trials are underway. The development heightens cross-border risk amid DR Congo’s ongoing outbreak (over 9,500 cases and more than 4,000 deaths since May). The US has warned against travel to Kenya; neighbours Uganda, Ethiopia and Somalia are on alert. Kenya has enhanced screening for travelers from 10 high-risk countries, requires digital surveillance forms and QR codes, and has a dedicated Ebola lab at Kenyatta National Hospital. 134 of 135 contacts remain in quarantine (99%); eight patients are improving; hotline 719; and messaging to stop stigma. Collaboration with Africa CDC and WHO.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアのエボラ出血熱：9例確認、制御下にあるか？
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ発生で9例確認、医療従事者への二次感染や近隣国への越境リスクがあり、IHR4基準すべて該当するためフルRRAへ進める。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの初のエボラ発生だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続中のアウトブレイク（9,500例超、4,000人超死亡）を抱えるDRCのみ対象国として計上。US、Ethiopia、Somalia、Uganda、Kenyaは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 江苏2026年秋冬季流感疫苗接种全面启动
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiangsu Fully Launches Influenza Vaccination for the 2026 Autumn-Winter Season
article.articleSummary: Jiangsu Province, China, has fully launched the 2026 autumn-winter influenza vaccination campaign. Under the national policy, rural residents aged 65+ and students in compulsory education receive one free dose of the trivalent influenza vaccine. By Oct 18, Jiangsu had distributed about 1.28 million free doses, including roughly 500,000 for students and 780,000 for elderly residents. Influenza season runs Oct–Mar; after school resumes, respiratory infections rise in kindergartens and schools. Influenza can progress to pneumonia and may be complicated by bacterial infections such as Staphylococcus aureus and Streptococcus pneumoniae; in children, influenza-associated encephalopathy can cause seizures or altered consciousness within 72 hours, and myocarditis or myositis can occur. Priority groups include adults 60+, chronic disease patients, children 6 months–5 years, and residents of care facilities; vaccination sites offer weekend clinics, extended hours, and some venues run “two people together, one free” promotions.

triage.headline_ja: 江蘇省、2026年秋冬季インフルエンザワクチン接種を全面開始
triage.triage_reason: 通常の季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種キャンペーンに関する行政広報であり、異常な感染症流行や公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 内容は季節性インフルエンザワクチン接種の推進に関する通常の公衆衛生広報であり、異常な流行や新規感染症の発生を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Mexico halts Brazil chicken imports after Newcastle disease outbreak
article.articleSummary: Mexico suspended imports of Brazilian chicken meat, live birds, and hatching eggs after a Newcastle disease outbreak in Brazil. The measure, announced by the Secretariat of Agriculture and Rural Development in Mexico City, aims to protect domestic poultry production. Brazilian authorities detected the outbreak on Sunday at a commercial farm in southern Brazil. Newcastle disease is a highly contagious respiratory virus that does not pose a human health threat but can cause neurological disorders, reduced egg production, and higher mortality in chickens. Brazil, which exports about 30% of its poultry products, faces increased scrutiny. This marks the second suspension by Mexico of Brazilian poultry in 18 months. In 2025, Brazil's poultry exports were disrupted by avian influenza, triggering import halts by Mexico, China, the European Union, and other Latin American countries.

triage.headline_ja: メキシコ、ブラジルのニューカッスル病発生を受けて鶏肉輸入を停止
triage.triage_reason: ニューカッスル病は家禽の疾病であり、記事内でも人への健康被害はないと明記されている。人の公衆衛生上のシグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本件は家禽疾病（動物衛生）および貿易上の措置に関する記事であり、人の感染症サーベイランスの観点からは重要度が低い。中国は過去の輸入停止国として言及されているのみで、現在の発生地ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 快訊／伊波拉疫情擴大！奈及利亞驚現「首起病例」
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Breaking News: Ebola outbreak widens! Nigeria reports its first case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak widens as Nigeria reports its first case. A female patient in Abuja has laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus infection after arriving on an international flight from Uganda, where Ebola is circulating amid a regional spread that followed the May declaration of a large outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The patient was treated in a private hospital and is now in isolation. Public health authorities have initiated contact tracing and identified 44 close contacts to date. The case represents Nigeria’s first imported Ebola infection linked to the ongoing regional outbreak in East Africa, prompting continued surveillance and border vigilance to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 速報／エボラ流行拡大！ナイジェリアで「初症例」確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCでの大規模流行からウガンダ経由でナイジェリアへ国際的に拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリアの輸入症例だが、ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・モザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは5月に宣言された大規模流行の発生源として言及されており、対象国として該当するため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: China, Chile e México suspendem compra de frango e ovos após caso de Newcastle em granja de SC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: China, Chile and Mexico suspend purchases of chicken and eggs after a Newcastle disease case on a Santa Catarina farm.
article.articleSummary: China, Chile, and Mexico suspended purchases of chicken and eggs from Santa Catarina after a Newcastle disease outbreak was confirmed at a farm in the state’s interior housing about 6,000 turkeys. The farm is quarantined as authorities intensify surveillance, inspecting roughly 1,600 rural properties and tightening cargo transport monitoring. Next steps include sanitary depopulation of affected birds, proper disposal, and cleaning/disinfection of facilities; blood sampling may be required at more than 130 surrounding properties. Brazil’s federal government declared a 60-day zoosanitary emergency in Nova Itaberaba (the outbreak site), Águas Frias, Coronel Freitas, and Nova Erechim. The Agriculture Ministry says officials are in contact with importers to negotiate a safe restart of trade. Santa Catarina is Brazil’s second-largest poultry producer, responsible for about 14% of national slaughter. Meat from officially inspected products remains safe for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・チリ・メキシコ、サンタカタリーナ州の養鶏場でニューカッスル病発生後に鶏肉・卵の購入を停止
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（鳥類）であり人への直接的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、貿易制限と国際的な影響が生じており経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ニューカッスル病は鳥類感染症でヒトへの感染リスクは極めて低いため、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響には該当しないが、貿易停止という経済的・政治的インパクトがあるため監視対象とする。中国・チリ・メキシコは輸入停止措置を取った側であり、発生国はブラジルのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: Nigeria ghi nhận ca bệnh đầu tiên
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Nigeria records the first case.
article.articleSummary: Nigeria records the first Ebola case in the latest African outbreak. A woman who traveled from Uganda to Abuja was confirmed on 20 October 2026 and is being isolated and treated in a private hospital. Nigerian authorities have started contact tracing, identifying 44 close contacts, with teams continuing to identify and monitor those potentially exposed, including healthcare workers, patients, caregivers, and travelers linked to the patient’s journey. The current Ebola outbreak began in the Democratic Republic of Congo in May and has spread to Uganda and other countries, with Kenya reporting its ninth case on 20 October 2026. As of 20 October 2026, the outbreak has caused 4,381 deaths among more than 9,000 laboratory-confirmed cases. Transmission occurs via direct contact with blood and bodily fluids; early detection, isolation, contact tracing, and strict infection control are critical to limit spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：ナイジェリアで初の症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ複数国に拡大する大規模エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク（死者4,381人、確定症例9,000人超）であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはDRCで発生し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ナイジェリアに拡大しているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: 奈及利亞聯邦首都特區確診伊波拉 當局緊急追蹤44名接觸者 - OwlNews
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory confirms Ebola case; authorities rush to trace 44 contacts
article.articleSummary: One imported Ebola case confirmed in Nigeria's Federal Capital Territory (FCT): a woman who arrived from Uganda on an international flight. Health authorities have traced 44 close contacts, including healthcare workers, other patients, caregivers, and fellow travelers, with a 2–21 day incubation period. The patient is isolated and receiving care at a private hospital in the FCT. Minister of Health Muhammad Ali Pate said the response is coordinated with the FCT Health Services Secretariat and the Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC), which issued a nationwide alert on Oct 6 about travel-linked cross-border risks. Nigeria has previously managed Ebola outbreaks tied to the DRC and Kenya and contained the 2014 Ebola outbreak. The public is urged to practice hand hygiene, avoid contact with blood or body fluids, and report suspected cases to authorities promptly, rather than self-presenting if exposed and symptomatic.

triage.headline_ja: ナイジェリア連邦首都特別区でエボラ出血熱の感染確認、当局が接触者44人を緊急追跡
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの輸入エボラ症例がナイジェリアの首都圏で確認され、44名の接触者追跡が行われており、国際的な越境拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められるためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はナイジェリア（対象国リスト外）での輸入エボラ症例であり、DRCは過去の流行歴として言及されているのみで、今回の発生国ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Tödliche Infektionskrankheit: Jetzt auch in Nigeria - Erster Ebola-Fall bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Deadly Infectious Disease: Now Also in Nigeria — First Ebola Case Confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of 21 October 2026, Nigeria confirms its first Ebola infection, imported by air from Uganda. The patient, a woman, was treated for several days at a private hospital in Abuja; laboratory results identified the Bundibugyo strain. She is in isolation and receiving medical care. Nigerian health authorities, working with the National Centre for Disease Control and regional partners, are tracing contacts, with 44 identified (healthcare workers, other patients, caregivers, and travel contacts). The government urges public and private facilities nationwide to maintain high vigilance. This marks the fourth African country with Bundibugyo Variant cases, after the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) reporting 9,552 cases and 4,602 deaths, Kenya with eight cases (one death), and Uganda with 20 cases and two deaths (Uganda ended its outbreak in late August after 42 days with no new cases).

triage.headline_ja: 致死的感染症：ナイジェリアでも初のエボラ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの輸入例によりナイジェリアで初のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）感染が確認され、DRCでは9,552例・4,602死亡という大規模流行が継続中であり、複数国への拡大が既に起きているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ナイジェリア・ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは本件エボラ流行の中心国として記事中で具体的な数値（9,552例、4,602死亡）が言及されているため含めた。
